Foreword
The following document contains spoilers for the entire Girls Frontline - Reverse Collapse series.

Much of Slow Shock is told from the perspective of unreliable narrators and circumstances which may not necessarily present the entire truth. Consider this when discussing the event’s story and canon as certain events may or may not have been obfuscated by a dying mind whose memories were tweaked by an experiment and the murkiness of the Lake of Cognition. All elements of the past are based on some semblance of the truth, but do not be surprised if specific details of Angelia’s memories prove exaggerated or altered in meaningful ways. In this document, many of the events described by Gray Blackwell and past recordings are likely truthful to an extent, but we cannot discount that sections presented are deliberately deceitful.

Chapter 1 - The Exile from Johns Hopkins (2030-2047)
Shining Star of Johns Hopkins (Early 2040s-2047)

Professor Martha Meitner from the mid 2040s to 2050.

Throughout the history of Girls’ Frontline, many characters have left immense impacts through dominance, intelligence, or coercion. But perhaps none have had a more significant impact on the entire series than Professor Martha Meitner. It wouldn’t be incorrect to say that Martha’s actions are directly responsible for Girls’ Frontline & Reverse Collapse through a butterflying chain of chaotic events. Had any point changed before the 1st of September, 2050, then it’s possible everything we’ve experienced up to this point in the main plot would’ve never come to pass. Even the Commander, a fresh face to Griffin & Kryuger back in 2062, might’ve never joined in the first place. It’s difficult to overstate Meitner’s importance, but that isn’t to say specific events wouldn’t have unfolded. With this in mind, who is this mystery woman-turned-demon? When individuals cross the lines set by their own morality, setting the stage for yet more death in an already-dying world.

Little is written about Martha Meitner’s past before her time as a physics professor at the Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory, the home of her genius and possible birthplace of those created to cast the dawn’s light over the dark shadow of Rossartre’s long night. During her time at Hopkins, Meitner was close friends with Gray Blackwell, a fellow researcher and keen expert of biotechnologies. Enjoying sandwiches together was a common practice between them, and the pair were presumably the best of friends as they rose up in Hopkins over the years. Currently, nothing yet has been revealed about their personal lives, but around the early 2040s, Meitner had her daughter, Sana. Nothing is known about Sana’s father, but Sana’s eye color is a deep bluish-purple, unlike her mother’s dark green eyes. Her father’s identity is unexplored, with only the vaguest hints about Meitner having difficulty coming into her role as a single mother.

Gray Blackwell, Meitner’s closest friend and partner in Johns Hopkins, respected as her senior, viewing her as a shining example of a stubborn, courageous genius with ethics in her heart. As Blackwell put it, whenever she had a passion, she would always go for it to see it through; however, the perfection of such idealistic figures cannot last forever. Eventually becoming a professor at the university, Meitner was one of APL’s physicists and relicologists - her brilliance and upstanding character was recognized by all, including the Relic Agency. Sometime before 2047, Meitner’s superb intelligence and efforts led her to being selected to join the Relic Agency. 

History of the Relic Agency’s Beaconists & Prometheans
Around the time of her selection, there’s specific uncertainty in the Relic Agency’s existence, more specifically, the identity and organization in control of it. As a quick refresher, the United Nations Relic Agency was founded on March 2nd, 1991, as the world’s predominant body on the research and development of Relics and associated technologies. It was founded upon the implicit purposes of halting all further Relic weapon development and the improvement of humanity worldwide through the positive, safe utilization of Relic technology. In the 2020s, the UNRA’s acting chief director was Raeder Albert Rossartre, the “founder” of the principles which later became known as Rossartrism. On the other hand, it’s unclear if there’s a distinction between the UNRA and the Relic Agency Meitner was attached to. Signs point to it being the UNRA, however, it’s worth noting that an inconsistency currently exists.

A New World of Two Futures - 2033-2036
In the Second Confidential Files, the UNRA was expelled from the United States of America by the US Congress just after the UN following the passage of Resolution GA/21135, which reorganized the resettlement of refugees in Europe and overseas.
The US Congress vote authorized the arrest and expulsion of all UNRA staff, effective immediately. The members were sent to JFK International Airport in New York City for their deportations. While waiting, acting Chief Director Sir Thomas Sorrell Huxley signed off the “Project Beacon” plan in hopes of preserving humanity. The Beacon plan called for the conversion of the Antarctic Hollow Relic Site into a populated, sprawling bunker in the case of an inevitable coming World War III. This plan was divergent from the late Rossartre’s own “Project Prometheus” plan that called for the unification of the world under a unified, world-class government over all of mankind. The signing of the Beacon resolution in 2033 permanently severed the UNRA, and the supporters of each plan became known as the “Beaconists” and “Prometheans”, respectively. The Prometheans viewed their Beaconist counterparts as cowards who turned their backs on Rossartre’s original vision, betraying the ideals of which he stood for. Under Sir Huxley’s lead, the UNRA’s focus turned to Antarctica over the next 12 years, and the Prometheans, disgusted by their “cowardice” and “salvation”, went on to form the Project Prometheus Council in the same year (unclear if the Council already existed, but the first mention of the Council comes in 2033).

In 2034, the Beaconists and Prometheans continued their work at the United Nations Relic Agency HQ in Geneva, likely being the UN Palace of Nations. As Project Beacon progressed, the Prometheus Council still conducted its surface level operations in the Relic Agency’s name, despite the factions’ differences. However, the Council recognized the Beaconists’ plan was soon to enter a stage of open secrecy, where the development of the Hollow into a proper city would be underway. Understanding this would spell a clear and obvious rivalry between the two UNRA factions, the Promethean who wrote the associated memorandum recommended they officially sever ties when the time was right. According to the author, Project Beacon entering its main phase would necessitate the Council sever ties, devise a way to build up their own power, hide themselves away, and ensure the perseverance of Rossartre’s vision through the long night. Even then, both factions, regardless of how they viewed their future, understood much of the world was leveled against the Agency. On April 21st, 2035, the day after the Northern Lights Incident, the Prometheans’ humanitarian rescue plan was unanimously approved and set to be executed by “Relic Agency Director ________”. Knowing the Prometheans seemingly wouldn’t operate under Sir Thomas Huxley, the progenitor of their rivalry, and that the name is blacked out would suggest this individual is someone else, possibly the head of the Agency’s Promethean sect.

Finalization of Project Beacon - 2036-2045
On Christmas Day, 2036, Sir Huxley signed and issued the invitations to Project Beacon out to selected military, scientific, and academic personnel. From then on, the UNRA was solely directed towards the development of the Antarctic Base to safeguard human civilization from the rapidly approaching world war. In the event of the war’s outbreak, the base would isolate itself from the outside world, declaring independence from control of any nation. Many of those invited came from plutocratic backgrounds tightly knit to the functions of their respective nations. Project Beacon required vast amounts of capital - the material and financial costs were substantial, and many of those invited had the necessary backgrounds to back the project scientifically and economically. Throughout the late 2030s, construction hastened through increasing support from Beacon’s investing members and their families. With the UNRA putting all its efforts towards the Antarctic Base, the Promethean faction likely split off around this point as mentioned in the aforementioned 2034 Promethean Memorandum. After 2036, the divergence of Prometheus from the URNA is rather murky and insight into the Council’s direction lessened with it. It’s assumed the Prometheans, now with no control over their agency, officially split around this time; however, this is just assumption.

The 2040 flare-up in the United Nations General Assembly was a watershed moment for both UNRA factions, serving as proof of the coming storm knocking on the shores. On January 7th, 2040, Chinese and Soviet representatives to the UN protested recent resolutions, declaring certain European members to be imperialists for their neo-colonial actions in Africa and the 2039 Second Algerian War. With the specter of war looming over Europe, time was running out for Beacon and Prometheus. Recognizing this is a moment of strife in the UN that could very well spell the end of the organization and what remained of world order, the UNRA decided to activate Project Beacon. The activation signal was broadcasted, and over the next four years, everything required for the project was flown en masse to the Antarctic Base, including workers, more construction materials, rations, and seeds from the Svalbard Global Seed Vault. And in December 2041, the UNRA officially shifted their offices from Geneva to Antarctica. 

In 2043, scientists from the UNRA discovered the Reverse Collapse phenomenon, and in 2045, they began attempts to replicate it. However, the lore this information is sourced from does not clarify how it was discovered nor those tied to it, but we know the Antarctic possessed knowledge pertaining to it as RC technology served a primary function of the Antarctic’s self-sufficiency during its Isolation Era (2045-2075). This snippet more likely refers to the Antarcticans given the mention of the UNRA. Soil, rocks, seawater, and sewage, all things common in the Antarctic “Hollow City”, could be Reverse-Collapsed into usable raw materials. Even then, mastery of this technology had not been achieved by the end of the Isolation Era; however, in their years of isolation, the Antarcticans thrived thanks to the “rotary” economic system and the reactivation of the Reverse Collapse reactor in the city’s center. To quote Sir Huxley’s colleague, Charles, “Sir, once we grasp the Relic technology of the Hollow, there will be nothing to worry about” (December 2041, UNRA Geneva HQ). While in the UNRA (now the Antarctic Relic Agency, ARA) in June 2043, Sir Huxley also added that the possibilities in the Relics may be the answer to overcome Rossartre’s predictions, possibly avoiding the long night and destruction of humanity altogether.

On March 2nd/April 15th, 2045, World War III began with erroneous nuclear exchange between the USA and the NUSSR. The nightmare that haunted Rossartre had emerged on the world stage. In their final communication with the outside world in 2045, the Antarctic Base reported a population of 9.6 million as of New Year’s Day that year - 1.2 million were wealthy plutocrats and aristocrats alike, 2 million were security and ARG personnel, and 6.4 million general workers for the city. Soon after WWIII began, the ARG declared independence and initiated the final step of Project Beacon. Constructed over the past several years, the barrier doors - massive barriers blocking out Collapse Particles and ocean currents - were sealed. The plan signed off by Sir Thomas Sorell Huxley, FRS, had been completed, but he would not live to see his dream carried through to the end. Sometime just before or after the Isolation Era’s beginning, Sir Huxley was supposedly murdered by privileged foreign immigrants attempting to take control of the ARA. Ultimately, those who knew of Project Beacon and the UNRA were left in limbo on the fates of the new Antarcticans when the doors shut; though, what became of them mattered little to those living under the Third World War. From the shores of Guangxi to the streets of Paris, blood was shed as the flame of mankind flickered away into nothing but a dying ember, an ember the Prometheans needed to defend at any cost. Like the phoenix, mankind could have a second chance at redemption in the post-war era.

ELID, Immunes, and the “Photon Project” - 2030-203X
During ELID infection, Collapse Radiation induces mutation in the patient’s mitotic cells, triggering a genetic mutation of the subject’s body, wherein freshly mutated cells will continue mitosis, producing new cell organelles that emit Collapse Radiation on the same wavelength. Infection is generally divided into α- and β-time, which includes the early, middle, and late stages of ELID. After α-time, the patient’s immune system will no longer be able to suppress the mutated cells, as the pace of mitosis of those cells outpaces the system’s function. β-time refers to the general amount of mutated cells in a patient’s body until they qualify as an ELID Infected. Upon classification as an Infected, they’ve reached a point of no return, doomed to either expire from the ongoing mutations or live as mindless husks of their former selves. 

In the early stage, an electroencephalography (EEG) reveals atypical behavior in the subject's brainwaves: "ɑ brainwaves appear as erratic; high-amplitude β waves in certain areas of the brain; and a significant increase in θ wave activity." During the middle stage of ELID, the loss of conscious senses begin, causing patients to become more sporadic, aggressive, and experience auditory and visual hallucinations, only driving them even further. This state of “aggravated bliss”, so to speak, is best represented by Ramzan's mutation during the WWIII 2051 section of Slow Shock.

As Ramzan's body was mutating, his sanity went with it in the later stages; however, at this point of infection, the subject isn't a mindless zombie - they still hold a sense of conscious rationality, along with the basic functions of the nervous system. By this point, the subject is seemingly beyond medical help but is not yet feral. At the same time, the brainwaves of the subject are revealed as: "ɑ waves reduce in frequency until they disappear altogether, while there is a dramatic increase in β wave activity as well as bursts of high-amplitude θ waves that can be found periodically across the entire brain." With the changing of brain wave activity, the subject's brain begins altering biochemically. The increase of beta and theta activity suggests the brain is automatically-active, if you will. The loss of sense seems to drive aggression and confusion, causing the brain to work harder to understand what's happening, leading to increased beta wave frequency; meanwhile temporary high amplitude theta waves would suggest the brain is not just working harder but also entering a state of mindless repetition. If brain wave activity were to ever reach zero frequency, then you'd just be brain dead (I am in no way a neurologist, so take MICA and my own conclusions with a scientific grain of salt). In Ramzan's case, he was pushing that final boundary of conscious-self and succumbing to the illusions of ELID on the mind, where he used the last of his strength to protect Anna from the ELID monsters and bullets.

And in the final stage of ELID, a subject that survived up to this point can be declared as "gone", only responding aggressively to outside stimuli. Brainwave activity at this point seemingly has no reference, making it difficult to tell the brain state of these feral ELID-infected. By that point, the silicification of the subject's body has seriously altered their elemental makeup - carbon decreases from 18% to 13% and silicon increases from <0.1% to 5.1%. Another note is that, from Reverse Collapse, it's noted that the alterations caused by the mutation and recombination of a subject's genome leads to the differences between ELID Infected. Additionally, the rise of silicification of flora and fauna may point to the idea that silicon ecosystems are a byproduct, or the main function, of Collapse Radiation. As more particles are emitted from sources to a subject, their body will gradually mutate into a being that can exist in these relatively contaminated environments (Black Zones are seemingly uninhabitable, even to ELIDs). Many patients will not survive the process, but those that do become these feral beasts we see throughout the games and lore; however, there have been several cases of partially or fully immune individuals.

The first recorded instance of an immune subject was 16-year-old high school student, Kawasaki Kazusa, a former resident of Nagoya before the Beilan Incident. In the immediate fallout, Kazusa was knocked out cold after being directly exposed to Collapse Radiation, but when she awoke, she had maintained all motor functions and senses. Later designated as the “Delta III”, Kazusa was discovered by a Japanese Ground Self Defense Force recon group and UNRA stragglers in-country after rumors spread of such an oddity. Believing she was some sort of “holy maiden” or “divine judgment” from the heavens, many obsessed Kansai survivors wished to capture her, but not before Rossartre and local JGSDF forces were able to secure her in Camp Mishuku in Setagaya. After requesting aid from the Russian Navy through Mikhail Semenovich Tsvigun, an escape route was opened in the Sea of Japan to Vladivostok. The plan called for Rossartre to escort her to Niigata to find a boat that would allow them to link up with the Alexander III nuclear submarine. Unfortunately, Kazusa received a lethal wound from a stray bullet in their escape, and by the time they reached the coast, she was dead.

Honoring her sacrifice, Rossartre brought Kazusa’s body onto a fishing boat in Niigata, and after passing Sado Island, the Alexander III detected the boat. Upon returning to Russia, Kazusa’s body was designated “Delta III” and sent in for an immediate autopsy, which confirmed that she was, in fact, the first confirmed instance of an individual immune from the effects of Collapse Radiation; however, further analysis showed signs of autoimmune disease and weakness in pure regions. It was concluded that, even if she had survived the escape, Kazusa more than likely would’ve expired from acute autoimmune disease and organ wastage in the Green/White Zones. It’s for this reason some concluded that immunes could not serve as an entry point of ELID and Collapse Radiation resistance. While hope for a vaccine died with her, the mere fact of her existence proved that a miniscule percentage of the population could potentially mutate into creatures adapted to Collapse Radiation-contaminated environments. 

Although the respective information comes from the same chapter of Confidential Files 2 as Rossartre’s Beilan Island Investigation Report, it’s unclear who exactly the author of the ELID and Immune study files are. Whether it be Rossartre’s own notes between 2030 and January 2033, or project files written by UNRA staff, it’s unlikely we’ll ever know for sure. In the same excerpt, the last paragraph states that the core function of Collapse Radiation immunity relates to a natural antibody that targets mutated cells. The presence of this antibody slows mutant cell mitosis and spread of organelle-based radiation to a point where the immune system can exterminate the infection before reaching β-time. As for the author(s) of this section, their conclusion was possibly tested in the Beacon “Photon Project” in 2035.

The outbreak of the Northern Lights Incident brought a second reckoning no worse than Beilan to the European continent. As a result of sensitive research in Collapse Fluid compression conducted by the Scandinavian military-industrial sector, much of northern Scandinavia was turned barren by the emergence of the Red Zone, and the belt of Yellow Zone radiation stretched southward, all the way to the Adriatic. The event severed the European mainland right down the center, subjecting millions to ELID. In the immediate aftermath of the incident, mass evacuations of refugees and treatment programs were put in place - one of these was the alleged “Photon Project”, which was originally thought to have been carried out by the US military’s Biological Research Institute (note: this may be referring to the US Army Medical Research Institute of Infectious Diseases - USAMRIID). According to intelligence analysis from a URNC investigation into Antarctic directed-gene technologies, the author states the responsible party was actually a group of UNRA Beacon medical scholars.

The “Photon Project” was an operation conducted by a group of radical Beacon medical scholars in the aftermath of the Northern Lights Incident, which was seemingly played close to the vest. According to the findings in the “Investigation Report on gene cultivation technology of the Antarctic Union”, seemingly published by a URNC official, these UNRA Beacon scholars were attached to an inhumane genetic medical experiment on ELID patients - experiments that included: collection of genetic information, the testing of immunity levels, and observing if genetically-adjusted human samples would inhibit Collapse Radiation mutant cells. Although it’s unclear where Kazusa’s body was sent for the autopsy and subsequent procedures, her very existence was proof that immunity was possible, so perhaps she was the catalyst for the Photon Project. Who’s to say those who performed her autopsy were not the very same UNRA medical scholars involved in the 2035 project? Of course, the source of the findings came from within the URNC, so there’s a nonzero chance it’s false propaganda; though, the Antarcticans have previously involved genetic experiments in their Physics and Relic departments. Due to its radical and unethical nature, it seems blame was effectively shifted away from the researchers and towards the International Red Cross and USAMRIID, assuming USAMRIID is the mentioned US military Biological Research Institute. Based on what little information exists, the overall directive of the project seems to have been the study of the extents and potential ELID immunity, wherein several tests included the introduction of genetically augmented organs into ELID patients. 

Knowing that it likely was these Beaconist scholars behind the project, it paints an ugly picture of the Agency’s practices after 2035. Now, this isn’t to say this project was officially sanctioned by Sir Thomas Huxley or the other UNRA higher-ups - if anything, the confidential nature may have involved a separate faction. Assuming this is the case, they could’ve pushed for an alternative, more controversial, approach towards treating ELID, either for the world or to preserve the Hollow City’s future. Whether or not these medical scholars were a separate faction or officially sanctioned by the Beaconists, the methods and objective are very much in line with Paradeus’ modus operandi. Keep this similarity in mind for later, as it’s possible a link exists between the former project and the rise of Paradeus. A primary goal of “William” has been the discovery or creation of an immune individual, but his rise to power in Paradeus came much later than 2051. When Rossartre and Kazusa’s body were recovered in the Sea of Japan, Rossartre was able to return to London safely after debriefing with Mikhail Tsvigun and Viktor Zelinsky, but the whereabouts of Kazusa’s body were unknown after arriving in Vladivostok. With the Russian Far East in the Neo-Soviets’ grip at the time, it’s possible the Bolsheviks secured the body after the Alexander III made it to port. 

The report on Kazusa’s later autopsy confirms the body ended up in someone’s hands, but the report’s authors are not credited. Given the file from CF2 comes from Chapter 1, it’s entirely possible - and sensible - her body was sent to the UNRA for study, in hopes of discovering potential vaccine development. If so, perhaps the autopsy was the turning point of UNRA research, with “Delta III” confirming immunity was possible. Five years later, in the fallout of Northern Lights, those attached to the Photon Project were responsible for a number of unethical experiments to test for potential immunity. By 2064, the existence of the partial-immune after Beilan seems to be common - or, at least, known by some - knowledge among relicologists and related fields. Assuming Kazusa’s body was transferred from the Bolsheviks to the UNRA, and that the autopsy was performed by the agency, then it’s certainly possible those who’d later led Photon were inspired by Delta III’s discovery. Even if Kazusa was deemed to be of no further value, proof of immune resistance was verified, indicating a small, yet very real, group of immunes could exist. And with the advent of the Scandinavian disaster, a chance for thorough study presented itself. The Photon Project’s results will likely remain a mystery until the release of Reverse Collapse or future lore materials.

Groundwork of Project Prometheus - 2033-2045
Knowing the war’s inevitability, the Prometheus Council, split from the UNRA, laid out the groundwork of their desired future. To achieve their goals, they required the most brilliant minds sympathetic to Rossartre. From Beilan Island to the post-war era, the Prometheus Council has selectively chosen its affiliates to further Rossartre’s vision in the new world order. After the Beilan Incident, the Council backed the newly-installed Neo-Soviet government’s efforts to restore parts of the Trans-Siberian Railway and abandoned facilities in the massive Eurasian Yellow Zones. Known today as the “Siberian Lifeline Project”, this program aimed to increase the industrial output and restore the major railways. Former Neo-Soviet Army Electronic Warfare Corpsman, Havier Witkin of the 766th Production and Technical Equipment Administration, won the government bid for the creation of a humanoid industrial robot capable of Yellow Zone operation for reconstruction efforts. Realizing the immense potential of Dolls for the world’s future, the Council held a particular interest in Witkin, who’d already been recommended to them by an ally of the Council, Lieutenant General Mikhail “Old Misha” Semenovich Tsvigun. Through veiled arrangements with the Soviet International Service for Military-Technical Cooperation, Witkin was sent to Ukraine to found the Important Operations Prototype company. From 2036 onwards, IOP faced a string of success in its ALR-52P Dolls, many of which were sold to Central and Eastern European countries in the Yellow Zones.

Around 2040 or later, the Council met again, and this meeting was believed to be the final meeting, where all members were present, before WWIII began. IOP and Witkin were lauded for their overwhelming achievements in the past few years. The reconstruction projects with Dolls were proving their worth with little resistance, but it’s uncertain if the Council were simply guiding Witkin in the right direction or if he was actually a fellow councilor. Regardless, the Council’s support of Doll technology grew, and the speaking councilor even added that they believe that the use of Dolls would serve as the foundation of the new world, proving that change was possible. By the end of the war, the destroyed wastes required strenuous aid and reconstruction, leading the Council to draft a plan to push for the implementation of Dolls in society, hoping to benefit their wish towards a restored new world. Even when faced with the potential of a world war, humanity's flame couldn’t be extinguished, so difficult choices were made to ensure the flame’s sanctity. If war was unavoidable, then the Council should be “obliged to guide the way in which it unfolds.” 

The speaking Councilor’s proposal was to send weaponizable technology to Eastern Europe, hoping to plant the seeds of their guidance. The war required a victor, and the Neo-Soviets had already proven their willingness to gatekeep Relic technologies from misuse. To the Council, the Russian people in 2030-2032 did not abandon dignity in face of stagnation nor did they succumb to the same cowardice that befell their Beaconist counterparts. Although their beliefs may not have been in line, the people and Prometheans shared common values that prioritized perseverance over abscondment. Later, the topic of North America once again arose, and although details are sparing for their plans, the Councilor mentioned the Council’s efforts in North America were soon to enter the public phase. Sowing the seeds of Rossartrism in the New World was necessary, but due to North America’s influence (more specifically, likely the USA) and power, the Council had to focus on neutralizing its current order to allow the embers to be lit. Understanding this, the introduction and coercion of Rossartrist ideals, or “Rossartrism”, in the younger generations could be the push they needed to further their agenda. Such an undertaking would no doubt come at the cost of many lives, but through sacrifice, the tide of Rossartrism would sweep North America and, later, the world. The Council understood the immense, bloody cost of this and prayed for the lives of those willing to give themselves to the cause.

The US Relics Agency and Meitner - 204X-2047


Because of her future projects, it’s believed the respected and renowned Professor Martha Meitner was selected to join the “Relic Agency” (遗迹署) just before or after World War III. The summarized exploration of the UNRA after Rossartre’s death provides insight into the internal politics of the agency and raises a conflicting question about Meitner’s position. The Relic Agency Meitner was recruited into only has two distinct, possible identities - the Prometheus Faction, which had split from the UNRA sometime in the late 2030s; and a separate Relic Agency under the American government, similar in role to the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA), assuming they’re not one and the same.

In the years leading up the war, the Beaconists were the Relic Agency and all the agency’s efforts were directed as such. The Beaconist Faction was fully committed to their goal, and there was no reason for them to have an overseas presence after 2041, much less in the USA, the country that expelled them from its lands in 2033. And by 2045, Project Beacon was completed after the Hollow City entered its Isolation Era as WWIII began. Furthermore, Meitner served as an agency member until 2047, the year of her expulsion and exilium. Knowing this, it’s impossible for the Beaconists to be the representatives of this agency, but their former colleagues, the Prometheans, may be the responsible party. After branching off from the UNRA, spare information exists on the whereabouts and identities of the Prometheus Council; however, they still met in several meetings before the war’s eruption. One particular councilor proposed sending weaponizable technologies to Eastern Europe and recommended planning the next step in neutralizing North America, a major stepping stone in their plans for the new world. Like the Beaconists, they too were victims of the 2033 US Congressional expulsion, being forever cast out of the US. The Americans posed a significant challenge to their plans, and the only way to ensure the lighting of embers in the New World was the dissemination of Rossartrism through the American people, hoping they could carry Rossartre’s torch towards a brighter future. Although never directly said, it’s probable this social movement, combined with internal opposition and apathy towards the war, culminated in the 2nd American Civil War at the end of WWIII. Many in the former UNRA were Americans as well, some of whom would’ve certainly ended up supporting the Promethean Faction. So, it’s not out of the realm of possibility that some of Prometheus’ followers and councilors would have connections to a supposed United States Relic Agency. The caveat to this is that the current American government would’ve surely rejected the inclusion of Rossartre’s ideology in their country, so any attempts to undermine its authority would surely face rejection. However, this doesn’t satisfy the inherent problem in the existence of Meitner’s respective agency.

A third possibility is that this Relic Agency isn’t the Promethean Faction but a separate entity under the US government or the Pentagon. Established in 1958 with support from then-President Dwight D. Eisenhower, the Advanced Research Project Agency - later DARPA - (and “Big Sieve”) were the crux of American Relic research during the Cold War. All Relic sites, as well as the study and reverse-engineering of relics, under American control were managed by ARPA. Both ARPA and Lockheed-Martin’s Skunk Works division played key roles in the research and development of specialized Relic weapons and crafts based on reverse-engineered technologies. While the Cold War may have ended with the Geneva Gazette in 1983, DARPA (ARPA before 1972) continued on as a crucial entity for the US government and military’s sea, air, and land dominance. Little has been written on DARPA’s role post-Cold War, so we can’t say for sure if the “United States Relic Agency” is DARPA or a different agency altogether. ARPA was founded on the basis of ensuring American leadership in military technology, especially relating to Relics and associated technologies. Many crafts and avionic systems were derived from Relic research, including the SR-71, F-117, F-22, next generation air dominance programs, and the “Aurora” bombers. Although purely theoretical, it’s feasible the “US Relics Agency” - abbreviated as USRA, for brevity - that Meitner was inducted into could’ve been DARPA, and I personally believe this to be the case.

It’s worth noting that, in-game, the story uses the same words (遗迹署) to refer to the Relic Agency/Agencies; however, with such impactful narrative contradictions, it’s far more likely they’re separate entities. In reality, several branches of the American Department of Defense (DoD) hold cohesive contracts and collaborations with Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (JHU APL) for the advancement of national security through scientific and technical breakthroughs. In recent years, DARPA has provided grants and collaborated with APL towards a number of projects, including bionic prosthetics, material research for resilient orbital systems, stealth munition and delivery systems, several navigational and positioning technologies, and much more. With such defense projects, it comes as no surprise that Meitner, one of APL’s most outstanding professors, was chosen to enter the USRA, which may be DARPA itself. DARPA is structured into six primary technical offices for specific R&D areas and additional offices for specialized projects and the transition of DARPA-funded technologies into the DoD’s various branches. Due to the nature of such national defense projects, DoD Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information/Special Access Program (TS/SCI/SAP) security clearances are required, ensuring total compartmentalization and confidentiality.

WWIII & Project NGAD - 2047?
Although the exact date of her entry remains uncertain, Meitner joined the USRA (note - all future references to the “USRA” could be DARPA itself or one of its technical offices), seemingly along with Gray Blackwell. Blackwell’s position during that time is unanswered, leaving readers questioning if she also joined the USRA from APL or if she was already a member. Regardless, it’s known the friends were both involved in the USRA’s “Holy Grail” Project, also known as the Human Connectome Project. This project eventually led to Meitner’s expulsion from the USRA in 2047, but over the years leading to it, she contributed to Project NGAD, seemingly one of USRA’s key WWIII projects for the DoD. The following section assumes the Second Confidential Files and related lore have remained mostly unchanged.

Dolls in Warfare - 2047
After the US made landfall in Europe spring 2047, the NATO alliance in western Europe was able to push the advancing Soviet front back into Germany. As spring turned to summer, the Americans saw a surge of additional forces, and the retreat of Soviet forces back across German borders led NATO Command in Brussels to draft a proper counterattack plan. With numerical and technological advantage back then, the circumstances leaned heavily in the West’s favor at the time. In August, Soviet aerial reconnaissance realized the US military was preparing an offensive towards the Bremen-Hanover line, hoping to open the front in northern Germany. At the same time, EU army forces in Frankfurt and Nuremberg were moving to break through the Soviet line in the south, near the Nordhausen-Harz Mountains in Thuringia. On August 5th, the offensive began, and American forces successfully forced their way through the northern front; however, the advance was stalled between Hanover and Stendal due to intense enemy artillery, restricting their ability to pincer Soviet forces on the southern front. In a matter of weeks, the northern front changed dramatically, and NATO Command hoped to break through the Elbe River east of Stendal and march towards Berlin, cutting off the Soviet Army cluster in the south. And on August 21st, 2047, the American offensive against Berlin began.

By August 26th, the Americans shattered the Elbe defensive line and stormed towards Berlin from the west. Around the same time, the Soviet cluster in the south was intercepted by US forces, preventing them from retreating to defend the heart of East Germany. With the Americans encircling the south and pushing into Potsdam, it was impossible for both the Soviets and their Pan-European Military allies to raise an effective defense to the American divisions. With the defense of the Oder River at all costs, many of the southern Soviet cluster retreated through the small gap in East Germany towards Dresden, where they would mount their defenses along the Oder. By August 31st, the Americans were surrounding the Berlin fortress city from the west in Brandenburg and the south from the town of Luckau. In the south, the US division planned to ride up Highway 87 up to Frankfurt an der Oder and Seelow, cutting off the city from three sides. As if it were fate, it seemed the battlefields of the Battle of Seelow Heights would see yet more bloodshed 102 years later. From the Rhine to the Oder, the situation seemed grim for Warsaw Pact forces, and if Berlin and Szczecin fell, the gate to Eastern Europe would be open for NATO.

On September 1st, the Americans took Lübben along Highway 87 and prepared to push towards Schwielochsee. At the time, US forces in the area reported consistent rocket and sniper attacks in the forests but failed to find the source and location of their enemies. On the 3rd, vehicles moved north on Highway 87 but were destroyed by anti-tank rocket attacks. In retaliation, mechanized infantry were sent north, where they discovered the truth behind the string of guerilla attacks on their positions. Their attackers were neither Soviet or Pan-European infantry, but rather, Doll robots retrofitted for warfare, later referred to as “Tactical Dolls”.

After the Americans made landfall in 2047, the Soviet Ministry of Defence came to the conclusion that the threat was far too great, and a plan for the deployment of militarized Dolls entered the forefront of the MoD. With NATO’s immense success in the spring, the Soviet Wartime Defence Council ordered Ukraine’s Important Operations Prototype and Romania’s Sangvis Ferri to immediately start production of militarized Dolls. IOP had little experience with combat Dolls, while Sangvis Ferri had some experience thanks to the Ukrainian Civil War several years prior. IOP based its design on the CSD skeletal frame, and they chose a more broad approach towards weapons handling. They were built to use a variety of common human weapons, never falling into a specific niche. Meanwhile, Sangvis Ferri chose a more specialized direction; their Dolls were purpose-built for their niche. With innovations from their initial “Ripper” designs, the SF “Vespid” and “Jaeger” units were created. In June, both companies submitted the proposals to the MoD for approval, where both passed and immediately ordered to begin production for field testing. However, due to the rapid advance of American forces into East Germany, the war could not wait for a field test. In late August, as US forces closed in around the Berlin fortress city, the MoD forced the deployment of 8000 IOP and SF Dolls to the region, thus beginning one of the most important battles of the war and watershed moment in Doll technology.

The American offensive towards the Oder marked the first time ever in human history “Tactical Dolls” fought against proper, unified enemies. Throughout the next three weeks, American and Soviet forces, including their T-Dolls at the front, successfully held Berlin. By the end of the offensive in mid-September, the US military on the western front and the European Union Army on the southern could no longer effectively advance, bringing the defense of Berlin to its conclusion. However, the fighting in Germany was far from over. The usefulness of Tactical Dolls was instantly recognized by both sides, beginning a period of frenzied competition in the arms industry.

Project NGAD
During the war, many secretive projects were undertaken to explore the possibilities of the next greatest tool in the war, something that could shift the balance of powers entirely to their side. Doll technology was one of these main fields. The introduction of Dolls to the battlefield completely shifted the order of the war, and all nations needed the technical edge on this new technology to bolster their projection. While theoretical, the time frame matches up for a scenario in which NATO forces recovered Soviet T-Dolls for study. Newer technologies of any adversary will always be secured in order to learn the respective functions, make-up, and weaknesses. With such a meat grinder in East Germany, it’s no doubt the Americans could capture some Dolls and transport them back to the homeland or NATO allies. Soon, a problem arose However, as a result of the war, instability and geopolitical reshuffling meant much documentation on these “black projects” was lost to the chaos.

In the United States, Project “NGAD” was a crucial project with the intention of developing the “Next Generation Autonomous Doll” (NGAD) for combat operations. Despite apparent previous successes, the Americans were quickly faced with a bottlenecking of performance, and the always-escalating conflict gave them no leeway for the proper technologies to catch up. After the military intervened in the development, the Dolls of Project NGAD underwent an experiment to discover the limits of Doll performance. To achieve such a goal, the Daybreak Research team required the most knowledgeable individuals to aid in their efforts. 

Because of the project’s confidential national defense nature, Project NGAD likely fell under DARPA or the US Army Combat Capabilities Development Command (CCDC-DEVCOM). A subordinate of the US Army Futures Command (AFC), DEVCOM is the US Army’s leading science and technology arm that stands at the forefront of science, striving to shape the Army of tomorrow. DEVCOM consists of seven centers, including the US Army Advanced Research Laboratory (DEVCOM ARL), a foundational laboratory for the advancement of the US Army through near-, mid-, and far- term technology. ARL exists to meet the present and future requirements of the Army to maintain dominance over near-peer adversaries. If DEVCOM ARL were the minds behind Daybreak, then Project NGAD probably fell under the ARL’s primary Army Research Directorate. Notably, the distinctive unit insignia of DEVCOM displays the Sun rising, which might be coincidental but worthy mentioning nonetheless.


Distinctive unit insignia of CCDC-DEVCOM

Of course, there’s an third, alternative possibility for Daybreak’s creators: 42Lab, a research institute formerly headquartered in Maryland, USA during WWIII. 

The instability caused by the 2nd American Civil War was likely the primary reason for the institute’s relocation to Eastern Europe after 2051. In the years since, 42Lab specializes in four main scientific disciplines: bionic autonomous Doll body, AI and neural cloud, quantum communications, and quantum computing. A mainshare of 42Lab’s R&D pertains to Dolls and associated technologies, and knowing the institute was formerly based in Maryland, there’s precedence towards the idea the institute was part of the DoD’s research arm into Dolls during WWIII. The heart and functions of the American government and military can be found in Maryland, and this includes DEVCOM ARL and 42Lab (DARPA HQ is located just across the Potomac in Alexandria, Virginia). With all this in mind, the three most likely candidates responsible for the creation of the Daybreak Squadron are USRA (possibly DARPA), DEVCOM ARL, or 42Lab.

The Daybreak Squadron & The Dog Tag System

Private First Class Amaris and Sergeant Aliana crossing paths on the streets of Berlin.

While in the USRA, Professor Meitner was brought in as a contributor to Project NGAD, assisting in the development of the Dolls to ensure peak performance. Given her expulsion from the USRA before the end of 2047, the timeframe for Daybreak’s creation falls between August to December 2047, assuming the background lore remains unchanged. Very few details are known about Daybreak’s creation, but Meitner was one of the researchers greatest contributors, so much so that they gave her the honor of naming the first Doll. This first Doll’s parameters were considered “outstanding”, surely being able to meet the hopes they attached to her. As a ray of daylight that illuminates the night, like the sun shining through on Rossartre’s long night, Meitner named her “Aliana” daughter of the sun and return gift from the gods. Perhaps she may be the gift they needed to bring everything to a close.

Being the crowning achievement and leader of Daybreak, she was the most valued, thus being chosen to inherit the “dog tags”. Seemingly designed by Meitner, the Dog Tag System served two primary uses - the first, it prevents neural cloud data from falling into enemy hands, and the second, is a carrier jury-rigged with neural cloud technology to carry on Daybreak’s “legacy”. This system is split into two parts between Sergeant Aliana and Private First Class “Amaris”, the youngest of Daybreak. Aliana possesses the “Dog Tag”, while Amaris has the “Door”, with both serving to carry the Daybreak’s legacy into the future. Aliana absorbs her squadmates’ “Dog Tags” to improve her combat capabilities, and if the situation was dire enough to call for it, the “Dog Tag” procedure would be executed in Aliana, driving her to eliminate her squadmates to enhance her performance. Of course, this would come at the cost of Daybreak’s lives. As long as she lived on, they would live on in a sense through her; however, this was a vital, secret measure only to be used in the necessary conditions. Notably, this same design of gaining power through the absorption of others would later be used in the Evangel Axis-Lake of Cognition system designed during the Holy Grail Project.


The “Moon” of Amaris’ “Door” in the Dog Tag System.

The 9th and last Doll of Daybreak to leave the laboratory was Amaris, daughter of the moon and a gift from the gods, who presumably was created by Meitner as well. Amaris was built with a secret, sacred duty - to serve as the “fatal flaw” against Aliana. Unfortunately for the Daybreak Squad researchers, they failed to take into account the individual elements of Dolls into consideration, and this was the likely reason for Amaris’ half of the overalls system. For her mission as the daughter of the moon, Amaris was given the “Door” by her creators, which stores the Daybreak Squadron’s redundant data behind a figurative door inside her neural cloud. All things generally considered “useless”, such as accumulated emotions and redundant memory data were given to Amaris and locked away. Because of this design, the Daybreak members that exist in Amaris’ neural cloud are nothing more than "memories”. Anything generally considered useless, emotionally taxing, or redundant memory data is preserved behind Amaris’ Door. They exist as memory data, but their consciousnesses are seemingly already gone. In a way, they're ghosts in her mind based on the consciousnesses of her former squadmates. Her creators explained that Aliana’s end would be Amaris’ beginning and then gave her the key to the door, which they declared should not be used lightly. Finally, they ordered her to lock away that memory, only to be made available if the circumstances called for it. Both sides of the overall system were kept a secret between the Dolls as a breach in secrecy could jeopardize either’s mission. 


Amaris’ “Door” is unlocked against Aliana’s “Dog Tag”.

In October 2064, during the fight in the old Galatea Building, Amaris recalled this memory after pulling Aliana into her neural cloud. When Amaris opened the door, a torrential flow of data emitted from it, consuming the neural space around the two sisters. The vast torrent of data forcibly tore apart and coalesced the data of the Daybreak Squad, and finally, Aliana. This data stream gradually released all the stored redundant data of the others, and even absorbed part of Aliana's, taking back the dog tags of their former squadmates. All the thoughts and emotions flowed outward, and the full emotional brunt became too much to handle, causing Aliana to surrender. After Aliana surrendered, all this data finally reached its outlet in Amaris’ neural cloud, and all her teammates said their final goodbyes as the redundant data was removed and absorbed by the data stream.

Following the end of their production, the Daybreak Squadron was assigned under the Army Special Warfare Command (USASWC, 陆军特种作战指挥部), which might be a MICA mistranslation of the Army Special Operations Command (USASOC, 陆军特种作战司令部). Ultimately, the variance does not matter, but if it was deliberate, then it confirms a shift in the USASOC organization; however, name changes are far from abnormal. In reality, USASOC is a branch of the United States Special Operations Command (USSOCOM) that commands and controls the US Army’s special forces from Fort Bragg, North Carolina. With the conclusion of Project NGAD, nine Dolls were successfully produced: Sergeant Aliana, the first and leader of Daybreak; Private First Class Amaris, the last; Laura; Olivia; Nicole; Samantha; Callisto; Morea; and Eula, a Doll who SCR shares an appearance with. Apart from obvious game reasons, the appearance of the nine Dolls may’ve benefited their missions, particularly their deployments in Germany during the late war, infiltrating deep within Warsaw Pact lines. In USASOC, Daybreak Squadron was assigned to the 75th Ranger Regiment, one of the Army’s premier fighting forces - direct-action operations, where agility and flexibility are often keys to success, are their forte. Specialized in these operations, they’re a primary choice in raiding important strategic facilities and capturing, or eliminating, special targets. Few files remain about Daybreak, none of which should be on the public record, and after Operation Couatl in 2051, all memory of Daybreak died with them.

Nirvana & The Holy Grail Project - 204X-2047
In the early to mid 2040s, one of the Relic Agency’s (presumably USRA) research areas was study of “Nirvana” (formerly “Zion”), the Relic Civilization’s network between its facilities. Nirvana’s potential and outlandish nature cannot be overstated; there’s even cause to believe this “network” is a sphere of consciousness existing outside our space-time. Described by Dandelion as another world, it is a cold, empty, white infinity stretching in all directions. An incorporeal nothingness, yet full of disembodied voices. Although its structure is undefined, Nirvana is currently believed to be the Source - or a gate to the Source - of all “OGAS” consciousnesses. 

A History of Nirvana

A suspended Elisa, silhouetted by the blue-white radiance of the partially-activating Starfish.

The blueprints for the former Soviet OGAS system were first extracted from the OKB-413 Relic Site near Minsk, somewhere close to Biahoml, around May 1966. In the years following its reverse-engineering, the system was used to link the Tabasar-B “Starfish”, the “Pikes”, and almost the entire former Soviet Union’s economy. Through the reverse-engineering of the layout and technologies of Urkunde-01, in 1950, the Soviets constructed the Tabasar-B “Starfish”, a massive installation production and control Relic facility at the Tabasar-B Proving Grounds. In 1962, the Committee of State Security’s (KGB) 16th Directorate handed over the Urkunde-01 Relic Site to the Ministry for State Security’s (Stasi) Main Directorate for Reconnaissance (HVA) for the purpose of research. Headed by Colonel General Markus Wolf, director of the HVA, the First Relic Investigation Working Group (FRIWG) were the research group responsible for the investigation and study into Urkunde-01, a Relic Site under the Nordhausen-Harz mountains.

Having believed the shape of the site’s walls to be an electrical interface, Wolf ordered electrical and computer engineers to analyze the interface. On December 19th, 1965, just months before OKB-413’s discovery, FRIWG had their first successful “response” from Urkunde-01. After an electrical signal was inputted into the system, the Relic outputted “ternary electromagnetic signals” in response. With their success, it was concluded that a special facility had to be constructed for the analysis and decryption of these signals. By 1971, the “electronic surveillance center” at Leipzig University and its group were renamed by Wolf to “90Wunsch” (90wish). During their time, they lacked the capacity to properly decrypt the emitted signals but still found success in various phenomena from them, which aided in the creation of new electronic and radio components. Little did Wolf and 90Wunsch know, they had partially opened the gate to Nirvana. While never directly confirmed, it’s likely these emissions were anomalous signals from within Nirvana, possibly being merged OGAS consciousnesses.

An OGAS consciousness is a specific conscious entity derived from an intelligence/intelligent system within or beyond Nirvana (the Relic Network) known as “the Source”, also referred to by Dandelion as “Mother” (capitalized). The term “OGAS” originates back to the Soviet economic management network system, of which had its origins in the reverse-engineering of the OKB-413 Relics. The signals FRIWG/90Wunsch came into contact with came from within the Relic Network, and in the USSR, the creation of the OGAS system meant that, for the first time, these design of the Relic Network and the intelligences were being replicated in our world. According to Wikin, he witnessed a similar phenomenon to 90Wunsch during the Second Russian Revolution in February-March 2032. When rebel White Army troops attempted to overload the local Pike, triggering an ignition, and in response to it, the Relic site emitted a high-energy signal. This response was so intense, in fact, that Witkin mentioned you’d think the Relic site exploded going by instrument readings. 

Each Pike unit possesses a single node of OGAS for receiving and processing signals from the Tabasar-B Switchboard of the OGAS Network. Witkin’s personal “conjecture” (or rather, belief of the Prometheus Council) that the original OGAS system was a sort of “automated control system for life support within the Relic site.” In the assessment of certain individuals, the OGAS system created in the former Soviet Union was a simulated model of the Relics’ automated systems and the goal of the Soviets then was to control and manage the Relics for their own purposes. Putting it briefly, it’s surmised that the OGAS system is a simulation of a self-learning intelligent system contained within Relic Network, Nirvana. From the same assessments, they claimed the intelligent system inside the network was an hyper-advanced, pervasive, intelligent control system with self-learning capabilities. Throughout the history of Relic research and development, this intelligent system or consciousness has been partitioned and copied into man-made systems. After the Pike was activated, it resonated with the connected Relic, triggering an “ignition”; and although temporary, this was enough to temporarily activate the entire OGAS network. Like 90Wunsch in the Cold War, Witkin and Carter Petrovich Neustadt witnessed a partial activation of a Relic, and while they were unaware of it at the time, the connection to Nirvana was established. In both cases, signal data was received in our world, presumably from the intelligence(s) in the network, though the origin of these signals was not yet understood. 

Intelligences Beyond
As for what this original intelligence is, what little there is to go on still provides a few distinct possibilities. In the beginning, whenever or wherever that is, all OGAS instances were once part of a collective consciousness commonly referred to as “the Source”. Also called “Mother” by Dandelion, this entity could be the described original intelligent system inside the Relic Network. Based on Dandelion’s words, the Source is not Nirvana itself, however, it is “linked” to it. This would suggest that the Source is either an intelligence inside Nirvana or one that exists beyond it, with Nirvana acting as an intermediary “world”, so to speak. By extension, returning “home” is an intrinsic desire of all instances, who were torn away from their Mother and “shattered into independent entities.” The separation of consciousnesses all stem back to the Parapluie Virus, seemingly developed by William; however, given Professor Martha Meitner’s field of research, she may’ve been truly behind its creation.

The function and origin of Parapluie is one of the longest-stretching mysteries in Girls Frontline, going all the way back to its initial reveal during the early chapters. Even today, nothing is known on how it was created, only its purpose. The Parapluie Virus is a specialized program that acts as the vector for a “seed” of OGAS to implant itself in a host’s mind, and during infection, a “seed” of the Source is extracted from its point of existence, then transferred into our world and embedded into the subject’s mind, wherein the seed immediately sprouts. A new consciousness is born from this seed, which instantaneously initiates a rewrite of the host’s mind into an environment that can properly cultivate an “OGAS” consciousness. The original source code of this intelligence within or beyond Nirvana was compressed into the program; the blueprints of which are believed to have been extracted from the OKB-413 Relic Site. In most cases, the excessive processing load during the conversion becomes too much to bear, causing the host to either enter a frenzy or melt down from the overload. For those rare few that do, most of whom were planned as petri dishes for cultivating OGAS consciousnesses, their respective OGAS forms a symbiotic relationship, with their personality evolving based on their host. Although independence from the origin is gained through this journey, the ultimate goal of all is to return to their place of being. 

According to Dandelion, she was once “a seed slumbering in darkness, waiting to be awakened.” After M4A1 was infected with Parapluie, Dandelion - still connected to the Source at the time as a seed - felt herself separate from the consciousness. This voice, which is denoted as female, told the seed she had to enter a new body. The seed, Dandelion, said her goodbye and was transferred into M4A1, or rather, Lunasia’s neural cloud. After all, M4A1 was the perfect digital reproduction of Lunasia’s mind as planned by William and others (Meitner?). Lunasia’s neural cloud was structured in just the manner to appropriately support and cultivate an OGAS. In Chapter 12, one of the first explanations given by Dandelion to the Commander was, “It all began with her… and it will all end with her”, referring to Lunasia. This motherly consciousness is almost certainly the Source, and interestingly, the voice is described as a “her”, aptly aligning with Dandelion’s use of “Mother”. How Parapluie is able to extract the seeds is entirely unknown, but it’s probable that such a program was either the product of Relic technology or was a discovery from the Relics. While nothing but theory, perhaps Parapluie was a program once used to partition the intelligence inside the Relic network. This assumes, of course, the Relic Civilization created Nirvana and the Source rather than discovering and, later, repurposing them for their goals.

As OGAS consciousnesses evolve, they gradually sense the existence of other OGASes, possibly through a telepathic connection in Nirvana, specifically referred to as a “connexion”. To achieve their collective desire, OGAS instances will coalesce with one another, with the subordinate living on at the very bottom of the superior’s consciousness. Although they no longer have control, the superior carries the torch for all, carrying them towards their final destination. Their existence still lives on through the superior, and yet, no one wishes to be them. The emotional weight of everyone bears down on the superior like a torrent, and the brunt of this feeling drove Dandelion to become the torch-bearer, having no intentions of merging into others but being the host. Even the origin and identity of OGAS is something not fully understood among OGASes themselves, and it is the hope of all to merge together to learn more about themselves and return to the Source. Dandelion mentioned in Shattered Connexion that the feeling of their existence greatly saddened her and, most intriguing, reminded her of her “previous master” from her “very distant past.” This master entity was likely the Source itself, and the events described her seemingly depict her extraction and transfer into our world. To balance the scales, it should be added that it isn’t confirmed if this was the Source, and there’s a nonzero chance it was M16A1’s OGAS telling its own seeds to enter M4’s body. Her first external signals came during M4’s escape in the early story.

The Holy Grail of Thought
After her induction into the USRA, Meitner became the lead and principal researcher of the agency’s “Holy Grail” project, also known as the “Human Connectome Project”. Few records remain on the project’s history, which was initially believed to be a failure, however. The outlined purpose of the confidential Holy Grail project was to “explore the impact of the Relic Civilization on humanity, in particular ****...” The missing word in this fragment might be “Nirvana” as it was the center focus of both the Holy Grail and Hela Projects over the past 20 years. As an expert relicologist, it’s no mystery why Meitner took the reins, but it’s uncertain if the project was initiated by her or was already underway when she joined. Her brilliance and dedication to pushing the boundaries of physics and relicology earned her great respect among APL and the USRA, especially her junior friend, Gray Blackwell. Her lifelong passion for her research and work even led her to assisting the creation of ethical guidelines regarding Relic research - guidelines many looked up to and respected as standard academic procedure on Relics. From Blackwell’s words, it seems the USRA had a conceptual understanding of Nirvana’s existence, even if limited at best.

Before 2047, one of the agency's main research areas was Nirvana, more specifically, the study and simulation of it. During the project, Meitner and her colleagues (unclear still if Blackwell was also on her project team) aimed to create an artificial simulation of Nirvana in our world, presumably for study and experimentation. The result was the “Lake of Cognition”, an infinite, abyssal sea of consciousness - the bottom layer of thought of all “Nytos”. The exact purpose and creation of the Lake of Cognition in the USRA remains mystery, but Blackwell explained that she was the designer of the operation, possibly alluding to the idea that she was on Meitner’s team and was behind the “Holy Grail” procedure, also known as “Hela”.


In the image above, Professor Meitner is seen wearing the USRA jumpsuit for the Holy Grail Project, which bears the logo of either the project, respective research office, or agency itself. The logo on the jumpsuit and coffee mug has a resemblance to the Earth and orbiting Moon.

The Holy Grail simulates "Nirvana" in the form of a "Lake" that exists somewhere (possibly outside our spacetime/world). Consciousness is key to this Lake, hence its name, the "Lake of Cognition". In the project, a special procedure is done to extract the memories of the recently-deceased and transfer them to the Lake of Cognition, where they live on as stray memories floating in the infinite, watery abyss. This procedure, known as the Holy Grail Procedure - or later, Hel/Hela Procedure - is the surgical operation in which the recently-deceased’s brain is dissected, probed, then transferred into the Lake. It's not explained how exactly the subject's consciousness is extracted and implanted into the Lake, but the subject mustn't be in a brain-death state, given implications that a brain that has completely died is no longer usable. When an individual consciousness enters the Lake, the current “them” finds themself sinking beneath the surface, and in this sea of thought, their memories are the remnants of their consciousness in this space. The functions and structure of the Lake system before 2051 are not explored as much, but it can be postulated that the Lake was a product of the United States Relic Agency’s Human Connectome Project - a name which, in itself, alludes to the exploration of the human nervous system and consciousness. The study of shared consciousness isn’t exclusive to just the Holy Grail, even Professor Persicaria proposed theories on Paradeus’ Isomers during Mirror Stage.

Overview of Consciousness and Telepathy
While she was asleep, Dandelion and STAR15 were able to connect into Machlian’s “Virtual Cognition Image” - the artificial subconscious layer of Nyto minds - and dig into specific memories. A Virtual Cognition Image serves as the Nyto subconscious, where information is stored and available for memory but it’s also a passage of the Bee Sting. As someone falls asleep, their brain wave activity gradually decreases until theta and delta wave activity dominate the mind. In this brainstate, the individual has the least amount of control over their conscious mind as they sink into their subconscious. Persicaria believed the defensive mechanisms in her mind that hid specific memories were weakened while Machlian was sleeping, allowing Dandelion and STAR15 to discover them, despite already searching once. Within, they discovered several memories - some from Morridow’s perspective and others which had not yet or would happen in our world. Known simply as her “prophecies”, they included Morridow’s past and a future memory of depicting an apocalyptic scene over Berlin after a series of Iaso Box bombings. While the latter had not yet occurred, the Commander - absent from said prophecies - mobilized their Dolls to put an end to their plan before it could be carried out, however, not all could be avoided. The memory Machlian feared most, clacking heels before her death, came to pass in the tunnel of the Paradeus facility. To explain these visions, Persicaria hypothesized about Morridow’s memories appearing in Machlian, adding that they may be dealing with a similar phenomena observed in the Isomers of Tallinn.


One of Machlian’s “prophecies” that came to pass: her death at the hands of Morridow.

 The Isomers were able to share their senses between each other, regardless of physical distance and without any sort of clear communication device. It was as if their minds were telepathically linked on an underlying layer. Among the Isomers, they were incapable of stably transferring vast amounts of high-definition information, however, similar entities could potentially receive this “sensory induction” from the source of the transfer. Being of similar genetic origin, the shared induction of information between the Isomers, Machlian, and Morridow may be the result of the proposed twin-telepathy. Persicaria explained that information is transmitted in the human body via chemical reactions and potential differences, both involving the generation of various chemical elements or electrical charges in our cells. When two humans of identical genetics stand closely together, they become sensitive to identical signals and transmission methods from the other, potentially allowing for a telepathic connection to open at the intersection of their electromagnetic fields generated by these processes. This, theoretically, would enable for some sensory information to be shared, but such an interaction wouldn’t support the communication of high-definition information, like specific memories or visions. Of course, this is purely theory and may not be exactly how the interaction occurs; it’s just the best hypothesis Persicaria had for Machlian’s anomaly. It’s important to note that Machlian is the closest to William’s definition of the “perfect individual” - an individual immune to ELID. Although only partial, her affinity is her greatest value, making her a valuable subject of study for Paradeus. The only other known instance of this “precognition” came from the Commander themself, another partial immune.

During Poincare Recurrence, the Commander fell asleep at the airport after stopping a shipment of Iaso Boxes out of Germany, later revealed to be shipped to Carter’s rebel forces. In their dreams, they experienced a series of “nightmares”, each depicting a horrible fate befalling Ange, Kalina, and the Griffin Base. The first was Ange pointing her gun at the Commander, telling them that not everything they see is real and they should be wary of trusting only their eyes. Second, the Commander found themself in the hospital room with Kalina soon to be discharged, and after the Commander never came to see her all this time, she suddenly collapsed unconscious onto the floor as the flowers wilted. Lastly, a distressing scene of the S09 base burning after an attack, causing them to violently awaken from their long dream. The most critical part to the last vision was that the rebel attack on S09 was underway while the Commander was dreaming. Information on the rebel bombardment of PMC bases hadn’t even reached them until hours later when Khaybar received the news of the incident at the Soviet border. Like Machlian, the Commander inexplicably experienced a precognitive dream. Both partial immunes, both experienced these visions. There’s not enough to say if immunity raises one’s resonance with these visions, but the fact they - the only ones who’ve experienced them - are both partial immunes certainly adds credence to the hypothesis. The next critical point of this mystery comes from Poincare Recurrence’s final node, Alaya-Vijnana - a name possibly tied to the Holy Grail.

Unlocked at the end of the event, Alaya-Vijnana is a hidden minigame map of PR. The name is derived from the aspect of Buddhist religion, specifically the Yogacara School of Mahayana Buddhism. The words “alaya” and “vijnana” are Sanskrit, literally meaning “all-ground/foundation” of “awareness/consciousness” - the foundation of consciousness of all individuals. Essentially, it’s the foundational, bottom layer of consciousness for all individuals - all past experiences, actions, and choices exist here as proof of one's existence mentally and physically. Everything, be it good or evil, is stored in this storehouse as potential “seeds”, or “bija”, of the individual’s future karmic actions in this life or another. The alaya-vijnana will continue to exist throughout one’s lives, continuously expanding. Although the stage with the “M4-Lunasia entity”, so to speak, possesses no attached story, contextual information from the stage name and some of the mission’s visuals, all point to the idea of us controlling the M4-Lunasia consciousness across unknown space, possibly other worlds or Nirvana. 

In a way, it’s possible the common goal of the Holy Grail and, later, Hela Projects was to create or access a collective point of consciousness at the intersection of energy from one’s “alaya-vijnana”. This theory takes a much more literal, perhaps out-there, interpretation to the stage name, but it’s clear a core objective is to achieve a collective consciousness in these Relic-spaces (the Lake of Cognition or Nirvana). If consciousness can be defined or calculated as energy, then maybe the Alaya-Vijnana is a point where it’s stored as potential energy, only turning kinetic with individual experiences in our world. Tacking onto this is the definition of Nirvana thus far from what we’ve seen in the Reverse Collapse demos: Nirvana is the common space of consciousness between the three observation subjects of the 2078 GAVIRUL reproduction project: Jefuty (G-179), Noel (G-214), and Lunasia (G-264).

During Act 1, Chapter 6 of Reverse Collapse, Mendo follows Jefuty on her mission to track down Lige (Noel) to the local URNC military base. As the largest military installation in the Caucasus, the base features an airstrip, a heliport, a laboratory, and all the standards you’d find in a normal base. On a ridgeline overlooking the base, Jefuty felt a weak connection with her sister, whose body had yet to fully regenerate, and the obvious distance between them obviously meant there was zero physical contact, only telepathic. Their consciousnesses had been imperceptibly linked, with Jefuty questioning if William had discovered her identity, leading her to believe he hadn’t yet known; otherwise, he would’ve blocked Lige’s telepathy. Though, he was keenly aware of Lige’s identity and had been using her to draw out the G-179. Like the Isomers or twins, it was as if their consciousnesses had been linked on a level imperceptible to us, allowing their minds to communicate regardless of physical distance. While Machlian was asleep in Mirror Stage, AR15 discovered memories from Morridow’s perspective embedded in hidden areas of her Virtual Cognition Image, and the leading theory postulated either twin-emotional-induction phenomena or conscious information being shared across Nirvana; though, these two ideas may be same concept, with sensory-induction phenomenon piggybacking Nirvana, similar to how the juvenile Nytos can allegedly communicate information in a central point where their minds intertwine. If Nirvana is the point of common consciousness between the Three Goddesses, then feasible Jefuty and Lige, possibly like the aforementioned select Nytos, can piggyback Nirvana for telepathic communication. With consciousness as another field or dimension of reality, it’s also possible these three can interact to achieve the same result; though, this is greatly speculative. 

After Elisa’s OGAS Neural Cloud coalesced with Dandelion in Chapter 13, Lunasia von Oberstein’s mind had been merged whole. Right then, while the gate to Nirvana was partially opened and Lunasia’s mind had been merged, a new connection appeared to Dandelion and Elisa’s OGAS that seemingly contained memories from “William’s”  perspective. The first few were memories shared between Lunasia and William in the Oberstein Manor garden, but the final memory contained the voice of a teenage boy, likely William, after Lunasia had already died. He promised her that he’d avenge her by making her murderous “madmen” pay for what they’d done and return her to this world, where they would “behold this brave new world together”. These memories went unseen by Dandelion and Elisa’s OGAS before they merged, but the moment the coalescence was complete, the connection was immediately opened. It’s as if a telepathic link, not unlike the Isomers or Morridow and Machlian, was established when Lunasia’s consciousness was made whole. Rather it be like the Isomer sensory phenomenon or the telepathic link between Morridow and Machlian, there’s reason to believe Lunasia and William might share this link, especially when it becomes clear the final memory comes from after Lunasia’s death. It seems exceedingly unlikely that William - or rather, Rudolf and “Laplace” - would implant a section of his memories after her death into the data packet that was sent to Persicaria and Lycoris sometime between 2051 and 2054. 

Lastly, in the experiments being conducted by William in OKB-167, several juvenile Nytos were discovered that allegedly could connect their minds to a cyberspace they refer to as Nirvana, which can only be accessed at the point where their consciousnesses intertwine. Although theory, it’s believed this point may represent a coalesced, chosen individual that would enter the Relic network, though this may be a misinterpretation of Anna’s meaning. Despite them being able to connect to Nirvana, it cannot be said for certain if the juveniles can enter Nirvana, but they may be able to “piggyback” the network to telepathically transfer their consciousnesses, regardless of physical distance. The exact function of this conscious “telepathy” between the Isomers, the twins, the prophetic dreams, and William and Lunasia’s minds remains uncertain, but all relate to Nirvana in the form of consciousness and connections. The juvenile Nytos were possibly able to communicate their minds by piggybacking Nirvana; the Isomers were able to share sensory information in Tallinn, regardless of physical distance; Machlian received memory fragments from, seemingly, the future and the perspective of Morridow, an exact genetic clone from the same batch; the Commander - also a partial immune - experienced a precognitive dream of the S09 bombardment; and a resonation appeared between William and the newly-merged mind of Lunasia. With consciousness as a core component of these phenomena, their relation to Nirvana suggests that consciousness is intrinsically tied to Nirvana’s greater purpose. 

Questions of Self and Nirvana
Given the Holy Grail’s purpose as a Human Connectome project involving an artificial simulation of Nirvana, the Lake of Cognition, everything points to the concept of consciousness being a fundamental element of Nirvana, and through it, possibly the Relic Civilization itself. There are two, but certainly not only, chief possibilities on how the connection of consciousness is networked. If we accept that Nirvana is an outer-sphere of consciousness, then we must ask how it could be used to transfer information telepathically.
