Laplace, the omniscient demon that haunted science, was impressed that no matter how many times Angelia lost her memory nor the changes done to the people around her, that the latter remained true to her choice - that same headstrong self lived on, even if it meant diving straight into the abyss. Given Laplace’s reaction and past actions, perhaps she, too, follows the belief that living with unshakable persistence is pivotal for one’s self and ambition. After all, Martha Meitner was willing to give up her identity and humanity - her values and ethics - to save her daughter and force her research forward. This is where the core foil exists between Anna and Martha: both see the futility of struggling, yet they push forward for different causes. If Angelia held her convictions as she charged into the shadow of death itself, even at the foolish cost of herself or those around her, then Laplace is one who gave up humanity to push the bounds of science to their absolute, abhorrent limits, all in hopes of finally unlocking the truth that plagued the world of Relic science.

The Beslan School Siege - September 1st, 2050


With the dismantling of the Beslan Guards Regiment, the extremists within the local ranks had been halted for a time, but their actions would have a butterfly effect three years later at the Beslan Secondary School No. 1. None could’ve predicted the tragedy that would befall the town on September 1st, 2050, made all the more ironic by the fact that the town’s defenders had been dismantled following Operation Eternal Flame. By shutting down the regiment to prevent further bloodshed, only more was spilled - an irony that Meitner herself would point out after the incident.

After the Beilan Incident, the number of Islamic extremists greatly thinned, but the over 40-year period of independence in the Caucasus states meant fertile ground had been plowed for certain terrorist groups. As the war was reaching its twilight stage, the Bureau of State Security continued to isolate and eliminate key members of these nationalist and religious terror groups. One such group was the “Relocation Action Group” - a small contingent made up of around 20 people, led by “Mashadov”, who had consistently evaded StateSec capture. With the war nearly over, counter-terror operations became commonplace, especially with NATO and Warsaw Pact arms flooding the European black markets. Although the war was not yet over, the post-war era saw many small-scale conflicts across the continent - from farmers rebellions to extremist terrorism, all while the people were still licking their wounds. In 2050, the Soviet Union successfully convinced some Western countries to aid in closing the net on terrorism, and the head of RAG promised vengeance in return.

The Beslan Incident
On September 1st, StateSec’s Alpha Group and the local Interior Troops’ 36th Brigade narrowly missed cutting the RAG off before they could slip away into Beslan. Departing from two nearby hideouts, the 20-strong group entered the worst-case scenario target - the Beslan Secondary School No. 1. Once they had breached the perimeter, the gunmen took over a thousand people - students, parents, teachers, and staff - hostage in the gymnasium while brandishing a modified bomb from a Relic power source. It’s unclear what this modified Relic power source device was, but the existence of such a weapon was a terrifying prospect. In order for the hostages to be released, the terrorists demanded the Soviets put an end to the West European counterterrorism operations and release all suspects arrested in conjunction with them, threatening to detonate the Relic power source if they did not adhere to the terrorists’ demands. The following standoff lasted over 11 hours, and an opportunity was discovered by security forces when they learned that one of the female members of the RAG refused to kill the child hostages, causing a strong rift within the group. This rift culminated in an apparent major dispute, wherein the CO of the security forces ordered an assault to quickly begin to prevent the power source from being intentionally or accidentally detonated. If such a device were to be detonated, it’s more than likely everyone involved would’ve died and the surrounding area made into another Contaminated Zone.

The security forces were made up of: StateSec’s Alpha Group and Vityaz; the local Internal Troops’ 36th Brigade’s 9th Company, being Ismaili’s company; and local police. When the assault began, an intense firefight ensued, and at the same time, the Relic power source had started melting down, jamming communications on both sides from the electromagnetic interference. The loss of communication only further complicated the delicate operation, and in the chaos, while the RAG were engaging the counterterror teams, Anna seized the opportunity and ran towards the bomb, located in the center of the gym. She ripped out all the wires, disabling the bomb; however, with the bomb’s deactivation and the rapidly encircling security forces, the desperate RAG saw the writing on the wall and turned to carry out one final despicable act - one that would live in infamy for so many. Just before rescue could breach, the terrorists opened fire on the hostages - brass, blood, and bodies littered the floor. The gym was quickly thrown into commotion, and the subsequent stampede trampled many. The smell of blood permeating in the air and the horrifying feeling of squishy chunks would haunt Anna’s mind for life. By the time the assaulters had shot all 20 terrorists dead, hundreds were dead, including 186 children. Over half of Anna’s Year 11 classmates were dead, having only been spared because of the bomb’s protective shielding. The same could not be said for those close to her.

Aftermath of the Beslan Incident
When Ismaili Ibrahimov heard the news of the unfolding attack, he rushed over with the 9th Company, and in the ensuing siege, he’d been injured in the crossfire. His physical injuries could be treated, which he did recover from, but the mental scars of what befell the children would never heal. His oldest, Armin, had been killed in the shooting, having been shot straight through the brain. Ramzan had been with him in the moment, and though awful, it was comforting to know at least it was a quick, “lucky” death. Although he survived, Ramzan had lost his left arm in the battle, likely from gunfire or shrapnel. When the dust had settled, Isamili, who’d already lost four men from the 9th Company, was beyond devastated to realize the fates of his sons. The total mortality count of the incident stands in the hundreds, with many more injured.


Hostages
    • Hundred reported killedd
        ◦ “186 students and even more parents”
    • Armin killed by gunfire
    • Sana killed by unstated cause
    • 4 Men from the Internal Troops’ 36th Brigades’ 9th Company killed
        ◦ Two killed were of Vehicle 291, being the driver and commander (possibly Captain Zvetaev)
    • Ramzan lost his left arm

Security Forces
    • 4 Men from the Internal Troops’ 36th Brigades’ 9th Company killed
        ◦ Two killed were of Vehicle 291, being the driver and commander (possibly Captain Zvetaev)
    • Ismaili was injured in the assault crossfire

Relocation Action Group
    • All 20 terrorists killed

Among the dead was Meitner’s daughter, Sana, who would’ve been aged around 9 or 10 by September 2050. What killed her mustn’t have been destructive to the brain, as Meitner would later go on to use it, indicating that if she was shot, the bullet did not damage the brain. 

Two days would pass until Armin’s burial, where Anna helped her grieving adoptive parents and brother, and upon returning home, Anna rushed into her room to be alone, locking the door on her way in. Fearing her potentially harming herself, Ismaili bashed the door open six hours later, only to find Anna - who’d cut her hair off in solitude - writing a letter to her pen-pal Bureau Chief Viktor Pavlovich Zelinsky. In April 2047, Anna coincidentally met Zelinsky on her way to school, riding in the 9th Company’s Vehicle 291 Bumerang APC. While on the way, Zelinsky spotted the peculiar sight of a 14-year-old girl riding with the Internal Troops’ APC, so naturally, he walked over to meet the crew. Meanwhile, an attached photographer followed Zelinsky to the vehicle, and upon meeting the girl, he offered his hand, to which Anna responded in kind; all of this was photographed and shared with the media, becoming one of the widest-circulating WWIII photos. The juxtaposition of the Minister of the Interior shaking the hand of a young girl on her way to school in a military vehicle perfectly epitomized the war’s effect on the homeland. After the chance encounter, Zelinsky and Anna started writing letters for a while; though, such things come to the wayside in wartime, limiting their exchanges over time. 

A similar solemn, yet peaceful end could not be said for Martha Meitner, who greatly mourned the loss of her only loved one, despite her motherly struggles. It’s unknown how Sana died and its cause, rather it was instant or protracted, but there was a chance - small, yet very real - Sana could live on: the reactivation of the Holy Grail Project. Even Meitner, who’d been ejected from her position due to misconduct, likely wouldn’t have gone to such detestable ends to reject fate, but grief can just as well corrupt the mind into darker places. On the late evening of the 6th (September 6th?), Meitner penned another letter to Blackwell, one of guilt and desperation. Blackwell’s strongest conviction was that of the Hippocratic Oath, and having always held true to it, she’d always try aiding those in need, regardless of background or ailment. In a letter that appealed - or perhaps, used - Blackwell’s principles, Meitner pleaded for help. With Sana dead, but the brain preserved, there was still a chance to “save” her through the Holy Grail, the potential key to immortality. In her emotional typhoon, one thought rang out: she knew what she needed to do, no matter if it stemmed from guilt for Sana, potential revenge against the USRA, or her ego falling to the abyss. And with a quote that resonates well past 2050, “When humanity, good and evil, is lost, what human values need be defended?” When the principles and ethics that govern the self are uprooted, what remains of ego when the simple understandings of good and evil have been cast out? The act of killing has been the original sin of humanity since inception, and the traces of such tradition have been engraved in our genes; although death is its natural conclusion, there was a chance to reject it - a chance for Clotho to weave Atropos’ severed threads. Blackwell was the last hope in the world, and Meitner’s perverted spirit knew what plucked the former’s heartstrings.

Chapter 3 - The Sparks in My Heart (Jr. Lt. Angelia)

(Spring 2051)

Berlin Metropolitan School Incident - December 1st, 2050

As an aside, on December 1st, 2050, Berlin Metropolitan School in the Mitte borough in Berlin was attacked by several unknown gunmen. While details are sparing, first hand accounts from students have recounted the events that took place in the classrooms and hallways that day. Cheryl, a young elementary-aged school girl at the time, was with her class when the gunmen entered, barricading and hiding in the classroom as the event unfolded. When safe passage was temporarily opened, the teachers and other adults evacuated the children, but in the fear-driven stampede, Cheryl was shoved aside by another student, throwing her off her balance and knocking her out cold from the fall. When she came to, she couldn’t see, likely as a result of blunt trauma to the head and the blood pouring down over her eyes. In the dark confusion, an unfamiliar voice in the familiar surroundings spoke to her, asking her why she hadn’t followed the adults’ instructions to flee outside.

Big Sis’ Operation

(L to R) Private First Class Amaris, Eula, and Sergeant Aliana of the Daybreak Squadron.

Still shaken and confused, a pair of cold hands gently inspected her wound, and the same female voice commended her bravery up to that point. The voice applied bandages to her head, but her wound and temporary blindness surely needed professional attention after reaching safety. When asked about her identity, the voice refused to answer, only adding that she couldn’t say her name. To satisfy Cheryl’s probing, the voice allowed her to call her “Big Sis”; however, the implications of Big Sister’s true identity are all the more intriguing. The voice’s hand helped Cheryl to her feet, and it’s mentioned the soft, yet somewhat rough, hands would make you “entrust everything to them.” As Big Sis escorted her, Cheryl’s tears continued flowing; though, the former taught her a special trick to distract her from the tears and ongoing crisis. Big Sis carried a gun as well, and she had Cherly wrap her hand around its grip and trigger, protected by the firm grip of Big Sis. Further, she apparently taught her a trick for disarming bombs. Both of these skills she later applied in life for her firearms license and disabling the bombs with “Samo” (Amaris) in October 2064. Aside from the physical and mental trauma inflicted by the attack, the memory of Big Sis was deeply rooted into the young Cheryl, who desperately awaited the return of her new sister that protected and guided her in the darkest moment.

Fourteen years later, Cheryl would discover who she believed to be her Big Sis once more, only to realize that, in truth, she had died long ago and Amaris had been carrying her legacy ever since. Private First Class Amaris was the last Doll of the US Army Rangers’ “Daybreak Squadron” to be completed, and given the timeframe of Meitner’s expulsion from the USRA, the Daybreak Squadron must’ve been completed prior to the winter of 2047. Furthermore, it was Amaris who was designed to carry the redundant legacy of Daybreak, and Cheryl’s Big Sis from 2050 was nothing but a ghost in Amaris’ mind by 2064. Truthfully, Big Sis’ identity was that of Eula, a Doll with a notably popular appearance among Doll manufacturers, causing confusion 14 years later with SCR. Her appearance during the school attack begs the question - what was an American Army Ranger Doll doing in Berlin, the heart of the GDR, in the late war, namely in an attack on Berlin Metropolitan School? According to Cheryl's recollection, what followed the incident gives an interesting lead about the potential reasoning behind it and possible relations to Daybreak.

In 2064, Cheryl described the time back then as the “kidnapping case”, which had a far-reaching impact that, allegedly, required the military to wrap up in the end. When the children returned home, the parents were told to remain silent, and it wasn’t until several years later that Cheryl could find only some information about it on the internet. From Eula’s perspective that day, several “cold, unfeeling” soldiers moved among the schoolchildren, none paying attention to the weeping Cheryl in the corner of a classroom. During “Operation [REDACTED]”, at [REDACTED TIME], in Berlin Metropolitan School, Eula patched up Cheryl’s head wound, then stayed with her while they were waiting to leave. Cheryl revealed her name to Big Sis, but asked again why Big Sis wouldn’t reveal her own. Her reasoning was that it was “complicated adult stuff”; however, her identity as an American Ranger Doll would surely compromise operational security, regardless of why she was there. Given she was still temporarily blinded, Cheryl asked how she’d be able to find her after regaining sight; Eula paused, then gave her one of her shell cases that “she had just used.” Although all she could feel was the cold metal, Cheryl promised to protect it, as it was what Eula used the most.

From what’s understood and alluded to, Eula and, possibly, the rest of Daybreak were deployed on a clandestine operation into Berlin - an operation that was linked to the attack on Berlin Metropolitan School. The operation’s name is redacted from the memories, but Eula had apparently fired her weapon at least once in the school. In a building that had once been a classroom, she discovered Cheryl among the frightened children, who she applied medical treatment to. Moreover, the attack was connected to a “kidnapping case” back then, and parents were hushed about the incident, with little information existing on the internet about it. There’s an endless amount of questions about the incident; though, the core of this mystery is Eula’s presence at the school. There are three primary possibilities regarding Daybreak’s role: the gunmen, possibly involved in kidnapping or human trafficking; the military’s response to the attack, though this conflicts with politics of WWIII; or an independent third party that came to the school’s aid.

Cui Bono?
If Daybreak were actually the gunmen, then you must ask why the Rangers were attacking and seizing children from a Berlin school. If so, perhaps there was a specific VIP in the school that had to be captured, but an attack on a school seems way too high-profile for one or a few people. In 2050, NATO was already on its last legs as the Warsaw Pact had effectively forced them back to Western Europe, where the decisive battles of the war took place. Outside of a black project of questionable ethics, such as the 2035 Photon Project or 2040s Holy Grail Projects, there’s little reason currently for them to commit to such a radical operation. Alternatively, this event was carried out by unknown actors - be they state or radicals, but Daybreak was part of the force sent in to eliminate the attackers.  

Knowing Cheryl’s comment about a kidnapping case that was kept off the record, those responsible likely orchestrated a high-profile event to capture several, rather than one. Moreover, a school is both heavily populated and full of children, and assuming this was orchestrated as such, then the likely aim was to seize children for a currently unknown purpose. By December 2050, Martha Meitner had not yet come to Berlin to work with Gray on the reactivated Holy Grail Project, so that eliminates any possibility of Laplace’s responsibility; though, Rudolf von Oberstein maintained his position as the head of 90wish at the time. The Bundeswehr Special Technology Development Group, as it was officially known, was formed in the early 2040s in the Leipzig University of Karl Marx, focusing on the research and development of cutting-edge technologies - specifically Dolls, in the case of Persicaria and Lycoris - for the Federal Republic of Germany’s Bundeswehr. As a result of rising instability in Germany after the 2044 rebellion, the Leipzig University 90wish project team was relocated to the Max Planck Institute of Computer Science. It’s not abundantly clear if Oberstein was the head of 90wish in Leipzig University then was relocated to Max Planck, along with Persicaria and Lycoris, or was already the director of the institute and became 90wish’s leader.

In January 2049, the war was reaching the doorsteps of 90wish, and souring relations between 90wish members jeopardized progress in favor of secrecy, refusing to release any information outside the group itself. To keep the Americans from capturing Lycoris, a Russian national, he and Persciaria were escorted to safehouses by Soviet Captain Berezovich Kryuger, who was employed by IOP CEO Havier Witkin. Not too long before they were escorted, Oberstein had his children relocated to the Oberstein Family Manor in Neu-Tempelhof district of Berlin, where they remained until 2051 - the introduction of Martha Meitner to Germany. Of course, the timeline does not point to Meitner being involved in any way, but if she was involved, it makes sense for Daybreak to investigate a school that their target, “Capita”, was involved in, especially considering the nature of her later experiments with the Evangel Axis; however, that’s all made mute by the fact Meitner was still in Moscow in 2050 and hadn’t yet restarted the Holy Grail Project with Blackwell, all to show that Laplace was unrelated to this events. On the other hand, there’s stronger - though, far from concrete - lead for a potential Oberstein involvement. This isn’t to say he was implicated in the attack, but there’s a nonzero chance his children were students there.

It’s entirely circumstantial - and factual evidence has yet to be presented, but the Neu-Tempelhof District is only approximately 5-6km (3-4 miles) by road from the Berlin Metropolitan School in Mitte. At their age, Lunasia and her younger brother still would’ve been in school, and unless they had private tutoring, they’d be educated in the city. Although the ages of Oberstein’s children back then are inexact, it’s possible they could’ve been students, with William being much younger. Admittedly, this is stacking theories atop theories, but if that proves true, then there’s a possibility that William could’ve been Cheryl’s classmate or junior. It’s a major stretch, one that’s probably wrong, but there’s a chance Oberstein’s family was targeted by the Americans, and Daybreak was sent on a clandestine mission to kidnap his kids, possibly in hopes of forcing Oberstein into the open. Before leaving the Max Planck Institute, Lunasia consistently told Persicaria and Lycoris about how little time her father could spare for his children; although true, the reasoning behind his neglect was seemingly due to his cumbersome workload and desire to keep them out of harm’s way. Back then, Oberstein was under a lot of fire and, for unstated reasons, held a poor reputation with the Relics Department/Agency, believed to be the remnants of the Relic Agency that hadn’t gone to Antarctica by 2045. If he was a former member of the UNRA - which seems to be the case, given the discovery beneath Avernus, perhaps certain actors wished to acquire his or 90wish’s material for themselves. Again, all of this hangs on a loose wire, held together by even looser connective joints, but it’s worth considering. What this doesn’t answer is why the school attack happened and why Daybreak was there, deep behind enemy lines.

Only two components to this mystery have any substance - the confidentiality of the attack and Daybreak’s involvement in the affair. During a redacted operation, Eula entered what had once been a classroom after the attack, where she discovered an injured Cheryl, shriveled up in the corner. Several gunmen had entered the school prior, and by the time the scene had been “secured” Eula’s voice soothed the young Cheryl, then patched up her wounds and did what she could to take the latter’s mind off the day’s tragedy. That’s the essence of this incident. It’s possible it was simply a random terror attack on a school in Berlin, as the incident rate of terrorist attacks had increased since WWIII. But why were the parents hushed about a major incident involving children, seemingly with many killed? Why was Daybreak in the school? Were the gunmen Daybreak, or was Daybreak coincidentally in the area when these unknown actors assaulted? The US Army Rangers specialize in light, organized infantry raids and other combat operations that prioritize neutralizing special targets, installations, or infrastructure in all environments; all of this made them excellent candidates for the later 2051 Operation Couatl, which required the Rangers’ finest due to its nature and risks, including the Dead Sea’s elevated Contamination Index. Daybreak’s appearance as female model Doll robots may have been the intention, so as to not raise too much suspicion for infiltration missions, especially when the squadron were behind enemy lines in 2050 and 2051. For example, SCR in 2064 asked Aliana why Eula looked so similar to her, and the believed explanation that her body model had mass-market appeal. If the Americans wanted to embed undercover Ranger Dolls behind enemy lines, what better way than to make Dolls that had mass appeal, not out of the ordinary with other human-like Dolls? Although this remains a theory, it does provide a potential explanation of how Daybreak could remain low-profile, possibly granting plausible deniability to the USASWC.

On the other hand, it’s entirely possible this attack was another instance of terrorism in the late-war period, but it seems incredibly coincidental to have two separate school sieges stemming from terrorism, one of which involved Daybreak. Sure, by happenstance Daybreak could’ve been performing reconnaissance or gathering intelligence while undercover in Berlin, only for an external terror group to attack; however, the squadron’s presence and involvement in an unstated operation, along with the apparent cover up afterwards strongly suggests otherwise. The general lack of details about the incident and Daybreak’s perspective restricts us, but the latter’s involvement could’ve been the catalyst of the event or its response. Considering their ambiguous role in the attack, discussing Cui bono is presently insufficient, as the lack of information severely limits how this event is perceived. Worse yet, if William or Lunasia happened to be enrolled in the school, they could’ve been part of the injured, and if we wish to be especially speculative, perhaps the event was orchestrated by unstated actors - be they Americans, former UNRA, or another group - to get at Oberstein through his family; however, this is hardly factual and lacks basis and strong connections between the influential figures of the time. Ultimately, the Berlin Metropolitan School attack boils down to three simple questions: what happened that day, who benefits, and what was their objective?

Million Roses, Million Memories - 2050-2051
With the death of Sana, so too did acceptance cease in Meitner’s heart. The cruel death of a young girl only set course for what was to unfold over the next 45 years - one of love and hate, joy and pain, and like the agent who so valiantly gave everything to sever this destructive thread of fate, Meitner would never stop until she had no choice. A cherished hope to save her daughter would ultimately be corrupted by the desire for progress. Sometime after the Beslan Incident, Meitner moved to Moscow, where she stayed until an unknown date in 2051; though, her activities and reason for moving are unexplained. It’s feasible that Meitner wished to stray as far away from Beslan as she could after Sana’s death, but her status following the incident remains in the air. Anna and Ramzan had gone on to graduate in 2051, but it remains to be seen if Meitner continued teaching when she shed her former self. While in Moscow, she wrote a series of letters to Blackwell - the contents of which ranged from the Holy Grail proposal to the “death” of Martha Meitner and the conjuration of Laplace’s Demon. There’s significant lapses of time between letters and events between late 2050 and Operation Couatl in 2051, near the end of WWIII; however, a general timeline can be drawn from them, but keep in mind, there’s a reasonable possibility of events not playing out exactly how they’re told in the Lake of Cognition, especially anything from Blackwell or Anna’s memories. Furthermore, the order of the 2051 letters are not laid out sequentially, so we’re left trying to piece the puzzle together.

A Lake of Scarlet Roses

The interior of the Million Roses Record Shop in Bremen, Germany.

What is the purpose of a key that promises immortality, only for that next self to be nothing but an amalgamation of deceitful memories? Why struggle to refuse reality for a meager wish that corrupts the soul, filling it with lies and twisting it for eternity? These questions are what lie at the end of the Holy Grail Project. What was once a search to save one’s soul had corrupted the souls of all those involved - a relentless march for scientific progress, blurring one’s principles in turn for a chance to glimpse “divinity”.

At noon on the 3rd in 2051, Meitner wrote bleakly to Blackwell again, stating that she knew the time had come for the Holy Grail’s reactivation. While initially wanting to ensure everything was ready, her predicament and disdain for her former self, which she added may have caused her to be targeted for removal by the Relic Agency, held her back, but there was no other choice, with delay only serving as a doomsday clock for Sana’s eventual braindeath. Had she not gone to those lengths in 2047, it’s possible she would’ve never been expelled, and everything in the past four years could’ve been avoided; though, one cannot rewrite reality, not yet at least. Likely stemming from her past expulsion, war situation, and the rapidly-deteriorating social order in the United States, she was unable to return to the homeland, and expatriates could’ve even get a shot of dexamethasone at the hospital. The drug has a multitude of uses for inflammatory conditions, so the specific reasoning can’t be stated; however, this comment could’ve just been aside that Blackwell, seemingly a surgeon or doctorate biologist, would completely understand. With a dramatic change of self came a change of identity, where she declared her past name would be abandoned for “Hel”, the Norse Goddess of the Death and the Underworld - a name befitting to the one who would soon become the ruler of death and resurrection, hidden away in world’s darkest corners.


Alla Pugacheva’s (Алла Пугачева) single, “Миллион Алых Роз” (“Million Scarlet Roses”)

By 2051, Blackwell had immigrated to Berlin in the German Democratic Republic, presumably to found her biology laboratory, which is known as the Gray Institute of Biotechnology; though, this Institute’s prominence in 2064 is thanks in part to being subservient to the Galatea Corporation, one of Paradeus’ major front companies. In Bremen, there was a record shop called “Million Roses” that Blackwell used to frequent, and here she’d occasionally pick up a few to send to her old friend in Moscow. A particularly beloved record was singer Alla Pugacheva’s (Алла Пугачева) single, “Миллион Алых Роз” (“Million Scarlet Roses”), released in December 1982, which later became the title track of her 1983 Million Roses album. It was this album that was safely stored in plain sight in the Bremen “Million Roses” record shop; however, the coincidental shared name could’ve been the result of the twisted memories in the Lake. 

Pugacheva’s phenomenal success in Soviet and Russian music earned her several awards and titles from the government, even Russian leaders from Boris Yeltsin to Vladimir Putin. The song was actually a cover of the 1981 “Dāvāja Māriņa meitenei mūžiņu”, composed by Latvian composer, Raimonds Pauls, and lyrics by Latvian writer, Leons Briedis. The lyricist for Pugacheva’s cover was actually Russian writer Andrei Vozenesky, who also received a fair share of fame from this hit. It’s alleged that Vozenesky was inspired by a Georgian folktale about Georgian painter Niko Pirosmani; however, the authenticity and extent of exaggeration are very much in question. As the story goes, an illustrious, stunning French actress once came to Tbilisi for a play, where Pirosmani had lived for several years of his life. Upon seeing her, infatuation was total, completely entranced by charming beauty, and after learning of her love for red flowers and roses, Pirosmani sold all he owned, even his own shop, so he could purchase every rose possible for her. He then set these million roses in the public square in front of her hotel, waiting for the woman of his dreams to see the field of red, created from his beating heart. In some versions of the tale, people described the immense aroma that permeated Tbilisi that day like a flowery perfume. When she awoke the next morning, her gaze from the window was met with the sea of a million, scarlet roses - a gift from Pirosmani worth truly everything. Sadly, despite her pleasure, the actress failed to see him below, and soon she prepared to leave the city and return to France. In another version of the folktale, the actress awarded him with a kiss, only for them to never see each other again after returning. The loss devastated him, and it’s said his heartbreak was so consuming, so intense that his failure took control of him, with his life spirally downward until his eventual death in 1918 from apparent malnutrition and liver failure. 

Although the story may lost to history or heavily exaggerated, it is no less a popular folktale told throughout the USSR, inspiring several stories, poems, and movies; however, Pirosmani did paint the Marguerite de Sèvres, a painting depicting the French actress, apparently titled after her name. Interestingly, there’s been a story regarding the 50th anniversary of Pirosmani’s death, where several of his works were displayed in the Louvre, including the painting in question. According to the story, a quiet, elderly woman came up to the painting and revealed that she was Marguerite. Although there’s not much proof of her identity, as anything on the apparent real Marguerite has been lost to history, it’s no doubt an incredible ending to a half-century old tale that would later grow all the more prevalent in Pugacheva’s Million Roses. The photo and testimonies do indicate the incident happened, however, the credibility of the claims are still in question today. Regardless of the folktale’s legitimacy, it’s absolutely rooted itself as one of the most memorable stories on the intersection of love, fate, and tragedy.  

The name “Marguerite” is pivotal to the story of Meitner and Blackwell, as that was the name known to “Sana” and the flower given to her by her motherly-figure in Paradeus, Nemhran. The marguerite was a gift from her to Nyto Sana after returning to Avernus from Moscow, where it was the favorite of many girls. In the locked box, hidden away in a storage room, the marguerite entranced Sana like it had Pirosmani. This Sana was not the Sana of old, as this Nyto - the last Gatekeeper of Hell in Avernus - used Sana’s name and retained her memories from the Lake of Cognition. The two have different personalities and tastes, but most of all, the Nyto Sana wasn’t allergic to flowers. And when those flowers began to bloom, Sana - or rather, Marguerite - was lost in their beauty, just as Marguerite de Sèvres had with Pirosmani’s million roses of adoration - a love story that, in 2064, so few could appreciate or believe in.

Hidden away in the Million Roses record shop, the aged, unassuming album sat on a shelf, doing little but gathering dust in a run-down second-hand shop. Despite the faded, yellow exterior, the record within shone good as new, and a small note had been written on the interior, beneath the record, that was directed at its future reader. The author isn’t known, but given the exquisite handwriting quality, along with Blackwell’s prior visits, it’s possibly Blackwell or Meitner; though, the former is more likely, considering Blackwell had bought records from there back in 2051. Having been written sometime between 2030 and 2064, the message was almost a sort of time capsule that asked the future reader about the predicaments of this time. Collapse Radiation and environmental pollution have been commonplace for decades, and although the author’s days were despaired by the collapsed natural order, they cherished thoughts - and perhaps, were even jealous - of a hopeful future, a world that solved the catastrophes and unified towards a greater purpose. Blackwell’s incorrigible convictions were well known, as she held the Hippocratic Oath and her ethics in the highest regards, never betraying her ideals for the sake of progress and desire. While it’s possible the note in the album came from Meitner, the prose, mannerisms, and extraordinary handwriting would suggest Blackwell, possibly written as a future note to whomever a hundred years from then discovered the album, unaware of the tragic ending that befell the former best friends. From eating sandwiches together at JHU to traveling the world on their graduation trip, nothing could come between them but themselves, and with Sana’s death in 2050, Blackwell answered Meitner’s misery. The series has always been known for butterflying events going back decades, but the story of Blackwell and Meitner, in a way, is most apt to the style of storytelling. Obviously, the past affects the future; however, when the thread of fate woven between Blackwell and Meitner is finally severed with Sana’s death and the Holy Grail’s reactivation, the history of the world is irreparably altered. 

Setting the Stage for Reincarnation
In the same letter to Meitner, she added that Germany was soon to experience a major technological storm and a certain, intelligent man was about to enter an influential position. Formerly the director of the Max Planck Institute for Computer Science and head of 90wish, Rudolf von Oberstein is one of the most powerful men in Germany. As the known patriarch and eldest of the 7th generation of the Oberstein line, he possesses firm ties to academia and politics, as well as being a staunch patriot. With an upcoming scientific boom, Blackwell saw a chance for the Holy Grail’s continuation with his support, who she suggested to Meitner in the letter. It’s unclear how she came to the conclusion that Oberstein’s involvement would benefit them; however, the Gray Institute of Biotechnology today is a subsidiary of the Galatea Technology Corporation, and during a dinner between Oberstein and Nemhran at an unknown date, Nemhran mentions “Father”, indicating that he was Paradeus’ leader before “William” assumed the position, presumably in the late 2050s. Tangentially, their dinner was not held in that room, but likely the room in Avernus that William sat down with her and the Lunasia hologram to eat in Fixed Point.

There’s a span of lost time between Meitner’s plan to reactivate the Holy Grail and her eventual trip to Berlin, so the facts presented may be twisted or misinterpreted. In another file found in Nemhran’s room in Avernus, she mentions Father spearheading Galatea’s global recruitment campaign, and Oberstein has backed them “since the beginning”. By 2064, Galatea was essentially Paradeus’ front company to research and develop biomedical and military technologies for Paradeus itself, the Nationale Volksarmee, and the Stasi. After all, the corporation’s motto is “Creating possibilities in a new world” - a motto that derives from Rossartrist and Paradeus' mantra for the brave new world soon to come. In Nemhran’s report, she mentions Gray Blackwell’s name in association, possibly indicating that Blackwell had been recruited to join Galatea after 2047, depending on your interpretation of the files found in Nemhran’s room; additionally, all of Blackwell’s letters to Meitner were written in Berlin, the stronghold of Oberstein’s influence and location of Galatea’s third branch. Given Oberstein's long-term support and backing of Galatea, it may explain Blackwell's acknowledgment and recommendation of him to Meitner, plus he was soon to enter an important position, possibly as Minister of Science and Technology. While not related in any known way, Galatea’s CEO Fidina and Oberstein may have a connection because of the latter’s strong support, along with the corporation’s strong black budget ties to Paradeus, so the CEO’s dispositions are in the air as well.

On the other hand, it’s possible Blackwell initially refused to join Galatea, only to be killed and replaced sometime in 2058, then her institute fell under Galatea. Considering the final letter was written in 2058, and Blackwell knowingly refused to join Galatea at some point, there’s precedent for Blackwell being executed that year. The crux here, though, is that the “Lady of Ashes” has been a renowned medical prodigy for over ten years, and we know she’d been active in Berlin since at least 2051. From what’s understood currently, there’s only one way Blackwell would know Oberstein - her involvement in Galatea, however, it doesn’t seem like she began working for the company until 2058, after she’d been killed. By 2064, she’d been “promoted” to chairwoman of the corporation, all while maintaining a low profile throughout the year, then quickly disappeared from the public light after Mirror Stage. All of this is admittedly messy, and continuity is lost when the full picture is lacking - a picture that’s been deliberately faded, torn, and burnt to cover up the history of Paradeus and its key figures. The missing time is the biggest issue, so we’re left piecing together a puzzle without all the pieces. Generally, it’s understood that Blackwell came to Berlin sometime after 2051, where she either formed her own biotechnology institute or was recruited into Galatea, however, the latter conflicts with her known refusal to join Galatea, stemming from her distaste of serving the interests of Meitner or Oberstein, something that totally violated her steadfast principles that defended humanity over personal interest.

Back in 2051, as the plan to reactivate the project was underway, Martha came to Berlin, possibly to meet with Blackwell to prepare for the next steps. While in a certain executive lounge in Berlin, she was approached by a middle-aged man who greeted her and poured her another glass of wine. This man was none other than Rudolf von Oberstein, the man in question from Blackwell’s letter, and this “chance” encounter in the lounge was by no means a coincidence. In a previous unsourced letter, seemingly written by Oberstein or unstated colleagues, the topic of the Holy Grail project was outlined, explaining that it was an exploration of the Relic Civilization on humanity, in particular ???? (Nirvana?). Its lead investigator and researcher, Professor Martha Meitner of JHU-APL and the USRA was expelled for academic misconduct, then immigrated to Beslan in 2047. The author of the letter or file went on to commend Meitner, saying that she was a leading relicologist and undoubtedly a monumental asset for this group’s “plan”, so she must be embraced by them, whoever they are. She was still in the Neo-Soviet Union at the time of writing but was coming to Germany in a few days, placing the document around early 2051, sometime after Meitner and Blackwell were discussing restarting the Holy Grail project. There’s no direct indication of such, but Meitner was likely coming to Berlin to meet with Meitner for the next step, and the authors of this document determined this was the best time to strike. Two more of these letters would be written post-Lunasia’s death, each describing their difficulties with Meitner in the later “Hela” Project. These letters are also subject to the same blurred history of Paradeus, as they were discovered by Alchemist in the Avernus projection room, where they were recorded being burnt in a fireplace, as if the author or someone close to them was covering their tracks. 

These letters beg some interesting questions, namely the identities of the author and their colleagues. It’s almost certain that Oberstein was involved in this group, given his encounter with Meitner and known history with the Relic Agency. The author may even be Oberstein himself, but that doesn’t answer the question of who “they” are, especially with their apparent keen interest in relicology and the Holy Grail and Hela Projects. If we wish to make a shot in the dark, maybe this group is 90wish after Persicaria and Lycoris had left, where it became a precursor to Paradeus. Oberstein was the former head of 90wish, and the organization went dark around 2054~; however, it remained heavily compartmentalized, with research carried out close to the vest, ensuring more sensitive materials did not leak to the other members. Remember, 90wish’s internal structure was murky, as many of its members worked remotely in secure locations. Some of these individuals even went as far to masquerade their face and voice, namely “William”, but this William may not necessarily be the Father of Paradeus we know in 2064. When Nemhran spoke to Oberstein in one of Nemhran’s Avernus files, she refers to him as Father, implying he was the former head of the organization, and considering that much of 90wish’s research later fell into the hands of Paradeus, it paints an image of Paradeus being birthed from a segment of 90wish. Or, perhaps, 90wish was nothing more than an arm of Paradeus or its precursor, serving as its research and development wing.

Alternatively, there’s an additional suspected group behind the letters, being the radical, Beaconist medical scholars of the Photon Project. During the Photon Project, several medical scholars from the Beaconist sect of the UNRA were responsible for a number of unethical experiments in wake of the Northern Lights Incident, all of which were directed towards the study of potential immunity, both natural and artificially engineered. In an act right out of Paradeus’ playbook, the project members even went as far to implant genetically augmented organs into ELID patients to observe if their bodies would halt the spread of mutated cells. While his dispositions are undefined, Witkin stated that Oberstein was subject to much censure and held a poor reputation with the Relic Agency in the past; however, he did not bring himself and his family to the Antarctic in 2045, so who’s the group tied to Oberstein’s plans? They existed prior to Meitner’s resurrection project with Blackwell, and seemingly even orchestrated Meitner’s introduction into Paradeus. The answer to this unknown group may lie in the dark heart of Paradeus - Avernus, testament to Paradeus and the Fathers’ blood-soaked might towards a brave new world, and physical proof of mankind’s abuse of Relic technology.

Avernus Arisen - 20XX-2051

The Avernus Megastructure seen from afar.
Secluded deep in the “Dead Sea” - a man-made Black Zone, somewhere in northern Germany, formed through years of war waste, the black twin towers of Avernus cast long, haunting shadows on this otherwise godforsaken land. After January 2049, Oberstein sent his children to the Oberstein family Manor in Berlin, seemingly to keep them out of harm’s way, but Oberstein’s whereabouts are unstated until he met with Meitner in the executive lounge - the beginning of their sanguinary partnership.

City in the Sky (20XX-2064)
While the full history behind it remains in its shadows, it seems Avernus was originally planned as a floating city, with the twin towers serving as the city center. From what was discovered underneath Avernus’ foundational platform, there's reason to believe the UNRA - more specifically, a faction within it - built a considerable subway system to what is now the Dead Sea before WWIII. This train station contains multiple lines out of the region, but their bearings and destinations are not investigated further. As Fe56 was exploring underneath the Avernus platform during Operation Ilya Muromets, they discovered the station when a 12-car remote transport train - full of boxes containing daily necessities, household goods, spare parts and even more luxury food and drink, such as Norwegian lobster and French wine, pulled into the platform. At the time, three outgoing trains were parked side by side and covered in dust, with Dreamer adding that they likely hadn’t been in service for the longest time; therefore, these outbound trains could’ve been stationed in reserve for emergency evacuation of staff, delivery of sensitive materials, or just general travel from the facility. The conspicuous buildup of dust indicates a lack of use, and unless they were reserved for emergencies only, it points to no one departing Avernus on them in many months or years. Furthermore, the unmanned train carried an abundance of necessities and foreign luxuries, which undoubtedly needed to be imported. In the past, the tunnels were likely constructed to move supplies and UNRA Beaconist staff to a Relic research facility external to the UNRA’s Geneva headquarters. In the pre-war days, many governments and institutions had constructed their own Relic research centers, but the underground base today bears the UNRA’s symbol, leading us to a simple question. Considering the Hollow City Relic site bunker-city was well underway in the early 2040s, why did the UNRA build it?    

In one of the control rooms of this facility, seemingly the ground control center for the towers, there's a series of control interfaces and screens for raising the structure. Notably, the aesthetics of the entire underground area point towards pre-war construction, along with having a faded logo of the UNRA on the wall and control room video. Here, an animated video played on one of the screens, showing a pair of towers ascending high into the sky, then the emergence of a floating city around the towers, with flying banners bearing UNRA’s crest. All of this is narrated by a blonde spokeswoman speaking in perfect Interlingua, an international auxiliary language as a lingua franca. However, everything about Avernus towers specifically points to Paradeus construction and aesthetics - namely, the white veneer seen across their architecture and units, while the foundation was originally constructed by the UNRA, possibly a separate faction from the Beaconists and Prometheans. The primary theory is that these towers, now known as Avernus, were originally planned to be an independent city operated by the UNRA, possibly planned by the Prometheans or, more likely, the Beaconists.

By Operation Couatl, just before the war’s end, Meitner wore the Paradeus symbol and one tower of Avernus had been constructed, something incredibly unlikely to have been built in a few month time frame, in a Black Zone no less; therefore, construction must’ve already been underway when she joined, and considering the UNRA’s direct connection to Avernus platform’s underground, Oberstein may have carried through with the UNRA project after 2045, with the “Dead Sea” as nothing but a facade. The UNRA’s apparent goal was the creation of an international floating city, presumably outside the jurisdiction of national governments. The reasons behind its construction are open for interpretation, but given the Beaconist and UNRA charters, perhaps it was intended to serve as an independent city-state, similar to the Hollow City from 2045 onwards. In the animated demonstration video, it paints a picturesque scene of the city, with large forests, meadows, and even flocks of birds - all things uncommon in the desolate Contaminated Zones.

Adding on that, my main theory is that it was a faction among the Beaconists that led the construction and planning, but their efforts were stalled with the start of WWIII, wherein they immigrated to Antarctica. It makes more sense canonically for it to be planned by the Prometheans as a secret base of operations, especially when you consider that they officially broke away from the UNRA in the late 2030s, but the interesting part here is Rudolf's background. We know he was once a Relic Agency (UNRA) member in the 2040s, but we don't know specifically his faction. It would otherwise be sound in the conclusion that it was planned and partially constructed by the Prometheans in the past, however, there's a major development in Reverse Collapse on the unethical experiments conducted by the Beaconists, all of which were very much in line with Paradeus' MO. (Subject to change with translation) With evidence gathered in the "Investigation Report on the Gene Cultivation Technology of the Antarctic Union", the report alleges that a group of radical Beacon medical scholars were responsible for the "Photon Project" after the Northern Lights Incident in 2035. Although the US Biological Research Institute was initially suspected of being behind the program, its said that these Beaconist scholars were truly behind the radical treatment program in the Red Cross. The Photon Project, a radical treatment program of refugees in the fallout of the Northern Lights Incident, is revealed to have been an unethical and inhumane genetic experiment controlled by these Beaconist scholars, aiming to collect as much genetic information and immunity levels of ELID patients as possible. Then, they tested where the human samples after gene adjustment could effectively inhibit the Collapse Radiation mutant cells in patients. The worst element of this program was a human experiment that implanted genetically adjusted organs into ELID patients.

Avarice in Avernus
You may ask "where does Oberstein and Avernus fit into all of this?"; first and foremost - Witkin has alluded to Oberstein being a former Relic Agency member or associate, and the core of the UNRA were Beaconists until 2045. Many of the Prometheans had split from the UNRA years prior, but that's not to say they all left; there’s just a span of missing time between 2041 and 2045 regarding the Promethean whereabouts. The URNA officially shifted its Geneva HQ to the Hollow City in December 2041, but it's not like they removed all presence from the outside world by that point. The Photon Project's description aligns with Paradeus' MO, featuring the standard forced genetic experimentation on ELID patients in the Contaminated Zones. When Martha "Laplace" Meitner began working with Oberstein in 2051, she seemingly was inducted into 90wish or its subsequent sister group, Paradeus. We don't actually know when Paradeus came into being, but during a meal between Oberstein and Nemhran at an unknown date in the past, the latter refers to him as "Father", suggesting that he was prior leader of Paradeus. During Operation Couatl in 2051, the Daybreak Squadron discovered Avernus to be a floating skyscraper, which the text makes out to be singular, suggesting construction was still underway, with the Eastern Tower as the central control station. Strong doubts are cast on the idea that the Avernus towers could've been built and functioning before the end of the war, so it's possible - in fact, almost certain - that construction on the core towers was underway for months or years prior to the US Ranger raid; however, construction of the facility may have been underway during Daybreak’s mission. The subway in the Avernus platform is stylized with pre-war aesthetics and the logos of the UNRA, pointing towards the idea that Avernus, and possibly Paradeus itself, was built upon the concepts of the UNRA pre-war. 

As a former(?) member of the Relics Agency, possibly a former Beaconist that rejects Rossartrism today, Oberstein was said to have been under fire and held a poor reputation at the Relic Agency, so much so that he allegedly moved his family out of harm's way to lie low for a bit. As the head of the Max Planck Computational Institute, he was well-respected among his peers, but something was happening behind the scenes that Persicaria and Lycoris were unaware of, with the former suspecting something was amiss because of Oberstein’s sporadic behavior. He was apparently always in a bad mood, and around January 2049, Oberstein had relocated his family, with Lunasia and "William" seemingly having been sent to live in the Oberstein Manor in Neu-Tempelhof, Berlin. Given his former status as a Relic Agency member, then it may be possible he was formerly connected to the Beaconists and Prometheans. With his strong rejection of Rossartrism in the 2060s, he’s unlikely to be a former Promethean, unless his disposition shifted dramatically as a result of the war or the direction of his research, hypothetically turning him against his former colleagues. In a certain past incident, Oberstein's plane exploded on the tarmac in front of reporters, where he emerged from the wreckage unscathed, followed thereafter by squadrons of Paradeus troops flanking him, under orders to eliminate all witnesses. It's nearly certain Oberstein was the former head of Paradeus, which may have emerged out of 90wish, but Persicaria would've likely mentioned the logo if that were true, unless Paradeus was a compartmentalized organization within 90wish, associated with Galatea. The next piece comes from RC, where Mendo's mother is named "Helena (von) Oberstein", which is absolutely not a coincidence. Given her approximate age when Mendo was born, it's likely she arrived in the Antarctic with her parents in 2045 while still very young or being born soon after the doors closed. Her name and age would imply one of her parents, more likely her father, was an Oberstein, specifically a 7th-generation. Rudolf is the patriarch of the Oberstein family, eldest of the 7th generation, and father of Lunasia and "William"; his sibling, likely a younger brother, was likely a Beaconist who took his side of the family to Antarctica in 2045, splitting the Oberstein family for 30 years. Helena Oberstein is also noteworthy because of her appearance, almost as if Helena from GFL2 was a clone of her.

    • 
    • 
If Helena Oberstein is the original, assuming she isn’t a clone herself, then her DNA must've been applied to whatever genetic experiment led to the creation of Helena in GFL2. Assuming she was the daughter of Rudolf's sibling, that would make her Rudolf's niece and the cousin of Lunasia and "William". Furthermore, the designation embedded in GFL2 Helena's box is revealed to be E-Helena-O-43, which could represent "Experiment-Helena-Oberstein-# 43" or, more theoretically, "Helena-Oberstein-2043", representing her birth year. That would make her 25 when marrying Philip and 27 when having Mendo. Now, to connect all of this back to the beginning - the original concept for Avernus was planned by the UNRA, and the underground railyard and subterranean facilities were seemingly built pre-war by the Prometheans or external faction of Beaconists. With Oberstein's strong disposition of Rossartrism in the modern day, there’s unlikely he was ever sympathetic to Prometheanist ideals; however, we know he’s connected to Avernus in 2051, where Martha Meitner was believed to have been carrying out her Hela experiments before the war's end. Assuming that Helena's father truly was Rudolf's younger brother, then that would directly put an Oberstein among the Beaconist cause, exemplified by Helena’s family branch fleeing to Antarctica. Next, we know Rudolf was once a member of the Relics Agency, but his placement isn't known, only that he was once a member with a poor reputation. Much of the Beacon program was made up of some of the brightest minds in worldwide academia, as well as rich oligarchs that could provide capital for the development of the Antarctic Hollow. The Obersteins are among the wealthiest families in Germany, spanning at least eight generations and closely entangled in German politics and academia; they are, by definition, a true intelligentsia family. By the time Meiter began cooperating with Oberstein, the symbol of Paradeus and one of the Avernus towers had already been completed. As the head of 90wish, Oberstein was in contact with the brightest minds in all of Europe, dealing with a number of highly-confidential projects. Paradeus feasibly could’ve been formed as a secretive offshoot of 90wish or Galatea, as Paradeus’ logo was visible on Laplace's 2051 outfit.

The aesthetics of Avernus are unlike those of the subway system, but the overall design of the towers seems to have been planned by the UNRA, led by primarily Beaconists after Sir Thomas Sorrell Huxley - last director of the UNRA - directed all the URNA's effort towards the development of the Beacon Program in the wake of the Northern Lights Incident. With a probable Beaconist sibling and membership in the Relic Agency, there'd be no way for Oberstein to be unaware of the Beacon program; however, as we already know, he did not choose to go to Antarctica by 2045. Perhaps then it's possible Rudolf knew of or was attached to the alleged Beacon medical scholars responsible for the Photon Project - the forcible genetic human experiments to collect and study ELID patients for possible immunity, including the implanting of genetically adjusted organs into patients; and given his reported poor reputation, barred from entering Antarctica or chose to stay in Germany due to his nationalistic stance, instead pursuing his own research ventures in the form of 90wish/Paradeus. Moreover, knowing the UNRA's connection to Avernus, perhaps the Dead Sea was intentionally heavily polluted to conceal its location from both NATO and Pan-European forces, permanently isolating the truth behind a deadly veil of Collapse Radiation. The site was noted to have been used as a dumping ground during the war, and constructing such a smoke screen would ensure none could survive, let alone glimpse Avernus at its core. It's the perfect seclusion; no one's going to come searching a Black Zone unless they had hard evidence on someone's location. During Operation Couatl in 2051, the region was only a Red Zone, suggesting that the contamination index has steadily increased in the post-war era. Lastly, Oberstein was implied to be the original Father of Paradeus before the rise of William, and given his former role as 90wish’s head - along with the unknown, burnt letters in the fireplace - his involvement in Paradeus’ formation and progress cannot be understated. While initially sensible for Oberstein to be a former Promethean, when the pieces of Oberstein and Avernus’ pasts are assembled, there’s a few actors that stand out. It’s nigh-impossible for Helena von Oberstein to be excluded from this mystery, as her likely father would’ve been Oberstein’s younger brother, who must’ve been associated with the agency.

The crux of Oberstein’s hazy past is his colleagues, as the burnt letters revealed there to be an unknown group that wanted to poach Meitner for their own “plan”, possibly related to the later Hela Project. Paradeus’ has its origins going back decades, seemingly formed by Oberstein and an unknown group sometime before or during World War III. It seems exceedingly unlikely that Meitner and Oberstein could've built the first tower, even partially, in the short timeframe between their collaboration and Operation Couatl. It's on the order of a few months at most, and they'd be building in the heart of the Red Zone in wartime. There's always a possibility that the Dead Sea was purposefully contaminated to cover up its construction during the late-war period, possibly starting after January 2049; however, Avernus was clearly built upon the plans put forth by the UNRA, consisting mostly of Beaconists after the 2035 Northern Lights Incident, so Oberstein and his partners must’ve known about the UNRA site somehow. If Oberstein and whoever he'd been working with, possibly an early manifestation of Paradeus, had already graduated to depraved acts that followed the known modus operandi, then it's possible they could've been responsible for the Berlin Metropolitan School attack in 2050. There’s little precedent for this, nor is there a particularly solid reason why they’d carry out such an operation; however, the incident was downplayed, as parents were hushed and information limited across the internet, so it’s worth creating a cross section of potential suspects and the history of Paradeus. It’s far too circumstantial to be evidence, but the fact it occurred in Berlin - Paradeus’ future stronghold, when Oberstein, already working with an unknown group that’s likely tied to Avernus’ construction, was rising to prominence - is notable. With the family’s credible connections to the UNRA, it’s possible that Oberstein staunchly denied going to the Antarctic or had been rejected, instead working with a number of post-Isolation Relic Agency members to occupy the URNA’s former, possibly confidential, Relic research facility underneath what’s today the Dead Sea.

Relic Fields & The MB-13-A Incident
As for Avernus’ ability to float, apart from obvious Relic technology, an answer may come in the form of Lycoris’ dissertation to the Ministry of Industry in Izhevsk. Submitted in May 2049, Lycoris’ “Principles of Automatic Control in a Relic Quantum Gravity System” introduces commendable, yet considerably worrying data to explain the nature of Relics - namely, the “Collapse Technology Quantized Gravitation Field”, a subject of much debate across Relicology. Stemming back to 2041 through 2043, the Leipzig University of Karl Marx Doll robot control system optimization project team had discovered the former 90Wunsch data from Urkunde-01, hidden deep within the university’s archives, and Lycoris, who spent months toiling over what seemed to the untrained eye as gibberish, had determined there was a particular logic to 90Wunsch’s data. While still in 90wish in 2049, Lycoris completed his dissertation, offering a hypothesis on the gravitational phenomena and the origin of 90Wunsch’s recorded signals intelligence. He postulated that the field was the response from the Relic itself, referring to Urkunde-01, or the greater Relic system, colloquially Nirvana. Through analysis of the signal data, he determined the Relic as an unimaginably complex automatic control system, and the emitted ternary signals recorded by 90Wunsch originated from the internal control circuit of the system, possibly Nirvana as a whole or the Source. Of course, he knew nothing of the intricacies of Nirvana and the Source, however, the signal data was evidence enough of such a network. He believed that duplicating or simulating the system was impossible, but that may not necessarily be true, given the USRA and Paradeus’ Nirvana simulation. What this doesn’t answer, however, is the Source, the origin consciousness, entity, or reality of all OGAS consciousnesses. The detected emitted signals could’ve been the OGAS instances left in limbo or the Source itself, regardless of its identity. Furthermore, the Source is the origin consciousness of all OGAS instances, so it makes sense for the sprouting of these minds to represent a “simulation” of the Relic system in our reality. Although Lycoris understood little, if any, of this wider subject, he recognized the possibility to comprehend and control the mathematical model and control theories of the system, serving as the dissertation’s subject.

Lycoris’ submission quickly caught the eye of the Ministry of Industry, even making it to the brass of the Ministry of Defence and Ministry of Internal Affairs. It didn’t take long for him to be summoned to the Dean’s office, presumably to discuss the experimental data’s origin and potential. That same month, it even made it to Bureau Chief Zelinsky’s desk, who immediately fretted and ordered a thorough investigation upon reading. It was so concerning, in fact, that Zelinsky requested a report on the author’s background, relevant experts from the First Directorate and Signals (modern StateSec equivalent of the KGB 16th Directorate?), and a secure line to Mikhail Tsvigun, as there was a significant possibility of a Relic technology leak. Apart from the author, anyone with information on the report or close to the author needed to be controlled, as any violation of the Relics Treaty would necessitate extreme measures in the NUSSR. In the past, anyone who operated outside authority and violated these rules were put to death. While there’s no direct connection, and Relic technology-derived engines had already been created, perhaps Avernus’ is suspended through a similar phenomenon described in his essay. During Polarized Light, controlled emissions from the Relic triggered localized gravitational anomalies, probably caused by Reverse Collapse phenomena, flinging several combatants into the air, including one of the KCCO’s Assault Artillery(AA)-02 units. It’s a weak theory that could be pieced apart easily; however, the data for this research was discovered before WWIII, so it’s possible it was essential to Avernus’ construction, presumably through the late 2040s. Unlike the pre-war construction in the underground facility, Avernus itself, the twin towers and the island at their base, have the familiar Paradeus motif of elaborately glossy whites, contrasted by black. As serious as Lycoris’ essay was, it was nothing to the wider leak of Relic technology unfolding in Germany.

To be direct, all of the following is very speculative. The identity of Oberstein’s group in the  burnt letters remains enigma, but Oberstein’s relation to events proposes three primary suspects: one, a faction among the Relic Agency, seemingly not the Prometheans, however, they cannot be vindicated, especially considering their exit from the Relic Agency after the Northern Lights Incident; two, a compartmentalized wing of 90wish under the guise of Oberstein; or three, a certain Relic department in [REDACTED], described in the Shattered Connexion intelligence [“MB-13-A”] document as a highly controversial department that pushed for Relic weapon R&D, which ended in the imprisonment of [REDACTED] and the further execution of sixteen related personnel. Many of the specific names and groups are redacted in the aforementioned document; however, noteworthy is the department’s interest in secondary Relic weapon technology, as the only other organization post-war that holds any interest is Paradeus, which has manufactured a number of Relic technology-derived weapons and equipment.

The number of executions, too, is particularly notable, as sixteen is the same number of recorded cases of the Lunasia clones attacking Griffin-controlled sectors in 2060, but that number could be much higher. It’s harping on a mute point, but it seems too specific to be coincidental or just lazy for that number to appear twice; then again, discrepancies exist in the dates, so perhaps the connection is over-analyzed. What does stick out, however, is that a group of high-ranking officers, which may have included General Carter Petrovich Neustadt, remained interested in Relic weapons long after the Soviet government’s enforcement of that unknown department. It’s said the Pike Node delivered to Sangvis Ferri prior to the Butterfly Incident had been “deliberately leaked by a certain department in [REDACTED]”, and the events of Chapter 10 and Singularity revolve around William and Carter’s plan to recover the mature OGAS from M4 and Elisa’s OGAS coalescence. So, the existence of an unknown department involved in secondary Relic weapon technology would certainly align with Oberstein and his unknown group, especially when considering Oberstein’s probable familial connections to the UNRA and ties to the Holy Grail and Hela Projects under Blackwell and Meitner. Surely a stretch, but there’s questions to be asked about the project the unknown department in MB-13-A were working on, including if it had any relation to Oberstein and Meitner’s Hela Project. Similarly, it’s entirely possible that “Paradeus”, or its precursor, even predated 90wish, with the group of radical Beacon medical scholars - responsible for the Photon Project immune experiments, which followed Father’s own creation or discovery of an immune - revealed to be this precursor group; however, this could be picked apart by the simple fact that much of Antarctic Relic Agency and institutes had been taken over by those sympathetic to their studies.

The Gospel of Sana - 2051


In the United States Relic Agency, the "Holy Grail" project members were attempting to study Nirvana through replication and simulation of the Relic system, as forced Relic activations were not yet possible, nor how it could potentially be achieved. Professor Martha Meitner and Gray Blackwell were members of this project, with Blackwell being the creator of the surgical procedure and overall system. Meitner and Blackwell, along with other members, would extract memory-consciousness from the recently deceased, then transfer it to the "Lake of Cognition" system. This system is divided into three layers, like a Doll: the Nyto Consciousness, the Virtual Cognition Image, and the Lake of Cognition. It's not abundantly clear whether or not these names originated from the original Holy Grail project in the US or the subsequent experiments from 2051 onwards.

Demonic Communion
When Oberstein approached Meitner in the Berlin lounge, a friendly relationship seemed to grow from them sharing a drink. In the burnt letters discovered by Fe56 in the Avernus project area, Oberstein and his colleagues tagged Meitner’s potential value for their unknown plans, and we know Oberstein must’ve made an enticing cooperation offer that piqued her interest, seeing as “their” plan was relevant to her desire of reactivating the Holy Grail to resurrect Sana. Notably, the name “Martha” likely derives from one of Lazarus’ sisters, the man who Jesus arose from death four days later. A few weeks or months after first meeting in the lounge, Meitner met Oberstein again on the tarmac, having just disembarked her flight to Berlin. 

Meanwhile, Judge, who had followed the warmth in the Avernus project area, was listening in on Oberstein and Meitner’s meeting through a monitor in a cramped apartment. Had it not been for the context of the conversation, this apartment was seemingly nothing more than a dense Berlin apartment, but the present surveillance equipment point to someone monitoring or wiretapping Oberstein, possibly the Stasi or another group during WWIII. It’s possible this could’ve just been his colleagues or Paradeus’ surveillance room, perhaps connected to the Bee Sting System, but if not, major candidates would include: the GDR Stasi, reformed sometime after separatist forces broken away from the FRG, who would later go on to investigate Paradeus in the future; Soviet StateSec, who have always kept a tight leash on Relic technologies, given the overtly destructive potential; the Prometheans, who could’ve been monitoring former UNRA Beaconists, questioning why they remained in-country; or the Americans, possibly the Central Intelligence Agency, who theoretically could’ve picked up Meitner’s trail after leaving the NUSSR - after all, both the Americans and the Soviets must’ve learned of “Laplace’s” existence before Operation Couatl in 2051. Tangentially, the Americans and Soviets believed that the former Relic Agency scientist “Laplace”, codenamed “Capita” was actually a “him”, so perhaps whoever was monitoring Oberstein had falsely believed that the man was responsible.


Rudolf von Oberstein meets Martha Meitner after landing in Berlin Airport - 2051.

At the airport, Meitner shook his hand and accepted the cooperation offer; however, the purpose and conditions of which have been obfuscated by the stretch of lost time. With silent approval, Oberstein nodded, and a ground crew began offloading Meitner’s special cargo. Interestingly, Meitner flew in with a box freezer, which probably preserved Sana’s remains, as the brain seemingly cannot be damaged or decayed if it’s meant for the Holy Grail. Soon after, Blackwell and Meitner reactivated the Holy Grail project, striving to bring Sana back. Although not directly stated, the subject of the cooperation seems to have been Oberstein, along with his unknown colleagues, organizing a successor project to the American’s Holy Grail, but his reasoning for doing so is shrouded in mystery, tied together with Lunasia von Oberstein’s death. During the initial period of working with Blackwell again, Sana’s remains successfully underwent the Holy Grail procedure. Gray was able to extract Sana’s memories and embed them into the Lake of Cognition; however, a flaw in the design had consistently impeded their efforts: memories could freely move between the three levels of consciousness, making it near impossible to stabilize the implanted memories in place. This was the pivotal issue their Holy Grail could not overcome, stalling them until Sana’s brain was completely biologically dead, and only through the creation of a new device would they begin working again. 

The Holy Grail System

The surface of the Lake of Cognition.

Before 2047, one of the United States Relic Agency's core research areas was that of "Nirvana", more specifically, the study and replication of it. Also known as the Human Connectome Project - or coquially, the “Holy Grail”, this project aimed to explore the impact of the Relic Civilization on humanity, specifically **** (Nirvana?). Its lead researcher and investigator was one of JHU and the USRA’s greatest minds, Professor Martha Meitner. Believed to have been created during the original Holy Grail Project in the USRA, the Holy Grail is a simulation of Nirvana in the form of a "Lake" that exists somewhere, possibly outside space-time. Although there are nodes that can access the Lake, there doesn’t seem to be a physical storage device or location, as if it exists in a separate realm or in a layer imperceptible to the human mind. Consciousness is key to this Lake, hence its name - the "Lake of Cognition". In the project, the surgical procedure of the same name is performed to extract the memories of the recently-deceased and transfer them to the Lake of Cognition, where they live on as stray memories, floating in the infinite, watery abyss. It's not explained how exactly the subject's consciousness is extracted and implanted into the Lake, but the subject’s brain mustn't be biologically dead, given implications that a brain that has completely died is unusable. By 2064, it doesn't seem as if the subject has to be recently-deceased but in a near-death state. As the body begins shutting down and dying on a biological level, the procedure extracts their memory-consciousness before total brain death is reached, but the bodies of many subjects can still reject the procedure, leading to them suffering major injury or expiring from the extensive trauma.

There are three primary layers of consciousness in the system: the Nyto Consciousness, the conscious mind of an individual with memories from the Lake; the Virtual Cognition Image, the Nyto subconscious, where information is stored and communicated, similar to a neural cloud’s LVLII; and the base layer of consciousness for all those who undergo the operation - the Lake of Cognition, the origin of memories for all Nytos’ consciousnesses. The three-level system was based on reason, emotion, and instinct, respectively. The Nyto Consciousness is represents the conscious self, where reason and logic dictates action; the VCI represents the subconscious mind, where information is processed and interpreted through emotions; and the Lake of Cognition, the bottom layer of all Nytos, represents instinct, serving as the origin of self - a space of deterministic seeds, like the alaya-vijnana, that constitute one’s self. What isn’t explained is the origin of these words, especially “Nyto”. Although the Lake was most likely created before 2047, the vague history leaves us to guess if these terms - NC, VCI, and LoS - originated from the USRA or by Meitner and Blackwell in 2051. The term “Nyto” is a portmanteau of the words “Nyarlathotep” - a prominent and malevolent entity that first appeared in H.P. Lovecraft’s poem of the same name - and “Tyto”, the genus of owls. Regardless if the three named layers of Nyto consciousness originate in the United States Relic Agency or the former friends in 2051, the history of Nytos extends further in the past than any could’ve expected. In this sojourn for false immortality, a new species is birthed - created from the depths of a simulated sea of thoughts, never again to recognize one’s self in the mirror.

The true goal of the USRA Holy Grail Project is uncertain, but Blackwell’s expressed mention of it being a “Human Connectome” project points to the study of human connections, possibly shared consciousness, i.e. a collective unconscious.
