Moreover, what “research” was he working on in Lunasia’s twilight days, when he would’ve only been an elementary schooler at the oldest? Now, it’s fair to say he simply was a young child enthralled by science, possibly influenced by his father’s work, inspiring him at a young age to become inquisitive about the world he was just starting to comprehend. What this doesn’t explain, however, is how a child gained such a position in 90wish, along with that enigmatic pseudonym, “William”. Returning to the car ride with Witkin and Persicaria, the latter explained that when she and Lycoris refused to go through with “Professor William’s” request, he erupted, even going so far as to vaguely threaten them for their rejection. Unaware of his true identity, Persiciara believed he must’ve cared a great deal for Lunasia, and without their help, he lost his cards at the first beginning; however, this wasn’t the end of his hand - a hand he’d play to perfection in 2057, one aimed at exploiting Persicaria’s curiosity and Lycoris’ ambition. But what is his pseudonym’s origin?

While Witkin, in line with Persicaria and Lycoris back then, questioned if the man was actually Minister Oberstein, Persicaria was doubtful due to his expressed opposition to the relevant technologies. The greatest rebuttal to this assumption is Oberstein’s indirect involvement in Lunasia’s death, likely at the hands of Meitner or his anonymous colleagues, as he personally had two men drag Lunasia from manor and into the black limousine, never to be seen again. Although the reasoning is yet to be explained, he told Lunasia that it was a necessary sacrifice, one that apparently was worth the mutilation of his own child. Without any clue who “William” was, Persicaria had discreetly dug into Max Planck’s archives, and within there was nothing but a single lead. There was once a researcher named “William” whose name had been removed from most records, barring what she’d found. With nothing else to go on, this researcher was her best guess, despite a difficult caveat. The researcher Wiliam had no connection to Lunasia that she knew of, and Witkin’s following comments surely didn’t support her theory; however, we cannot confirm the validity of Witkin’s testimony. The researcher was her prime suspect, but Witkin added that they - likely Witkin, Zelinsky, Griffin, and the Prometheans - had reviewed him beforehand. 

In his later call to who we presume to be Sir Griffin Lyons, he mentioned that much of Persicaria’s testimony aligned with and verified their speculations. During Fixed Point, it’s made abundantly clear that Griffin and his associates wished to bring William under their control, with Perosa mentioning in Mirror Stage that Sir was greatly impressed by William’s technical skill. Such is the case of William’s technology - a jar of blood-soaked power that everyone wanted a piece of, even if all the evils contained within were unleashed upon the world. Furthermore, in the [MB-2-A] document, possessing the same naming scheme as [MB-13-A], the author wrote in the report that securing and mastering the former Soviet Union’s OGAS system was paramount to “our long-cherished wish” towards success of Project [REDACTED]. It can be declared with near certainty that the author(s) of the MB-X-A classified internal documents are the Prometheans or closely associated with them. Although it’s old canon, the Rossartrist Union of the original Bakery Girl universe introduced a worldwide economic AI to automatically manage the global economy, serving as the basis of Rossartrist economics in the new world order. Likewise, the author(s) of [MB-2-A] have pledged their support towards a Project, adding that the OGAS System was an essential “key” to their wish. When Project Prometheus was drafted in 2030 by Rossartre, he concluded with, quote, “Our wish can only be realized through a new order.” 


Sir Griffin Lyons’ file in Paradeus’ Bee Sting System.

Although he’d never live to see it, Rossartre’s Promethean loyalists carried on this dream through WWIII, preserving humanity's embers in the darkness. Indeed, the ultimate dream of Rossartre and his supporters is the foundation of a global, world-class government, and what better way to manage the resources of this new world’s economy than the inclusion of hyper-advanced intelligence, derived from the Relic system? Given OGAS likely isn’t the Prometheans’ sole desire from Paradeus, William’s offering of supreme power to those most befitting, along with the all-pervasive Bee Sting System, are as enticing as ever to those seeking the establishment of a new world based on meritocratic order, one that enforced unity amongst humanity. “Those who cause division must be punished. Those who help each other must be rewarded.” This is Griffin’s honest truth; unlike Rossartre, he is no idealist, as the only way to ensure social unity in Rossartre’s envisioned future was order written with stabilizing, behavior-shaping guidelines. As Griffin put it, “Idealism cannot help us build an ideal world.” Indeed, only the idealistic would be foolish enough to believe humanity - after so much impoverishment, turmoil, and bloodshed - would collectively agree to the new world order. Regardless of opinions on Rossartre’s vision, it was inevitably going to be corrupted by an authoritarian power to maintain stability. And by poaching William into their cause, they glimpsed a demon’s power - a power that commanded all to their knees, leading them towards a new future, even if it unknowingly came at the cost of the world’s destruction. By Reverse Collapse, William has been fully inducted into the URNC, serving as a leading researcher in both the Ministry of Science and Technology and a Warsaw-based military-scientific R&D laboratory. With such respectable intellect, he’s ascended to a professional academic in biology, genetics, and vestigial sciences.

William’s exceptional character can be described as nothing less than genius, enough to attract the world's attention, forsaking everything for Lunasia’s sake in the process. His involvement in Nyto creation, particularly Morridow, given he personally performed her surgery in Fixed Point; the development of the Iaso Box WMDs, devastating devices meant to artificially time the blooming period of the epiphyllums, effectively turning them into controllable radiological weapons; and a supremely forward-thinking mind, capable of orchestrating plans on the order of years with such precision it bridges superhuman, going beyond to play to one’s weaknesses to set the course for an unavoidable chain of events - albeit, this may be explained with the involvement of Oberstein, Meitner, and Paradeus’ other researchers - all greatly demonstrate this enigmatic figure, shrouded in a veil of false identities and dubious origins. But this demon did not spawn from nothing. Assuming Lunasia and “William” truly are Oberstein’s children, then who was the man believed to be the origin of the pseudonym? 

When the Prometheans first heard of the OGAS System’s potential, it became obvious its securement was a obligatory part of their agenda, and William’s expertise in the field, along with the power offered by him that would eclipse the world, the desire towards poaching him likely was acquired over time. When Persicaria delved for answers on the pseudonym, all she found was a false lead, someone the Prometheans had already determined was not the man they were after, but his name made all the difference in discovering the heart of this well-kept Relic secret. As Witkin put it, no ordinary researcher could so totally manipulate intelligence to erase his trail; however, one such man had the power to do so - Rudolf von Oberstein, the director of the same institute as the researcher William and believed to be the first Father of Paradeus. Allegedly, the researcher died several years before Lunasia, then all information on him was purged, “as if he had never existed.” Assuming Witkin is telling the truth and his colleagues’ findings are correct, then someone, likely Oberstein, seized William’s identity after his death or, possibly, murder, using it as a pseudonym to dissociate their name from any official works, ensuring total isolation of self from potentially leaked or exposed information. Furthermore, Lunasia's brother would go on to join Paradeus, eventually succeeding his father as the Father, and yet, all this time, the pseudonym of “Professor William” hasn’t changed. We’re not entirely sure of Oberstein’s role in his partnership with Meitner, nor is it known how William consolidated his position; though, it’s possible that Oberstein bestowed the false identity to his son while he was still very young, possibly in service of keeping his close family confidential. On the other hand, if the original researcher William wasn’t actually dead - instead, faking his death and disappearing, with Oberstein likely flexing his muscles to cover it up. Even if his son was always planned to be his successor, it doesn’t explain William's unusual circumstances around the time of Lunasia’s death.

Presumably in 2051, when William came to visit Lunasia in the manor’s garden, she commented that he need not worry for her and that he should go do what he wished. As said, it could just be the curiosity of a young child, but there’s precedence for William’s involvement in 90wish in the years following Lunasia’s death. His keen obsession with the queen-of-the-night epiphyllum species unnerved his colleagues, and there was no bearing of Oberstein or Meitner ever having an interest in the subject, barring the Cocoon Plan, which Oberstein might’ve known about. William would’ve only been a few years old in 2051, yet he had his own research, later evolving into an obsession over the flowers and Relics. As said, how could a simple, young child be a professor, let alone command such respect among the brightest minds in Europe? Given his father was - and perhaps, still is - the head of 90wish, assuming 90wish isn’t just a precursor or an arm of Paradeus, nepotism easily would’ve provided a pathway for William to enter, but he’d still be single digits in age by the time the data block was sent to Lycoris and Persicaria, even younger still when working in 90wish. Nothing adds up for Lunasia’s brother to be “William”, leaving few potential theories to go on about who “William” was in the 2050s and how he rose to the title of Father.

Most in line with Occam’s Razor is that “William” in 90wish simply wasn’t Lunasia’s brother. The one major issue that almost negates this idea, though, is that Lunasia’s brother certainly had an interest in science and his interest in cultivating epiphyllums is absolute. During the Hela cooperation, Meitner was specifically chosen by Oberstein and his colleagues as the prime candidate to support their plans, which landed her the position of one of Paradeus’ elite researchers. Although Meitner was referred to by the pseudonyms “Laplace” and “Avernus Hela”, she could’ve applied the William pseudonym to herself when dealing with 90wish, using a voice modulator to cloak her female voice; however, there’s no evidence of Meitner ever interacting with 90wish, just an assumption formed based on Paradeus’ ambiguous origins. In 2051, USASWC had targeted the former Relic Agency scientist “Laplace”, codenamed Capita, in a decapitation operation into the Dead Sea, but according to Aliana, Capita was reportedly male, given her expressed mention of “him” in context of the target. 90wish had participated in Relic research, so maybe some groups, hypothetically the Soviets and Americans in this instance, caught wind of the illegal research and delved further into all those connected, coming to the false belief of Laplace being male after a series of surveillance operations, possibly related to the monitoring room witnessed by Judge in the Avernus projection area. Likewise, it’s known that Meitner, and likely Oberstein as well, had eventually turned to using the former’s students for the Hela Project or to sustain the Evangel Axis, something so profoundly evil that Blackwell assailed her; therefore, it’s feasible Blackwell could’ve escaped retribution and disclosed the details to relevant agencies, which in turn, potentially designated Laplace as a potentially wanted war criminal by both sides. The greatest issue with this idea, though, is that Blackwell would’ve known that Laplace was female, as that name was nothing more than the pseudonym in their letters. It’s more likely that an investigation into Oberstein, his colleagues, or Paradeus as a whole led to Daybreak and Anna’s squadron believing the target was male, with whoever was responsible lacking widespread evidence.

Oberstein went to horrific ends to achieve Paradeus’ plan, seemingly sacrificing Lunasia to the Hela procedure, and it’s possible that, after Persicaria and Lycoris left the city, Oberstein experienced an internal moral change, explaining Persicaria’s initial doubts due to his strong opposition to unethical research. Though, like Meitner, he could’ve always nurtured that willingness somewhere deep within him, awaiting its sprout. Witkin could’ve been lying or twisting the truth somewhat, but antithetical to his claim that Oberstein was free of suspicion is his very role as head of Paradeus, using his and his colleagues’ influence to wipe any trace from the records. We know he was under much fire and censure in the 2040s, including a poor reputation at the Relics Department/Agency; unclear if this is the UNRA, the Relic Department described in [MB-13-A], or another faction. Even if “William” was a pseudonym used by Meitner or Oberstein in 90wish, it lacks definitiveness; however, it’s possible that “William” was another, so-far unstated member of 90wish or Paradeus, possibly even the original William himself, having faked his death if this is accurate. If “William” was someone else, or even the original William, then it throws a new tangent into the fold, with Meitner and Oberstein as nothing but red herrings. It’s known that Paradeus has additional human scientists and researchers, and Galatea seems to be the organization’s primary front, with its pharmaceutical and biotechnology divisions having direct ties to major Nytos or figures in Paradeus. During Slow Shock, on the surgical floor of Avernus, a Nyto requested “Dr. Harvey” report to room 6 to confirm Subject #6’s condition, however, the Doctor’s identity is never expanded upon. This comment obviously wasn’t referring to Meitner, but there’s no mention of any other surgeon or doctor in Avernus, apart from William or Lady Gray, both of which cannot be this person. In recent years, Paradeus had expanded its sphere of influence to several well-respected professionals, including the later-introduced Dr. Eugene Rugosa and Dr. Arthur Hume.



Dr. Eugene Rugosa aboard the Intercontinental Train “Future” - October~ 2064

Another idea is considerably more esoteric than the previous; putting it bluntly, Lunasia or William are not Oberstein’s blood children. There’s near-zero evidence for this, apart from some circumstantially possible information, yet could easily be refuted with the simplest information. Without Oberstein as their father, who was their father by blood? In 2022, Russian Relicologist and academic Mikhail “Old Misha” Tsivgun joined a special Relic research discussion hosted at Poznan University, and following his discussion, he was approached by Viktor Zelinsky, still a young mathematics student from the University of Warsaw, who probed Tsvigun with a plethora of questions about the 1981 Khyber Pass Pike Operation - the series’ most detailed account of Relic weapons in warfare. Mikhail led the 1981 operation under the operational pseudonym “Borikin”, later earning him the Order of the Red Star, given his role as one of the chief academics of the USSR’s OGAS project, directed by Viktor Glushkov. In the New Union of Soviet Socialist Republics Character Profiles, a so-far unreleased - therefore, technically noncanon - document covering major figures of the NUSSR, Mikhail’s file is present with an additional paragraph excluded from the official Confidential Files 2 “A Brief History of the Development of Relic Weapons in the Cold War”, one potentially unveiling the truth behind Mikhail’s unusual aging. Given the CF2 section omits this paragraph, remember to be skeptical of the following. 

Within, it’s said that Tsvigun contracted ELID in January 1984 after years of frequent contact with Relic technology in his research, his health quickly deteriorating in just three months, resulting in him being unable to continue his duties. Just when it seemed that death was irreversibly ticking closer, a bizarre turnaround occurred during the fourth month, wherein his condition rapidly improved within three weeks. At the time, ELID was considered a death sentence by most that contracted it, and with the lack of medical information on its disease vectors and treatment, the ELID crisis of the 1980s was only exacerbated. His absurd recovery made waves in the system as rumors spread, with some even theorizing he wasn’t of this world; this was dismissed as obvious hearsay - though there certainly remains questions about his sudden recovery. In the times since, he’s been found to be mostly immune to Collapse Radiation, and the serum extracted from his body later served as the basis for the Phase II (middle-stage) ELID vaccine. None of this directly answers Mikhail’s unusual aging, given his current age of 111/113 years old; however, there’s evidence of ELID affecting aging - albeit, inversely to Tsvigun’s condition. After Gorman Weyland arrived at the D-2 Relic Site during the 11th Lady Liberty experiment, the associated report mentioned the rapid onset of geriatric wrinkles and crows’ feet, along with the general collapse of his molecular system as his DNA proteins were decomposing. Although the opposite occurred with Mikhail, the core difference was their conditions, given that Weyland was not immune. Many are unable to physically survive the DNA chain recombination stage of ELID, and Weyland was no different, succumbing to the infection 61 hours after exiting the submarine. According to documents on immunes, particularly Kawasaki Kazusa, the authors believed these subjects possessed a natural antibody that, with the exception of a burst of high-intensity Collapse Radiation, eliminated ELID-mutated cells faster than these cells would undergo mitosis, effectively excising all mutant cells from the body. Unlike Kazusa, however, prior partial-immunes - such as Machlian, the Commander, and, possibly, Lunasia and Tsvigun - are able to survive in non-contaminated environments, so what truly causes the unusual aging?

Perhaps in those that share compatibility with the Relic Civilization, in the form of immune individuals, exposure to Collapse Radiation inadvertently slows the body’s metabolism; this is rather nondescript and doesn’t quite satisfy the question, though. Although we cannot say for certain that Mikhail’s alleged partial-immunity is the root of his anomalous aging, there’s no other direct lead to pursue, unless he secretly involved himself with some hypothetical Relic biotechnology. During his 30s throughout the 1980s, Mikhail insisted his younger colleagues refer to him informally, as if he wished to keep the appearance of a youthful colleague. By the turn of the millenium, he had reserved himself to teaching encryption, his forte, at the FSB Academy, but in the age where time showed its obvious scars, there was an obvious dichotomy between him - now in his 50s - and his similarly-aged colleagues, some of whom even recognized his noticeably younger appearance, forcing him to properly disguise himself. At some point in the late 2010s or early 2020s, Mikhail had children with his former wife; however, after their divorce, the children stayed with the mother, with Mikhail seemingly encouraging his children to have their surnames changed. As one of the most respected and highly-placed Relicologists worldwide, there was always potential for pushback on him or his family, similar to what likely occurred to Oberstein the 2040s, so maybe he requested their names be changed to keep them from harm’s way. What is perhaps more relevant is the chance of his aging anomaly and possible partial-immunity being genetically passed down, which surely would’ve riled intrigue among certain parties. If this is the case, then the protection of his children from outside factors, such as the aforementioned researchers and possible opponents, justified his encouragement. And this worry wouldn’t go unfounded. During the evacuation of Japan, Rossartre spoke one-on-one with Kazusa, who feared she’d be nothing more than a lab rat after escaping; later, in the UNRA Beaconist Photon Project, the scholars went to reprehensible ends to collect and study genetic material of ELID patients, then testing if genetically-adjusted human cells could effectively inhibit the mitosis of ELID-mutated cells; and today, Paradeus seeks the the perfect individual, an immune paramount to William’s overarching plan towards the new world and the resurrection of Lunasia, possibly an immune herself. 

As for the mother, we know nothing, but all of this speculation was directed towards the identity of these children. As a Russian national since the days of the Federation, it’d make sense for his wife to have lived in Russia, knowing the language and culture thoroughly. Do not take the following as fact, rather, speculation with loose connective threads. By 2064, Nemhran was the chief-of-station for Paradeus’ clandestine outpost in Moscow, serving as tactical operations center for their international intelligence gathering and surveillance. Here, Paradeus puppeteered behind the scenes to orchestrate the Fireworks Incident, running counter-intelligence operations against the MoD and Western Military District’s forces with the aid of plants, including Colonel Dupieux of StateSec’s First Main Directorate. Nemhran obviously wasn’t acting alone, but she exiled to Moscow for this task and William’s own wishes; so, wouldn’t someone of such importance and status to the station be fluent in Russian and understand the nation’s culture? It’s true that Russian is a crucial lingua franca, especially in the current post-war order, so all of this could simply be explained away by having an intelligent Nyto knowing the language relevant to their work. And yet, it sparks discussion over Nemhran’s mysterious background; little is written on her character, even less so on her background, with our only lead is her serving a motherly role over William and Nyto Sana. 

It’s yet to be revealed if Nemhran is a synthesized Nyto impersonation or the original mother, having undergone considerable cybernetic augmentations. In Fixed Point, Nemhran named her new underling Nyto that replaced the recently-discombobulated Susanna, “Olga”, said by Nemhran to be a Russian name; then, when she returned from Moscow to Avernus, she brought along a marguerite flower for Sana - a favorite among all Muscovite girls. Although the threads possess slack, much of Nemhran’s character relates to Russia - her position as chief-of-station in Moscow, her naming schemes for Nytos, and the flowers grown in Moscow - and the potential of a Russian background. It’s not actually known how Oberstein and Nemhran, assuming that’s her actual name, met and were wed, later supposedly having Lunasia and William in the 2030s to 2040s. But what if Nemhran, hypothetically, already had both of them prior to William’s approximate birth year? There’s no evidence of such, but to entertain the concept of Lunasia’s possible immunity and Nemhran’s peculiar connection to Russia, what if the children’s father was actually Mikhail Tsvigun? Nemhran would take these kids, their identities kept a secret, into a new marriage with Rudolf von Oberstein, becoming their step-father. If Mikhail’s traits could be passed on, then it implies that both children are potentially partial-immune and aging slower; interestingly, these traits also have some measure of crossover with Oberstein’s children. Assuming the M4-Lunasia entity wasn’t manufacturing an entirely fictional scenario, then William’s praise of his sister indicates to her possessing some level of immunity, and if deprived of a contaminated environment as a full immune, she would’ve began to suffer from the same fate that would’ve befelled Kazusa, regardless. In William’s case, perhaps the explanation for his young age could truly be described as somewhat “paranormal”, given his body has been physically aging slower from birth, enabling him to leapfrog in intellect while his body ages at a fraction of the norm. Perhaps “Professor William” truly was Lunasia’s brother all along, not necessarily as a true child, but depending on personal perspective, a genius trapped in a cursed or blessed body, granting him “all the time in the world”, as he put it during Operation Butterfly.


The Pike Node entombed beneath Belgrade Fortress.

While little more than speculation, after Lycoris passed away during the Butterfly Incident, a mysterious voice believed to be that of William’s was heard through a transmission to M16A1. After realizing that Lycoris had an ace up his sleeve in the form of deleting several of Elisa’s base codes, inhibiting her ability to resonate with the Pike Node. He’d deleted the necessary authorizations originally part of the OGAS System, dooming her developed OGAS consciousness neural cloud to be unable to fully activate the Relics. When Elisa had initially responded in the months or years leading up to Operation Butterfly, Lycoris - a lifelong atheist - feared what he’d created trespassed into God’s domain, and the observed resonance eventually sparked a revelation that the Pike Node was a trap put in place by “William”, hoping Lycoris would extract the Node’s core OGAS algorithms, then implant them into Elisa. Unlike Elisa - whose OGAS neural cloud underwent a partial evolution towards optimization after connecting to the Pike Node in Belgrade, the base layers of the AR Team’s neural clouds have remained intact, and through M4A1’s creation as a 1:1 recreation of the clone data, it seems that Lunasia’s brainscan was particularly relevant to the cultivation of OGAS consciousnesses. The insufficiency of Nytos and Dolls to qualify as “Lunasia” is most telling, and considering all of Paradeus’ research from Oberstein and Meitner’s collaboration to William’s OGAS conspiracy has been directed at Relic activation, Occam’s Razor suggests key to Lunasia’s soul, returning her true self to this world, opens the gates to Nirvana and the Source.

The Brave New World
What does it mean to be the progenitor of a new world, where the Old World is abandoned in exchange for a one built upon foundations of avarice, tenacity, and bloodshed by those who’ve forsaken everything - their morals, ethics, even their families - towards materializing this new order? Paradeus is Latin for “Prepare for God” or “(for) God, you prepare”, possibly meaning prepare for a coming day of divinity, where God - be it a literal divine Creator or a metaphor for a world-eclipsing power that forces all to bend the knee - will forge the world’s future. Perhaps Paradeus are its harbingers, responsible for orchestrating humanity, or those in its domain, to prepare for the day of humanity’s transcendence from the ephemeral into eternal “godhood” through the Relics, built or placed there by ethereal ancients. The Relics and Nirvana hold limitless potential, even instilling religious fear in those that reject theology; such was the case with Lycoris, who grew anxious of his creation’s resonance with the technologies of these ancients. If humanity is to ever harness this potential, old human identity and the order that upholds it may have to be abandoned, as any errant fool could wield “collapse and reconstruction, disintegration and rebirth”, as foretold by the Voices of Nirvana. Both William and Nyto Gray have criticized the self-righteous, selfish people and the powers that be, and as William said in Fixed Point, he is a creator using his research to alter the status quo, aiming to reshape what he views as the world’s “wrongness”; towards this end, he’s claimed to be creating a world-eclipsing power, bestowed only to those most befitting, that’ll bring about this change. 

Contrasting his father, who seemingly sacrificed his daughter for his own interest and remains a staunch anti-Rossartrist nationalist, William seeks to change, possibly desiring a world that “benefits” his view of the natural human order - an order that may finally allow for humanity to wield the Relics with their intended respect, even if Paradeus has committed various atrocities in the name of progress. When Nemhran entered William’s room later in Fixed Point, she promised him that all was going to plan, and soon the world would hear his voice, likely hinting at the old world order politicians and bureaucrats, possibly including Griffin and the Prometheans, as they had taken notice of Paradeus’ capacity, unable to ignore the demonic allure infused with its potential. William’s promised power was the key to overturn the world, enough to force the old to bend the knee with his new-found influence. Later during Operation Aeneas, RO635 discovered Angelia after her consciousness had temporarily escaped the Lake back to her body, where she immediately left an encoded message in the Aeneas Conference Room for the Commander. The message was divided into two parts, the latter half encrypted behind a password that only her true comrade would understand. She explained that she had a compelling reason to stay behind; though, her meaning was locked behind the answer to the question “what should we look to in order to save the world?” 

Nearly all characters in the series can be categorized between past, present, and future - not in terms of the ages they lived, but the causes they strived for and principles they upheld. To those that dwell in the past for differing reasons, they’ve lost the forest for the trees, as they desperately cling to days and ideas gone by. The nationalists like Oberstein and Neustadt are nostalgic for an old world awash with blood and the power of few - vying to preserve the fading embers of the world they’re unable to let go, promoting the cyclical rejection of the law of life: inevitable change. When the past turns to an ideal, deviations become apocrypha to its adherents, permanently enslaving their consciousness to glorified memories. What needs to be defended when the principles of the majority are written by a spare few, many of whom are guilty of the deviations they govern against? On the other end of the spectrum are those who adhere to an idealized, intangible future, without any regard for the consequences, especially the abstract, felt today or tomorrow in order to achieve this future. Often do people imagine utopian futures, yet rarely do they consider the cost of achieving their idealized world; from mere monetary costs to impacts on people, places, and culture, changing the world requires immense power and influence. Sometimes all it takes is the will of a steadfast individual, while others it takes a persistent movement to push necessary change in their desired direction, sowing the seeds of tomorrow. Like William and Meitner, the ethical and moral cost is secondhand to their objective, as demonstrated by their ruthless campaign to activate the Relics and, in William’s case, avenge and resurrect Lunasia. The Voices of Nirvana have warned that awakening them would prove a grave mistake, adding that the destined children are but a gear in “the story that sets the world on its path of destruction”, implying that William, in his relentless push for the new world and Lunasia, may very well shape its ground zero. In Chapter 13, M16A1 told M4A1 that she’d played right into his hands by becoming the “key” to the Relics, and as long as she continues to exist, she will one day be “ground zero of the world’s destruction”, as if M16A1, too, knew of the Voices’ warning. Those that only look to the future forget the most important component of it: the present - the element that shapes conflict and reconciliation in tomorrow’s news cycle. The idealism of those chained to the past and future are two sides of the same coin, as no matter how picturesque a world its adherents envision, these worlds are unobtainable today. Humanity’s flame is always pushed forward, leaving those behind in the darkness, yet the path ahead remains unobservable until the present reaches it, and if people today squander the opportunity they have now, their ideal will never come to pass.

Given William’s incorrigible spirit, willing to forsake all, even Paradeus and Avernus itself, towards actualizing the power that guides the future, perhaps his primary aim is to enter a true position of influence, possibly as a Councilor or affiliate, to exploit and direct humanity into an order befit to wield the Relics. Maybe the described power isn’t even necessarily a tangible “thing”, but a potential idea that captures all - the true activation of the Relics, now made possible through William’s “key”. Relic activation has been the dream of much of the scientific world going back well over a century, and those lost in this dream conveniently ignore the present, understood costs of improper Relic use. Beilan and Northern Lights had taken over a billion lives, but the strive for Relic progress has never ended. Has it dissuaded many? Yes, but it’s never stopped. When Prometheus stole the Olympian fire, it granted mankind the opportunity to independently prosper, leading the Gods to collectively punish humanity in the form of Pandora and her jar, delivered to Epimetheus. If the idealized human world demanded prosperity, never would they consider all the evils in the world that would come with it. That is the price of the Relics - god-like power, capable of the destruction and rebirth of the world, awaiting its Prometheus. After all, when the M4-Lunasia entity was interrogating Morridow, the latter added that Paradeus was “blazing a trail to a new era”, leading humanity to this “real promised land”, which immediately spawns thoughts of Nirvana, or the God-proclaimed promised Holy Land. While true Morridow had been living under a false pretense of being Father’s chosen daughter, her statement for Paradeus’ existence and its objective ring true.

In an often heard and paraphrased quote by Albert Einstein in a letter to Heinrich Zangger during World War I in Berlin, he wrote, “All of our exalted technological progress - and civilization for the matter - is comparable to an axe in the hands of a pathological criminal.” Years of humanity’s most kinetic war up to that time granted decades of warfare technologies an opportunity to shine on the wider battlefield, with novel innovations continuously being researched and developed everyday by its belligerents, laying millions to rest from Ypres to Gallipoli. Indeed a shame that warfare and strife is perhaps one of humanity’s greatest motivators for science and technology, but idealism means nothing when in contrast to the past, where shared adversaries, propaganda, egotistical leaders, and violence itself has time and time again paved the course for the future, regardless of independent moralities. To Einstein, that amorality is what’s comparable to an unswung axe, handled by a potentially self-destructive civilization that endlessly toiled to create these weapons, some of which demand respect greater than that of humanity at current. The axe itself is just a tool, as is technological progress, but its wielder is the variable that decides if its edge falls on lumber or their fellow man. With William and Meitner, the technologies that promise Paradeus’ ethereal future stand tall over innocent lives, all to see through Paradeus’ bloodsoaked sojourn towards solving the eternal mystery of the Relics. Then again, “what’s one more body amongst foundations?”

Indeed, the only way to defend the closely-held idyllic is to safeguard the present, never losing yourself in a world that no longer exists or cannot exist, for the world of now is the only real thing we can change, as the inevitable law of life is forged with human hands. Even if the future is fated, that’s never reason to abandon reason and hope; abandonment is to forfeit your chance at changing the present to shape the future, as tomorrow is always formed by today. In contrast to Oberstein of the past and William and Meitner of the future, the Commander and Angelia of the present explicitly understand this: they can safeguard what’s truly in reach. Faded orders and abstract futures are products of the imaginative, while only the present is the real.

The present is the key to Angelia’s message because it’s neither intangible, nor stuck in the past. When the message continued, she was forthright that “he”, referring to Sir Griffin Lyons, never sought to eradicate Paradeus as they did - he wished to bring William under his control, likely to poach William’s talents and Paradeus technology for the soon-to-be-founded Union of Rossartrism Nations Coalition, the manifestation of Rossartre’s idealist vision of a new world over all of mankind. In an interesting continuity, William isn’t too unlike Meitner, whose talents brought her into the sights of Oberstein and his unknown colleagues, in this regard, as Griffin and the Prometheans have already paid “an adequate price” to speak with him, according to Nemhran. It’s unclearly exactly what this price is; it could be sacrificing Angelia to him, a seat in the upcoming URNC or on the Council, the continuation of Meitner’s research, the evidence they needed to play their cards against detractors of Rossartrism, or perhaps putting Dandelion in an vulnerable position like Angelia, allowing for an opportunity to capture her. As long as William remains at large, no matter his age, the respect his technological superiority demands and its potentials are a worthy price. After all, the [MB-13-A] document implied the Councilors desired to master the OGAS System as a foundational step towards realizing Rossartre’s dream. As Angelia put it, a demon is not a demon due to greed, but because “he possesses a demon’s power”, and with Paradeus’ blood-soaked promise, the power to usher and enforce a new world order would soon be in Griffin’s hands. Although their dispositions may not exactly align, both Lyons and William wish for a new future; though, the former believes a return to the natural order is the path of the future, while William's ambition envisions an entirely new world - a world that destruction and rebirth are for him to decide. In his conversation with Nemhran, William even chuckles at the thought, anticipating the day that “he”, likely Griffin or Oberstein, recognizes William’s authority.

While true that William seeks a new world, his life-long goal since he was a young boy was to avenge and resurrect Lunasia, hinting at him conspiring against his father and, possibly, Meitner, who are currently believed to be directly responsible. Notably, William seemingly handed evidence of Oberstein’s backing of Galatea, along with being its intermediary to the Ministry of Defense, which had planned to receive the corporation’s technologies through a cooperation between Oberstein and Minister of Defense General Heinrich Schweinsteiger. When the Commander and Stasi encountered Bramedb in the hidden Paradeus-Galatea facility beneath Berlin Prison, Dandelion managed to obtain audio recording evidence from Bramedb’s Virtual Cognition Image, as if it were left there for someone capable enough to discover. After sending it to Sir, he affirmed that it was their ace, likely to be used against him prior to the formation of the URNC later that year. A foundation of a new future requires sacrifice, and William may have sacrificed his father towards this end, while also exacting revenge for taking Lunasia away. With the URNC soon coming to fruition, will Paradeus, namely William, be a guiding light for humanity, nudging the collective unconscious for the “betterment” of the world? When the day comes when Pandora’s jar is opened - when the Relics can be activated properly, unveiling the untold possibilities of the Relic Civilization and its technologies, will humanity truly deserve to uncover these secrets? The humanity of today surely isn’t prepared for the day of God, but through an elevation of consciousness and reason, perhaps stemming from Paradeus’ infiltration of culture and religion, maybe humanity could be worthy of that privilege. But how did this symbol of personal and collective ascension rise?

Paradeus’ Possible Origins

The corridors of Avernus in the Relic Experiment Zone (LVL70 Above)

The exact origins of Paradeus are murky, and considering Obersteins past partners, it’s likely years older than 2051, when Meitner was visibly seen wearing the Paradeus emblem. Furthermore, it seems exceedingly unlikely that the first skyscraper of Avernus could’ve been constructed, even partially, in a spare few months - not to mention, the ongoing war and highly contaminated Dead Sea certainly posed significant challenges in its construction; however, the presence of the “former” UNRA Relic research facility beneath Avernus today does indicate that Oberstein’s faction built the megastructure upon this foundation or were simply continuing the UNRA’s work post-Isolation. After the Northern Lights Incident in 2035, a radical group of the UNRA medical researchers of its Beaconist bloc initiated the Photon Project, launching an investigation into potential immune research, as previously mentioned. For the genetic experiments, its members collected genetic information and immune levels of ELID patients, using human samples to test for potential immunity after genetic adjustment. As a genetic engineering project, the improper ethics and secrecy for no doubt abhorrent, but the sheer possibility of an ELID vaccine was too valuable for them to ignore, even if it came at the cost of innocent lives; however, it’s most pressing element was a series of human experiments, wherein genetically-adjusted organs were implanted into “ELID-Infected people”. It’s unclear if this refers to patients just suffering from early stage ELID or true ELIDs in their early stage of ferality, as there’s a great difference between these two states. The aforementioned alignment with Paradeus’ modus operandi today is apparent, with studies into immune research and genetic experimentation on living humans surfacing thoughts about Paradeus’ soldiers and its mission to create or discover the perfect antibody - an individual that possesses the “perfect” antibody, capable of eradicating ELID-Infected cells before they overtake the immune system’s protective capacity.

In one of the projections discovered by Alchemist in Avernus, after following the wind, she found herself standing on the tarmac of an airport in the middle of the night. Before her was a private jet preparing to take off, hounded by a flurry of media personnel, including an “Official”, possibly Oberstein, soon to board the plane. One of the reporters shouted several questions on an alleged outbreak of Collapse contamination, presumably in Germany, that was apparently a serious cause for concern. One of the reporter's questions implies the incident was caused by a failure to control the disaster area, hinting at a wider catastrophe that the government was ineffective in preventing. The Official responded by promising that special search and rescue teams were already carrying out SAR operations, along with decontamination operations in the affected region. Hearing the Official’s blank statement, the reporter again pressed him, asking why he chose to leave, despite his apparent affirmation that everything was continuing as normal. According to the news at that time, many of wealthy backgrounds had moved themselves and their families away from the city, with the reporter questioning if the Official’s sudden departure and the upper-class flights were related to the government’s inability to halt the spread of contamination. The Official vehemently denied the allegation, explaining that he was away for legitimate business, and as he walked towards his jet, the rapid fire questions and crowd severely intensified the atmosphere. The reporter’s last question was perhaps the most pointed, asking if the government’s funds for the purification work were appropriately distributed, indirectly probing whether or not certain figures were siphoning capital from the budget. The Official entered the plane as the crowd faded into a clash of vulgarities, accusations, and physical unrest. Just as the door was closing, the plane volcanically exploded as its engines started, casting a massive plume of fire and smoke into the air, and knocking down many people from the subsequent shockwave. Right then, several Paradeus soldiers flanked around, then turned their weapons on the bodyguards and journalists, firing into the crowd until none were left standing. With the scene secure, the official, who should’ve been liquified in the explosion, miraculously walked to the crowd, assuring them that it was all a minor accident and that the government will do their best to fulfill its promise to the people, ensuring protection and safety in the aftermath.

This section of Slow Shock is easily one of the most cryptic, more so than just twisted memories with missing sections of time. Again, the veracity of the information discovered in Avernus should be questioned, as it’s unclear how and why Paradeus would have such detailed projections of specific events, which may suggest the Bee Sting System had been implemented years ago or the memory fragments of the relevant individuals were stored here. Although the official is never given a name, he is referred to as “Minister” by the media, and given the Paradeus troop presence soon after, it’s likely this was Oberstein, presumably after 2051; however, this guess may be incorrect. In Chapter 13, Witkin mentioned that Oberstein was promoted to his current position as the GDR Minister of Science and Technology after serving as the Max Planck Computational Institute’s director, and in Slow Shock, Blackwell wrote to Meitner in 2051 about the latter’s proposition to restart the Holy Grail, adding that Oberstein was soon to enter an important position - all implying that Oberstein entered the ministership after his cooperation with Meitner. Whenever this event occurred, it followed an apparent contamination leak in some part of the country, leading to many of the rich in the affected region to relocate, with portions of the GDR purification budget allegedly being funneled into certain pockets or other works. The presence of Paradeus soldiers further backs this idea, as the first Paradeus-affiliated troops - whether they be an offshoot of the GDR NVA or mercenaries paid off by Oberstein or, tangentially, Galatea Technology Corporation - first appeared in 2051 during Operation Couatl and Anna’s pursuit of Meitner. 

As Daybreak were pushing into the Dead Sea, they were bogged down by at least six elite squads, and later, the unidentified enemy force encountered by Anna and Ramzan in the materials factory had spoken in English, possibly relating to the Avernus ascent control room discovered by Fe56 in 2064. In that room, one of the terminals displayed an animated tutorial film on the floating towers, featuring a massive banner of the UNRA symbol at their peak; notably, the film showed a blonde woman explaining the operations in Interlingua - a modern “international auxiliary language” once envisioned to unify communication between Romance language speakers, some of whom may ascertain written Interlingua even if they don’t understand the entirety of the text. Binding the West European languages through their shared Latin roots, a common set of Interlingual grammatical rules can inversely be used to introduce one native speaker to another Romance language; however, Interlingua has never seeded itself as a true lingua franca, as International English or French has shown prominence business, NATO, and the EU. Still, as an international agency for Relic technology, the UNRA may have adopted and conducted many affairs in Interlingua, consolidating the predominantly West European organization in language; moreover, the construction of a grand tower ascending into the heavens, its denizens unified by language, no doubt echoes the Tower of Babel.

Initially designed as a megacity whose top grazed Heaven itself, God halted its builders and citizens’ prideful transgressions through confusion (Babel in Hebrew), introducing multiple languages among civilization; unable to understand one another, the people of Babylon were left divided, thus exiling the inhabitants from the city itself. The original UNRA project that is today Avernus was probably inspired by Babel, possibly emblematic of the technological prowess that would one day unify and steer humanity’s collective ascension, akin to Paradeus’ envisioned future. If the day should come where Paradeus reaches through the realm of Nirvana, will humanity face the same retribution as the tower’s architects? Given that English is a dominant lingua franca, it may be the case where specific divisions of the more radical wing of the former Beaconists or another unidentified group were hired as Paradeus’ paramilitary forces in 2051 - long before the modern human-spliced Nytos came about - which were overheard by Anna and Ramzan’s wiretapping. While possible disconnected, when Meitner was expelled from the USRA, many members apparently vouched for her, but this did nothing for the agency’s heads who ordered her removal, and considering Meitner had already illegally cited Relic data from confidential projects to push her research forward, it’s feasible she’d do the same in Moscow, assuming she had joined the Soviet Relics Department. Alternatively, these English-speaking troops could’ve been staunch pro-Meitner members of the USRA and UNRA, supportive of her forthright methods towards Relic technology. There may be a venn diagram with the Photon Project Beaconists, working alongside former USRA members in Paradeus, possibly the Oberstein-loyalists of the UNRA/Galatea’s black project research branch.

Unlike the Strelets of today, the unknown Paradeus soldiers in 2051 were entirely capable of normal speech, transmitting and receiving orders to each other, while also casually chatting in downtime. Today, the mainshare Paradeus’ paramilitary foot soldiers are Strelets - heavily-infected individuals desperately clinging to life, their nearly-decayed brains only maintaining consciousness thanks to the suits and other possible cybernetic implants. In a nameless village in Dual Randomness, Paradeus deployed an Iaso Box, infecting many of its citizens, then took the near-death residents to be converted into additional units or “material”. It’s unclear when Paradeus turned to using cyborg soldiers, nor can we necessarily say if the Paradeus soldiers that flanked Oberstein’s plane in the projected scene were living soldiers or Strelets. Given the media referred to him as the “Minister”, it suggests that it occurred after Oberstein sent his children away to Berlin, considering Havier’s comment implies he entered after Persicaria and Lycoris took the picture with him and Lunasia, presumably 2049 or before. Originally, the spread of contamination and mention of the wealthy fleeing spawned thoughts of the Project Beacon evacuation, which had some basis through Helena von Oberstein’s presence in Antarctica, implying her presumed father was Oberstein’s younger brother; however, with his ministership, it seems rather pointed that this is during or after World War III, leaving many questions on Paradeus and its origin, including how he walked out of the explosion alive.

Assuming the incident occurred as shown in the projection, it’s possible that the plane attack was a false flag, as it lacks reasoning why Paradeus troopers would suddenly execute all civilians who witnessed what they likely thought was an assassination or a freak accident. Had it not been for the Official’s survival and the subsequent slaughter, that’s all this would’ve been: an attempt on Oberstein’s life, witnessed by media personnel who happened to be on scene during the explosion. The severity of the explosion, tearing the plane into shreds and knocking down the crowd, left little chance for him to survive, yet miraculously, he casually walked out unscathed, not heeding any mind to what just happened, only to tell the now-dead media that all was well. There’s three core questions to ask here: first, how did Oberstein survive the explosion; second, why did his plane explode; and third, why is the incident posed as if it were a false flag? Question one has the most straightforward answers, with his prior connections to 90wish and Galatea possibly providing him with a Paradeus force shield; however, it’s unknown when the first force-shield modules came about, but considering that much of Paradeus’ technologies are derived from 90wish, as he was its former head, it’s reasonable to imagine that 90wish would’ve developed the shields by the late 2040s or 2050s. Then again, there’s no confirmed date, so we’re left to our own devices to speculate. Alternatively, and certainly more theoretical, is that this wasn’t Oberstein, or rather, his organic self. If this occurred in the late 2050s, then hypothetically, Oberstein could’ve been replaced in the past like Nemhran; though, William actually speaks to him with some respect in PR, but this may just be another Nemhran scenario, wherein respect is only reserved for his family. There’s zero precedence for the idea of Oberstein being a Nyto, so the use of a forceshield or another protective device is considerably more likely. Regardless, the scene of the plane explosion seemed staged, but why?

When the plane exploded, everything points to the attack being staged, possibly as a pretext to eliminate the veracious media deconstructing his character, but there’s some major flaws in this train of thought. Oberstein wasn’t fearing death, nor did he acknowledge the situation, a sure sign that this was orchestrated or he had prerequisite knowledge of the attack. A false flag assassination is one thing, but potentially dozens of fresh bodies requires a much greater cover-up. Not once so far has there been any mention of an assassination on Oberstein’s life, though he may have had a target on his back in 2051 due to his poor standings with the unnamed Relics Department. Even Oberstein, in all his plutocratic influence, would surely be questioned why his plane exploded, unless nothing about this incident was ever made public, yet it still doesn’t explain why. Perhaps it was an attempt to fake his death to throw off the opposition, but again, Oberstein is alive and breathing today, probably, so what purpose would this serve? This is the problem at the heart of this enigmatic scene: we just don’t know why he’d do this. Sure, he could’ve been covering up his tracks, killing the media personnel after the plane exploded to present it as a possible terror attack, but what’s the point if he was to return to politics anyway? All theories are quite baffling, as they require immense absence of belief to piece together. If Oberstein was replaced, there’s little reason to kill him, assuming his cover had not yet been blown. Another errant thought is that this isn’t Oberstein, but considering his title of Minister and former position as Paradeus’ Father, surrounded by the appearance of its soldiers on the tarmac following the attack, it’s rather unlikely. If Oberstein is the unknown “Minister” representative of Ultimate Life Holdings, then it would confirm his ministership to at least the late 2050s.

Previously, Witkin mentioned that “we”, certainly referring to the Council and its affiliates, had studied Oberstein’s record while investigating Paradeus and “William”, questioning whether or not this man bared any involvement in Persicaria’s experiment, the shadowy Paradeus cult, or the Butterfly Incident - turning up nothing that directly implicated him, even mentioning he was totally above suspicion. Furthermore, the title of “William” is likely to be a pseudonym, taken from a deceased, possibly executed, researcher from the Max Planck institute, then his records were almost universally wiped. When Lyons sat down with Ulrich to discuss their plan for Germany’s future, Ulrich considered Lyons’ hesitancy, asking if Oberstein truly was the adversary they sought. He replied by affirming Witkin’s comment on the lack of suspicion; even so, he understood that Oberstein couldn't have been acting alone. Even if he was nothing more than a financier, it still doesn’t explain his reach and ability to gather resources on a city-state level. The Prometheans' suspicions would later be vindicated, coming to learn that Oberstein certainly wasn’t acting alone, nor could he ever have the capacity to do so in spite of his wealth. When Alchemist discovered the projected scene of Oberstein’s burnt letters in the manor’s fireplace, there’s an obvious reference to multiple people being involved in Meitner’s poaching, with Oberstein likely as her main proponent, and further, in a following letter to his partner or partners, he implicitly mentions the Hela Project, putting this unknown other party in the know. Given Oberstein certainly wasn’t acting alone, who was working with him, and had Paradeus already formed prior to Meitner’s entry?

During her discussion with Lyons, Ulrich comments that Oberstein has been a major supporter of the Galatea Technology Corporation “since the very beginning”, so taking into account that its was founded in 1964, as 2064 was its centennial, Ulrich’s statement implies that Oberstein had been a backer of Galatea since his early days as intelligentsia. Nothing, so far, has said the plutocratic family’s wealth originated in Galatea, but the corporation today is notable for serving as Paradeus’ massive front company, where its research and technologies are publicly disseminated, all to maintain the masquerade. Stretching back 2035, in wake of the Northern Lights Incident, the inhumane practices committed during the Beaconist Photon Project were notably in line with Paradeus’ modus operandi, and Oberstein’s aforementioned theoretical younger brother would directly link him with the UNRA; he was, after all, said to hold a poor reputation with the Relic Agency, but it’s unclear if this refers to the Beaconist UNRA prior to its isolation or the unknown Relics Department mentioned in the [MB-13-A] document, whose illegal Relic research landed sixteen of its officers in the target sights of Soviet intelligence. If he was associated with the UNRA - partially supported by Avernus’ presence over a former UNRA research facility, including several English-speaking soldiers, as English is a dominant lingua franca of the UN, possibly in itself for plausible deniability - then it’s possible he or Helena’s father were tied to these illegal experiments, aiming to discover a potential genetic treatment for ELID. In fact, after Antarctica shut its borders, the radical Beacon medical scholars responsible for the Photon Project were directly involved in forced directional evolutionary technology, based on the genetic adjustment, used to develop an effective treatment to ELID in the Antarctic Hollow City Relic Site.

It’s unclear why Oberstein wouldn’t have gone with the Beaconists; though, Witkin’s comment about his poor standing in the Agency may have acted as a roadblock, assuming he was tied to the organization. Perhaps Oberstein, a staunch German nationalist, valued his country far more than Project Beacon, believing his nation was his only home, unwilling to enter a self-exile with his family to Antarctica - his detachment may have made him a pariah among the Beaconists. Assuming he was indeed involved, then maybe there was a schism among the UNRA researchers, with a detracting party - possibly made up of Oberstein, his unknown colleagues, and others - disagreeing with the outcome of the Photon Project or the entire concept of Beacon in the first place. All of this is greatly theoretical, and something as simple as Oberstein bearing zero relation to the agency would shatter this idea; keep this in mind. It’s unknown when Oberstein entered his position as the director of the Max Planck Institute of Computer Science, presumably in Saarbrücken, but he likely was already working with Galatea by this point, given Ulrich’s comment. If Galatea is essentially Paradeus’ massive public front, then how would a shadowy organization subvert it from within, puppeting its strings - or better question, was Paradeus covertly founded by certain actors from Galatea and 90wish, some of who may have been involved in the Photon Project?


Angelia Viktorovna Tsoi rests on the laboratory table while Gray operates on her prosthetic.
Top Right: “Galatea: Creating Possibilities In A New World”

What’s perhaps most eye opening is Galatea’s own motto: “Creating possibilities in a newer world”, rather distinctly similar to Paradeus’ apparent goal of a brave new world, possibly in “aiding” humanity towards a future worthy of the Relics and peace. Many of Galatea’s modern functions benefit Paradeus, such as: first - Bohnsdorf Village - a year-old community of religious Paradeus zealots - was founded with Galatea’s help, with the Corporation continuously granting aid and capital, along with embedded Paradeus troops and, strangely, hidden one-way rooms; second - the creation of the Idunn Vaccine - a Tower of Babel-promise, formulated by the researchers of the Gray Institute of Biotechnology, a Galatea subsidiary - was directed by Nyto Gray in secrecy, who seemingly wished to use Idunn for genetic selection in search of the perfect antibody to extract a blood serum sample from, later appearing through Helena in Girls Frontline 2: Exilium - it’s also possible that Idunn was going to be Berlin’s “salvation” had Operation Cocoon not been stopped; third - the presence of several hidden Paradeus-Galatea miscellaneous “material” sorting and manufacturing plants - including the primary facility concealed beneath Berlin Prison, used as a meeting point for the dominant Nytos and Angelia’s holding cell following her capture before their relocation to Avernus; fourth - the trucks used to move Paradeus’ Iaso’s Boxes were actually from Galatea, who worked with the certain Free German Independent Party members, including Franz “Wolfgang Hopps” Shreck, to discreetly ship the WMDs to one of the local airports for export to Neustadt’s ultranationalist forces, representing Oberstein’s grisly gift to his anti-Rossartrist comrades, and notably, during a broadcast of Akeutelle Kamera, Shadowless reported that a Galatea contractor was shot in his home, almost certainly referencing Bramedb’s prior assassination of Hopps; fifth - the Flora Botanical Research Institute in Bremen - led by Galatea and Gray affiliate Leone Michel - was used as a source of some of the hallucinogens for the Paradeus’ child trafficking operations, which rendered the kidnapped children unconscious for a period of time while in transit in the “Sweet Dream Boxes”, following Paradeus’ pressure on Zeratul-Worcester Pharamceutical, another major German biomedical company with Paradeus ties, to refine the Flora Institute’s hallucinogens for effective shipping, handled by “Uncle Powell” of the GIP; sixth - during Agent J’s unauthorized investigation of the Oberstein manor in the aftermath of Light’s death, a glint was caught in his periphery, turning to find a medicine bottle bearing two logos - that of Galatea and the other of its subsidiary, the Gray Institute of Biotechnology - amidst the rubble, then slipped it into his pocket before rushing for an exit, and after being discovered by his colleagues, he eventually ended up before Director Riefenstahl for an interrogation, wherein he stated that the presence of an Idunn bottle on-site was indicative of Galatea’s presence in the manor, given that Nyto Gray herself had been present for the battle, even if Riefenstahl tried acting coy to skirt around the subject, isolating Paradeus’ connections to the Stasi; seventh - the “Tequila Gallery” ponzi scheme for forgery artworks, led by Maggie Ponzi of the Fox Sisterhood, became a subsidiary of Galatea following a private meeting between Nyto Gray and Ponzi, wherein the Tequila Project was reappropriated by Paradeus through Galatea, both to obtain Tequila’s prior investor list and to plant an informant on the Siberian Lifeline Intercontinental Railway for future black market and intelligence operations, leading to the founding of the Colt Express, a black market for Dolls hosted within Ponzi’s LVLII, whose neural cloud was converted to support the Bee Sting System after entering the partnership with Gray; eighth, after Galatea vindicated the former Chairman of the GDR National Drug Regulatory Administration, Dr. Eugene Rugosa - falsely accused of academic misconduct by voracious Schultz Pharmaceutical businessmen - entered a contract with Galatea through Nyto Gray, allowing him to return to field clinical work as long as he supported their endeavors and the Idunn vaccine, oblivious to its true, ominous purpose; most damning of them all, ninth - after Rugosa entered the contract, he was assigned to an unidentified Galatea laboratory for an “experimental procedure” prioritizing organs of several child test subjects, including “Rosita”, and several hours later, all the subjects had expired, except for Rosita, whose narration during her procedure described her mind being jumbled as the procedure continued, adding that it was as if her consciousness was “peeled away, reawakened, then peeled away again” in a “sea of darkness”, “drowning me in an abyss of eternal wails” - all of which firmly correlates with the Holy Grail/Hela procedure and the Lake of Cognition experienced by Angelia, implying that Rugosa conducted several Hela procedures during his Galatea contract, including Rosita’s, whose body survived in spite of rejection; and tenth - when Amaris entered Galatea’s third branch building in Berlin to face Aliana, the Dolls remarked that the structure was comparable to the Avernus skyscraper during Operation Couatl, and considering the Paradeus-Galatea relationship, these shared characteristics may allude to Galatea’s architecture and aesthetic being applied to Avernus construction.

When much of Galatea’s illegal research had entered the limelight through several whistleblowers, an investigation was launched by the GDR National Health Commission and the NDRA, following casualties stemming from its unethical biopharmaceutical research, including the old man Corenlia “Nele” Schafer tried saving in Poincare Recurrence with Idunn; later reports revealed prior history of falsified medical trials and illegal business practices, including market manipulation by company management - all culminating in the forced shutdown of several Galatea pharmaceutical branches, severely tarnishing the corporation’s prestige. After Nyto Gray disappeared following the battle at the manor, Professor Heine entered the director’s chair, who later killed herself upon the Galatea revelations surfacing. Frankly, given Paradeus’ history, her suicide could air more on the side of “two bullets to the back of the head”. The shattered image reflected harshly on Gray’s public image, only worsened by her routine absence from the institute and later disappearance, until she debated whether or not to forsake her false identity, then returning to Avernus with Morridow and Grig. Considering Oberstein’s long-time backing of Galatea and his offer to General Schweinsteiger to issue Galatea’s technology to the GDR MoD - thus implicating him to the Fireworks Incident and the trafficking of the Iaso Boxes to Carter, by extension - there’s a definite parallel drawn with Paradeus; wherever Galatea goes, Paradeus is intrinsically attached, vice-versa. Simply put, all roads, one way or another, lead to Galatea Technology Corporation, and this corporation has time and time again been supported by Paradeus Fathers - formerly Oberstein, then William - and high-ranking Nytos, such as Gray.

When Stasi Director Romy Riefenstahl postulated that Paradeus’ main research and production laboratory could’ve been within the Dead Sea, Major Kain “K” Schwaben questioned how that could even be possible, to which Riefenstahl commented that, given Paradeus’ keen edge in all research and technology sectors, perhaps someone had solved the Collapse Radiation problem - or rather, “a group of people devoted to radiation research.” Schwaben immediately realized Riefenstahl’s forethought; however, she hadn’t yet acted on this belief because of a lack of evidence, until the Stasi had excluded any of the Paradeus-Galatea plants or other smaller enterprises within Berlin to have the capacity to produce the quality of “products”, Nytos, and the cores of the Iaso’s Boxes. Paradeus must’ve had a sequestered primary facility, entirely invisible to any curious party, but this doesn’t confirm that the Stasi or others were unaware of the possible Dead Sea base. After Operation Couatl in 2051, Aliana reportedly “died”, having been mothballed after the operation’s failure as she entered that room in Avernus, but was recovered or was sent to StateSec at some point after, with any relevant information on the operation being heavily redacted. When StateSec sent the NGAD box to the Commander on MBV Elmo after the attack on the S09 Base, the Commander believed StateSec knew more than they let on about her, given the confidentiality and her prior mission to the very same target as Operation Ilya Muromets. Once Operation Couatl had been verified through the Commander’s “independent” Operation Aeneas, it proved to all the major power players that, yes, the primary facility existed in the Dead Sea, and was the former target of the American raid in WWIII. After Witkin and his colleagues conducted an internal purge in Moscow, which included former StateSec and Paradeus mole Colonel Dupieux, they uncovered the name “Avernus”, all while Riefenstahl was briefing Schwaben on the potential Paradeus HQ. Dupieux was eliminated before he could cross the German border by Agent Q - possibly “Maya”, as the file name suggests; though, it’s uncertain if he was hit was a live round or a less-than-lethal. Furthermore, the Stasi has been suspected of sharing many of Galatea’s ties to Paradeus, with Riefenstahl going as far as to send Q to eliminate Dupieux, along with totally isolating the Stasi was seemingly ever being tied to Paradeus. 

When Angelia first came to Germany, assuming the Lake memories are true, she learned from Q of an ongoing internal conflict within the Stasi over Paradeus ties, alluding to the former Stasi director and his faction maintaining a partnership with the former Paradeus-Galatea facilities across Berlin, where Riefenstahl later was discovered to be covering up evidence of. It’s intriguing that all the Councilors and Promethean affiliates were playing their cards just as the Commander’s operation was soon to begin, possibly covertly using Aeneas as a means to establish communication with “William”, as Lyons is known to be orchestrating towards William’s poaching for the future; though, several of Prometheus’ affiliates are unlikely to share this vision. With the target, “Capita”, having never truly been confirmed KIA during WWIII, “he” likely remained on the radar, assuming Anna hadn’t killed her. Aliana’s very existence, especially StateSec’s suspected reason for sending her to the Commander, and Riefenstahl’s - an affiliate of Councilor Lyons - assertion of a possible base in the Dead Sea, may indicate that certain influential figures, namely the Prometheans, possessed some measure of insight into this potential base. Given the Stasi divisions between Paradeus and state loyalty, leading Riefenstahl executing the Stasi’s internal purge to trim Paradeus-Galatea’ ministry-wrapped feelers, she - and, possibly, the Prometheans’ investigation of Paradeus - possibly caught wind of Paradeus’ sources, raising suspicions of the Dead Sea. And if some of the Beaconists splintered off with Galatea to form Paradeus, including Oberstein himself, then their former UNRA counterparts possibly know of the underground “former” UNRA base beneath Avernus.

Oberstein is a wealthy man, surely, but Paradeus’ reach and total infiltration of German society, academia, and politics, is nothing one man could do alone. Even just the construction of Avernus, just one skyscraper by Operation Couatl in 2051, would be a Herculean task in wartime, and obviously, no single man could design and build a megastructure in the heart of Red Zone. From Avernus’ construction to Paradeus’ continent-spanning tendrils, everything points to a specific group, as Riefenstahl suggested to Schwaben, with direct ties to Galatea and, possibly, the former UNRA. Just as Paradeus seeks to guide humanity towards a promised future befit of the Relics, Galatea proudly stands by its motto - “Creating possibilities in a newer world” - as it meticulously strives to be the cutting edge of biomedical technology. The only way for Paradeus to garner so much capital and maintain its reach would be the support of a group of wealthy individuals with a shared interest, established well before Meitner was ever poached by Oberstein. Paradeus and Galatea are inextricably linked, and if there is indeed a connection to the Beaconist Photon Project, perhaps Paradeus was founded by an isolated faction within Galatea, composed of militant Galatea personnel, 90wish members, and former Beaconists, sharing commitment to the continuation of the Photon Project, seemingly intent on creating or discovering the Perfect Antibody for Relic activation. Oberstein’s claws have been sunk into Galatea since the beginning, becoming one of its core advocates today. In the files discovered by Fe56 in Nemhran’s room in Avernus, a report written by her mentioned that Galatea’s talent recruitment program was building up an international team of experts, allegedly directed by “Father”, who’s believed to be Oberstein, given the approximate time of writing, as Gray Blackwell had yet to be executed, having refused to join several times because of her abhorrence towards Meitner’s methods. At the time of writing, dealing with Blackwell was held in abeyance; however, she was eventually replaced, possibly after 2058 when “Laplace” wished to meet with “Abaddon” again in Million Roses record shop - the latter obviously denied.

During her discussion with Schawben in Fixed Point, Riefenstahl described a hypothetical group of radiation researchers that could’ve solved the Collapse Radiation research problem, wherein the Paradeus Nytos’ possess some level of immuno-resistance, allowing ongoing operations in the Dead Sea today. Of course, Nytos did not exist in their current form in 2051; however, their definition likely originated in the Holy Grail Project or its subsequent reactivation in 2051, as Blackwell described the three layers of “Nyto” consciousness, hinting at Nytos simply being successful Hela subjects, whose memory fragments are now embedded in the Lake for consciousness synthesis in new, genetically developed bodies. Considering that modern Nytos with limited immuno-resistance hadn’t yet existed back then, Avernus could’ve begun construction before the Dead Sea was heavily contaminated, purposefully converting the region into WWIII dumping ground to conceal its dark heart. Today, Avernus is furnished with intricate purification filters, enabling normal habitation, but allows for the induction of ambient Collapse Particles for the Hela Project and other relevant research. Although Riefenstahl was theorizing about a hypothetical research group, the Photon Project was directed into immune research, implanting genetically adjusted organs into ELID-Infected subjects, and some of these researchers could’ve been associated with the biotechnology-dominant Galatea, which received immense support from Oberstein, a technocrat of the German intelligentsia. 

His wealth and status as the former head of the Max Planck Institute for Computer Science and 90wish naturally landed him an official government position, later becoming one of the highest-placed men in Germany. Sometime after entering the ministership, the Paradeus airport attack incident unfolded, wherein he miraculously avoided death in the plane explosion, then had Paradeus’ troops execute the surviving media and bodyguards. Persicaria believed that a significant portion of 90wish’s research made its way into Paradeus hands, matching Oberstein’s secretive position as Paradeus’ former Father, unbeknownst to her. Given 90wish was the colloquial name for the FRG Bundeswehr’s special research department, Oberstein had direct access to any number of confidential military and engineering projects, from Dolls to experimental military technologies, which could’ve later made their way into the Paradeus paramilitary. Meanwhile, his theoretical younger brother would’ve had direct ties to Project Beacon, given Helena von Oberstein’s presence in Antarctica, thus associating him to the Beaconists and, possibly, the Photon Project, aligning exactly with Paradeus and Galatea’s experiments. As the American Holy Grail Project was implicitly a simulation of Nirvana and, seemingly, its effects on humanity, this naturally brought its lead researcher, Professor Meitner, into Oberstein and his colleague’s sights, hinting that their “plans” implied in his letter were related to the study of Nirvana.

Some may simply refer to Oberstein and his colleagues - the probable composition of Galatea, 90wish, and, possibly, former Beaconist Photon Project staff - as “The Group”, if you will, which prioritized sequestering their research to a secluded region; fans of the STALKER video games - the setting and stories of which took significant inspiration from the Strugatsky brothers’ novel, Roadside Picnic (1972), and Andrei Tarkovsky’s film, Stalker (1979), written in part by the Strugatskys - likely recognize this blatant allegory, wherein a group of Soviet scientists set up their research facility in the heart of the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone and across the region, studying several research topics, including most aptly, after breaking away from the Soviet federal government, the Collective Consciousness project, which inadvertently triggered the 2006 disaster, when a hole was torn in the Noosphere.
