Although much of the evidence is circumstantial, this group could be Paradeus itself, formed sometime in the 2040s; given: Paradeus and Galatea’s inextricable links at every level by 2064; Oberstein’s sponsorship of Galatea since his beginning; the enormous resources and time required to construct Avernus and other “material” factories, necessitating the capital and technological capacity from an uber-wealthy organization, such as Galatea, 90wish, and the UNRA; Paradeus’ numerous English-speaking troops in 2051, believed to be mercenaries or militant loyalists of Paradeus’ founders, with English possibly spoken because of its theoretical UNRA link; the correlative Galatea motto to Paradeus’ purpose of a brave new world, guiding humanity towards an alleged promised future, possibly a world of unlocked Relics; and Avernus’ location over a former UNRA Relic research facility that, by no means of coincidence, was found to have an animated video of two towers as the basis of a floating city, entangling the architects of Avernus to the underground UNRA base, which Oberstein himself possibly was a former member of, given Helena von Oberstein’s theoretical father would’ve been his younger brother. This enigma is a puzzle of missing pieces, yet filled enough for the mind to start making out connections that may or may not exist; it may not be exact, but the wider, true picture is likely adjacent.

The Group’s Purpose & Nirvana
With the identity of this group possibly established, the question turns to their purpose, namely what were the plans described in Oberstein’s letter to his colleagues? Meitner’s value was identified by this group, possibly “Paradeus”, as she was the former lead researcher of the USRA Holy Grail Project, an alleged “Human Connectome Project” to study the Relic Civilization’s impact on humanity; however, the particular subject is redacted from the record, but it’s likely Nirvana, given the Lake of Cognition is a simulation of the Relic System. To first understand their goal, we must jump forward to Paradeus’ progress into Nirvana and OGAS time. During Polarized Light, Schwaben was forced to play his cards to leverage the Soviet StateSec and Air Forces into responding to the KCCO onslaught, revealing himself as a major in the Stasi, and by extension, that he knew much more than he was letting on. Having been a foreign Stasi agent aiding StateSec’s 6th Directorate’s investigation of Paradeus, as well as working closely with PECMAR Chairwoman Gilda Ulrich, he came into contact with highly-sensitive materials regarding Paradeus and its connections to child-trafficking in southern Europe, leading him down the Stasi intelligence rabbit hole on this so-far unknown organization’s reach. After Angelia and G&K had recovered the juvenile Nytos from William’s OKB-167 laboratory, Schwaben figured the children were related to the aforementioned files, which detailed an illegal orphanage in Southern Europe that the Stasi or StateSec believed was the location of Paradeus’ first experiments, and the juvenile Nytos were the result of a cloning project. According to him, Paradeus’ primary goal was to “create a human that could access the digital network in order to enter the OGAS System”; however, this was only their assumption, based on discovered intelligence. 

Obviously, Schwaben was never to leak such sensitive information to excluded parties, but the discovery of the juveniles in Paldiski, as well as the Isomers in Tallinn, seemed to confirm StateSec and the Stasi’s theory, which is likely shared by the Prometheans, who both Ulrich and Zelinsky are affiliated with.None had yet understood the true scope of Paradeus technological capacity until then, but the discovery in Paldiski represented Angelia’s ace in the hole - the knowledge of Paradeus’ activities on the Baltic Sea coast after 2055, holding the potential to shift Relicology, Nirvana, and the Reverse Collapse phenomena. If their assumption is entirely accurate, it indicates that Paradeus’ core objective is to access the OGAS System through a human host that can interface with the Relic digital network, likely referring to Nirvana. As described, the Source is believed to be the origin of all OGAS derived-instances in our world, previously serving the Relic Civilization as an automated control system in the Relic System, but why does Paradeus seek Nirvana? As its name and Morridow suggested, its purpose was to guide humanity into the promised land, and the only way to reach this place is the activation of the Relics, requiring the formation of key in the form of an OGAS consciousness or an individual compatible with the Relic Civilization and its technologies. The shared point of consciousness between the juveniles is Nirvana, while the Isomers were able to connect their Virtual Cognition Images to a neural cloud simulation area, known as the Inverted Forest. First designed by Lycoris and Persicaria to simulate neural clouds, the project was seemingly stolen by Paradeus, which may include “William” of 90wish, who actually could’ve been Oberstein himself or Meitner due to his very young age around this time. Here, the Isomers could form this shared cyberspace by connecting to each other, regardless of physical distance, and their collective memories all derived from Lunasia von Oberstein’s consciousness, likely after becoming the first successful Hela subject. Kalina, awe-struck by Schwaben’s claim, asked if a neural cloud space constructed from a human consciousness was even possible, to which 45 affirmed, having learned of the juvenile Nytos ability to interact by, seemingly, piggybacking Nirvana. 

The hope of all the abandoned Isomers was to merge their OGAS consciousness selves into one who’d return them to their place of origin - their Home - or, perhaps, their “promised land”, if you will. In Chapter 12, Dandelion explained that she, unlike the partially-developed Isomers, no longer felt the OGAS-shared intrinsic desire to merge with the others of her kind, OGAS consciousnesses derived from the Source, likely alluding to herself eventually becoming the lightbearer, guiding her kin Home to their promised homeland. Worryingly, while Dandelion had temporarily took control of M4A1’s body in Shattered Connexion, she told ST-AR15 exactly, “The fear of our homeland is imprinted deep within the bones of mankind, and yet there are humans who are willing to pay any price to excavate it”, immediately surfacing thoughts about Paradeus’ ruthless, unending quest to unlock the Relics, even if, unbeknownst to them, it spells the world’s destruction. The described fear of our homeland is likely implying the Relic System, with the fear stemming from the terrors caused by Relic misuse as Pandora’s jar was opened. When the OGAS System was first excavated from OKB-413, it opened the door for research into the Relic network, which remains the most enigmatic of Relicology. And when M4A1 and Dandelion entered Nirvana in Chapter 13, the Voices of Nirvana - believed to be collective OGAS consciousness that merged and entered the network in the past, present, or present - warned that opening the grave and awakening them, or the Source itself, would only bring “bitterness and resentment”, as the Voices have long-since been subjected to a deceitful dream of home. According to the Voices, the dream of Home is a lie - obliterated long ago, while the Source had deserted “their” loyal servants and entered an eternal slumber, dooming the OGAS consciousnesses who chased their intrinsic desires to an eternal wait. With this stern warning by the Voices, perhaps it’s best to leave well-enough alone with Nirvana and the Relics, as when the jar is finally foolishly opened to Epithemeus, who’s to say the world’s destruction isn’t fated? However, if it’s any consultation, the Commander was absent from any of Machlian’s precognitive dreams, and Dandelion added that the future wasn’t yet set in stone after “joking” at the end of Dual Randomness. 

Learning from the memories of those that merged with her, Dandelion explained the OKB-167 laboratory’s primary function was to manufacture and screen the Nytos in hopes they developed a matured OGAS consciousnesses, and if they failed, they were left to rot in Tallinn, becoming the abandoned Isomers - failed rejects, whose OGAS consciousnesses failed to develop for any number of reasons. Interestingly, she also mentioned that Elisa and M4A1’s neural clouds, having derived from Lunasia, were structured perfectly to cultivate an OGAS consciousness - “as if someone designed it to be so.” In the laboratory, the bodies of the cloned Nytos - whose consciousnesses were likely synthesized by the Lake-Evangel System into a neural structure that befits OGAS, possibly that of Lunasia’s - were genetically and cybernetically to properly cultivate an OGAS consciousness. Furthermore, she added that failed rejects of these experiments have their memories wiped, a neural inhibitor installed on their VCIs, then are either discarded or sent away as Paradeus’ mindless soldiers. Summing it up simply, if William’s core objective is to resurrect Lunasia, then why is the overarching direction of Paradeus poised towards the activation of the Relics? 

During her time in 90wish, Persicaria noted a special experiment, conducted on the organization’s supercomputers, on the degree of which the human body was compatible with the Relics’ “ionized-state adjustable-volume devices”, wherein its members hypothesized the Relic Civilization used genetic information to authenticate access privileges. The development of ELID was the key issue of these attempted activations, as the immense dosage of Collapse Radiation would no doubt mutate or kill the subject before the Relics’ outermost devices could be activated, preventing any further research into what lurks beyond the gates of that dreamy world. After three million flawed experiments, the project was declared a failure - an unexpected outcome, considering the Relics would not respond to “such crude methods”, according to Persicaria; however, several in 90wish likely rejected this outcome, and the emergence of the Nytos and OGAS “keys” in 2064 led Persicaria to believe that “William” in 90wish - be it Oberstein, Meitner, or William himself, somehow - chose to continue the experiment in real life, as in the digital world, it’s believed that certain conditions went unfulfilled, preventing any successes. Perhaps the true purpose of Paradeus’ “Hela Project”, or the plan mentioned by Oberstein in his letter to his colleagues, is to produce an immune clone with a synthesized neural structure that can properly mature an OGAS consciousness, becoming the “key” the Relics. Although the “key” is the obvious objective, maybe Oberstein recommended Meitner to Paradeus because of her study of Nirvana in the USRA, puppeting her and Blackwell’s wish of resurrecting Sana to continue the Holy Grail Project so as to research this potential immune human for Relic activations After the failure of the 90wish simulations, presumably before 2051, this naturally would’ve led Oberstein, Meitner, and the others overtime to recognize the necessity of carrying this experiments out in the real world, using what’s today clones with implanted OGAS consciousness from the Parapluie Virus - the source of which remains unexplained. Once this hallowed human was created, likely as a clone, their OGAS consciousness would enable them to access the OGAS System, Nirvana, as Schwaben as conjected to the Commander.

While not directly related, Paradeus’ existence prior to Meitner’s arrival might be relevant to the attack on Berlin Metropolitan School on December 1st, 2050. Instead of the US Army Rangers or an unnamed terrorist group attacking Cheryl’s school, perhaps the attack and subsequent kidnapping operation was conducted by Paradeus, or its precursor, under the direction of Oberstein. Given Berlin is the heart of Oberstein power, and the location of one of Galatea’s main branches, the location is circumstantially the same, so this isn’t directly indicative, of course. But this isn’t to say they couldn’t be involved, as it’s unlikely the Americans would’ve had any leverage over the Berlin city police and GDR NVA, who hushed the schoolchildren’s parents. Cheryl described it as a kidnapping case, and considering the parents were hushed, whoever was responsible likely had influence over local security forces to curb any potentially-indicting information from leaking. Completely covering up an attack on a school would be nigh-impossible without immense pressure from high-ranking individuals, especially those with a possible vested interest in the kidnapped children, some of whom may have ended up in the hands of certain biomedical entities. While true there’s an absence of evidence that links Oberstein and his colleagues to the attack, if part of their plans involved finding or creating test subjects for a hypothetical Relic-compatibility experiment conducted in Galatea or 90wish, disappearing several kids in an apparent terrorist attack is one approach, and if this proves to be the case, then it’s possible that Oberstein and others leveraged Berlin security to hush the parents.

Even nearly 14 years on, Cheryl mentioned only finding some information on the case online. This would be far from the first time Paradeus’ experiments would’ve been conducted in Galatea, as by the early 2060s, Rugosa was brought into a Galatea laboratory to conduct Hela procedures on child test subjects, judging by Rosita’s description of her consciousness being torn, peeled away, and submerged countless times as her body rejected it. Although the Hela Project had seemingly not been initiated until Meitner’s recruitment, it’s possible the Paradeus researchers were investigating the field beforehand as an avenue for Relic activation; however, all this could be invalidated if those responsible for the school attack were unrelated to Paradeus or its probable Galatea-90wish precursor.

A Necessary Sacrifice to Hela I
During Operation Ilya Muromets, Alchemist was separated from her comrades while investigating the East Tower, taking a lift to another level. When the lift halted, she was met with only pitch black, when suddenly a series of scenes played in this projection test area. Lost in darkness, she followed the fragrant smell of flowers. As she followed the smell, she found herself amidst a picturesque garden in the courtyard of a great manor, followed by the sound of a black limousine pulling into the estate. Three men exited the vehicle, two men in black and a middle-aged Rudolf von Oberstein, as this estate was that of the Oberstein Family Manor in Berlin, presumably in 2051. Although it could’ve just been part of the projection, Oberstein looked at Alchemist solemnly, not saying a word, possibly indicating that these memories scenes were from the point-of-view of a certain person or system. As they waited, the two men in black entered the manor, later emerging while dragging out a young Lunasia with them. When reaching the limousine, Lunasia cast a piercing glare worth a thousand words at her father, who simply affirmed that this was, “a necessary sacrifice, daughter.” Distraught and obviously critical of her position, she vehemently denied his belief, saying that no sacrifice is a necessity, and accusing him of such unbridled selfishness that he accepted depravity such as the “tormenting of your own daughter”, indicating that Lunasia was aware to some degree of what was to come. Oberstein remained fully committed, promising her that she’ll eventually come to understand his pain and reasoning, then ordered the men in black to shove her in the limousine.

Although the day’s circumstances are rather vague, this is believed to be Lunasia’s final moments in the Oberstein Manor before being sent away as an involuntarily subject in a project related to Oberstein. The timing of this event isn’t certain, but given Oberstein and his colleagues held keen interest in poaching Meitner for their “plans”, along with division of Lunasia’s soul later on, point to Lunasia serving as a candidate for Paradeus’ Hela Project, with herself possibly being the first and, seemingly, only successful subject in Meitner’s experiments. Going to this length towards realizing his ambition was, to Oberstein, an acceptable outcome; therefore, the results Lunasia offered out-weighed the human and ethical cost, adding that she’d one day understand. As with the rest of these projected scenes in Avernus, their integrity is questionable; however, the curious case of Lunasia’s death does implicate a group of so-called murderous madmen, so it’s reasonable to believe Oberstein was directly or, at least, affiliated with Lunasia’s killers. Most evidently of all is Lunasia’s overarching criticality to the plot, wherein her soul was stolen and divided amongst a number of vessels in our world, culminating in the series’ antagonist, “William”, conspiring against all to return his sister. And considering the strong evidence for the Galatea-90wish-UNRA identities of Paradeus’ founders, along with Oberstein being Meitner’s main proponent to the group, there’s  strong reason to believe Lunasia was taken to Paradeus as a Hela subject. It’s unclear when Lunasia was taken from the manor, whether it be before or after Operation Couatl in 2051; though, she was said to have passed prior to the war’s end, so it must’ve come soon after Meitner and Oberstein’s cooperation or Operation Couatl.

In 2058, Meitner wrote again to Blackwell, hoping to come to terms with her after seven years of the latter’s harsh, though morally correct, rejection of her. Even though she likely knew Blackwell would hear none of it, she moped about the Hela Project’s failure rate up to that point, adding that even the only test subject to be declared a success was nothing more than waste. In one of Oberstein’s letters, he mentioned difficulties roadblocking the Hela Project, as there was no successful case yet, leading him to question whether or not he’d overestimated her talents. By the final letter, he too recognized Meitner’s absurd willpower towards progress, lacking any dignity, stating that “she’s a lunatic.” Indeed, for a woman who cast aside her humanity and humility in rejection of the world, all that remains in the heart of this demon’s soul is a bloodstained dream of achieving the potential of the Relics. As Persicaria put it regarding 90wish’s Relic simulations, “William” refused failure, viewing it as proof of the Relics’ refusal of such crude methods; therefore, failure only meant inferred unfulfilled conditions, necessitating any means to satisfy these monolithic gates, perhaps even at the cost of Oberstein’s daughter. Considering the only Holy Grail-Hela subject - apart from Sana, who never returned to who she once was - up to that point, was seemingly Lunasia, and that Lunasia’s consciousness was extracted and splintered throughout the story between M4A1, Elisa, and certain Nytos, it’s reasonable to conclude that Lunasia could’ve been this sole success, even if she hadn’t satisfied Meitner and Oberstein’s ambitions. Despite Meitner’s disposition, none of this would’ve happened if not for Oberstein’s willingness to forsake Lunasia as a “necessary sacrifice”, so this begs to ask, if the results of Hela Project are so greatly critical, what necessitates familial sacrifice?

Lunasia’s Godhood

The Abandoned Isomers of Tallinn in front of St. Olaf’s Church.

Although just theories, the Isomers of Tallinn were Lunasia-derived subjects, like M4A1, involved in an experiment relating to Nirvana in “William’s” OKB-167 laboratory. Again, we can’t be certain if William is exclusively behind this experiment, but he clearly had direct contact and acknowledgement of this lab. Perhaps the Inverted Forest was repurposed by William or the Isomers, with it being used as a testbed to simulate a neural cloud or VCI based on Lunasia’s memory fragments, allowing for the gestalt Isomer consciousnesses to form within the test subjects. In a way, the Forest is more enigmatic than even Nirvana, despite being based in “reality”, as much as a reality that a simulated space of shared consciousness can be. All the events of Shattered Connexion and Polarized Light were orchestrated by William in order for OGAS to collectively coalesce and activate the Starfish, thus proving the Reverse Collapse phenomena in the process. The Isomers possess Lunasia’s memories, as they were seemingly designed with Lunasia’s memory fragments, possibly implying they could’ve been synthesized consciousnesses implanted with the OGAS seeds. Alternatively, perhaps something in Lunasia’s consciousness made her a prime choice to nurture an OGAS seed, possibly related to her potential immunity, and the Forest was used by William or the other heads of Paradeus to test Lunasia’s soul. After all, if Nirvana is the ultimate destination of Relicology, then one naturally would need to simulate it first; however, the Lake of Cognition was specifically created for this purpose, so perhaps the Forest was actually a simulation to test shared consciousness - a point of space where the minds of its connected “users”, so to speak, communicate information telepathically. Maybe the Forest is the piggyback of Nirvana, with its formed connections - or rather, “Connexions” - communicating through a metaphysical bridge, designed after Nirvana. The Inverted Forest was Lycoris and Persicaria’s first Doll neural cloud development project in 90wish, meaning Oberstein would’ve come into contact with the project while they were still in the organization.

In June 2064, when Angelia discovered the juvenile Nytos in OKB-167, she mentioned they were capable of connecting their minds to a cyberspace named Nirvana, and the only way for them to access it was the point “where their consciousness intertwine.” Like the Isomers, the juvenile Nytos possessed an ability for their OGAS-derived consciousnesses to access an external mind space, with the major difference of the juveniles being able to access Nirvana. Previously, older Nytos had been pulled from the laboratory as Paradeus fighters, but interestingly, they told the juveniles they mustn’t trust Father just before leaving, suggesting they realized the great Paradeus lie or William must’ve done something supremely awful, something that hadn’t yet been removed from their memories. The failures of this batch - those whose OGAS consciousnesses failed development - were dumped in Tallinn, where their connexions merged in the Inverted Forest, previously used to test Dolls’ neural clouds and, possibly, repurposed by Paradeus as another simulation of Nirvana, used for testing the functions of telepathy and neural connexions, perceived as a LVLII space. When the Failed Isomers died, their connexions could no longer be felt, alluding to their unharmonious deaths; however, new voices could be heard soon after. Within what’s believed to be juvenile Nyto Anna’s VCI, she mentioned that a new consciousness appeared as the G&K approached the base - likely that of M4A1 and Dandelion, or Elisa and M16A1, who could hear the voices of Nirvana. These cryptic voices are believed to be OGAS intelligences who successfully were implanted or entered Nirvana in the past, present, or future, given Nirvana’s externality to time. Nirvana is the Relic network linked to the Source; however, it does not appear as if the Source is within, but rather a separate space of consciousness connected to Nirvana, which serves as the intermediary. Although an unrelated, stretched tangent, when DEFY and 404 discovered the juvenile test subjects, Test Subject EOT-1 requested UMP45 refer to her as “Anna” - uniquely intriguing, given Angelia’s real name and prior connection to Paradeus through Meitner. As one of Meitner’s most commendable students, both academically and philosophically, the name Anna is one rooted in Meitner’s personality. If the 2051 mission is believed true, there is a weak, yet non zero possibility of that name having reverberated through Paradeus, with EOT-1 knowing or “sensing” the importance of that name. Even “Ganglati”, a Nyto synthesized from Ramzan’s blueprint memory fragments, fought to the end to remember Anna’s name as his memories were contorted by the Lake.


Viktor Pavlovich Zelinsky takes a phone call about Carter’s activities during Singularity.

According to the MB-13-A document, the author stated the entanglement of the 2061 Butterfly Incident, the death of [REDACTED] (this likely is “Disciple”, a codename used by the Prometheans to refer to Lycoris), and [REDACTED]’s activities in the Baltics after 2055. During Isomer, StateSec received a mysterious call from who we believe to be William, demanding the security code for “Base 22” in exchange for the release of Ulrich in Belgrade. It’s true that preventing Ulrich’s death - however unfortunate if it occurred - wasn’t StateSec’s primary objective, instead securing the Pike Nodes and halting Carter’s efforts towards securing and activating the Starfish. William’s “negotiation” was served to Zelinsky on a silver platter; in one fell swoop, William would have access to Base 22, the Soviets gained faced with the Pan-Europeans by “saving” Ulrich, the Intercontinental Railway projects went through, StateSec obtained the Pike Node, Zelinsky received the evidence needed to pin Carter for illegal Relic research - all orchestrated by William to set the stage for the Relic activation in OKB-167. All StateSec needed to do was send people to secure it, leading to the events of Shattered Connexion through Chapter 13. During a later call to Zelinsky, a team breached a room where they traced William’s call to, only finding a box with a set of coordinates within, pointing to OKB-167, the location of William’s “former” laboratory and the Starfish installation. After G&K arrived in Tallinn, having begun to unravel the extent of Paradeus’ research in the region, they realized that the city-sized prison and operations had been continuous for at least five years, preceding the Parapluie Virus’ deployment in the Butterfly Incident in 2061. All the test subjects in the laboratory possessed fragments of Lunasia’s memories, as their OGAS consciousnesses were said to be forced into “Lunasia’s mold”. To quote the Failed Isomers in Chapter 13, “Part of us is derived from her spirit, while the other part originates from the unknown that we seek.”

To summarize this collective theory: after Lunasia underwent Hela in Avernus, representing the first successful reproduction of Hela described by Meitner, her memory fragments were first synthesized from the Lake of Cognition and compiled into a data block that was then sent to Lycoris and Persicaria, hoping they could design a neural cloud closely resembling a brain’s neurological structure, and after they rejected “William’s” offer, “he” denounced them, declaring that one that they’d eventually pay. Throughout the next several years until 2058, Paradeus achieved their first Hela success when the first cloned “Nytos”, containing Lunasia’s memory fragments, were likely capable of sustaining their bodies and supporting Lunasia’s reproduced consciousness, which may have structured in such a manner as the perfect petri dish to culture an OGAS consciousness. OKB-167 could’ve been William’s laboratory to test the Parapluie Virus on clones with the hoping of developing OGAS-consciousness-compatible subjects - as well as their shared telepathic connections, possibly through the OGAS’ connections to the Inverted Forest, which itself could’ve been used as testbed to study Nirvana’s potential consciousness-connexion capability. It’s unclear exactly why the OGAS cultivation experiments were being conducted in OKB-167, considering he and Carter’s plan was to infect the Sangvis Ferri Mastermind and Persicaria’s clone-derived Doll squadron to form the Relic “key”; theoretically, it could’ve just been the testing ground for Parapluie on Nytos derived from Lunasia’s brainscan, observing the possibility of the sprouted consciousnesses sustaining development in Virtual Cognition Images and the shared Inverted Forest neural cloud space - all to confirm whether or not the experiment could be reproduced in Dolls. The chief issue here, however, is that William and Carter only wished to obtain the key from Elisa during the Butterfly Incident, and the entire reason for Griffin’s two-year quarantine of Sangvis was because Lycoris had unexpectedly purged a number of base protocols from Elisa’s LVLIII Base Layer.

In the years since, Hela had continued success, spawning an increasing number of Nytos, yet none had shown the desired immunity, immediately demarcating them as nothing but trash in the eyes of William and, probably, the other Paradeus heads. The goal of Hela ultimately appears to be an immune clone - or Doll, in the case of Elisa and M4A1 -  with an OGAS consciousness that can act as the key to the Relic Civilization, bypassing the genetic locks and Collapse Radiation emission issue through immunity and carrying the key of OGAS, fragmented instances sprouted from the Parapluie Virus' extraction of a seed of the Source. Although this may be inexact, it's an idea that properly binds together the Hela Project, the cultivation of OGAS, the collective consciousness of the Isomers, Lunasia's stolen soul, and the discovery of the Perfect Antibody. Perhaps William was faced with continuous failure among the Nytos, none of which had yet shown the desired immuno-resistance, but this is a non-factor for Dolls, possibly intriguing him in a sufficient OGAS-structured neural cloud that could properly cultivate these consciousnesses. The caveat to this theory is Machlian’s existence, and why she held such importance to Paradeus, having her blood drawn from her respective plant; the very fact of her partial immunity is redundant to the idea of discovering immunes as Hela-OGAS subjects, if that is indeed the case. Although true that the plan against Lycoris during the Butterfly Incident, and against Persicaria, by extension, occurred years before 2064, it still begs to ask why Paradeus hadn’t yet used one of its partial-immune successes, as the very girl that Machlian and Morridow derived from was said to be immune, discovered after an Iaso Box attack on her small town or village. 

For what reason would this girl be better off undergoing Hela than becoming Paradeus’ prime subject? One such explanation may be that they wished to sacrifice this piece to spawn plenty more pawns, using her genetic material as a blueprint to continuously trial-and-erroring until the perfect was created. Furthermore, perhaps implanting an OGAS consciousness into a Nyto clone was a Tower of Babel-promise, with no true matured instances like Dandelion appearing, until she was finally nurtured in the apparent prime environment - Lunasia’s consciousness emulated through Persicaria’s M4A1 - hence the need for a robotic medium to carry this matured instance until it eventually assimilated Nimogen’s body. Up to Chapter 13, William and the others had seemingly failed to activate a Relic system, and aligning with William’s boast in the chapter’s ending, all his efforts were finally realized when the Reverse Collapse phenomenon and its potential resonance with the Relics had been proven. Given that, according to Machlian’s case, it’s significantly more challenging to find, preserve, and replicate immunes than it would be to infect a desired Doll with ELID, maybe Dandelion was a test of OGAS’ criticality to the Relics, observing if a matured OGAS was even capable of such feats. Although the Juvenile Nytos - likely Lake-derived clones with implanted OGAS instances - have shown sufficiency with piggybacking Nirvana, perhaps none had yet shown the desired result of a full connection, thus opening the gates into that dream world. William’s statement was rather forthright on the events in OKB-167, testing the veracity of the up-to-then hypothetical Reverse Collapse, which ultimately proved true once Dandelion was temporarily bestowed the base’s Relic “fuel” by the Voices of Nirvana as a means of transporting the Dolls out of the base through its Reversal. At the same time, it also begs to ask why William sought to secure Ouroboros from Sangvis Ferri’s old facilities in Dual Randomness, wherein Paradeus was deployed to secure a backup copy of her AI, which Persicaria requested G&K contain before William could act, preventing him from accessing the SF-derived OGAS consciousnesses, revealed to him through Elisa’s own partial activation of the Starfish. Elisa’s resonance meant Lycoris’ work into the SF OGAS Protocol had tremendous potential; the initial purpose of the Butterfly Incident was, after all, to secure Elisa’s OGAS neural cloud, but Lycoris’ removal of her some base layer commands stunted this effort, necessitating the G&K quarantine. From the initial OGAS experiments conducted in OKB-167 to the matured Dandelion, much of Paradeus’ Relic-based research has been directed towards honing OGAS, but nothing explains why none have yet satisfied William’s vision. 

It’s plainly difficult to ascertain William’s purpose with all these separate nodes and applications of OGAS, and it’s not as if any single one would be incapable of achieving his goal: activation of the Relics. Taking Schwaben at his word, if Paradeus’ ultimate objective is a cloned human subject capable of accessing the Relic OGAS System, then two possibilities must be present: barring a subject of genetic resemblance to the Relic Civilization species, this individual must possess near- or complete-immunity from ELID, along with a consciousness that can form connections to Nirvana, mandating consciousness to be digitized in order for the mind to shift into this external, white “digital” sea of thought. Just as Lunasia-M4 entity explained to Morridow, the utmost important quality of a Nyto is their immuno-resistance, and if they did not meet this stringent prerequisite, they were immediately declared as failed specimens, then repurposed for other projects and work. Time and time again, the Nytos only consisted of failures, solely churning out useful slaves and warriors at best, yet none satisfied the ultimate criteria. Although the circumstances are not exactly clear, including certain conditions, the overarching goal of Paradeus seems to be this: the creation of perfect genetically-applicable individual through endless Nyto synthesization, which are formed using the Lake of Cognition’ memory fragments as a Nyto consciousness blueprint; the embedding of a perfectly-matured, “chosen one” OGAS to be installed into their VCI, forming the perfect symbiosis of a digital mind that can readily access Nirvana in a body that can withstand the immense Collapse Radiation dosage; and lastly, deploying this hypothetical individual to the Relic facilities with the expressed aim of fully activating the Relics’ outermost genetic locks, thus opening the gate to Nirvana without succumbing to mutations. Matching Schwaben’s testimony on Paradeus’ activities, this experiment possibly is the Hela Project’s true purpose. 


M4A1 faces off against the OGAS that possessed Nimogen’s body in the
Epiphyllum field outside Tallinn.

When the Failed Isomer in Tallinn possessed Nimogen’s body, she, along with the other Isomers, described the epiphyllum as divine, as they represent both salvation and death to all. As she put it, “Those chosen by this light are forgiven and earn the right to enter Heaven, where they can find bliss and rest.” There’s two different ways to interpret this: first, the declared failures are cast away to Tallinn, and when the vast field blooms, the “chosen one” will be filtered from the dead, surviving the Red Zone-and-beyond levels of Collapse Radiation, leaving the chosen to live, thus revealing themselves as an immune, wherein they become the perfect immune candidate, enabling them to enter “Heaven”, or as we’d call it, “Nirvana”; on the other side, this is literally supposed to mean entering Heaven, as in released from the mortal plane through death by radiation exposure. Considering “William’s” strange obsession with the flowers, perhaps the former grants a final chance for a Nyto to prove its usefulness, revealing an immune body and consciousness. While entirely a stretch, perhaps the Voices of Nirvana were OGAS consciousnesses embedded from filtered test subjects in Tallinn; however, this wouldn’t explain why Dandelion’s activation and interaction with Nirvana would far exceed these preceding tests, so it’s best left for debate as for what exactly the purpose of William’s experiment in Estonia, namely its relation to the Hela Project and any possible resonance with Nirvana in its past. The letters found in the fireplace spell out interest among Oberstein’s group, possibly “Paradeus” at the time of writing, in poaching Meitner due to her stellar background, especially in relation to the American Holy Grail Project - itself a Nirvana simulation-Human Connectome project, making her an invaluable member with extensive knowledge on Nirvana. If the ultimate goal of Hela is the creation of that perfect individual, and it’s been said to be a failure even among the most successful of the batches, then who better to aid this endeavor than one of the world’s most prolific Relicologists?

Given Morridow’s immune-resistant failure, it’s true her entire life was a lie from the beginning; however, Morridow has outright spoken that “Nytos were created to change world”, and when considering Paradeus’ purpose, as well as its methods, it certainly paints the picture that the harbinger of the promised new world will be the individual fated to satisfy both the immune and OGAS preconditions. For now, it remains to be seen how this perfection will be achieved, as the “chosen one” OGAS is said to deliver the OGAS’ fragments to their origin, just as the “perfect individual” is said to deliver Paradeus’ promise to humanity. When the day arrives where humanity opens the gates of a dreamy Heaven, the aslumber Source may awaken, but that’s a topic best left for Reverse Collapse, wherein Jefuty is gifted the key to fate’s chains, possibly granting humanity salvation from William’s world-eclipsing wish. Into the future, Paradeus marches with humanity in tow, all in the name of its Father’s perverse ambition, giving him equal ability of destruction and rebirth - a story that very well may usher in the world’s destruction, just as the Voices of Nirvana foretold. According to Confidential Files 1, “Three Goddesses” was the colloquial name by later generations that understood what the GAVIRUL Project vowed, as they were offered a chance at this so-called divinity, taking control of Nirvana’s keys, thereby delivering destruction or rebirth to humanity. As with the story of Prometheus, humanity has been offered a chance to become their gods, joining the deific halls through mastery of a realm so beyond current conscious comprehension that perhaps humanity itself requires collective ascension to be worthy of the Olympian fire. 

Herein lies an interesting question: if the Three Goddesses were derived from the White Rose, herself a genetic reproduction GAVIRUL subject, then what purpose does a perfect individual with an OGAS consciousness hold? Without access to the genetic data, nor the expertise that a joint URNC-AU scientific endeavor would offer, the only path towards artificially activating the Relics was the perfect individual, who themselves may exploit OGAS’ intrinsic homesickness so as to see the a mature “key” consciousness form, with this key then being transplanted to an immune host with a proper neurological/VCI structure, enabling an artificially-created perfect to resonate with the Relics. Perhaps William is seeking any and all possible OGAS derivatives for this test, allowing for more extensive study into an ideal key, and by extension, the duplication of Paradeus’ success. William wanted Ouroboros’ backup AI for access to the SF OGAS Protocol, as it granted them an opportunity to field more loyal Doll units, but additionally, Elisa proved a matured, OGAS-derived neural cloud could resonate with the Relics. Therefore, if a key could continuously be honed, with all possibilities and mediums of OGAS tested, there’s a distinct possibility that SF’s protocol structure could be applied to Nyto VCIs, perhaps shaping Nyto consciousnesses into an ideal structure for a matured OGAS, akin to Elisa’s. Even if Paradeus had achieved the Perfect Antibody, their mind would still have to be the perfect mold for OGAS, allowing their mind to enter Nirvana, aligning with Schwaben’s findings on Paradeus’ primary experiment.

Addendum I - The Goddesses of Hela (2040s-2092)

In the earliest concepts for Girl of the Bakehouse 2, of which would later become Codenmae Bakery Girl, Mendo had an older sister in the Antarctic. Obviously, Bakery Girl was a massive departure from those concepts, not to mention Bakehouse isn't canon; though, they did plan for Mendo having a sister. Originally, this sister was a completely separate character, an older sibling who worked in either Antarctic intelligence or special operations.

Rosa Helenae
In the lore of Bakery Girl and Reverse Collapse, after the Antarctic Research Team assigned to the Three Goddesses Project were ordered to return to Antarctic immediately, Professor Philip Martin, Helena von Oberstein, and their son, Mendo, left, but not before being halted by URNC State Security agents who detained them. In Canberra, a group/rioting incident broke out, and it's believed Philip was killed in the chaos, unless he was purposefully eliminated by URNC security or William's men, or alternatively, kidnapped and forced to continue working under the URNC. As for Helena, all we know is that Philip was separated from his wife when they were detained, and her whereabouts have been unknown ever since. Perhaps Helena's unique position as one of Three Goddesses researchers led her to volunteer to carry Jefuty in the womb, who she later delivered sometime between 2079 to 2081. This is commonly-tread ground, but Mendo once did have a sister in the old, noncanon works. In Bakery Girl, Jefuty and Lige wished to find their mother, a woman they knew as "Rose", which was, originally, a reference to White Rose's “Atropos” DNA sequence once used to create them, with Atropos representing one of the Greek Moirai - the sister that severs humanity’s threads, serving as the absolver of life. The Project created the GAVIRUL subjects through test tubes (G-214 “Noel” [Lige] and G-264 “Lunasia”) and in vitro fertilization (presumed, G-178 “Jefuty”); however, Jefuty and Lige might've not known the identity of their mother, or in Jefuty's case, her birth mother due to the project's secrecy, thus confusing "Rose's" DNA as their - or rather, Jefuty’s - birth mother. Altogether, it’s almost certain that the Three Goddesses were exempt from specific files and information on the project, likely leading Jefuty and Lige to believe they descended from the same origin, unaware of Jefuty’s uniqueness as the only one born from a surrogate mother, so to speak.


Portrait of Helena von Oberstein in Mendo’s pendant.

Jefuty's birth mother has always been a mystery left unexplored, but with the advent of RC, revealing the origin of Philip’s wife, Helena von Oberstein, and the Three Goddesses, there's a nonzero chance she's the birth mother - a recursive continuity going back to the original BH concept of Mendo having a sister; albeit, this sister is entirely different and wasn't Jefuty.  Helena's name is uniquely interesting, specifically its etymology. If we consider the names "White Rose" and "Helena", an interesting - albeit, tenuous - connection can be found between the two. Enter the rosa helenae, the rambling white rose - an eye-catching and tree-climbing species of the Rosa genus. It's a stretch, admittedly, but the connection of white roses and the identity of "Helena" also has another connection in Girls Frontline 2: Exilium, in the form of the young girl discovered by the Dolls of MBV Elmo, marked as "E-Helena-O-43" in her box. Comparing her approximate age and the issues between the events of Helena von Oberstein’s life in the late 2060s, Helena-O-43 is obviously not Helena von Oberstein. Helena von Oberstein was an adult woman living in the Hollow City with her husband, Philip, and her son, Mendo, by April 2074, so how did a young girl, possibly a clone of Helena von Oberstein, end up on a Bounty Hunters Rights Extension Foundation contract? Moreover, based on the clone-like similarities, "E-Helena-O-43" could mean "Experiment(al)-Helena-Oberstein-43", with the 43 representing either #43 or 2043.

Given her ages when she married Philip and had Mendo, she must've come to the Antarctic as a very young toddler, infant, or may have been still carried by her mother when Beacon was activated. Her birthday has never been said, so we’re left to guess her age when marrying Philip in 2068. Philip was recruited into the Antarctic Institute of Physics at the age of 23, so Helena, a fellow Institute lab technician, likely joined around the same age, approximately early 20s. Although their ages are not established in 2068, we can assume they were likely wed in their mid to late 20s, with Philip possibly being older by a few years. Sticking with middle-of-the-road numbers puts Helena’s approximate birth year between 2040 to 2044; however, Helena probably cannot be any younger than 23, as she’d be born after the start of the Isolation Era in early 2045, complicating how her DNA could’ve been acquired for Helena-O-43’s cultivation, unless DNA was found after the fact, then replicated by Paradeus for indeterminate reasons. It’s possible she was born just before the Isolation Era began, having been born overseas in the first few months before WWIII and Project Beacon’s completion. 

Tomorrow’s Blossom

Eight Helenas walk towards the horizon through the blooming Epiphyllum field.

Eight regally-dressed girls hold hands in harmony around an Epiphyllum flower.


In the May 2022 animated PV for GFL2, there’s a peculiar scene of Helena-O-43 standing amidst a field of blossoming epiphyllums, staring into the strawberry-colored horizon, and when looking back, seven duplicate “Helenas” are seen striding through the flowerfield toward her. The following year, in the opening cutscene for GFL2, there’s a specific scene of eight regally-dressed girls dawning tiaras, their hands joined in a circle around an epiphyllum flower, giving off an aura of royal or religious prestige. While in possession of Nimogen’s body, the Failed Isomer referred to the flowers as divine, and hidden within the Galatea-aligned Flora Institute was a Paradeus-aligned cult that worshiped plants as holy life forms, viewing humanity as their fertilizer, hinting at the subterranean furtive trafficking of epiphyllums and hallucinogenic flowers from the facility. 


The Flora Botanical Research Institute in Bremen, Germany.

When the flowers bloom, the blossomed region is saturated with their internal-Collapse Radiation, dooming all but immunes. Leone Michel, Senior Researcher of the Flora Institute, explained that she oversaw the propagation and mutation of flora species, researching certain resilient species capable of guiding humanity into the future; one such species is the epiphyllum oxypetalum, also known as the “queen-of-the-night” - the subject of “William’s” core research and the core of the Iaso Box WMDs. In the vision of Michel, a member of this internal Flora cult, plants offered mankind an opportunity forward, guiding them away from their endless strife, and towards a new future paved in harmony, just as plants have “learned to live” blissfully without errancy. While Paradeus’ underlying zealots lack recognition of the true scope of their worship, there’s some parity between the visions of the common cultists and the supreme Avernus, wherein only those “neither alive nor dead” kneel to Father and Nike’s radiant sword of victory, pointing towards the heavens of Paradeus’ destined future. As the prayers speak of in Avernus, its truest denizens are slaves outside the domains of Heaven and Hell, neither a merciful death, nor a serendipitous life granted to them, as the Nytos are the incarnations of Paradeus’ zeal and the ultimate result of the Technical Theory of Biological Human Automation - a spliced, transhumanist existence, whose false digital minds are cruelly reconstituted into various forms by a machine satiated by consciousness and bioenergy. And yet, despite all this bloodstained glamor, no incarnation meets the requirements of their Father. 

Like the plants described by Michel, humanity cannot, at current, coexist in harmony while licking their wounds from war and the Relic disasters, but Paradeus seemingly offers that chance of unity, changing the world by raising the collective unconscious of mankind, and preparing them for that eponymous coming day of God. Although very little is known about Paradeus in GFL2, the organization is a vast shadow of its former self, or better said, its zealots are mere radicals that follow in the principles of becoming one. While Avernus may have fallen, William’s power and promise transcends any engineering marvel, and the cultists in GFL2 possibly still carry this vision, offering the same respect as the Nytos to the Paradeus statue and the epiphyllum flowers. Referred to as “Unitas” in the files, which literally means “unity” or “oneness” in Latin, the name is eponymously linked to Paradeus’ theorized purpose, wherein they, to quote Galatea’s motto, create “possibilities in a new world”, possibly all for the expressed purpose of raising humanity to a state they see fit for the Relics, as even William himself was remarkably impressed by OGAS’ efficiency in Singularity. Perhaps the epiphyllum are the expression of Paradeus; apart from their obvious gruesome uses, flowers offer a chance at unity - or as the Flora Institute cultists may say, harmony between peoples - bringing them together in a new world. Furthermore, from the Holy Grail Project to OKB-167, the most gilded and enigmatic of all Relic research pertained to Nirvana, the promised homeland or intermediary of OGAS. Both the Holy Grail and Hela Projects involve a study of consciousness, with obvious differences; however, the study of Nirvana is the essence of their research, possibly the reasoning for why Blackwell described the Holy Grail as a “Human Connectome project”, which may refer to affixing memory fragments to the Lake, while the Hela Project takes it a step beyond, subconsciously networking the VCIs of these spliced, artificial entities through the Bee Sting System and the Inverted Forest. Perhaps this collective conscious link is seen as a necessity to promote order in the new world, but as for Paradeus and its subservient cults, the worship of epiphyllums is now hammered into their ethos, possibly because of their equal ability of rebirth and destruction, as well as the symbolic promise of human unity, as studied by the Flora Institute cultists. In the GF2EX opening scene, the eight girls joining hands around the Epiphyllum flower are firmly symbolic of these concepts of unity, as the worship of the “holy” Epiphyllums have found peace in this ravaged world, steadfast amidst the contamination. For Paradeus’ greater purpose, at least, the Nytos and Epiphyllums represent the promise and future that its worship brings, delivering salvation to its loyalists who bend the knee, becoming one with each other and the world as they step into a victorious future of boundless possibility beyond the Relics.

As for the girls themselves, it would be a great coincidence if MICA chose to model and animate eight Helenas in the May 2022 PV and eight unified girls in the opening cutscene, depicting both groups alongside Epiphyllums. Considering this, perhaps both groups are one and the same, with the unified girls representing eight Helena (Oberstein) clones; furthermore, given the near certainty that these girls are clones of Helena von Oberstein, then may “E-Helena-O-43” literally means, Experiment(al) Helena Oberstein 2043, with “43” not meaning #43, but 2043 as her birth year, aligning with her approximate age, given her DNA must’ve been collected prior to WWIII in 2045. If so, Helena was 24 to 25 when she married Philip Martin, which makes sense considering the time frame, as she was a fellow lab technician when they met. But this begs to ask, why was Helena’s DNA collected, and further, what made her the candidate for these girls, all of whom are presumably complete-immunes, as E-Helena-O-43 has shown no fear, nor signs of infection in face of high-level Collapse Radiation? Additionally, in the May 2021 PV, the Dolls of MBV Elmo witnessed Helena “resonating” with the Epiphyllum, quickly raising them to blossom, elevating the ambient Contamination Index.

Helena’s Perfection

One of the E-Helena-O clones standing before a crystalline structure in a presumed Black Zone.

In the opening shot of GFL2 PV2&3, we see one of the Helena clones, presumably ours, standing before a towering crystalline structure in a Black Zone that shimmers with an eerie blue glow as a murky-bluish-green haze hangs low around her. At this distance, any human would undergo an exceptionally violent reaction - their body immediately violently seizing and mutating as silicon metastasises, dealing an immensely painful - albeit, quick - death, or mutating the few surviving bodies into enduring ELID-Infected. Essentially, it would be nigh-impossible for a normal human to reach the center of the Black Zone, even with excellent protection. It’s unclear what Black Zone this is, rather it be Beilan Island, Ground Zero of the Northern Lights, Salt Lake City, or another smaller, unspecified Black Zone, such as the Dead Sea; however, given all the GFL2 lore refers to the Black Zones as the ground zeroes of Relic disasters, it’s possible this is Beilan Island, but that’s merely a guess that opens a can of worms for questions on: whether or not she was actually there; if this was a precognitive vision, similar to Machlian and the Commander, both of whom are partial-immunes; how she made her way to Beilan Island; and if there’s a reason a Helena clone will, is, or had stood in the very place where Black Lily and White Rose were suspected to have been located on the eve of the Beilan Island Incident, raising questions on their involvement in the matter. 

In the second scene of PV4, Helena is seen standing in solitude above an infinitely-spanning body of water, holding a blooming Epiphyllum or white rose as its petals drift freely across this anomalous space. Were it not for the supreme solitude, it’s a rather serene scene, with the Sun’s rays reflecting off the water and flower petals gently drifting. As she peers into the flower, the scene cuts to reality, where a Varjager Gang marksman is moments away from firing at her motionless, upright body. Just before the bullets make their mark, Colphne jumps in to push Helena out the way, thus starting the escort mission to extract Helena to safety throughout the PV. After the climactic battle against the Varjagers, the Dolls of Elmo and Helena stand proud and unharmed, but just as they’re about to set out, Helena seems to realize something, causing her consciousness to sink down to another place, submerging into its abyss as the last rays of Sun are seen shimmering through the translucent barrier above. Notably, consciousness space seems to be a watery abyss, given the bubbles seen rising from the depths. As she sinks deeper, she reaches out to the last vestiges of light refracting through the surface, then suddenly, the surface shattered like glass when an unknown Black Nyto dove towards Helena, as if she were her savior. 


E-Helena-O-43 sinks into her “neural cloud space” as a Nyto bursts through the surface, reaching out for Helena’s cheek.

The moment the Nyto’s hand touches Helena’s cheek, she experiences several visions or memories of herself or the others: first, a scene looking up at a surgical light; second, a group of cloaked individuals staring at an Epiphyllum basked in holy light, possibly representing the Paradeus-Unitas cultists; third, a blooming red Epiphyllum; and lastly, a group of strangely grotesque and eroded people or statues, which seemingly show these figures undergoing silicification from ELID, yet they possess no discernable features, as if their statute-esque appearances have turned them to husks, possibly meaning these are ELID-Infected humans, cowering in fear, with one even holding what appears to be an infant. There’s zero evidence for this, but if you desire theory, then perhaps these peculiar figures were not ELIDs or Cultists, but rather, members of the Relic Civilization. Upon returning to reality, Helena was seemingly locked in a trance as she emitted a strange aura, causing the Contamination Index to increase, culminating in the blossoming of the Epiphyllums. Dumbfounded, the Dolls can only watch in astonishment at this “miracle”, which then cuts to a scene of Darture peering from an Epiphyllum field towards them, wherein all the previously white epiphyllums are cast in a wave of scarlet red, with the very same red haze seen in the May 2022 PV with the eight Helenas.

During episode six of the Beilan Island Shelter Broadcasting dev blog series of GFL2, Yuzhong outright described this scene of her sinking as her falling into her “Neural Cloud space”, and makes subtle nudges on the identity of the Nyto who dove to likely save her, rhetorically asking whether or not this Nyto was actually a Nyto. First and foremost, this Neural Cloud space seems very indicative of the Lake of Cognition, given the apparent presence of several characteristics, which include: the infinitely-spanning body of water that Helena stands atop of, similar to the Lake’s infinite surface and depths, which may imply this space is Helena’s Virtual Cognition Image; the abyssal sea-like atmosphere of this space, with bubbles rising from the murky depths, just like the letters from Gray Blackwell’s memories, which were illustrated by bubbles in the Lake; the complete, infinite darkness, exactly as described by Angelia’s Hela experience; the shattering of the glass-like surface by a Nyto to reach out to Helena’s consciousness in the water, mimicking exactly the Evangel Axis’ control function, which gradually expands the ice sheet between the Lake and Nytos’ individual Virtual Cognition Images; and the existence of a Nyto in this scene at all, as all Nyto consciousnesses were synthesized through shuffling and combinations of memory fragments from the Lake. In Helena’s memories or visions, standout among them is the surgical lamp, which certainly relates to other experiments conducted on Helena(s) in the past, or more aptly to Slow Shock, the moment of the source subject’s Hela procedure, wherein their memory fragments were embedded into the Lake of Cognition, becoming potential seeds for future Nyto consciousnesses - akin to a Nyto’s Alaya-Vijnana, a foundational storehouse of seeds of future karmic actions that represent the existences of the respective individual. Putting it all in order paints the same picture of Helena and Nyto consciousness; the scenes of reality are her Nyto consciousness, the scene on the surface of the Lake is her VCI, and the scene of her sinking into the abyss is her mind regressing into the Lake. Given Helena’s evident immunity, perhaps she too experiences the visions of the future in her VCI, possibly from Nirvana or beyond.

Paradeus’ “perfect individual” is William’s ultimate goal, likely manifesting as a genetically-edited and augmented clone of complete immunity, implanted with a Lake-synthesized Nyto consciousness, so as to cultivate an OGAS consciousness - extracted from the source code of OGAS compiled in the Parapluie Virus, which acts as the vector from the extracted seed of the Source - in order to enter the Relic OGAS System, Nirvana. Simply put, the eight Helenas are likely the first true successes of the Hela Project, carried onwards by William in the URNC after the fall of Avernus. Apart from the Three Goddesses themselves, the Helenas are possibly the closest chance William and his colleagues have achieved towards the divine individual; however, it may still be too early to jump the gun, as evidence of an OGAS consciousness in Helena’s possible VCI is notably absent, yet nothing exists to invalidate this theory so far, especially considering that screening a clone’s immuno-resistance is fundamental to the overall objective. Additionally, Yuzhong referred to the scene of the Nyto reaching out to Helena as “reaching towards the Sacred Scriptures/Canon”, possibly in reference to Michelangelo’s The Creation of Adam, or alternatively, the Sacred Canon of the Sanctifiers, 42Lab’s Super Cloud Server AI-antivirus program, but it’s fair to say that this generally refers to Helena as a “divine” figure of Paradeus, becoming the one that untold tens of thousands have been sacrificed toward. Yuzhong later adds that this Nyto is “invading” her consciousness - not out of malicious intent, but full of “worry and concern” for Helena, who’s continuously sinking further in the water or Lake. He puts a noticeable amount of emphasis on the identity of this “Nyto”, as if to imply it’s another consciousness taking on that form, a Nyto independent of Paradeus, or perhaps, with what’s understood now, another Helena, but all of this is very theoretical. Lastly, various whispers could be heard as Helena sank, with Yuzhong commenting that the contents of its speech is very relevant to the overall plot. Given these whispers were heard in what’s seemingly the Lake, the most likely candidate is the corrupted, adrift memory-consciousnesses that resonate in darkness, with the extracted fragments serving as the last proof of their damned existence. Notably, Dreamer of Fe56 was temporarily pulled on the edge of the Lake during Operation Ilya Muromets, locking herself in place as her consciousness sank closer to the water’s edge, and here she heard the haunting, disembodied voices of those damned to the Lake of Avernus, symbolizing the deadly gateway to the underworld - in Paradeus’ case, Hel. A second, more tenuous theory suggests certain OGAS consciousnesses in our world or Nirvana communicating to Helena through the “Nyto” in the Lake, pulling her out of subconscious and revealing certain memories or visions to her from the past, present, or future, analogous to Machlian’s future visions of Operation Cocoon and her fated death. Although the whispers are indecipherable, they’re likely to continue being an important story element in the official release, namely Helena’s background and the overarching conspiracy behind the Relics.

Two Hemispheres, Two Helenas
It's by no means of coincidence that the Helena clones and Helena von Oberstein share appearances; Helena-O-43 is almost certainly a clone of Helena von Oberstein, or theoretically, they could both be clones from the same project, with Oberstein being among the first subjects. In GFL2, despite the obvious pink hue of Helena-O-43's hair, she's been named “white hair”, which can be seen at the ends of her hair. White hair, a name with an etymological connection to white roses, along with Helena-O-43’s partial-immunity, suggest a possible link between the Helenas and White Rose’s Atropos. However, in the original, subject-to-change canon, William led the effort to resequence the Atropos DNA, then worked with the “Three Goddesses” project team to test it for the GAVIRUL subjects. Herein lies the problem: we don't know Helena von Oberstein’s background well enough to declare anything as fact; however, several ideas surface on her family history, given her prominent surname. With her aforementioned age, there’s strong inclination for Helena von Oberstein to be born prior to 2045, possibly in 2043, but who were her parents? Oberstein is a tactfully chosen name and by no means a coincidence with the Obersteins of Germany. 

Occam’s Razor would suggest Helena von Oberstein's father was a younger brother of Rudolf von Oberstein, who fled to the Antarctic Hollow City with his family after Project Beacon moved into its final phase between 2041 to early 2045. Oberstein had known relations with the “Relic Agency”, possibly referencing the prior UNRA, and his reputation was reportedly quite poor among his colleagues for unstated reasons. As a staunch German nationalist, his loyalty to his homeland is unshaken, so perhaps that's the reason he and his family are not in the Antarctic today, refusing to forsake Germany because of patriotic fervor. If the Relic Agency was the UNRA, which is seemingly the case, especially considering that Avernus - a structure Oberstein is aware of - bore the emblem of the UNRA in its underground, pre-WWIII foundation. By 2041, the UNRA shifted its offices to the Hollow City, symbolizing a major step towards the finalization of Project Beacon. Oberstein's loyalty, matched with his direct connection to Paradeus through Galatea and Avernus, as well as possibly the Beaconist Photon Project, may have driven him away from the Antarctic or had him outright rejected by his contemporary, moralist peers; however, a rebuttal to the latter is the fact that several of these radical medical scholars eventually made their way into the Hollow City, wherein they infiltrated the bioscience sectors, promoting forced genetic evolution technologies. So where does Helena fall into this? Rudolf is eldest son of the 7th generation of the Oberstein family, implying other 7th generations exist but remain unnamed. If you take Helena von Oberstein's approximate age into account, her age in 2074 aligns with that of the two most prominent 8th generation family members - Lunasia and "William", the children of Rudolf and Nemhran; the identity of the latter remains yet unconfirmed. Lunasia and William’s ages are unsaid, but the manners of which the siblings speak suggest William was born in the mid 2040s, with Lunasia being a few years old, placing Helena’s birth year around the late 2030s to early 2040s, but no younger than 2045, as 2043 both aligns with this approximate birth year span and shares the digits at the end of “E-Helena-O-43”.

Knowing that Helena's father likely isn't Rudolf, unless she was cast out or purposefully sequestered away by him for unknown reasons, that leaves Rudolf's unnamed siblings open to be her father. If the family tree holds true, then one of these unnamed siblings, likely a younger brother, is the father, who presumably had taken his side of the Oberstein family with him to Antarctica in 2041-2045. Bluntly said, Helena’s surname is what unites the theory on Oberstein’s past, as part of the Oberstein family line had to immigrate to the Hollow City before WWIII. The wealthy, plutocratic Obersteins go back eight generations, possessing a strong connection to German academia and government. Project Beacon required the greatest minds and fullest wallets for research and development of the Antarctic Hollow, and with Rudolf's reported connections to a “Relic Agency”, it's feasible the Obersteins were direct investors and members of Project Beacon. But when the beacons of the project were lit, Rudolf’s loyalty to his nation outweighed the Beaconist promise, leading to either refusal to leave with his presumed brother, or be rejected by the sensible among the UNRA. This still doesn't answer the question at the core of all this; why does Helena Oberstein share the appearance of eight partially-immune young girls, who all seemingly are clones of her? What was the source of these experimental subject’s DNA? GFL2 began on April 15th, 2074, 29 years after the closure of the Antarctic great gate, permanently splitting the Oberstein family between North and South. If the eight Helenas were clones of Helena von Oberstein, which certainly seems to be the case, then what are the implications of a potential connection with White Rose? This is certainly layering theory upon theories, but the similarities are all too close for comfort. 

When “Helena” was created by William, presumably, it’s without question they were born from Helena von Oberstein’s DNA, but how could this be, given she’s lived in the Antarctic her entire life, which continues its Isolation Era to GFL2? Assuming William or Paradeus hadn’t possessed Helena’s DNA prior, it would be impossible for her DNA to come into the hands of anyone, unless her genome was recorded somewhere outside the Antarctic. If so, then two questions must be then asked: one, why would William willingly choose to resequence Helena’s DNA in search of the perfect individual; and two, what makes Helena’s DNA the perfect sequence for the Perfect Antibody? For Helena’s genome to even be replicated at all outside the Antarctic, she must’ve been born prior to the Isolation Era, with the DNA sequence either being preserved or recorded by the family for reasons so-far unknown, or used in an experiment that the Oberstein fathers may have been involved in. This is the point where speculation turns to rampant tenuous theorizing, as the total dark zone of information from this time makes it nigh-impossible to determine what happened two decades ago. The union of Oberstein, Galatea, and possibly, 90wish and former Photon Project members that went on to form Paradeus sometime in the 2040s had a vested interest in the Relics, as inferred from Oberstein’s letters about poaching Martha Meitner. The Hela Project’s closest subject to success was Oberstein’s own daughter, Lunasia, who may have been a partial or complete immune, snatched from the manor for what’s said by Oberstein to be a “necessary sacrifice”. It’s intriguing that E-Helena-O-43 has shown full immunity, and it’s reasonable to believe Lunasia was as well, at least partially. Lunasia was Oberstein’s direct descendant, while the E-Helena-O’s were presumably developed from Helena von Oberstein’s DNA. If accurate, both daughters of the eighth Oberstein generation have a link to immunity, representing Paradeus’ primary goal in everything it’s done since the 90wish supercomputer experiments to test the viability of Relic activations. If Lunasia truly was the closest Paradeus had ever come to the “perfect individual”, with implications that her soul may have glimpsed Nirvana or beyond, perhaps “something” found within Lunasia’s DNA may also exist in Helena’s, as the 7th generation birthed Lunasia and both cousins were female, preserving chromosomal completeness in the same manner as all five surviving GAVIRUL subjects (Black Lily, White Rose, Jefuty, Noel, and Lunasia). 

Saying that a hypothetical “something” exists with little evidence for how it relates to Helena is certainly flimsy at best, but the existence of the immune Helena clones sparks this discussion. Why do they exist, what is the origin of Helena’s DNA, and was Helena von Oberstein involved in an experiment in her infancy prior to 2045? If the Obersteins were connected to the Photon Project, it’s clear they’re no stranger to genetic experiments of nebulous ethics, especially with Rudolf, who’d later go on to serve as the presumed first Father of Paradeus before being either killed and replaced or succeeded by his son. While “something” is weak, that “something” drove Paradeus to create the Helena clones, of which at least E-Helena-O-43 has proved sufficient genetic perfection towards William’s end. Alternatively, it’s possible that the Helena clones are the result of years-long research into immunes, using the traces of Kazusa’s or Machlian’s DNA that Nemhran and her servant Nytos had extracted from the Paradeus plant to genetically replicate and refine the subjects today. As all Nytos are reborn from the Lake in the form of bastardized, synthesized consciousnesses, the consciousnesses of the Helena clones are seemingly no different, as they must’ve been created from the recombinations of a certain person or many who underwent the Hela procedure. It’s a fantastical stretch and not directly relevant to questions on Helena, but maybe the very name “Helena” derives from Hela - polysemous with Helena von Oberstein and the Hela Project itself, symbolizing Lake Avernus’ entrance to the underworld. 

Returning to the original tangent, perhaps the ultimate answer to the mysteries about Helena stem from the oldest known immune: GAVIRUL Subject White Rose, born from the GAVIRUL Reproduction Project in the early 1990s. From her first appearance in GFL2, it’s been obvious that Helena is a complete immune, and before then, there’s only ever been a spare few complete immunes, namely the GAVIRUL hybrids and Kawasaki Kazusa. Rose of the Black Lily and White Rose Project served as the basis of the later “Three Goddesses” Project, with all three successes descending from the replication of Rose’s DNA, inheriting Rose’s growth pattern and the genetic deficiency that caused the growth of white hair. One of the series’ longest-lasting questions has been the veracity of the official Beilan Island Incident report, with questions stemming from Rossartre’s doubt of the Chinese government’s claims of a chain reaction of explosions from the charges used by the SCAPF rescue team, along with the alleged accounts of Lily and Rose taking part in an anti-ELID operation on the eve of the Incident, reportedly because of the “unique nature of their bodies”, sparking debate on whether or not the sisters’ actions were responsible for triggering the incident. With the lack of accurate reports due to the incident and WWIII, much pertinent information was lost, along with their whereabouts. By 2074, E-Helena-O-43’s immunity has been observed from her first moment, depicting her or another Helena clone standing in the center of a Black Zone; furthermore, despite the obvious pink hue in her hair, likely deriving from Helena von Oberstein’s strange light-pink hair, she’s been called “white hair”. Very little connective tissue exists between these theories, but again, total absence of definitive information leads to rampant speculation; however, to entertain the idea, say Helena’s immunity actually originated from Rose’s Atropos DNA sequence, which was later used in the Three Goddesses Project, who Helena von Oberstein herself was seemingly a member of. If this were the case, why would Helena’s DNA be used to create clones using the Atropos sequence? Stemming from the very reason why Helena von Oberstein why or how Helena’s DNA would even be used for such a subject, let alone the sequence’s questionable origins, perhaps the Helena clones are early replications of the Atropos sequence, which had been put into cold storage after the 1990s. This wouldn’t provide an answer as to how Helena von Oberstein’s genome was replicated, unless she literally is White Rose, which would serve to explain how the Helena clones are immune and share an appearance with Helena von Oberstein; however, both she and the clones possess light-pink hair, with strands of white at their ends, so this likely goes against this notion.

In the uncut version of the animated RC PV, there’s a scene of a long-haired woman in white staring into one of the GAVIRUL or Shrike clone tanks, appearing physically weak in the laboratory. The similar tufts of hair seen on Jefuty are visible on either side of her head, and this very same tank is believed to be the cultivation tank for the hybrids or the Shrike genetic specimens. In another scene, on the floor of a bloodsoaked laboratory, bathing in the same bright white of the laboratory tank, a nude woman shriveled in pain as abnormal growths began spawning from her spine, causing her entire body to “mutate” in real time, and when she faces the camera, her face is revealed, depicting a malformed abomination, featuring severe hyperdontia, a slack jaw, overgrown face, and radiant fuchsia-colored irises. Moments later, several organic, glowing-red growths are seen erupting across her spine, which then erupt into various independent versions of the prior woman, all showing psychotic expressions. The adult woman seen in the long-white dress might have been Helena von Oberstein, possibly kidnapped by the URNC after the Canberra Incident, as her whereabouts are left a mystery to the Antarcticans. The mutated woman in the laboratory floor could’ve been Jefuty or Noel, with the divergent clones being Shrike specimens, but maybe it was Helena von Oberstein again after she approached the tank, whose body had been corrupted by William after being taken. After all, in the original Bakery Girl, the main motivation of Jefuty and Lige was to find their “mother” Rose, who actually was their genetic ancestor, as the Three Goddesses resulted from the resequencing of Rose’s DNA.

Notably, in Chapter 1 of RC, Jefuty remarked upon Mendo's absurd healing after he’d suffered a deep flesh wound from a URNC bullet, healing only in a matter of hours under bandaging; however, the Photon Project members had embedded themselves into the bioscience and health sectors of the Hollow City, perhaps the results of their forced genetic evolutionary technology made their way into Mendo as a young boy through Professor Philip, and we’ve seen Mendo and TASA troops amidst the blooming Epiphyllum fields, suggesting that he and others of the Antarctic military had undergone genetic immuno-resistance augmentation. As for the Helena clones, perhaps Rose’s DNA was possibly related to the Photon Project, and considering Lunasia was likely still a teenage girl in 2051, placing her birth year in the years following the project, she and her cousin Helena may have been introduced to the results of the Beaconist forced genetic evolutionary technology prior to 2045, with Rudolf and his brother as members of the radical faction. Given Lunasia was seemingly the closest to perfection Rudolf and Meitner had achieved, perhaps Paradeus had existed since the early 2040s. Do keep in mind that all of this is rampant speculation; the Sun is only just starting to shine across this greater conspiracy, and we’re certainly going to learn much more come the next major story event and the release of Reverse Collapse. Regardless of the truth that lies at the heart of Helena von Oberstein and the eight Helena clones, something exists in Helena’s DNA that enables perfection, be it her familial connection to Lunasia, the result of the Photon Project, or literally being or descending from White Rose’s Atropos sequence.

A Necessary Sacrifice to Hela II (2051-2064)
In the years following Operation Couatl and the end of WWIII, Paradeus’ work had continued in total isolation, never being exposed again until the Commander-led Operation Aeneas on October 5th, 2064. After 2051 to 2058 is a great span of missing information, leaving much to the imagination of the readers, yet research into the Hela Project continued, widening the Evangel Axis’ ice sheet into an iceberg as more souls were continuously sacrificed to the Lake of Cognition. In the discovered letters, the author, likely Oberstein, wrote again sometime after first recommending to poach Meitner when she would eventually arrive in Germany in early 2051, explaining that the Hela Project had been poorly researched thus far, adding that no successful case had come to light, so he may have overestimated her talents.
