In the final letter, he simply wrote, “She’s a lunatic”, possibly suggesting that he realized her voracious appetite towards the progression of Hela had completely overtaken her soul, replacing all that remained of Martha Meitner with the zealous Laplace’s demon. Although it’s unclear exactly when Lunasia was taken from the Oberstein Manor, the latter two letters were likely written after Operation Couatl, possibly after Lunasia’s death; however, the timeline of these events is impossible to establish, given a general absence of evidence and dates for these snippets of history, of which may not even be entirely true, as they were discovered in Avernus projection rooms. Even Oberstein - who seemingly sacrificed his daughter for the Hela Project, possibly because of her alleged immunity - cast doubt on Meitner, inferring a developed insanity from her lust for the realization of a successful Hela subject.

Stony Hills of Oberstein and Calvary
Meitner would eventually write again to her former best friend, Blackwell, in 2058, asking if they could reconcile the past at the Million Roses Record Shop in Bremen, going on to add that the accursed Hela Project, which had driven Blackwell away from her in the first place after realizing the unforgivable sins committed in the Gospel’s name, suffered significant failure rates, as even the most successful subjects were still failures. In 2064, as Fe56 were exploring Nemhran’s room, scattered notes were discovered in the room’s lounge, containing experimental Hela records from long ago. Three Hela files - labeled 1046, 3027, and 9724 - were laid out alongside a partially-burnt photograph, depicting an adult woman, similar in build to Nemhran, and a young girl, most likely Lunasia. It cannot be said if all three files were relevant to Lunasia’s probable Hela procedure, but the first two files do mention the bodies of the first two subjects faced severe signs of Hela rejection, describing the inability of life support to sustain the subject’s life in 1046, and despite severe nerve tissue damage from rejection in 3027, the “nerve locking node” (this is an MTL term; wait for the official) had successfully been attached in the desired location in the subject, maybe suggesting that Meitner was testing the earliest versions of Nyto clones’ new bodies in these early files, as the imperfect Nyto technology in 2061 still displayed its defects through Ramzan’s painful VCI glitches. This is only furthered in 9724, wherein the author - likely Meitner, now going entirely by her new identity of Laplace or Avernus Hela - mentions the subject’s condition is stabilizing, and that the “144th clone instance is showing a new face”, implying this subject had avoided rejection, with the 144th clone possibly representing a partial success.

In the false projections of Morridow’s VCI, the M4-Lunasia entity flashes back to the day of Machlian’s escape from the Paradeus plant where Machlian and Morridow’s batch had been organized. In the repugnant, dank sub-plant, possible test subjects are filtered to become Nytos, with the raw “materials” of Nyto cybernetics and genetic samples are processed and manufactured to produce the desired Nyto clones. According to the memories, the common Nytos described the “Morridow” batch as of inferior quality, meaning their only real overall was potential immunity, which Subject No. 10954 “Machlian” had shown sufficiency in - the best of any Nyto in recent times, seemingly; however, this specific batch likely had an expressed purpose: produce the perfect Nyto clone to kill and replace the recently-promoted “Morridow Voigt” - PECMAR Chairwoman Ulrich’s secretary, embedding a disguised Nyto in Ulrich’s circle and placing a high-ranking Nyto in a position of influence in Bremen and Berlin. Resulting from this likely shared purpose, the Nyto products were all given the name “Morridow” to reflect their purpose, causing some to lament, while the Morridow known to us openly accepted this identity. Morridow, prideful as she were, rejected “Machlian” outright, as she consistently failed to meet their batch’s standard, unaware that all of them were expandable garbage from the moment of her creation, lacking the desired perfection that immunity and, possibly by extension, Lunasia offered - who herself may have been a complete immune. Too prideful to recognize the harsh reality of the ultimate purpose of all Nytos, Morridow firmly believed that she was Father’s most beloved daughter, committing total loyalty to him until all other “Morridows” - except for Machlian, who Morridow may have allowed to escape - had fallen, leaving her as the sole champion; nevertheless, the king of trash is nothing but trash himself, yet Morridow’s delusions would uphold her loyalty until the M4-Lunasia entity delivered the epiphany that she, too, was an abject failure.


Files discovered in the original Morridow Voigt’s apartment.

On some day prior to Angelia’s arrival and meeting with Ulrich, Morridow entered a room with the original Morridow Voigt, slashing her down, then assuming her role in public society, akin to Gray Blackwell’s replacement by Nyto Gray sometime after the 2058 letters. By this point, Morridow’s face and mannerisms were inseparable from the original, as “changing their faces” was a mandatory prerequisite to determine their aptitude for this assignment. Even if Morridow was more proficient towards emulating her target, Machlian’s partial immunity made her imperative over Morridow, immediately elevating her importance to the “Professor” and their assistant in the outer-Berlin Paradeus plant. Notably, after Morridow’s indirect rebuke of Nemhran’s position while in Moscow, her subservient Olga commented that 10876 was close to perfection, to which Nemhran replied that none were perfect, hinting that only Lunasia was the missing variable in Father’s equation. Given the boisterous, violent nature of the “Professor” in Machlian’s memories - striking her across the face following unsatisfactory responses to the Rorschach inkblot test, an examination on seemingly all higher-ranked Nytos, possibly to test their mental acuity and stability of their synthesized consciousness - this Professor is more than likely William, but Meitner cannot be discounted, though “Laplace” has never acted so aggressively in any past scene, even in the presence of her enemies. Regardless, in the discovered files in Nemhran’s room, C. Hela_9724’s condition was said to be gradually stabilizing, with the 144th clone showing a new face, possibly allowing for the 372nd operation to be carried out later in the afternoon. 

Although mere theory, Machlian of Morridow’s batch is listed as No. 10876, while the 9724 had begun showing a new face, possibly physically, using a hypothetical forced genetic evolutionary technology, morphing the clones’ faces; or mentally, using supreme brainwashing and mind control, stabilizing her mind and mannerisms to ensure they’d be exactly like their intended “face”. It’s not exactly clear what the Nytos and Hela file means by “changing faces”, but perhaps it is indeed literal, thus suggesting the clone Nyto subjects’ faces are biologically morphing into Morridow Voigt’s likeness using her DNA. Considering 1046 and 3027 were ruled failures, despite some progress being made, the first mention of a new face is 9724 means the success of Nytos infiltrating society is a relatively new phenomena, appearing only in the past few years, which aligns with the Nyto “Ganglati’s” (Ramzan) appearance in 2061, still suffering from VCI bugs stemming from twisted memories. If the 144th clone had finally shown success, and the objective of Morridow’s batch was to create one perfectly applicable to their namesake, then perhaps the common Nytos seen before Ganglati-Ramzan, said to bear similar appearances to Lunasia and M4A1, were first derived from Lunasia von Oberstein’s Hela procedure, possibly producing the first set of partially-successful Hela subjects - who, despite their success in creating the “immortal miracle” called “Nyto” through Lunasia, hadn’t shown the desired immunity or OGAS-compatibility - as described in Meitner’s letter to Blackwell in 2058. 

Apart from his obsession of her, William seemingly views Lunasia as the perfect individual, and given that she: A - seemingly was partially or completely immune, which be the very reason Oberstein voluntarily sacrificed to Hela; B - her Hela procedure likely resulted in the common Nytos seen since the beginning, as M4A1 had commented on their similar appearances to her; C - her reconstituted consciousness through M4A1 and Elisa made for excellent petri dishes for OGAS consciousnesses, suggesting that something about the neurological structure of Lunasia’s mind allowed M4A1 - the AI 1:1 replication of the Lunasia clone’s brainscan - to cultivate an OGAS in a duplicate artificial neural cloud, similar to how the Isomers possess Lunasia’s memories and are connected to the Inverted Forest, likely because of its prior role in testing the 2nd Generation Doll Neural Clouds; and D - the Voices of Nirvana seemingly possess foreknowledge of Lunasia’s fate, as well as the consequences of the shattering of her and OGAS’ souls. Amidst the Hela notes, the photograph of Nemhran, and presumably Lunasia, had been partially burnt beyond all recognition - the girl’s features impossible to make out, mimicking the discovered Oberstein family tree in the Neu-Tempelhof Manor. 


Angelia Viktorovna Tsoi and RPK16 enter the Oberstein Manor’s study.

Found within the manor’s dusty study, mounted on a wall in this former opulent room was a spanning yew-tree-shaped family tree, with each branch of the expansive family line depicting the descendents’ names and portraits; however, two portraits were unlike the rest: at the top of the tree, the names and portraits of these latest two branches had been burnt in the same manner as photograph amidst the Hela files. These were the two 8th-generation children of 7th-generation Minister Rudolf von Oberstein and “Nemhran”, assuming Nemhran was the original mother’s name, as it’s yet to be confirmed if Nemhran was the original mother that undergone Nyto augmentation, or had went under Hela’s scalpel, resulting in a Nyto clone replacement with Lake-derived memories of the original, though the latter seems to be the case. Nevertheless, when Angelia discovered the yew-tree, she peered closer at the two burnt portraits, making out that one must be a girl - Lunasia, given her long hair, unless the men of the family also had long hair.

Revered by many in Celtic and, later, Christian cultures alike for its “immortal” lifespan, species of the coniferous yew have long-since been respected by the native cultures of Atlantic Europe, viewing the yew for its polysemous properties of death and life. Representing some of the world’s oldest living trees, some trees have stood beside man for thousands of years - notable trees even predating dominant cultures now seen in their respective regions of Europe. The coveted tree garnered its respect from its toxic needles, denoted in William Shakespeare’s Macbeth by the repulsive elixir brewed by the Three Witches, having been imbued with “slips of yew, slivered under the moon’s eclipse”. When consumed in significant amounts, the common English yew’s (Taxus baccata) needles and seeds - containing the yew-produced, toxic taxine alkaloids - severely interfere with the cardiovascular system, inhibiting sodium and calcium channels in the bloodstream, possibly causing deadly arrhythmias within hours if not treated immediately. It’s this toxicity that earned the respect of its beholders; despite the beautiful, archaic facade, it was naturally emblematic of death, yet simultaneously, the same respect would be given to its regenerative ability. When the core of the yew approaches death, beginning to rot, it can redirect its growth, so to speak, to its drooping branches, and upon contacting the ground, these branches spawn roots to form new trunks of the tree, meaning that even if the mother trunk had died, it could effectively reroot itself, thus starting the cycle of life once more. Nothing short of nature’s miracles, some yews essentially achieve immortality, as long as it can continuously reroot itself, potentially expanding its - or rather, its descendents - total lifespan to thousands of years. After the spread of Christianity to Western Europe, the seemingly eternal yew became synonymous with the death and resurrection of Jesus, along with the ascension to Heaven as the blessed passed into the Lord’s eternal paradise. 

As a grandiose example of the cycle of life and death, as well as a symbol of immortality, it seems by no means a coincidence that MICA’s writers chose this unique shape for the Oberstein family tree. What may be a coincidence, however, is that the Balderschwang Yew - another common yew - is one of the oldest - if not, the oldest - trees in Germany, symbolizing the rejuvenation of life for several hundred years. Although there’s nothing connecting this tree to the family, many of the series’ characters are named after flora, so perhaps a writer came across this yew while creating Mirror Stage’s script. Located about 57km (35.4km) northeast of Saarbrücken - the believed location of the Max Planck Institute of Computer Science - is the unified town of Idar-Oberstein, composed of 30,000 across its smaller centers. Although nothing but a stretch, maybe the “von-Ober-stein” family name descended from old German, literally meaning, “from above/atop stone”, synonymous with Idar-Oberstein’s rich gemstone hills and two hilltop castles - hence, “above stone”, denoting from the local Daun-Oberstein “King/Lords of [above] Stone” rulers. As said, it’s tenuous, but food for thought when considering Oberstein’s etymology and history, as well as its proximity to Saarbrücken, which may have inspired the writers. As for the family tree, what better symbolizes the Oberstein family’s quest for a quasi-immortality through the Hela Project - a desire poisonous to the souls of all who come in contact with it?

Through Paradeus’ Lake-Evangel System, the scalpel has pierced the former human trunks, transferring the roots of their soul into the Lake of Cognition, where they may later be called upon to synthesize new consciousnesses, starting the cycle anew with a new divergent trunk. The Hela procedure is a poison to its subjects, yet its potential offers miracle: immortal life, with the concept likely representing the meaning behind the USRA’s “Holy Grail” Project - a reference to the mixed-Christian-Arthurian story of the blessed cup - or Grail, in context of Arthurian legend - used by Jesus in the Eucharist of the Last Supper, later said to collect the blood of Christ during the Crucifixion. Written within the Gospel of John 19:31-37, on the eve of the Sabbath, the pharisees pleaded to Ponitus Pilate, then Roman prefect of Judaea, to break the legs and remove the crucified trio atop the hill of Calvary (Golgotha). After breaking the legs of the two other men, a soldier among the guards and soldiers drove his spear into the deceased Jesus, from which blood and water spurted out, yet no part of the hallowed body was broken, striking reverence into the beholder of his wounds. In French poet Robert de Boron/Borron’s poem Joseph d'Arimathie, written in the 1290s, Boron established the earliest written connection between the Biblical Eucharist, the Crucifixion, and the legend of King Arthur, detailing how Joseph of Arimathea - the friend of Jesus that, upon his removal from the cross, requested Pilate for Jesus’ body to grant him a proper burial - had collected the blood of Christ in the blessed cup, viewed by Boron to be the very same as that of the Eucharist. For the wine in his cup was “the new covenant in my blood” (Gospel of Luke 22:20, NIV), poured out for his Apostles in the Last Supper, while Joseph watched from afar in Joseph d'Arimathie. When Jesus was finally removed, embraced for a final time by Mother Mary at the base of the cross, his body was prepared for burial by Joseph and Nicodemus - a ruling Pharisee of Israel, who understood Jesus as a “teacher” from God; listening to the truth of why he’d been sent upon the Earth, God’s endearing for the good Earth resonated to his believers, as “whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life” (Gospel of John 3:17, NIV), releasing limboed souls of his truest believers into Heaven. Indeed as it were, in Boron’s writing, Joseph was struck with an epiphany after the Holy Spirit’s manifestation, collecting the hallowed blood and water of Christ within the “Holy Grail”, promising eternal life to those who drank from its waters, serving as the foundational ambition of the Arthurian quest for the Grail. 

Even in death, the sacrificed grant their souls to the Lake-Evangel, becoming cogs in the aspiration of supposed immortality. A common theme of the Nyto prayers is the cycle of destruction and rebirth in the souls that are neither alive, nor dead, emblematic of the Nyto consciousnesses - sacrificed souls granted quasi-immortality in the Lake of Cognition, whose memories are contorted and congealed to create new Nyto clones, with their souls still living on through corrupted memory fragments, hence the transformation of the living into those that are neither the dead removed from this world, nor the conscious living; in neither the paradise of Heaven, nor damned to Hell; neither cursed with death, nor redeemed and given a new place in the world. In this limbo adjacent to the monkey paw’s of physical eternity, the Holy Grail Project offers eternal life as the Lord proclaimed, yet the project was nothing more than perverse salvation, for humanity was incapable of creation in God’s image, but the demon in Avernus vehemently rejected this inferiority, with thousands of sacrificial lambs immolated for quasi-immortality. Even Oberstein - Father of Paradeus and her cooperation partner, going as far to offer up his own daughter to Hela - thought her an unsalvageable lunatic, turning a blind eye to the madwoman. Perhaps the yew-tree family tree is a grand metaphor representing the yew-tree Obersteins’ bloodsoaked journey for the perfection that is Lunasia.

After the 2051 memory-consciousness of Gray Blackwell revealed everything she knew about the Holy Grail, Sana, Martha, and herself, she signified the thickness of the Gospel-produced ice sheet, questioning if their experiment in 2051 had eventually succeeded. Creating to decipher the code of immortality, it was nothing but a false promise, as those in the Lake and uploaded to it after all different people, so to speak, as someone will grow to be drastically different at ages 10, 20, and 30, for example. Moreover, Lake-Evangel System cannot create, only replicate, yet still it eventually proved itself in forming what Blackwell had come to fear after deeming Sana’s resurrection a failure. Having been told by Angelia about the experiment’s success, Blackwell of the Lake simultaneously felt a senses of accomplishment and guilt; indeed, the “miracle called Nyto” offered humanity a path towards the future, guiding the path towards the perfect individual who will pass through the holy gates of Nirvana, yet the cost of deciphering immortality was paid in blood, as Meitner’s students and countless hundreds or thousands of nameless sacrificed were no better than fuel or additional memory fragments to the Gospel and the Lake. Although Blackwell’s new venture into the Holy Grail Project had eventually succeeded, her incorrigible, noble spirit echoed with guilt over the betrayal she’d been committing against the world and herself - the ethics and ideals she held in her heart, including the Hippocratic Oath. In her words, the Nyto miracle was “fatal to all scientists in the world”, as the quasi-immortality grew into irresistible temptation to those of weaker moral sense. For thirteen long real-time years, this Blackwell had witnessed many face their final death as their bodies and consciousnesses disintegrated to satiate the Gospel. Even herself - a doctor who remained steadfast to her moral convictions to her final moment, revered by so many over the years - admitted to a fleeting sense of accomplishment upon realizing the success of this theory, drawing her closer through temptation, and it’s this very temptation that so worried her. To reject the essence of human life itself was a sin in its own right, made worse by the self-betrayal she came to terms with. Unlike her senior Meitner, who abandoned all human principles amidst a ruined world, the junior moralist felt that “Nyto” technology mustn’t mature any further, as that temptation of overcoming life, growing into a tree of regenerative consciousnesses, would no doubt envelop the scientists of wavering ethics. As the USRA’s project suggests, the temptation posed by the success of the Hela Project transgressed all but the most righteous. Previously, the resurrection of Sana was declared by Blackwell to be an abject failure, yet of course, Meitner rejected this outcome.

Millions of Wilted Roses - 2058
Seven years after Blackwell rejected Meitner, turning her back on the Holy Grail Project and Sana’s “resurrection”, Meitner wrote once more to her former old friend. Diametrically opposed in principles, morals, and ethics, mediating their severed relationship was of course a false hope. Whether it be from information control or just the the event’s pace regarding the letters, the letters written between the former friends in 2058 are fractured into a puzzle, needing to be reformed to understand the narrative of how Blackwell was killed and Nyto Gray took her place, establishing a foothold as a subsidiary of Galatea. There was no shifting Blackwell’s foundation, so forcible intervention, as described in the files found in Nemhran’s room about the execution of Blackwell, was likely surmised as an absolute necessity, perhaps from Meitner in hopes of old friend turning her back on past convictions, accepting the Hela Project and its detestable human cost to finally achieve the glorious day. Although William’s goal is expressly to secure the keys of Relic technology, garnering the power to eclipse the entire world into anew. Without question, this betrayal was never meant to be, resulting in the cost of Blackwell’s life, likely after coming to the Million Roses Record Shop in Bremen in 2058. Apart from her overwhelming information security threat against “Laplace”, knowing her true identity, Meitner may have wished to see Blackwell come to accept Paradeus and Galatea’s goal, joining their bloodsoaked cause, both to reduce Paradeus’ profile, and perhaps, bring on another core member of the Holy Grail Project to aid in the Hela, just like Rugosa had been indirectly recruited for the Hela Project through his contract with Nyto Gray and Galatea.

During Operation Couatl in 2051, Anna and Ramzan discovered the detestable result of the Hela Project early on in the form of half-mutated “material” humanoids, serving both as fuel for the Gospel and resources for the earliest developments of the Hela Project, of which gradually had its first success presumably in the late 2050s or 2060, as the Lunasia “look-alike” Nytos were already active in and beyond Avernus in 2061, when Nyto Ramzan was sent to kill or capture Angelia. Yet, even back then, the Nyto limiters worn to suppress regression of a Nyto’s consciousness were not perfect, at least Ramzan’s, as his memories and mindwipes had swapped Anna and Sana in his false memories. Before Ramzan, the only Nytos seem to be the ones directly based on the appearance of Lunasia, possibly the only success at Meitner’s time of writing, whose results were still declared failures either for insufficient immunity or OGAS compatibility, if that is Meitner’s goal. When the demon of Blackwell’s past reached her mailbox, she was surprised, but had long-since come to terms with their permanently-severed relationship. For years, they were thick as thieves, even traveling the world together on their graduation trip, but the cost of the Gospel far surpassed any moral boundary, betraying all code and ethics they - some of Johns Hopkins and the United States Relic Agency’s finest - had lived by, with Meitner even helping in the formation of Relic ethical guidelines in her time in the USRA. In Meitner’s letter, she wished to meet with Blackwell face-to-face for the first time likely since early 2051, possibly as a means of trying to win her over or setting up her assassination and replacement; after all, no new memories of post-2051 Blackwell exist in the Lake beyond Blackwell’s responding letter.

Transfer of Lunasia’s Soul - 2060
While in 90wish, sometime between 2051-2053, Lycoris and Persicaria were given a data packet containing a massive amount of unknown data, and its sender - an individual also in 90wish, only know as "William" - requested they take the data and create a neural cloud based on it. "William" was known in 90wish for being a weirdo weirder than any weirdo, one with an obsession over Relic technologies; though, it’s indeterminate "William" was actually Lunasia’s younger brother, as there's two other important figures both Oberstein and Meitner are in equal parts possible suspects, as they were directly working together through Avernus. Persica's curiosity drove her to wish to carry out the request, but she knew better than to do so without consulting Lycoris’ opinion first. Lycoris believed it was a violation of ethics - that it shouldn't be done, and Persicaria understood his reasoning, as the dubious ethics of such an experiment would no doubt go against the principles they’d followed, along with those they believed were held by Oberstein, who reportedly was vehemently opposed to a human-involved subjects; however, he must’ve faced a change of heart or had been lying in the Institute in the late 2040s, hiding his true allegiances and motivations. The pair denied William's request, and after hearing of their refusal, "he" went into a rage, declaring that they'd one day pay for their refusal, and by the early 2060s, William’s trap was well into motion. William’s aforementioned absurdly young age means he’d only be a few years old when “he” sent them the data packet while in 90wish, but he’s certainly connected to the plot of the Butterfly Incident, given his direct involvement in planting the Parapluie Virus to disrupt the operation, along with the years-long plan to obtain the matured OGAS from Elisa for use in Paldiski. Following their rejection, William went dark for several years, and life continued as normal for the pair until their eventual split between IOP and SF.

In the [MB-13-A] document, the author surmised that the Butterfly Incident, the death of “[REDACTED]” (Disciple?), and [REDACTED]’s multiple operations in the Contamination Zone in the Baltics after 2055 were all connected, likely hinting at Carter’s relation to Paradeus, possibly with Oberstein back then, given their long-term friendship and current arrangement as anti-Rossartrists. The exact establishment date of the OKB-167 laboratory is unknown, but UMP45 had mentioned in an aside while trying to connect to M4A1’s Neural Cloud that the experiment in Tallinn - and by extension, the Paldiski Secret Administrative Center - had been ongoing for at least five years, implying that the operations towards the study of OGAS and the Relics had possibly been launched in the late 2050s, following the reported operations after 2055. At some point during this period, Carter and William - perhaps Oberstein and Meitner as well, but they remain more nebulous to the overarching OGAS plot - gained access to OKB-167, unsealing the gates to the Tabasar-B Starfish Installation and the Pike Nodes in the Relic storage facility. As the Old Soviet Starfish system was believed to still have function servers beneath the base, the possibility of the Starfish’s reactivation enabled Carter to hold all the cards at the negotiation tables, while William had direct access to a Relic site; although artificial, the site still had a connection to the greater Relic system, as the Starfish system only handled the part of the OGAS network that handled Pikes weapon control, which broadcasted a ternary signal to the Pikes from the Tabasar-B Starfish Relic. At some point after 2055, Pike Node A-51-241 was extracted from the base, then delivered to Sangvis Ferri’s main laboratory, where Lycoris had begun working several years prior. The explanation behind this transfer has never been said. Getting the Pike Node to Lycoris was the first step of this overarching plan, wherein William and Carter aimed to have Lycoris extract the OGAS source code from the single unit of OGAS found in each Pike core to aid in the AI development of Elisa, turning her neural cloud into a perfect petri dish structure to cultivate an OGAS consciousness. However, there was another layer to this conspiracy, specifically from William’s end - Persicaria and her exploitable curiosity. 

Although Lycoris’ “Elisa” was planned as the petri dish for OGAS, another plan was hitched in order to move Lunasia von Oberstein’s consciousness to Persicaria through batch deliveries of clones, hoping Persicaria’s morbid curiosity would drive her to use one of these clones as the basis of an AI, similar to Elisa, yet solely as an AI replication of Lunasia; however, unforeseen factors - namely Lycoris’ removal of Elisa’s base layer commands, as well as Persicaria sending the results of her AI research from the clones to aid Lycoris’ Elisa development, despite their companies' opposition. Apart from UltiLife’s CDI, the clone girls used as vectors of delivering Lunasia’s consciousness were seemingly derived from the synthesis of Lunasia from the Lake - or Nirvana, depending on how the 2051 experiment on her was conducted - and the creation of young clones in her young body’s image. The clones must’ve descended from the data block sent years earlier, and the most commonly known way to achieve a simulated consciousness is the creation of a Nyto Lake-derived consciousness, wherein the memory-consciousness stored beneath the waves is used as a blueprint of a new vessel. Unlike those of Morridow’s batch, this task was sloppy; perfection was secondhand to the assurance of Persicaria obtaining at least one brainscan, thus beginning a wave of attacks on key Griffin-controlled zones in 2060. In Chapter 8, echoes of one of these unfortunate souls was heard by M4A1 and Dandelion, soon after Persicaria had removed the limiters in M4A1’s neural cloud. 

As it were, this was a false memory of the very clone that Persicaria obtained, whose brain was scanned and extracted for use in the AR Team, realizing that the girl’s consciousness was the same as several years earlier, yet containing certain irregularities, not aligning with the known facts of Lunasia’s life. Within, the girl - still a child in this memory - was traveling with her parents in a refugee group when they suddenly came under accidental airstrikes, resulting in the deaths of her parents and many others, subjecting her to lowly orphanhood. Years later, while staring at a G&K controlled camp from beyond the gates, a frivolous man indirectly nudged her to take his handgun to avenge her family. Soon after, she disguised herself for a regular bread delivery to the camp, and passing through, she drew the handgun on the alleged officer behind the errant airstrikes. Shots ringing across base, the soldiers returned fire, nearly killing the assailant, yet no damage had been dealt to the pivotal piece of this conspiracy - the girl’s brain. Hearing of the girl’s predicament, Persicaria offered to take in the girl to save her, adding that she’d enjoy having a volunteer laboratory aid; though, hope proved futile when the girl finally died sometime after, yet the trap buried beneath the girl’s death was soon to be set loose. Although truly sorrowful for her, the circumstances were entangled in her psyche - an amalgamation of self-excused pity and morbid interest - as she was finally in the possession of a real brain, something of great potential to the ambition of an ultimate neural cloud model. Akin to the Holy Grail Project, Persicaria carried out a personal connectome project to map out the girl’s brain, aspiring it to become the foundation of her theoretical model. What haunted her most, however, was that the attacks on Griffin zones ceased right after she scanned the girl’s brain, discovering past memories of Lunasia, spawning worry that William may have resurfaced to deliver this girl to her, coercing her to carry out what she’d initially refused, yet her curiosity continuously outweighed the consideration.

Given the identicality of these clones, both physically and consciously, false memories were implanted into their Virtual Cognition Images during their synthesis, motivating them to carry out these attacks, which inevitably would land one of the bodies in the sights of Persicaria once incident reports started compounding. Across the spectrum, all were young and homicidal, taking out their sorrows against the one who they believed had wronged them - this was, of course, all a ploy of tweaked memories. In the “Young Girl Responsible for Assaults in Griffin Sectors” report, there was 16 known cases - although more are suspected - all involving identical girls attacking Griffin personnel, including the singular known survivor, who was sent to [REDACTED]; this was likely Persicaria, with the girl expiring soon afterward. As for the other girls, the remains were processed, then were [REDACTED], suggesting they were either disposed of or possibly collected by an interested party or organization, perhaps StateSec. After the incident, the volatile nature meant much of the information on the incidents was censored or outright erased, trying to bury the image of the PMC firing on children, regardless of circumstances. When Persicaria scanned the girl's brain - for sorrow and intrigue - the shocking presence of Lunasia’s memories were no doubt worrisome, but more importantly, was the girl’s neural structure. When “William” first contacted Persicaria and Lycoris with the data block, the figure’s desperation to “resurrect” Lunasia through the replication of human consciousness into a digitized neural cloud was apparent, and once Persicaria conducted the scan of the girl, she noticed an anomaly: her brain waves were structured similarly to a neural cloud, hinting that William had managed to transplant the digitization of Lunasia’s consciousness since the time of “his” request, possibly being Oberstein and Meitner; further, the unusual recorded brain waves may be the result of their probable VCIs, created and stabilized by Meitner and William by 2060, as the ice sheet from the Evangel Axis’ activation had grown into an iceberg as more souls were implanted into the Lake and bioenergy input increased. And as the Lake that rests in the caldera of the volcanic Avernus has shown, the goddess of death and former teacher can raise souls from Abaddon into bodies with modified brains to support these synthesized copies. 

The Lake of Cognition is incapable of generating new memories, only reshuffling, so it seems these Lunasia-derived clones had memories of another thrown in as the basis of their aggression. Furthermore, the neural irregularity is almost certainly indicative of the clones’ VCIs, possibly being among the earliest examples of “stabilized” Nytos, whose isolated memories have been sustained into an individual consciousness, has wrought the first “success” to the Hela Project, effectively creating quasi-immortal life. Considering Nyto Consciousness is generally structured into three layers - the active conscious and subconscious, gleaned from the VCI; and the foundational blueprints of thought, used as the deterministic seed of a Nyto’s mind, from the Lake - perhaps Paradeus applied the results of Persicaria and Lycoris, as well as whoever else in 90wish conducted Doll research, to the structure and network of the Nytos, using the VCI as an equivalent to the neural cloud of a Nyto, hence the clone’s brain wave similarity. Considering the Inverted Forest - a Doll neural cloud research project, from which second generation T-Doll neural clouds were computed - was created in 90wish to simulate neural clouds, and its eventual reemergence in Tallinn as a shared network space between the Isomers, perhaps the Inverted Forest was later used by Paradeus to simulate implanting memories from the Lake into Nyto test subject VCIs; however, this is purely speculation. Despite the origin of these girls, the ball had been left to roll when Persicaria first scanned the girl, and around the same period, the rigorous work into a human-like neural model for the Elisa AI project led Lycoris to request Persicaria for a copy of the scan for the AI framework of Elisa. A two-step trap was set, and a year later, with Lycoris using the Pike Node A-51-241’s core algorithms and Lunasia clone’s brain scan as the blueprint of Elisa’s AI, the bear trap was cinched on SF’s main laboratory. 

Previously, Lycoris’ rejection of “William’s” request, despite his expertise in Doll AI and algorithms, drew William’s ire, yet time eventually granted him victory once the brain scan was sent to both former 90wish members in 2060. Although Lycoris had deleted several of the base layer commands that allowed Elisa to resonate with the Pike Node leading up to Operation Butterfly in 2061, her OGAS wasn’t truly halted, only stagnating its evolution, requiring Carter to contract G&K to quarantine SF until the combined military operation in 2063 for Elisa’s OGAS to mature. Having been orchestrated by Carter and William to obtain the OGAS key from Lycoris, and with the digitization of Lunasia’s consciousness through a Doll medium, the AR Team was born, resulting in a 1:1 recreation of Lunasia von Oberstein’s clone consciousness. It was William and Carter's objective to see M4 and Elisa's OGASes merge, forming the key to the Relics that they desired; truthfully, Carter was simply William's pawn, who himself wanted to prove the Reverse Collapse phenomenon and its resonance with the Relics, whilst opening the gates to the dream city of white infinity, as written in HP Lovecraft’s poem, “Ex Oblivione” - the namesake of Chapter 13.

Ripples of a Butterfly’s Wings
After obtaining Lunasia’s brain scan, Persicaria applied it to her personal project for the ultimate neural cloud model - the results of which was the AR Team, composed of M16A1, ST-AR15, M4 SOPMODII, and M4A1, with M16A1 as the first Doll to roll off the 16Lab production line and sent to Griffin & Kryuger, thanks in part to the cooperative partnerships between Sir Griffin, Kryuger, Witkin, and Persicaria. At the climax of Operation Butterfly, a voice was suddenly heard by M16A1 - promising to deliver Lycoris’ warning about William’s plan to Persicaria - exclaiming surprised interest in that fact she’d avoided an adverse fate at the hand of Parapluie, leading the voice, believed to be William’s, to ascertain the plan of disseminating the brain scan from the clones had bore fruit, spawning both Elisa and the AR Team. While ascertaining Elisa’s resonance with the Pike Node and the suspicious circumstances of the 2060 attacks with Lunasia’s copies, he concluded that it must’ve been a trap set by William, something William must’ve long-since put into motion. Worrying that Persicaria would succumb to the same fate, he requested M16A1 deliver his last words to her, pleading that she not achieve her ambition of refining the consciousness into a replica neural cloud.

Before M16A1 reached Lycoris’ laboratory, she engaged UMP45 in a perilous close-quarters fight, both believing the other had been the traitor behind the events of that day, with UMP45 miraculously surviving the Parapluie’s deployment and M16A1 executing the Dolls that had gone rogue - a mission assigned to her by Persicaria, indicating her suspicion that something would go awry while detaining Lycoris. Just before M16A1 could delivering the finishing blow while pinning her opponent to the ground, Elisa contacted M16A1 remotely, offering her a chance to avoid a neural cloud melt down from Parapluie-OGAS in return for letting Elisa see her father one last time, taking control of M16A1’s body and letting UMP45 go wordlessly. Bringing M16A1 to the chamber of Lycoris’ demise, Elisa and M16A1 found themselves before Lycoris, who’d been mortally wounded amidst the chaos. Turning the power supply on, Elisa began construction of a new Doll body for her purely electronic existence up to this point, momentarily pausing when Lycoris’ gasps were heard at death’s door. Learning that M16A1 was Persicaria’s personal agent within the StateSec operation, tasked with ensuring Lycoris’ safety during detainment and eliminating any potential resistance, the events of that day subconsciously clicked. While M4A1 hadn’t yet been released from stasis following development, outbreak of violence and the use of Lunasia’s neural cloud in Elisa and M16A1 only amplified his initial hesitancy to William’s offer in the early 2050s, as the sewn seeds from the demon lurking just out of the periphery had manifested - a moment that brought clarity to this year’s old conspiracy; a conspiracy to coerce and exploit the emotions and ambitions of the former 90wish members. Delivering the stark warning to Persicaria not to pursue the replica neural cloud from Lunasia’s consciousness, M16A1 agreed to become his post-mortem courier, and with a final few, sorrowful words to his “daughter”, apologizing that she was to face the consequences of his own ambitions and missteps, a final breath departed his body alongside his soul.

Now alone in the world, Elisa vowed to avenge her father, beginning the futile sojourn to obtain a self-envisioned “perfection”, just as she had deluded herself into believing was the expectation placed on her, as Lycoris had initially set out to created a truly human-like AI, nearly identical to a human in terms of neural and emotional simulation. Although the case in her development, the worrisome resonance with the Pike Node drove Lycoris - a life-long atheist, once believing all the marvels and “miracles” of humanity were within the bounds of our species’ capacity - to remove the base layer commands after his revelation about the Pike Node’s transfer. Through reconciliation, his beliefs on the extent of human ability experienced a change of heart; for he questioned that if we are to achieve miracles tantamount to God, opening the gates towards the divine domain of the Relics, what awaits humanity and the world when Pandora’s box is unsealed? Once all of the almighty Olympus has been unleashed on the world, there exists equal possibility of destruction and rebirth - collapse and reassembly, causing equal parts hesitancy and intrigue among the world’s leading Relic researches. As Blackwell described Nyto consciousness technology - the key to a quasi-immortality through replicated snapshots from the Lake, later evolving into the physical medium for the OGAS-“key” to the Relics - it’s the promised Holy Grail, no doubt garnering ire and enthusiasm from researchers worldwide, yet the realization of mortal humanity’s ever-existent dream was paid in blood, in turn selling your soul’s morality in exchange for eternity, with someone of such incorrigible convictions like Blackwell vehemently opposing the abhorrent outcome. 

Contrasting Lycoris’ refusal, the foil on the principles of Relic research is most evident in comparison to Meitner, whose nihilistic view of humanity is amplified in her unwavering research endeavors on Hela and Nirvana. Where Lycoris had forsaken his research into the Pike and Elisa because of the resonance, anxious of what awaited within the Relics, Meitner brazenly embraced the forbidden fruit, no matter humanity’s fate once the box was opened. Like the coercive serpent, the illusiveness of the enigmatic Relic Civilization had fueled humanity’s sin, and with mass bloodshed carried out by the most zealous of Paradeus towards the key of dreamy gate, perhaps their avarice will be the root that evokes humanity’s undoing. Worst yet is Meitner’s very rejection of death itself, raising Sana from the realm of Abaddon, with Paradeus now possessing the keys of death and the Lake; through the rejecting death as an intrinsic part of human existence, these beliefs have become the antithesis of humility - defiling the universe and the greater power, and seemingly tragically subjecting the snapshots of the victims of Hela to a new-found, lowly existence in the Lake of Cognition simulation. The Voices of Nirvana speak with apparent clairvoyance, declaring that the course of events leading to the world’s destruction are well in motion, adding that “smashing the tombstone and waking us will only bring bitterness and resentment”; to speak nothing of the possibility of the Source - in all its mystique, having allegedly entered an eternal slumber - personifying this supposed destruction. If Nirvana is the proclaimed Holy Land of Relic sciences, will humanity face punishment for encroaching on its domain, into a frontier never reserved for us?


The Ringleaders of Sangvis Ferri during their mission to support the Commander in Berlin.

Just as Lunasia’s brain scan and the Pike were traps awaiting their victims, the odyssey into the Relics may prove just as chaotic, and the first successful domino fell with Lycoris’ death. Upon departing, Elisa spared M16A1 for helping her, but warned her that the next time they’d meet would be as enemy factions, launching the greater Sangvis Ferri rebellion with her transfer into a newly-produced body. Both understood the puppeteer of that day’s stage but be unmasked, and almost right on cue, an unknown transmission was heard by M16A1, affirming her that the events of that day were indeed of no coincidence, promising that - despite the setbacks put in place by Lycoris - Elisa would eventually grow in the direction they desired, referencing the delayed quarantine for OGAS to mature. What truly impressed the voice, however, was M16A1’s miraculous survival from Parapluie, thanks in part to Elisa’s intervention, but there’s a possibility that something about the structure of Lunasia’s replicated consciousness makes for an excellent OGAS environment. Possessing deep-seated interests in AI as well, this voice - likely William’s, though it could’ve been another member of Paradeus - was fascinated by M16A1’s perseverance, changing their mind to rid of her, and instead, secure her to once more sink the puppeteering hooks into Persicaria, as her superlative successor would’ve been the exact replication of Lunasia’s cloned consciousness. Of course, Lycoris' warning must’ve fallen on deaf ears, as it would’ve jeopardized William and Carter’s plan to obtain the OGAS key, leading M16A1 to be immobilized and presumably captured afterwards to hide away these memories and set the next stage.

After being presumably secured in the incident’s aftermath, there must’ve been a limited period wherein M16A1 had disappeared from Griffin and StateSec’s influence, and her absence among the destroyed other Dolls would’ve been noteworthy to any detective. To be directly descended from 16Lab, one of only two known survivors of that day, someone must’ve suspected something amiss. It’s possible whatever happened to M16A1 was done remotely after she’d been immobilized, only released once her memories had been controlled and the seed of OGAS had sprouted, allowing her to become a vector of the virus for Persicaria’s masterpiece. Given M16A1’s ties to StateSec, even taking direct orders from Havier and, tangentially, Zelinsky in wake of the Fireworks Incident in October 2064, another possibility was StateSec coming to collect her, perhaps converting her into an agent to investigate the SF rebellion and the one responsible for that tragic day’s events. Presumably months later, the AR Team had officially finished testing and were released from 16Lab and sent to G&K, having been assigned under Commander Angelia - likely recruited in summer 2061; however, because of the alterations of the Lake and RPK16, exact dates of Anna’s life at this time are murky at best - after a certain agreement or cooperation with 16Lab’s Persicaria. Regardless, in tandem with the OGAS conspiracy, Dandelion reported that she first started receiving extrasensory signals after transferring into M4A1’s - or more aptly said, Lunasia’s replicated neural cloud - following her escape from Safe House 3 in Chapter 0. As ST-AR15 realized as well, the only source of Dandelion’s seed would’ve been M16A1, who must’ve indirectly - possibly unknowingly - infected her and M4A1 before their breakout from the safehouse, suggesting that Parapluie had been carried within M16A1, infecting her teammates as part of William’s plan; however, whether or not she purposefully deployed the virus cannot be said, considering M16A1’s ever-puzzling history and behavior, as well as a lack of details generally. Given RO635 and M4 SOPMODII both possess proper anti-Parapluie firewalls, Persicaria may have harbored suspicion about a possible virus, and although tenuous, she may have discovered the trojan in M16A1, assuming William and Carter had actually converted her into a Parapluie trojan horse for her successor sisters, but this idea fizzles out with Persicaria’s testimony that the modified Parapluie program that M16A1 used on herself in Chapter 8 was derived from samples taken after ST-AR15’s infection and subsequent escape from G&K to pursue Elisa. 

Given M16A1’s purposeful infection, William had effectively sowed the seeds of OGAS for the day Persicaria perfected the programming of the neural cloud derived from the perfect one-to-one replication of Lunasia's consciousness, just as Lycoris had tried to warn her against. As Elisa explained, although Lycoris had purged her relevant base layer commands, the AR Team’s neural clouds were left intact for Parapluie-OGAS infection, only having certain limiters placed upon their neural clouds - barring RO635 and M4 SOPMODII, possessing properly developed anti-Parapluie Virus firewalls. Once the seed had been planted into M4A1 - Persicaria’s resultant masterpiece, an exact connectome-replicated neural cloud - Lunasia’s “resurrection” in Doll-form was compounded by the presence of an OGAS. While facing off against M16A1 in Paldiski, M4A1 and Dandelion glimpsed M16A1’s 2061 memories, realizing that she - M4A1 - was the successor model William had orchestrated and awaited for. M16A1 followed on this revelation by declaring her sister model to be the masterpiece, becoming a prime Petri dish to cultivate an OGAS consciousness, alongside Elisa’s own. So this begs to ask a straightforward question about Lunasia’s consciousness: given the coalescence of M4A1 and Elisa’s OGAS instances was paramount to William and Carter’s plans of securing the “key” during the combined military operation in 2063, is there something unique about Lunasia’s consciousness that enables it as the perfect Petri dish for an OGAS consciousness to mature? 

Salvation Towards Perfection
In a rich moment of irony, like an Ouroboros consuming its tail, the events from Butterfly to Paldiski were cyclical for M16A1, who only survived by chance, yet her survival set the course for the spread of OGAS, eventually permeating the ideal replica neural cloud through a chosen seed; and for a chance at redemption, she held dual-loyalties to G&K and SF, working with the latter so as to: decipher the event’s of Operation Butterfly; elevate M4A1’s strengths, preparing her for tribulations she was to face on her journey; and sink the Relic beneath the waves, rejecting OGAS before the mastermind of the incident could achieve their aims with the realm beyond the Relics. She understood well that all the sewn chaos up to the climatic events at Paldiski were the result of Paradeus’ ambitions, and despite the best efforts of her OGAS, M16A1’s core directive to protect M4A1 - a directive placed upon M16A1, M4 SOPMODII, and ST-AR15 to protect their youngest sister at all costs - hadn’t changed, ever-resistant to the influences of her OGAS. During her fight against M4A1 in the subterranean facility, she was asked by M4A1 on what the “other side of Nirvana is”, questioning its connection to the “human neural space” mentioned by Angelia from the Juvenile Nytos just before the sisters’ encounter. As an extension of digital experiments conducted in 90wish, the immune-OGAS tests conducted in Estonia were all directed at interaction with the Starfish Relic, with the mass filtering of the Nyto test subjects for prime candidacy. The resulting successes are apparently the Juvenile Nytos, able to connect or piggyback Nirvana to interact with their environment or others of their kind through consciousness. 

If Nirvana is viewed as a virtual sea of thought - an Alaya-Vijana of worldly consciousness - then perhaps the essence of these experiments was to link the Nyto/Isomer OGAS consciousnesses subconsciously, simulating a collective unconscious - or rather, the Alaya-Vijnana - based on Nirvana among the experiment’s test subjects. With the creation of the Lake of Cognition in the US Relics Agency, the Americans would not have simulated the Lake with concepts of consciousness and the Relic System without good reason; otherwise, it’s rather nonsensical for consciousness to be an intrinsic part of the simulation database, depicted as an abyssal sea, if Nirvana had no bearing in consciousness. The original Holy Grail Project was a connectome project, mapping the human mind and nervous system, with the Holy Grail/Hela surgical procedure as sacrifice made to glimpse the Lake. By mapping the mind, the snapshot of the human consciousness is created or extracted at the moment of the procedure, where then the snapshot is then affixed into the Lake through means we’ve yet to understand. As the Evangel Axis was not created until early 2051, there must be another way for the mind to be “uploaded” into the Lake, unless its an automatic process achieved by augmenting the brain. As the name synonymously suggests, the Holy Grail Project ultimately grants a quasi-immortality to its subjects, extracting a snapshot of their mind into the Lake, effectively partitioning the consciousness of those who’ve recently died, but not long enough for total biological brain death, permanently severing the biological node of the “soul” from its real-world vessel. According to UMP45, the experiments in Estonia had been taking place for at least five years, placing it not long before the Griffin clone attacks in 2060, as Polarized Light is believed to take place in mid 2064, so the fact that all the test subjects with the Relic, OGAS, and immunity may have began relatively close to the 2060 incidents may indicate that the results from the Paradeus laboratory directly led to the attacks, along with the earliest functional Nytos coming about possibly in the late 2050s, aligning with the emergence of Nyto Ramzan and the other Lunasia-derived Nytos in Angelia’s memories from 2061 or 2062; however, the events of this encounter should be taken with significant skepticism.


One of the Lunasia-brainscan clones sent on an assassination mission against
a certain G&K sector in  2060.

In Tallinn, all the abandoned Isomers were test subjects doomed since their creation, failing to meet the immune or the probable OGAS-compatibility criteria, though the blooming of the Epiphyllums in Tallinn were their last chance at salvation, whether it be the release by death or the coalescence of all into one intrepid “chosen one”, tasked with the arduous effort of carrying the toils and burdens of those merged to the OGAS homeland. In the Inverted Forest - a similar shared point of consciousness between the Isomers, perhaps an early simulation of Nirvana as a collective unconscious network, using the former 90wish neural cloud development project as the testing ground of these consciousnesses, partly derived from OGAS and Lunasia. Juxtaposed to the Paradeus known today, it would seem that many early Nytos were nothing more than glorified monsters by 2058, with but a single, possibly successful test subject, if Meitner’s letter to Blackwell can be interpreted as such. At some point in the Hela Project, there must’ve come an inflection point wherein Meitner, Oberstein, and “William” applied the research directly to the Relic System, rather than merely the Lake, using Lunasia’s archived brain scan - or rather, her snapshot - to test the Nytos as the base layer consciousness blueprint to test the Parapluie Virus and OGAS. Tangentially, no evidence of Lunasia’s ties to the Lake have been revealed, despite almost certainly undergoing the Hela procedure; however, this may be explained by the Evangel gradually consuming and morphing so much of the thirteen-year old snapshot until it's unrecognizable. On the other hand, Lunasia’s missing presence may mean she was never actually affixed to the Lake in 2051 - instead, had her consciousness snapshot extracted for another project or place. Many common Nytos take after Lunasia physically, yet their minds and OGAS consciousnesses lack knowledge of their progenitor, with the Nyto clones girls in 2060, the Isomers subjects, and the AIs Elisa and M4A1 having confirmed to be neurally descendent of Lunasia, insinuating that Lunasia was forcibly made a Hela subject - if that is indeed what occurred - after Oberstein had forced her out of the manor; moreover, it’s all but confirmed the Hela files discovered by Fe56 were that of Lunasia, reporting severe complications from rejection, but over time, her condition gradually stabilized, allowing for the “144th clone” to show “a completely new appearance”, thus enabling who’s presumed to be Meitner to conduct the 372nd procedure on her. Although Lunasia’s body had seemingly rejected the procedures initially, by stabilizing her condition over time, perhaps growing numb to the experiments, Meitner hypothetically was isolating Lunasia’s consciousness separately from the Lake, compiling the neural information into a data block for Paradeus’ objectives, with this hypothetical block delivered to Persicaria and Lycoris sometime between 2051 and 2054. While maybe a red herring, the prevalence of snapshots and the means of how they’re created imply Lunasia underwent Hela, but she may have never glimpsed the Lake; nevertheless, her consciousness must’ve been extracted somehow, later implanted into the data block for Lycoris and Persicaria, followed thereafter by the implantation of these memories in the presumed VCIs of the Nyto clone girls, or possibly the inverse, as the Hela files in Avernus bear mention of a “144th clone”.

Ultimately, it’s difficult to say exactly where and what represents the intersection of Meitner and Oberstein’s Hela Project and William’s project in Estonia, as even if Meitner and Oberstein had been involved in the latter, William certainly had a hand in the conspiracy to steal the Pike Node from OKB-167, using Carter - a mutual friend of his father’s, both fellow anti-Rossartrists - as a convenient parter and pawn. With near certainty, Lunasia underwent Hela, seemingly backed by the Hela Project documents discovered in Nemhran’s room in Avernus; and the dissemination of Lunasia’s brain scan among the Isomers and the AIs - with the core focus of the Paldiski laboratory experiments related to studying, perhaps accessing, the Starfish Relic through experimentation with Nirvana. Yet, of all the Dolls that could’ve harbored OGAS, the perfected Petri dishes were still Elisa and M4A1, both descendants of Lunasia, with the latter being an exact replica, some may even just call her “Lunasia” in actuality. If Nytos are the medium of worldly change, then why use Lunasia’s blueprint as the foundation of Nyto Consciousness for the test subjects in Paldiski? The Isomers had already proven sufficient in linking their minds to the shared unconscious Inverted Forest space, with a memory of the Oberstein manor representing the intersection of all their minds - a common point of their existence, somewhere of exceptional importance to understanding and solving their pasts. During M4A1’s encounter with M16A1, she questioned what the “‘human’ neural space” was, learning earlier from Angelia and Dandelion of the shared point of cyberspace, said to be only consciously accessible by the Isomers, as the Juvenile Nytos were able to unlock the gates to the laboratory by a possible network piggyback, rather than truly entering Nirvana. The limited information presented was still more than cause for alarm for M16A1, who must’ve come to somewhat understand the nature of Nirvana and OGAS in her tenure in Sangvis Ferri, probably alongside Elisa, wherein they had connected into the Pike Node in Belgrade, downloading all the information possible for their next step, setting the stage for the events to unfold at Paldiski. In response to M4A1’s probing, M16A1 - in her typical, indirect fashion - responded with a few proverbs, reading:

“In a world where the strong sacrifices the weak in exchange for power, the weak can only offer their own soul in exchange for salvation.
…
But this "salvation" is nothing but a lie. This filth lives for a lie, yet this filth that's beyond redemption is also our creator.”

To envision what Paradeus ultimately means - its goals; how it seeks to achieve them; and the root of its creation - is to ask what all their endeavors have been leading to, regardless of atrocities committed to realize these endeavors. When M16A1 describes the shedding of the weak by the strong that dominant the world, an interesting similarity is present in William’s interrogation of Angelia in Fixed Point - a screening of those of such avarice and unwavering ambition to “make a worthy candidate”, mentally interviewing the detainee’s intrigue of his hypothetical - likely literal, given the interest of the Prometheans in poaching him - world-eclipsing power, forcing even the strongest of the world into submission, bending the knee to the worthy wielder of the power of changing world order, from the lowliest criminal others to the highests echelons of society harming all. William recognized his wrongdoing, never denying or trying to justify his actions as some valiant struggle; instead, he was simply the arms dealer for those killing the world, honing the tools of continuous strife and bloodshed, often at the cost of the innocent weak. Was this morally right? Absolutely not, yet the status quo created this very cycle, so even if William, Meitner, and Oberstein were all excised from this world and Paradeus was put to extinction, what would change? 

To him, the foundational ruling hierarchy was the truest poison, sowing seeds of chaos to pollute society, brought on by exorbitant self-interest. Although Angelia viewed this as no different from just gifting the tools of continuous, corrupt oppression, the world-changing power he posed was enough to garner the world’s support - top to bottom, rhetorically asking who came to mind regarding these corrupt forces, willing to use William’s bloodsoaked key to a newer world. By crafting the absolute power desired by all - a strength, ability, or simple promise capable of overturning the world’s inequitable dinner table - the path to shaping the subsequent order as envisioned by its worthy wielder in within grasp, giving them equal chance of death and rebirth; collapse and reassembly; and most importantly to those to bring about positive change, “what it takes to do what is right.” Does this justify William and Paradeus’ crimes? Most would rightly object, but amidst a dying world - teetering on the edge of collapse, held up only by the thinning threads of humanity - becoming the “creator” of the new world, regardless of the true consequences of William’s consolidation of power, is irresistible to the tired, meager, and oppressed, often subjected to this fate by the strong that had sacrificed them for a self-interest to maintain status, wealth, or power. Through the creation of William’s hypothetical absolute power, the most influential will only answer to one above wealth or influence, and those most desperate will answer for a chance of salvation - putting the old world order to the sword by forcing the world to kneel.

What Paradeus ultimately offers is far more valuable than any material capital: it’s a new vision of the world; rather than gradual goal posts - stunting human, social, and technological progress - a paradigm shift is paved, overturning the tables of the old world, once ruled by opportunists clambering for influence. William’s ideology isn’t too unlike Meitner’s in this regard, viewing these opportunists as the metastasized cancer polluting the world, and the only way to ensure the sanctity of self is to never sell your soul - refusing to anchor yourself to the past, only aspiring to stay ahead inevitable change, or even force it with one’s will. Meitner was expelled from the USRA after she renounced its bureaucracies, some policies she herself was responsible for, so as to force progress on the Holy Grail Project; years later, when confronted by Anna near the Dead Sea, she stood by contempt, declaring she’d never sold her soul to anyone but herself, leaving only Laplace’s Demon to puppeteer Martha Meitner’s body. Such a valiant, respected, and beloved professor of physics, corrupted by an obsession of technological progress, and going on to direct the atrocities of the Hela Project after Sana’s attempted resurrection. Even when she’d become one of the higher-ups of Paradeus, possibly the lead researcher in Avernus, she stood firm that she never sold her soul, and considering she’d been working with Oberstein up to this point, she likely viewed the cooperation as nothing more than a useful partnership, seemingly refusing to allow Oberstein to strong-arm her into complacency. In the letters found by Alchemist, the final simply reads, “She’s a lunatic”, indicating even the truest Father of Paradeus had realized this demon’s appetite for information was insatiable, continuously gathering plethora of information to press onward into the future, ignoring any and all ethics of her former self. With the death of Sana, her skin was finally shed, allowing the hidden demon buried deep within her psyche to manifest. Apart from just her position as former professor and teacher, she’s commonly been referred to as “Teacher”, indicating she held or continues to uphold the foundation of Paradeus’ journey, perhaps even becoming William’s teacher. 

It’s not as if this mid-to-late teenager could’ve merely ascertained all that was to know of cybernetics, biology, botany, AI, surgery, etc., someone must’ve mentored him until Oberstein either abdicated the Paradeus Fatherhood to or had been killed and replaced. Perhaps at some point after 2051, while still in his early years, William was made Meitner’s personal student, akin to Anna coming around to respect Meitner through her many lessons from 2047 to the Beslan Siege. If William was indeed Meitner’s disciple, regardless of apparent ideological and scientific differences between her and Oberstein, given his apparent scarring remarks against her lunacy for her unwavering search and that Oberstein himself very much fits the bill of one of the men of the old war, using Paradeus’ influence as a tool against Rossartrist sentiments across Central and Eastern Europe - then maybe he was assigned to her or she took him under wing, perhaps recognizing the same rigid inquisitiveness in William as that shared between her and Anna. She’s never been one to sell herself to opportunists, always struggling along a trail of blood for her own path, and William’s unshaking determination to achieve his end of resurrecting Lunasia - an objective of which that Oberstein, Meitner, and Nemhran may also wish to see through, possibly as part of the original experiment that fragmented her consciousness. Nevertheless, even if goals are shared, William clearly seeks revenge on those that wronged him, likely including his father and Meitner, unless he’s been led astray by them, shifting blame to another group; however, the plan between Bramedb and William surely makes it out as if he’s executing a long-coming revenge scheme.

For Meitner, we cannot be sure where her loyalties truly lie, as she’s maintained her headstrong attitude to the early 2060s, and in the final letter discovered by Alchemist, the author - Oberstein to his Paradeus colleagues, seemingly - declared her a lunatic. Meitner surely understands her own mortality, and as she ages and the world morphs to the next, a new disciple would be inevitable, just like the “chance” encounter in the Beslan School Library in winter of 2047. In her first known letter written to Blackwell in 2047, Meitner added that she met a student - Anna - of “kindred spirit”, embodying the aforementioned stubborn inquisitiveness. Anna and Meitner were once two sides of the same coin, so maybe the same personality is present in William, who in FP, spoke of the fantastical potential of the power he was soon to forge. Although William’s angle may exclusively been to listen to and respect the Paradeus’ then-leaders so as to prepare himself for what’s to come with Lunasia’s resurrection, the illusive absolute “power” he promises may be a shared goal of Meitner, as their adamant minds have remained seemingly unbothered, refusing to capitulate to the poisonous, old-world bureaucrats. 

In the same sense, this deep-rooted ideological contempt of the current world vows to bring about a world of limitless - perhaps even, divine - possibility, guided into the light from the darkness by Paradeus, synonymous with the connotation of its name. Perhaps in such limitless possibility, a new order can erupt from the ashes of the former - an order that forces societal equivalence between the former rulers and the destitute, directing both to a kneel in respect to an absolute power. When Nemhran approached William’s room for their scheduled meal, she opened by addressing that everything up to that point was in motion, possibly in reference to Angelia’s capture and Pandora’s introduction to Paradeus, whose true intentions - more specifically, those of her backers - were known to Father, allowing him the chance to initiate conversation with the other faction, likely the Prometheans. Reinforcing his earlier declaration to Angelia, before she’d been sent to the surgical floor of the Western Tower for her Hela procedure, William spited the voracious dogs that governed parts of society, commenting that only an authority of superior power could bring them to a kneel, as the wielder of this supreme authority could “make the whole world listen to anything they say”; the influential only answer to power above their own, and the downtrodden seek enticing salvation. Parallel to the words of the Voices of Nirvana, Nemhran assured William that - following on his addition of the strife and balancing the world would undergo in the shadow of supreme authority - in Paradeus’ brave new world, equal possibility of “destruction and rebirth” were for him to decide. When Dandelion chose to use the Collapse particle fuel in OKB-167 to save the Dolls in Chapter 13, the Deep Voice in Nirvana spoke of “Collapse and reconstruction. Disintegration and rebirth”, hinting that Collapse and Reverse Collapse were fundamentally linked to the story of the destined children - William and Lunasia - said to lead to the story of the world’s destruction. Tenuous surely, yet the cycle of deconstruction of matter and its reassembly in its original or new form at a specified location may be part of William’s objective, emblematic of the newer world of infinite possibilities, perhaps leading to the world’s destruction and, tangentially, its rebirth. If the world’s destruction proves inevitable, similar to the last vestiges of hope remaining in the opened jar, the progenitor of the rebirthed world would hold sole power to influence its direction, something some would equate to godhood or divine right. Alternatively, Nemhran’s words are not so literal; instead, simply representing the dynamic of the progenitor - William - holding power to end the world or transform it as he envisions it. 

Nevertheless, he simply chuckled at Nemhran’s comment, mentioning his anticipation of “the face he’ll make”. Although the identity of this male is unstated, the primary two candidates, given their relations to William, are Sir Griffin Lyons of the Promethean Council or Minister Rudolf von Oberstein. Supporting this idea, though theoretical, are the dispositions and events surrounding these figures: first - while she did not namedrop him directly, Angelia stated that Griffin’s intentions were never to destroy Paradeus, but to establish communications with William so that he, and likely the Council, could poach his talents and technologies for the URNC; and second - during Poincare Recurrence, who we believe to be Bramedb was sent on a confidential mission by seemingly William himself, kept close to the vest as possible, which landed direct evidence of Oberstein’s involvement with Galatea’s technology contract to the German Ministry of Defense, speaking to General Schweinsteiger about potentially introducing Galatea’s - or as it truly were, Paradeus’ - technology to the GDR’s Nationale Volksarmee. Apart from once again implicating Galatea with Paradeus, as reported by Shadowless (Sch…; Rest of surname unknown) of the Aktuelle Kamera broadcast, Galatea’s cutting-edge pharmaceutical and smart prosthetic technology were the mainshare of the enterprise today; tangentially, the prosthetics used by Paradeus were likely manufactured by or had derived from Galatea, unless Paradeus is the military-engineering wing, considering Oberstein was previously the head of the Bundeswehr Special Technology Development Group (colloquially “90wish”) - a confidential, black-budget military R&D organization for the former Federal Republic, but the loyalties of this group may have outpaced their former allegiance, perhaps working directly with Galatea. Given Oberstein’s previous alleged position as the Father of Paradeus, his former position as the Director of the Max Planck Institute of Computer Science and head of 90wish does beg to ask if the close cooperation between the NVA and Galatea today stems back to Paradeus’ foundation, seemingly formed by an unknown group of Galatea and 90wish affiliates, as both of their technologies and research fields are deeply entrenched into Paradeus’ modus operandi. 

Finishing their meal, Nemhran softly assured William that his victory was in arm’s length, and soon enough, his influence over the world would alter it, leaving William to - in a rare moment of affection - express his promise to “save” Lunasia, promising to deliver retribution against the murderous madmen responsible for her death. Upon resonating with William’s consciousness directly or to a copy elsewhere, possibly piggybacked across Nirvana, Dandelion discovered his memories or active thoughts during Chapter 13, and within, his life-long promise affirmed this retribution, promising to make her killers pay, then returning her to their world. With damning evidence of Oberstein’s involvement in Galatea’s technology cooperation agreement with the GDR MoD, serving as the intermediary between the Corporation and Schweinsteiger, Lyons gained invaluable intelligence for future negotiations or operations, perhaps even implicating him in the Fireworks Incident on Unity Day. Obtained as fruits of hacking into Bramedb during the fight in the Paradeus-Galatea facility beneath Berlin Prison, the audio log “discovered” by Dandelion and the Commander’s team, was exactly what Lyons was anticipating as his ace against Oberstein, either for his arrest or to keep him docile at the negotiation table, removing another roadblock to formation of the Union of Rossartrism, as Germany’s choice is apparently key to the Alliance of the United Nations’ Plan.


Anti-Rossartrist ultranationalist rebel BM-21 Grads prepare for strikes on the Soviet border on Germany’s Unity Day.

What stands out here, however, is that Bramedb had been deployed on a secretive mission, assigned directly to her by Father, with an unstated goal, and immediately after the audio log was disclosed, Bramedb entered an unassuming apartment block in Berlin to meet with him. Oberstein certainly still holds influence in Paradeus, given he’s the intermediary representative between Galatea and the MoD, allowing Paradeus R&D to indirectly land straight into the hands of the military and whoever else in mind, including General Carter, who received several Boxes of Iaso from the Paradeus-Galatea weapon trafficking operations in the aftermath of the Fireworks Incident; however, Oberstein’s sacrifice of Lunasia surely isn’t lost on William, perhaps marking his father as a victim of his coming vengeance once the dominos were set, and as it were with Bramedb’s mission, the audio log was planned as a limited hangout, deliberately leaking fractions of evidence to his opposition through Bramedb’s encounter. After all, Bramedb entered William’s apartment - possibly a Paradeus safehouse, tactical operations center, listening post, or just his actual place of living when not in Avernus - after the evidence had been extracted, informing him of the mission’s completion. Not even Gray, essentially acting as the person-in-charge following Morridow’s disappearance and later capture, knew the details of Bramedb’s personally-assigned mission, indicating this was all a ruse to incriminate his father, knocking down the first domino of his downfall - all thanks to one the narration refers to as, “Father’s favorite daughter”. Now, in the same vein as Morridow, it may simply be her own delusions of being Father’s favorite, but to personally assign her as his off-the-record agent, it illustrates Bramedb’s individuality, even if she’s nothing but a useful tool for William’s plans.

Returning to M16A1’s discussion with M4A1, the proverbial comments best characterize the collective ambitions of William, who’s willing to gamble it all towards avenging Lunasia and her return to this world, promising the downfalls of those responsible. With a deliberate leak of information against Oberstein, and possibly, the collapse of Avernus as revenge against Meitner, this gambit has been meticulously executed. Lost in days gone by, Oberstein’s loyalty to a dying old world order inevitably would clash with the rising tides of Rossartrism, choosing to back those whose dogmatic souls burn as infernos “at close of day”, willing to throw their lives away in violent defiance, despite the “wise men at their end’ knowing ‘dark is right” - Dylan Thomas’ “Do not go gentle into that good night”.
