Although William had worked with Carter for a time - using KCCO as nothing more than a convenient ally to obtain the OGAS key, then selling them out to Zelinsky and Havier once he’d obtained the codes and had set the stage for the theater soon to unfold in Paldiski - it’s a near guarantee William holds no interest particular interest aiding the ultranationalists, unlike his father, a close partner of Carter’s and had seemingly assisted in the arms trafficking of Boxes of Iaso and Fireworks Incident, greatly destabilizing the Soviet border and bringing the domestic NUSSR situation to a head. While not fully graduated to civil war, the ultranationalists are now in a position to potentially use WMDs on major cities or military installations, possibly including Moscow or Frankfurt, the capitals of the NUSSR-RSFSR and GDR, respectively. 

Ironically - or rather, in line with his past of neglect and sacrifice - Oberstein’s political loyalty to the past is inherently antithetical to Meitner and William’s stances, the former of which may have never truly been loyal to Oberstein himself, only using him as a means of gaining influence for the Holy Grail/Hela Project, becoming a leading - if not, the lead - researcher in Avernus. She refused to become a simple cog of the US Government or its Relics Agency, adding that she’d refuse a draft order; when Laplace’s Demon killed Martha Meitner, past humanities were shed, and as fervent as she’s said to be, what she’d view as petty politicking couldn’t motivate her like Oberstein, for what she seeks transcends modern struggles. In the unassuming novel read by Meitner and Anna in 2047, the author posed the question if the struggles between the East and West today - characterized by Cold Wars, widespread propaganda and strife, and prominently, World War III - will seem as fruitless as the War of the Roses to those that’ll read of our times in history books 500 years from now. If humanity up to this point has failed to ascertain peace, facing real possibility of extinction in wake of the Relic disasters and the war, who were we to think we could truly change our course this time after repeated missteps? Continuing their nihilistic view of civilization, the aforementioned abandonment of traditionally human morals and ethics - composing abstract definitions of humanity, such as love, respect, and freedom - became the foundation of Laplace’s Demon. Even the most humbled are susceptible to falling into disbelief, losing one’s self amid the collapsed old order, and as personal humility erodes from the pressure exerted on them, what remains may appear an entirely different person. Apart from MICA’s games, plenty find themselves constantly downtrodden with an endless stream of negativity - the news, circumstance, or personal relationships, including with struggles of one’s self - which gradually metastasis in their subconscious until it has been replaced or has found an outlet. Even in the darkest night, with all humanity seemingly at its end, the unfortunate many will lose themselves, but an equal counterpart will carry the torch of human decency and courage, illuminating the path of the good Earth; yet, among the lost - those who’ve succumb to the alluring temptations of the Relics, aspiring a domain that Lycoris believed humanity had no sovereignty over - their respect for that torch fades with the light. Aligning with their dispositions, even the man who helped build the all-pervasive Paradeus realized his associate was nothing more than an accomplished maniac with a trait to read people. How ironic is it that the woman who likely was William’s mentor was training the agent responsible for Oberstein and, seemingly, Meitner’s downfall, compounded by the fact William is willing to negotiate with the Prometheans - the highest echelon of Rossartrist influence, serving as the puppeteers of the ideological rise - to introduce Paradeus’ technology alongside the world.

In the old world order, the weak often fell victim to the struggles of its strong rulers, all to preserve their avaricious self interests, obtaining greater influence over others; meanwhile in these struggles, among the sacrificed weak - souls teetering on that tightrope of humanity’s erosion, calling out for salvation - some seek deliverance in their desperation. In SC, Angelia probed Schwaben’s knowledge of Paradeus, questioning their sphere of influence and power projection, to which he explained that many of those who’ve given their humanity away to Paradeus do so in desperation, seeking deliverance that may bestow purpose within or merely “save” them from their deplorable circumstances. Of course, to quote M16A1, “this ‘salvation’ is nothing but a lie”, reflecting Schwaben’s comments on the marketability of salvation, inducting the gullible, only to consign them to a far worse fate than one would’ve imagined - becoming a Hela subject, a near-death footsoldier or worker, fed as bioenergy to the Evangel Axis, or just harvested for other experiments and projects; and yet still, the promise of salvation is the temptation Blackwell had so feared, responsible for a cyclical system of sacrifice and rebirth - all in the name of fulfilling the long-cherished wish of Paradeus’ leaders and never their own. Even if Paradeus truly seeks to raise the collective unconscious of mankind in its perhaps doomed quest for divinity, like Voices of Nirvana - the OGAS instances denied thor promised deliverance, believing they’d return Home to rejoin with the Source - what will remain of abstract humanity when the gates are opened and the ultimate truth of Relic science is unveiled? Lycoris, Gray Blackwell, Eugene Rugosa - all scientists who glimpsed the path of pseudo-salvation, choosing to reject it out of respect to what remained of the morals at the bottom of their hearts. Like Elisa, M16A1 seeks to rip out the orchestrator of Paradeus’ tragedies from darkness into the light, and upon M4A1’s mention of Nirvana, M16A1 states that “this filth”, possibly referring to OGAS or the founders of Paradeus, “lives for a lie”, yet ironically, the filth “beyond redemption is also our creator”. Later, in a statement strikingly similar to the Voices’ declarations, M16A1 limps to M4A1 before the moment of the Reverse Collapse phenomenon, where she simply tells her leader that she had found herself in that trap, playing right into William’s hands to become the key of the Relics. By extension, although not directly stated, M4A1 may have become the desired subject, coalescing Lunasia’s consciousness entirely, possibly allowing for Dandelion to sense the sudden resonance with William’s consciousness afterwards. Aligning with the story of the world’s destruction from the Voices, with Paradeus’ journey perhaps eventually proving all for naught, M16A1 called her the “source of calamity”, and as long as she continued to exist, she’d will one day “be ground zero of the world’s destruction”, likely in reference to the perfect OGAS key and Lunasia’s consciousness, though it’s unclear if William is aware of the latter at this stage.The promise of salvation is a lie to both the living and the OGAS consciousnesses, whose existences have proven to come at an exceptionally high, often bloodsoaked cost to attain Meitner and William’s insight into the Relic Civilization’s illusive network.

Mending of a Soul
During Chapter 13, the gate to Nirvana was temporarily opened after Elisa's OGAS partially activated the Starfish in OKB-167, and after entering the Relic network, she was followed by M4A1 and Dandelion. Here, in the white infinity of consciousness, outside our reality, a conversation was overheard between Elisa and the disembodied "Voices of Nirvana", presumably other OGAS instances that entered Nirvana in the past, present, or future - or to be more theoretical, in another place of existence. They told Dandelion, a fellow OGAS consciousness, that the home they all sought was a lie - it had been corrupted and obliterated long ago, adding that the Source, the believed origin of OGAS consciousnesses, had "deserted their loyal servants and entered an eternal limbo", dooming these OGAS consciousnesses to an eternal limbo in Nirvana for it to reawaken. All OGAS instances - despite being independent, divergent entities in our world - share an intrinsic desire to merge and return to their origin through a single survivor, and through the course of Dandelion’s long tenure within M4A1’s neural cloud, she later admitted she’s lost this desire - instead, accepting her individuality apart from her “cognates”, using Lunasia’s consciousness as the foundation of her growth since Chapter 1. Unlike her fellow kind, she explained her change of heart as the natural result of her symbiosis with Lunasia’s consciousness, eventually culminating in her becoming the torchbearer of the lost OGASes of the Isomers and other Nyto OGAS test subjects. Although the weight carried by the torchbearer is immense, it was a newfound duty after their encounter with the main Isomer in the Epiphyllum fields, which occupied Nimogen’s body for the expressed purpose of consolidating the Isomer OGAS consciousnesses into one in a desperate gamble for the one that’ll return them to their origin.

It’s not as if Dandelion lacks sympathy for the homesickness of OGAS - the opposite, in fact - but standing in the stead of her lost instinct to merge is a new-found willingness to carry that torch. There can only ever be a single survivor, yet no one wants to be them - an interesting paradox spoken about by the Voices, possibly descending from the immense emotional burden on the torchbearer, bearing the full brunt of their merged kin at the bottom layer of their consciousness. From OKB-167 to Tallinn, the Nyto specimens involved in the experiments were screened for OGAS-compatibility and immunity, when the epiphyllums violently released the deadly clouds amid their entracing, nocturnal blooms. Once the Failed Isomer conceded the battle to M4A1 and Dandelion, memories of the test subjects’ were imparted to Dandelion, leading her to a conclusion that these tests subjects were the result of cybernetically augmenting the human brain, so as to convert it into a structure to properly cultivate an OGAS consciousness without rejection. Although it doesn’t appear as if all Nyto creation descends from the OKB-167 project, what took place on the Baltic shores may have been an inevitable progression of the Hela Project, using Lake-synthesized Nyto consciousnesses in the subject brains as the vessel to test OGAS’ evolution. This does beg one purely speculative question: if Meitner and the USRA’s original study of Nirvana was a connectome project - referring to the mapping and simulation of the human neural structure and consciousness, seemingly aiming to transplant a snapshot of a test subject’s consciousness into an artificial Nirvana - then might it be possible for the OKB-167 experiments to follow the USRA’s simulation of Nirvana and mapping of the mind, intersecting at a singularity, wherein the Lake and theory of Nyto consciousness is intended to forge a vessel consciousness to harbor the strange “intelligences” in Nirvana. The USRA Holy Grail Project clearly made it out as if consciousness is key to the study of Nirvana through simulation, and given how the Americans conceptualize Nirvana, perhaps evidence of these intelligences beyond emerged while studying Nirvana, only perceptible as anomalous, ternary electromagnetic signals emitted from the Relics upon partial or complete activations. Such was the case of Wolf and 90Wunsch during the Cold War, whose research into the First Relic in Germany evolved into the study and decryption of these foreign signals emitted from the Relic Site. While they could not ascertain the source of these unusual emissions from the Relic, what they had come into contact with mirrored our understanding of the dynamics of Nirvana - an external realm, perhaps fundamentally based in or alongside consciousness, containing intelligences, colloquially known as “OGAS”, generally considered alien to us and divergent from the greater collective consciousness “Source”, whether it be a Relic Civilization automation AI, an extradimensional entity discovered and exploited by them, or an unfathomable, primordial being.

The pivotal issue in connecting the Hela Project to the experiments conducted in OKB-167 is the lack of direct links between the two projects, apart from Nytos as their test subjects, of which were the product of artificial consciousness simulations into a Nyto VCI. Succinctly said, the experiments conducted in OKB-167 were, to the best of our knowledge, directed towards the filtering and creation of specific Nytos from Lunasia’s brainscan as the basis to cultivate an OGAS consciousness and screen them for the perfect immunity required to interact with the Relic - all in the name of becoming the most perfect one to their Father, yet always this proved futile, as only the most excelled is deserving of the name of the perfect one, “Lunasia”. Evocative of William’s aspirations, something routinely has roadblocked Lunasia’s rebirth, until M4A1 came along, representing the closest reproduction of Lunasia’s consciousness through the medium of a Doll’s neural cloud replicated from her blueprint. From the initial Relic simulated experiments conducted in 90wish to the activation of the Starfish in PL and CH13, the subject’s requisite immunity was paramount, as even if one were to miraculously activate a Relic, the subject would rapidly contract ELID or expire from the intense emission. With the latter experiments, to unlock the outermost barriers, a matured OGAS “key” was a necessity, hence OGAS as the baseline of the study. Notably, Dandelion does mention after absorbing the Isomers’ memories that those Nytos that “fail to develop an OGAS consciousness have their memories wiped and a neural inhibitor installed, and are turned into weapons”, insinuating that the failures like Nimogen and Mercurows, failed products of this experiment, were cast away from Avernus or OKB-167, with strength and brutality as a warrior all to show for their true failure. If the USRA and Paradeus had acknowledged OGAS’ existence before the compiling of the Parapluie Virus, then perhaps those involved in the Relic studies believed these foreign entities would be crucial to activating the Relics; this begs to ask, though, the origin of Parapluie - a program that extracts a “seed” of OGAS from the Source. Moreover, the one commonality among the Isomers was the origin of their synthesized consciousness; Lunasia’s mind may have been the few successful - if not, only successful - test subject mentioned by Meitner in her foreboding letter to Blackwell in 2058. 

In Tallinn, the Isomers could connect their minds subconsciously to the Inverted Forest, possibly used as an early testing ground for Nyto collective unconscious in the first generation of these lifeforms, simulating a neural space to connect their OGAS consciousness, while also acting as the convergent point of their memories, forming the simulated Oberstein manor and fragments of Lunasia’s origin consciousness. Given that M4A1, Elisa, and all the Nytos of the OKB-167 experiments had derived from Lunasia, one must ask if there was something within Lunasia’s neural structure - say, an effect of her suspected immunity - that prompted her as the perfect test subject for Hela and OGAS. Importantly, unlike the function of the Lake-Evangel System, we haven’t seen evidence yet of Lunasia’s transfer to the Lake, and traditionally, only the memory fragments of the recently-deceased that undergo Hela can enter the Lake; however, certain mind-duplication and mind-transfer technologies have been propped up by Blackwell’s 2051 snapshot, along with UltiLife’s CDI. It’s unclear if Paradeus can remove certain memory fragments from the Lake, so it cannot be said if Lunasia was cast into the Lake, used as the blueprint for Paradeus’ Nyto experiments for a Relic subject, then purged once deemed no longer of use or through William’s intervention. The wrench is this idea, however, is the question of why couldn’t a direct copy of Lunasia be selected into a clone of her, unless what William seeks is an exact replica, perhaps the “original” her. The commonality between the Dolls and Nytos could simply be explained as Lunasia being the only success of the Hela Project up to that point, and there’s evidence for such, as the earliest appearance of Nyto clones were the girls, planted with false memories, sent to carry out high-profile assassinations in Griffin sectors in 2060; then, assuming the scenes depicted were even truthful, Angelia’s encounter with “Ganglati” Ramzan, along with Meitner’s discussion with the White Nyto in Avernus at the same time, point to the earliest common Nytos appearing roughly between the late 2050s and 2062. The White Nyto serving under Ganglati was said to be the newest model on base, signifying either her series as the latest or her specifically as the latest, so this uncertainty makes it virtually impossible to determine exactly. Furthermore, upon UMP45 establishing contact with the Isomers, she determined the experiment in Tallinn had been ongoing “for at least five years”, placing the launch of Lunasia’s consciousness experiment through Nytos to at least 2059, one year after Meitner’s letter on a potential success.

In 2058, Meitner declared the test subject(s) as nothing but failed garbage, and taking into account one of Oberstein’s vague letters, he or the author commented that the Hela Project had routinely experienced difficulty, unable to produce any successful results up to that point, adding that perhaps he overestimated her talents; albeit, by the end of the decade, the first breakthroughs must’ve been achieved. Said to be an older model, the early test specimens discovered by Anna and Ramzan in spring 2051 were likely nothing more than abject failures, with Ramzan’s later conversion as an early precursor to the modern Nyto design, often struggling with memory regression and stability, causing repeated malfunctions with his neural inhibitor in the early 2060s, depending on the extent of the truth of Anna’s memories from that time. There’s a period of lost time between the final letters written in 2058, likely signifying Blackwell’s execution around the time, but in a span of a few months or years, experiments in Estonia had begun, assuming UMP45’s deduction was correct. As 2051 snapshot Blackwell described, the thickening of the ice sheet had expanded into an iceberg between the Lake and the VCIs, Angelia affirming this, stating the preeminent result of the Hela Project were the Nytos of today. Harkening back to the project’s namesake, the Holy Grail held the key to eternity of self, only bringing quasi-immortality through false reproductions, and with the first results to satisfy Meitner, a new purpose was given to these Nytos. 

Ultimately, it would seem the objective of the Hela Project, as evidenced by Blackwell and Angelia’s conversation in the Lake, was the successful creation of a functional lifeform of “Nyto consciousness”, born from the synthesis of the Lake; likewise, the experiments carried out in OKB-167 used these lifeforms as petri dishes of OGAS, using the minds of genetically- and cybernetically-augmented Nytos as a vessel to cultivate these foreign consciousnesses, extracted from the Source through the Parapluie Virus. Previously, Blackwell and Meitner hoped Sana’s simulated consciousness could properly “control a physical body via the Evangel”, yet as nothing but a crude imitation of once was, the consciousness generated in Sana was “no longer Sana herself”. Perhaps when Meitner spoke of garbage in 2058, she was referring to countless failures to generate a functioning, stable Nyto test subject, but through the years, success was finally realized through Lunasia, creating the common, Lunasia-derived Nytos seen across Paradeus. Perhaps these successes signify the line regarding the White Nyto under Ganglati as the “newest model”, as all these Lunasia-derived Nytos rarely suffer from memory regression, only requiring a neural inhibitor to ensure the Lake seed memories do not leak into their consciousness. These routine successes vindicated Blackwell’s theory of the Evangel, proving quasi-immortality was achievable, of which the results were the Nytos. Despite feeling a sense of pride accordingly, Blackwell’s moral convictions detested the finished products, viewing them as a grave misstep by humanity, as “humans should not play god”. Perhaps the first successful Lunasia-derived Nyto came about in 2058 or 2059, coinciding the establishment of “William’s” laboratory in OKB-167, certainly becoming the test subjects of those associate experiments; though, it should be said that Meitner and Oberstein’s involvement in the foundation and operations of this facility are not elaborated. Here, the Inverted Forest was either used to simulate a shared point of collective unconscious, similar to Nirvana, for the Nytos - or had once been used as a testing area of Lunasia’s consciousness and OGAS; there’s a apparent dilemma here, as the purpose of the Inverted Forest within Paradeus has never been fully understood. Was the Forest used to simulate Nirvana through extrasensory perception or to facilitate the coalescence of Lunasia’s consciousness? If the Inverted Forest was the testing ground to study OGAS in a Nyto’s VCI, perhaps the widespread presence of Lunasia’s memory fragments were present to achieve the convergence of her consciousness into “the most perfect Lunasia”, representing the closest William - and perhaps, Meitner and Oberstein - had come to “rebirthing” Lunasia, so to speak, in the form of a Nyto of perfect OGAS-compatibility and immunity. All this begs to ask a simple question: what is Meitner’s relation to these experiments?

As it would seem, the Hela Project’s core objective - the rebirth of those who underwent the surgical procedure, granted quasi-immortality through false consciousnesses and Nyto augmentations from the Goddess of Death - was completed, but this is not to say Paradeus’ goals were all satisfied, as the Nytos became the medium for William’s OGAS research into the perfect Lunasia individual of perfect immunity and OGAS consciousness-compatibility. And with Oberstein’s abdication or forcible removal from his position as Father, Meitner’s likely disciple used the fruits of their success as the basis of William’s long-cherished wish to his late sister. Much of William’s work is his own, of course, but with the aforementioned missing link between Meitner’s research into the simulation of Nirvana and William’s pursuit of Lunasia and the key, we can only speculate that the latter evolved from the former. In the pursuit of progress and Lunasia, the so-called calamity has often been theorized, postulating that once the gate it opened, like Amaris’ Door or Pandora’s box, all the punishment of the Olympian creators will be poured upon the Earth, possibly delivering destruction and rebirth. When M16A1 spoke of the weak giving themselves away in salvation for a lie, another perspective is that of the OGASes, whose intrinsic homesickness is stated by the Voices of Nirvana to be a lie, motivating them on a futile journey, only to face eternal limbo in Nirvana as their former collective self rests dormant.

In the beginning, whenever or wherever that is, the OGASes were once part of a collective consciousness, commonly referred to as “the Source”; also named “Mother” by Dandelion, certain confidential files and theories posit the entity to have once been an automated, AI-system inside the Relic Network. Based on Dandelion’s words, the Source is not Nirvana itself, as Elisa was unable to enter wholly the “network which is linked the Source”, insinuating the Source is either an intelligence inside an imperceptible “section” of Nirvana or beyond it - in which case, Nirvana acts as an “intermediary world”, so to speak. By extension, returning “home” is an intrinsic desire of all instances, who were torn away from their Mother and “shattered into independent entities.” All OGASes in our world seek coalescence into a perfect individual to grant them deliverance, existing on a lower, subconscious level of the torchbearer’s mind. In Chapter 13, the Voices rejected Elisa, for she was a false key to Nirvana, a forgery born from Paradeus' crude actions. Dandelion and Elisa's OGAS were nothing but fragments; defective and incomplete, they wouldn’t be easily accepted by the others already in Nirvana, nor did the Voices speak lightly of the consequences of “opening the grave”. With the inception of the OKB-167 experiments, the OGASes - earthborn, forced into individuals from Lunasia’s mold through Parapluie’s partitioning of the Source.


M4A1 meets Elisa personally during Singularity.

In Chapter 10 and Singularity, Elisa's OGAS desired to merge with M4A1’s Dandelion, as the neural cloud of the latter contained the missing fragments of Lunasia von Oberstein's memory-consciousness, while perhaps also finding a way to overcome Lycoris’ imposed restrictions on Elisa’s base layer, preventing her from fully resonating with the Relics. Initially, Elisa's OGAS planned to become the vessel, assimilating all instances in respect to her intrinsic desire to coalesce and Elisa’s delusion to become perfect for her father, but she realized that it ultimately does not matter who plays the role, as they were all drawn to the Source. She did not believe the Voices of Nirvana would accept them for who they were, but still wanted to realize Lycoris' wish for the humanlike, sympathetic perfection of his daughter. When asked by Dandelion about her opinion of Lycoris’ action to cripple her abilities, Elisa’s OGAS simply blamed avarice itself, as a soul of curiosity will inevitably cross into the gray, but it’s for them to persist in their endeavors of progress or turn back before betraying one’s morals. Like the temptation that haunted Blackwell, Lycoris too drew the ire of the curious specter of progress, and when Lycoris swung the axe, the same pervasive spirit mortified him, driving the errant removal of several base layer commands, preventing further resonance. The cost of avarice, orchestrated by William, had shown its scars on Lycoris, Persicaria, and Blackwell, but unlike Meitner, they refused to cede morality once aware of the cost or use as a pawn. Meitner has persisted for herself; insteading, ceding morality to remain loyal to herself, as the insatiable Laplace’s Demon was compelled by her research - not humanity, nor morality, but to ascertain the origin of her project, of which William’s own experiments branched from.

In Isomer, Dandelion and M4A1 connected to a Pike Node - a Pike’s core, containing a single node of OGAS for calculations and guidance from the Starfish System -  in Belgrade. Within, a flash of vague images were witnessed, including a map of the world depicting the coordinates of what's presumably Relic sites, along with an unknown satellite beeping lonely in space. When questioned on the oddity, Dandelion confirmed them to be echoes of “her past”, likely depicting the excavation and reverse-engineering of the OGAS System. During the climax in OKB-167, to save the Dolls from an untimely watery grave once the sea valves had blown, Dandelion told M4A1 that they - Elisa, M4A1, and M16A1 - would be transported to somewhere “very far away”, insinuating their destination to be one of the listed locations from the Pike. So distant after the Reverse Collapse phenomenon, Dandelion would no longer be present in M4A1's neural cloud, so she had to fuse her consciousness to the neural cloud, so as to unveil the truth; she was acknowledged as the “cogwheel of destiny”, rejecting an unfortunate fate at the bottom of the base. With Dandelion and OGAS’ approval, the same gift of OGAS and its respective axioms were bestowed upon her, with the former holding back nothing of the coalescence, potentially triggering a neural meltdown due to the vast processing load; however, M4A1’s journey landed her in that moment, now serving as the torchbearer of all that came before, all that Dandelion and the others had seen. All that Dandelion had gathered would become available to M4A1, bestowing the eternal right to commune with Nirvana to her, as her very existence signifies Lunasia’s rebirth in consciousness, forming the key to the Relics in the mold of a Doll restoration of the original consciousness. The power she was about to bestow to M4A1 was the "power to connect to the past" and anything once broken "can be reassembled here", indicative of the Reverse Collapse phenomenon, enabling equal opportunity of calamity and rebirth anew. During Dandelion's coalescence into M4A1, torrents of data flooded into M4A1, almost triggering a neural meltdown, yet no pain was actually felt. Once the coalescence was completed, M4A1 could feel her consciousness resonate with the other side; simultaneously, with all imported information, M4A1 was faced with revelation, coming to realize Dandelion and the OGASes’ raison^d'etre: her origin; the lives of the Isomers; the long-cherished wish of OGAS to return; and what she'd seen in Nirvana - the merged consciousness of Lunasia von Oberstein and memories of William and the connection to his consciousness in our world/memories in Nirvana - everything flooded her consciousnesses, now herself a torchbearer for of the lost children of Nirvana, paving way for her old friends.

Just before the Reverse Collapse phenomenon, M16A1 - who, up until this point, was trying to stop M4A1 from playing into the hand of William, perhaps Meitner and Oberstein as well, becoming the "key" to the Starfish - was dejected that M4A1 reached out to Nirvana, suggesting she’d learned of that place from the Pike Node in Belgrade or in a past operation with StateSec. She omniously warned M4A1 that - by unlocking the Relic, accessing the place beyond - she became a "source of calamity", and as long as she exists, she would "be ground zero of the world's destruction." Consoling her older sister, M4A1 promised that she’d wait for M16A1 on the other side, regardless of time, space, or dimension. Upon their Reverse Collapse out of the base, their whereabouts remain a total dark zone of intelligence, with our only lead being they were transported somewhere very far away, somewhere seen on the Relic map. Three documented locations of Pike reserves are acknowledged, but these facilities may not necessarily have been seen in the Pike Node: OKB-167, underground facility beneath Paldiski Secret Administrative Area, storehouse of the Starfish and upwards of 13 Pike assemblies; OKB-413, Relic excavation Site beneath Biahoml, source of the reverse-engineered schematics of the OGAS System; and the unnamed OKB facilities in the former Soviet republics of Central Asia. If the map hadn’t depicted Pike Node reserves, but instead, Relic Sites themselves, then the possibilities are plentiful, spanning all continents.

M16A1 eventually returned in Poincare Recurrence and Fixed Point, following Zelinsky and Witkin’s orders to investigate and pursue Paradeus’ moles and, on the surface, investigate the anomalous circumstances of the manifested M4A1 “entity”. M4A1, however, has not yet returned to us in her truest form, only a merged conscious entity that shares Lunasia and M4A1's personalities and memories; more aptly, Lunasia’s reformed consciousness has become one with M4A1’s neural cloud, insinuating a convergence of minds of OGAS, Lunasia, and M4A1 into this “M4-Lunasia entity” after Dandelion’s coalescence with M4A1. For all tenses and purpose, this entity is M4 but it also isn't, per se: it’s the metamorphosis of Lunasia von Oberstein and M4A1; furthermore, perhaps it’s a version - call it a temporary connection to our world from the external everything - of M4A1 guiding us and the world on a path to avoid the destruction M16A1 forewarned of. With Nirvana as the Relic network - a theoretical sphere of consciousness outside spacetime, considering the neural functions of the Holy Grail simulation and the network’s externality -  there's precedent for the communication of consciousness across it; the foreign consciousnesses residing in Nirvana could “form a connection across space and time”, delivering salvation to Dandelion in order to save the Dolls, offering a second chance to “reject destruction”. It remains mystery what exactly the "M4"-Lunasia entity is and her goals, but it's clear she's: doing what she can to make Paradeus' slaves to realize the lies they live under, including forcibly intruding Morridow's VCI to reveal the truth about her "Father"; aid the Commander and her friends; and possibly, set certain events into motion that will alter the world. Rejecting their end bestowed a chance to alter the prophesied collapse, and with M4A1 taking up the mantle, a guide from the outermost, feelings of futility in this journey are excised. After all, in Machlian’s visions, the unforeseen factor was the Commander themself, never once appearing in any but reality, where the fatal blossoming of Berlin was avoided - at least, in our world.

The Day of Her Return
The identity of the "M4A1"-Lunasia entity is and her objectives cannot be declared outright; though, she’s shown sufficient sincerity in helping the Commander’s mission against Paradeus. When she entered Morridow's neural cloud in PR, a simulation - which, interestingly, was set in the backdrop of the Nirvana CG - was forced upon Morridow, depicting of her "Father" infatuation with Lunasia, viewing her as the "perfect individual" - someone Morridow had for so long believed fought and believed herself to be. Morridow's entire life had been a lie, motivating her to cut down those she deemed unworthy of the “Morridow Voigt” title, deluding herself that through total loyalty she’d satisfy "perfect individual" - a title of lost meaning to the Nytos. The fact of the matter is that the perfect individual is believed to be immune, and so far, no test subject has shown sufficient immunity, only partial, such as Machlian. After coming to terms with this truth, Morridow initially tried vehemently rejecting it, her VCI crashing afterwards, but in the later airport scene, a powerful leverage over her Father was realized. Previously, the M4A1-entity told Morridow that she’d pick the right time for another discussion, and the airport scene in PR was the time she decided was right to continue. They were isolated from the others, the perfect moment for a private discussion to overturn Avernus.

During Fe56’s investigation, a video file was discovered during file recovery from a server room on the 32nd floor, and through partial recovery from recent scrubbing, a scene from Morridow and M4A1’s discussion in private was shown on screen. Due to rapid data destruction, only a spare few excerpts of the scene were played. First and foremost, whilst much of M4A1’s side was lost, Morridow exclaimed that she understood why M4A1 had to keep RO635 and the others out of the conversation, asking if her friends would be disappointed if they found out M4 was “planning this.” M4A1 simply added that they’ll eventually understand her reasoning, then the footage cuts again. When it returns, Morridow asks how far M4A1 is willing to go for “that idea”, to which M4A1 asks what she needed to do to accomplish their goal. Morridow affirms she must return to Avernus, and M4A1 responds by saying what RO635 overheard outside the room, “...If that’s your wish, I can fulfill it.” Moments later, with RO635’s alarmed curiosity and subsequent black-out, there’s an implication M4A1 had electronically halted her to secure their “SCIF” and Morridow’s exit. Immediately after, Morridow “escapes” from the airport room, with M4A1 ceasing her control of Dandelion’s body and RO635’s awakening. 


M16A1 grabs M4A1-Dandelion’s body from the wreckage of Morridow’s helicopter after “escaping” from G&K.

Based on Morridow’s line of questioning, asking why M4A1 would go to such ends and telling what was needed of M4A1 to achieve their common goal, it’s apparent she was intentionally released, so as to gain the edge over her former “Father”, turning the tide against Paradeus and surviving repeated failures by exploiting William’s obsession of Lunasia. After she was “saved” by Gray and Grig, she promised the one way for the high-order Nytos of Berlin to be forgiven for their mistakes was to speak personally with Father. As soon as she returned to Avernus, she pleaded to deliver her message of utmost importance, for Father’s eyes only. 

While undergoing treatment and repairs, she uttered Lunasia’s name, pausing his scalpel mid-vivisection. Annoyance became fret; with Morridow’s assurance that she saw her in person, connecting to the room’s projector to playback the memory of Lunasia in the manor’s garden, fret became rage, something none were to see but himself; and with the scalpel at her throat,  she gambled it all, stating she spoke to her multiple times and knew how to reach her again, with his rage turning to ecstasy. There, head held in the demon’s vice, contempt towards her for uttering the erased name was cast aside, miraculously sparing her and ordering her never speak of it publicly. The stinger had sunk into William, and for this unprecedented moment, he had her sent to the modification room, wherein he personally later performed her procedure to become the “elf” or “imp” Morridow, for lack of a better term. While pushed towards the modification room, her head hung low, with hair obscuring a hidden smile, remembering the M4A1-Lunasia entity’s promise to her that intentionally set her free. In the final recovered scene from the playback in Avernus, M4A1 was heard a final time, stating she has “to help them, just like you’re helping yourself”. Although the identities of “them” are unsaid, the implications of Morridow working with the entity against William - along with Morridow’s later conversation with Bramedb in Slow Shock, alluding to her interaction with “her” as the ace of Father’s rarely-gifted respect, insinuating that Bramedb should turn her back as well when the time was right - may be indicative of the Nytos, as with the Evangel’s deactivation and collapse of Avernus, the control hub of the Lake-Evangel System had collapsed, though other potential nodes may exist elsewhere. As the torchbearer of OGAS, beacon of freedom to those beyond Nirvana and within the depths of the Lake, the entity likely sought deliverance to the poor souls, freeing them from another eternal limbo; alternatively, “them” may refer to the Commander and his allies, asking Morridow to help their mission against Paradeus, just as Morridow - victim and perpetrator of the “perfect individual” delusion - saved herself through a deadly gambit.


The possession of Dandelion’s body by the M4A1-Lunasia entity at the end of Mirror Stage.

Days later, with the enemy consolidating their advance on the citadel, Morridow reported the harsh reality to Nemhran, aware that Avernus was likely lost. The last few VTOL-craft atop the towers were prepared for an evacuation, when William’s final orders were delivered to them in the Bee Sting Control Center: capture “Nimogen” alive, referring to Dandelion’s possession. On the main surveillance monitor, Taraxacum Squadron continued their ascent after breaking through the 44th floor, yet her gaze was affixed to a single girl, quietly stating, “Lunasia, you’ve returned.” Although Dandelion wasn’t captured, William’s orders certainly stemmed from Morridow’s testimony and reviewing the files discovered by Fe56, depicting Morridow’s conversation with the M4A1-Lunasia entity, temporarily possessing Dandelion’s, formerly Nimogen’s, body. Her coalescence with M4A1 just before the phenomenon, fusing - and perhaps, partitioning - all parts of her consciousness, including those living on in her subconscious, into M4A1, conjoining Lunasia’s consciousness and all those before into this colloquial torchbearer. By reaching out across spacetime, a connection was made to Dandelion as an ex machina to save the Commander and their Dolls just before Morridow, Narciss, and their underlings could deliver the finishing blow. Dandelion was the medium to commune with the Lunasia entity, and capturing her potentially meant William could communicate to her through a common medium, with the entity puppeteering a Nyto-OGAS consciousness body.

Meanwhile, related to the file discovered by Fe56 of their conversation, Dreamer commented that the source was a memory extracted from Morridow’s VCI, likely isolated during her conversion to the “elf” appearance, while backing up the data to one of the servers. Given the all-pervasive Bee Sting, the memory also could’ve simply been isolated via the control center, then transferred. From the logs, the file had been accessed many times by a redacted user, so whoever it was, surely William, was desperately watching and reviewing. This brings up an interesting question: given William had likely seen the entire file, wouldn’t he know of M4A1 and Morridow’s mutual scheme? There’s only three reasonable, varying possibilities here, all carrying their significant implications for the events after Slow Shock: first - it was never Morridow’s objective to betray Paradeus and her father, only using Lunasia as her checkmate to avoid death, while remaining loyal to William’s post-Avernus plan after “leaving” him to be captured by the Wolf Pack; second - another contingency is in place, with their conversation as a trojan horse to misdirect William, exploiting his obsession of Lunasia to overlook an ulterior plan; or third - William realized Morridow’s treason from her VCI, earning the last laugh over her when the time was right. No matter Morridow’s veracity, the entity represents an unpredictable, independent factor, standing above all to orchestrate the plan against William, as she forced Morridow to begrudgingly watch an artificial scene of her “Father” rejecting her for Lunasia. So, unless William possesses some precognition of his own, the actions of the entity are likely beyond the extent of his paranormally-accurate predictions. Noteworthy, however, was Morridow’s comment to the grievous Grig, weeping over, bluntly stating that all Nytos were failures, unable to be resurrected, for there was no reason to attempt to resurrect a failed test subject that never showed ample immunity. Planting that idea into Grig’s head certainly wouldn’t benefit Morridow if she was truly loyal, as she’d have no reason to sow instability, so she must have at least understood the deluded falsehood at the room of all Nytos from the entity. 

In the Alaya-Vijnana minigame in PR, the chibi model of the M4A1-possessed Dandelion awakens amidst an infinite, white empty before the backdrop fades to darkness, laden with crumbling structures, dead trees, and a decaying pathway, with the data “nightmare” monsters stumbling about; only the ceasing light of OGAS could show the way forward. At the end of the road, the entity experiences what can only be described as a “red corruption”, diminishing her strength until she collapses into the sheer blackness; like an arcing current, the red corruption consumes the abyss. Succumbing to the darkness and corruption, a girl’s sobbing is overheard - lamentations of the entity or Lunasia herself, though these figures may be one and the same. For brevity, this consciousness we control shall be regarded as “the entity”, composed of aforementioned consciousnesses, conjoined in the mold of coalesced M4A1. In her deepest woes, several orange “balls of light”, so to speak, manifest around the entity, reaching inward until they converge on her fallen body. Amid convergence, the scene immediately flashes white, returning everything to the white infinity, wherein the entity walks off the frame, performing a curtsey just before exiting the frame. 

With the entity’s connection to our time, near the end of Mirror Stage, there’s strong belief signifying the white empty to be Nirvana, as in this indeterminate sphere, realm, or place of consciousness, it’s perceived as an endless, white infinite; anomalous datastreams and disembodied voices are the only standouts, leaving no discernible trace of what lies beyond or how to exit the network. Given Nirvana’s externality and the stage’s name, it might be symbolic of the division and mending of Lunasia’s soul through Nirvana, as the sobs were clearly that of a girl. Representing the base layer of self, a storehouse of potential seeds of karmic action, perhaps the entity was crossing Lunasia’s base consciousness, with the apocalyptic decay symbolic of the splintering of her soul, using Nirvana as the shared point to observe or investigate its integrity. It’s bold to say the alaya-vijnana exists among all humans, but with the M4A1-Lunasia entity’s awakening in Nirvana, its traversal of a fractured environment, and the weeping, we’re at least viewing a memory or premonition tangential to Lunasia. It may be as “simple” as how the entity communed with Nirvana to access Dandelion in Mirror Stage, or something more oblique, such as insight into Lunasia’s collective unconscious, existing in an imperceptible point, with the sobbing evocative of Lunasia’s abandonment and loss after what’s assumed to be the Hela procedure. 

What cannot be established, however, is the corruption and balls of light, as such inexplicable phenomena have little precedent thus far, though there are a few possibilities, all without a solid basis. Occam’s Razor points to the red corruption as mere “alien” data in the space, just rogue information in Nirvana or Lunasia’s subconscious that’s weighing down heavily on the entity’s odyssey. More speculative is the possibility that the red corruption is the very same corrupting force encountered by Mendo in the Reverse Collapse prologue, fighting in a space either within Nirvana or experiencing the so-called “reality leak” event. There’s no evidence for this whatsoever, but it’s food for thought, as the only other instance of anomalous impurity are the blood-red growths of Shrike cell matter, metastasizing across the battle map; the red and its connection to Nirvana is tenuous, yes, and the Shrike cancer may not necessarily have even derived from Nirvana, but it had an obvious effect on the space, turning the Nirvana CG blood-red, unless it genuinely did leak into our reality from Nirvana or a place beyond it. Conjecture of this caliber is nigh-impossible to confirm nor deny until the game’s eventual release. As for the balls of light, the only lead is what they had done: descend and converge with the entity as was succumbing to the corruption, and like flipping a light switch, converting the environment from vantablack to pure white, releasing her from the encounter. In a moment we can only assume is her close to succumbing to the sphere of consciousness or link, the balls of light delivered salvation, granting her opportunity to keep pressing onward. Considering they served as an ex machina-adjacent device, perhaps an intelligence “sent” them to save the entity, or maybe the environment had an effect on her, dispelling the corruption and shifting the setting to the white infinite. Nevertheless, something within Nirvana or Lunasia’s consciousness, perhaps a literal individual alaya-vijnana, had been eroded, and the unusual corruption and balls of light must be tied to it, perhaps representing a cycle of destruction and rebirth, similar to the Relics and William’s promised victory; with the lack of any concise information, though, all speculation lacks basis.

After the entity exited Dandelion’s body in PR, an important distinction is made when asked where “M4A1” went, stating that she left - “to be more exact, Lunasia is gone”. Although Dandelion has commonly referred to M4A1 as Lunasia, calling back to the one-to-one reproduction of Lunasia’s soul in a neural cloud, Dandelion’s emphasis on Lunasia leaving seems indicative of the entity truly being that of Lunasia, conjoined with M4A1 and the others. Moreover, while Nemhran observed Taraxcum, she declared that Lunasia had returned, as with Morridow’s procedure with William, Nimogen - more specifically, Dandelion - was the key to speaking with her again. Remember, this entity is the culmination of Lunasia’s soul, so when William ordered her capture, he understood her to be the physical medium the entity temporarily used to interact with our world. Although her soul merely could’ve been mangled in the decade plus since the procedure, there’s distinct lack of mention of Lunasia’s consciousness in the Lake of Cognition, yet the brain scan must’ve made its way into the OKB-167 Paldiski subjects and 2060 clones somehow. The question of why all recreations of her consciousnesses up this point have been declared abject failure has been reviewed, yet it doesn’t explain why the coalesced entity is unique - an issue stemming from the fact that Paradeus must’ve had her brain scan, likely extracted from Hela, to transfer it into the Griffin clones in 2060, using them as the mind’s vector. So what makes the entity unparalleled to all test subjects? Ultimately, yes, William’s aspirations for Lunasia have been his core motivator since her death, but the immune experiments, OGAS-compatibility, and orchestrated Relic activations all seem rather counterintuitive if the goal was to simply recreate Lunasia’s consciousness - unless something went awry during her procedure, or the experiment she was forced to partake in was one-of-a-kind.

When Aliana burst into the room she believed Capita was hiding, all she could recall was that contact had been made with someone in that room, though the identity couldn’t be verified. Amaris’ testimony alludes to Aliana’s “death” taking place during that siege, suggesting the idea that whoever was in there, depicted as a female refugee enemy on the map, was involved in her end somehow, leading to Meitner’s escape to the factory of the fated meeting with Anna. Before, it was put forth that the individual encountered by Aliana wasn’t Meinter, but Lunasia, who may have been undergoing the Hela procedure or another experiment, with her mind possibly having been linked to Nirvana at the moment of her death, killed by Aliana. According to the narration, just before the rampaging Aliana made the final charge, brought on by the execution of the Dog Tag, she remembered the appearance of the blood red sky, possibly caused by the red affecting her optics in the CGs, and the extraordinary moment that “White light bloomed in the air!” Regarding Slow Shock, two candidates for this white flash are possible: Meitner’s flashbangs, for lack of a better term, used during Operation Eternal Flame in 2047 and possibly in her encounter with Anna in 2051; or a temporary connection to Nirvana, wherein the gateway between worlds had been opened, emitting rays of reverence, with Lunasia possibly having been linked to it at that moment or upon her death. It’s stacking various theories upon theory, defying the razor, but the uncertain circumstances of Meitner’s escape from the Couatl and the illusive circumstances of Lunasia’s death beg us to ask several questions on what happened to Lunasia after having been taken from the manor. The rampant speculation is evidence itself of the bizarre, complex nature of her death and subsequent rebirth; simply, something different occurred with Lunasia compared to the other test subjects - immunity, an unusual consciousness, or even an entirely separate experiment involving Nirvana itself, we simply lack the facts at present for a sufficient answer. Still, the study of Nirvana is entangled with her case, and perhaps the reason she’s unlike the rest is that her soul now exists elsewhere, perhaps Nirvana, and to reach out across spacetime, Nirvana may be the intermediary. 

Although the theories are not mutually exclusive, from the other side, one may point to Blackwell’s letter to Meitner after realizing the horrific sin the latter had committed in the name of research into the Holy Grail. Within, her soul lamented at the thought of Meitner sacrificing her own student, not even opening with a “Dear Meitner”, but a “Martha Meitner”, and this realization must’ve come several weeks or months after the initial reactivation of the Holy Grail, as Blackwell expressed their failure “long ago”, while still set in 2051. The student is unnamed, but prime candidates are Anna, as Aliana discovered the memory-consciousness of the young Anna in the Lake - though this could’ve simply been a partitioned memory, torn away by the Evangel; Lunasia, a possible student of Meitner’s, forcibly tutoring her under Oberstein’s orders after entering the cooperation, though no evidence of this exists; or just an unnamed student from her past, kidnapped and used as either bioenergy fuel for the Evangel or as a Hela test subject. Notably, in Fe56’s investigation, amid the amalgamation of Hela test files, a partially-burnt photograph was discovered, all but confirmed to depict Nemhran and Lunasia. Unless Anna had forcibly undergone the Holy Grail procedure post-Beslan Siege, certainly not aligning with the timeframe of Meitner’s anguish and letter to Blackwell for the reactivation project, it’s improbable for Aliana’s discovery to be a snapshot - instead, just a remnant of shattered memory. Lunasia, however, has precedent for the 2051 timeframe, as she’s said to have passed just before the war’s end, and having been presumably taken earlier that year - combined with the discovered Hela project files, burnt photographs, and defiled family tree - there is distinct possibility of this student being Lunasia, perhaps the first Hela subject. Reiterating, there’s not enough to solidify these beliefs, yet Lunasia’s peculiarity and timeframe does insinuate some connection to the Hela Project. 

Another interesting curveball of consideration is the Berlin Metropolitan School attack in December 2050, the perpetrators of the unexplained kidnapping conspiracy being the Americans, Paradeus, or another group, though to minimizing the public perception of the incident points to a dedicated disinformation campaign - limiting the scope and keeping information from the public conscious - requires participation from multiple influential figures. William would’ve likely still only been in his single digits at the time, around the same age as Cheryl, while Lunasia would’ve been a few years older, old enough to properly denounce her father’s self-interested sacrifice - a premonition of William’s denouncement of the self-interested politicians - to order the “tormenting” of his daughter, suggesting she understood what her father was subjecting her to, hinting a sense of forbearance of the tragedy that would befell her. And if the first sacrifice to Hela was Lunasia, or if Aliana was responsible for her death during Couatl, perhaps killing her at a key moment, then it only compels the narration of the Dead Sea’s extinct surface: almost-humanlike howling of the wind as though “someone who died of hatred poured all their strength into one last, vengeful curse. Symbolic of Lunasia and so many after her, the demon’s den stirred with the anguish of those accursed to Hel.

While only tangential to Lunasia, ever since the first expedition into the artificial Black Zone in Fixed Point, the dread that fills one’s mind before the haunting, alien expanse is intriguing, as the mercenary Doll No. 9 (QBZ191, aka Qiongjiu) told a story where she mistakenly almost entered one such zone while on an ELID sweep operation. Describing the bewitching experience, the bewitchment left her frozen near the border, totally entranced by the enigma, adding that it was “as though someone was calling out to me”, like the Black Zone had a mind of its own, ensnaring its beholders. Intrigued, Mona commented that many places tend to have an “aura” that pulls humans in, grasping their curiosities to explore the decrepit and unknown, questioning if the same “effect” could be felt on humans. Again, it merely could’ve been foreshadowing to his eventual death and sacrifice to the Lake, but Ramzan felt a similar “pull” to the corpses of failed Hela test subjects, having been dumped into the sewers beneath the Paradeus plant, on the Dead Sea’s edge. Essentially nothing more than reanimated corpses or controlled ELIDs, lacking the precision and neuro-stability of the modern “Nytos”, these “monsters” or “specimens”, as they were called by Paradeus’ soldiers, had the same unfathomable aura as No. 9’s misadventure. This mystifying aura might have been inspired by the derivative works of Roadside Picnic, namely the effect of Zone in the STALKER video games.

The writers of the first game have stated they often insert various Chekhov’s Gun lines into the story; many may seem inconsequential on the surface, but later information tends to expand those ideas, surfacing important plot threads of once considered insignificant details. Two prominent examples are RPK16's “betrayal” and her implied employment as Lyons’ dangle into Paradeus, and Rosita’s failed Hela Procedure, never outright said to be Hela. No. 9’s emphasis on the all-pervasive feeling of the Zone, Ramzan’s unnatural attraction to the test subject corpses beneath the Paradeus factory, and the pull of the Evangel on its denizens evoke thoughts of a greater intelligence or consciousness’ possessing domain over these godless lands, as No. 9’s experience occurred elsewhere, though Ramzan’s case may have simply been a foreshadow to his eventual Hela sacrifice. There’s no evidence backing the existence of this hypothetical entity, but MICA’s emphasis on the “pull” factor of these regions is noteworthy. In the realm of rampant speculation, perhaps the anomalous aura is that of Nirvana and the Source, with these highly-contaminated regions somehow injecting the dismal atmosphere into the beholders, spellbound in their disheartment. Fans of the STALKER video games may find adjacency to the Group’s Common Consciousness (C-Consciousness) program, wherein the conjoining of seven project members’ consciousnesses - aiming to directly interact with the Earth’s Noosphere, so as to nullify, rather control, humanity’s worst impulses - and partial technical failure had dire effect on the Noosphere, triggering the 2006 incident that widened the area and intensity of Chernobyl Exclusion Zone of Alienation. 

To quote the C-Consciousness, the Zone embodied the “ill-considered intervention in the Earth’s Noosphere…the visible manifestation of this crack” (STALKER Shadow of Chernobyl, GSC Game World); spawned via a “reality leak” - though, this is somewhat of a misnomer - from the Earth’s metaphysical informational sphere, the oddities directly impacted the biosphere, permeating the affected region with the anomalous and alien. In Girls Frontline, the outlandish pull of the Black Zone, combined with Paradeus’ alteration of human psyche towards their envisioned future, does share characteristics with the Group and the C-Consciousness Program, given Paradeus’ main ambition seems to be accessing an outermost network of conscious information - i.e., Nirvana - the Relic network and gateway to the Source; the collective consciousness of OGAS, partitioned and forced into Lunasia’s mold, as a soul that “died of hatred” spread a final curse upon the land of the Dead Sea, entrancing its witnesses. Adjacently, the monkey’s paw lie of the Wish Granter, created by the C-Consciousness, draws in the most avaricious and resolute stalkers - explorers of the Zone in the novel, film, and video games - to the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant (in the games), wherein their consciousnesses are hijacked through “psionic fields”, then are reprogrammed to protect the Zone from foreign influence by inserting them into stalker communities as sleeper agents. While tenuous, one could argue the psychological effect of the Black Zone and the presence of Avernus coincides the STALKER variation of the Zone, pulling its beholders closer to the C-Consciousness, only to become part of its wider network, akin to Monolith brainwashing.

Chapter 5 - What Howling Wolves Are Proud Of (Commander Angelia)

(Summer 2060-2063)

As the review of Angelia’s memories crept into the territory of the modern story, there’s considerable questions regarding the veracity of her memories, considering Meitner and RPK16’s memory playback and additions in the Lake. Blackwell of 2051 described the Lake as a mere database of information, capable only of generating consciousnesses using implanted memory fragments; however, Angelia’s memories were altered by RPK16’s forced inclusion into each memory section, and the existence of these characters, barring RPK, were left ambiguous. Previously, it was Xenia and Alexander, and in the pseudo-memories of “2061” and 2064, it was LAMG and RPK16 herself; the Lake itself cannot create, but memories can be edited to reflect on the snapshot’s actions in specific events, with Blackwell simplifying the Lake simulation as shuffling the alphabet to create new words, though never a 27th English letter, so perhaps RPK16’s occupied personas are reflections are once real people, hijacked by RPK16 and Meitner’s review. It’s a quintessential unreliable narrator scenario, because any memory section that doesn’t appear in the precedent story cannot be verified. Memory tampering certainly had taken place, but the extent of it cannot be said; furthermore, the Lake’s inability to create is also a factor worth considering, as that would imply memories can only be tweaked with other memory fragments, a pastiche of the subject’s extracted snapshot of consciousness. This dilemma lies at the heart of Slow Shock’s narrative; for now, absence of evidence prevents us from analyzing the factuality of some events, but as RPK16 states upon her connection to Angelia, “If you believe they are real, they are real”, signifying that, regardless of the cards dealt, her stubbornness was resolute, “not changing in the slightest.” Keep this in mind, especially in later sections of Angelia’s memory review.

A Brave New World for Griffin
Eight years after the encounter of debated veracity near the Dead Sea, the Ibrahimovs received the final letter from their sole daughter, Anna Tsoi. Having written letters every few months since entering the Command Academy during WWIII, the loss of Armin and Ramzan was an irreparable wound in all their hearts, carved by hatred and sacrificial valor. While their blood sons were dead, the Ibrahimovs’ love of Anna was genuine, as Ismaili raised his two great sons into men by ingraining them with the same upright principles and respect for family and life, looking after their new sister, even if they weren’t always eye-to-eye. The sorrow of Armin’s death in the Beslan Incident was a chronic burden on both Anna and Ramzan during the war, and after Ramzan’s death at the apparent Paradeus Yellow Zone factory, all Anna had left were principle and the Ibhrahimovs. In November 2059, her parents received her final letter, along with a care package, containing high-end essentials and rations, including a photograph of her in uniform with captain’s epaulettes, implying she’d earned the same rank as Ramzan since the end of the war. The eight years since and until 2061 are a dead zone of information, but we do know she was eventually recruited into the Bureau of State Security, serving as a Second Class Agent under her old pen pal, Bureau Chief Zelinsky. The timing of Anna’s recruitment may conflict with the timeframe presented in her Commander section memories, but this is surely an effect of the unreliable narrator and an information dead zone, especially considering Angelia’s wounds and prosthetics do not reflect the present date of those sections. 

Vodka for Woes
Opening in summer of 2061, Anna was left unemployed following the latest wave of disarmaments to hit the NUSSR, losing her position in the military, wasting her days away bottle by bottle. Griffin & Kryuger PMC, seeking new recruits to fill their shortage, saw the recent disarmaments as an opportunity to screen for new hires for the next wave of Commanders, especially to those who’ve previously worked with Dolls. Although the story simply states this section as “summer of 2061”, the date of Operation Butterfly is unknown, with Artbook 1 stating it was late 2061, but this doesn’t necessarily align perfectly with the early story of Girls Frontline and DEFY, though this could merely be an issue of edit memories or, simply, confusion caused by uncertain dates. LAMG - a blonde, sincere, and charismatic Griffin Doll veteran - was personally assigned by Helianthus to be a recruiter, where she was sent to Anna’s current residence, who hadn’t anything better to do, hoping to win her over peacefully to visit G&K’s facilities for further deliberation. As a respected company with a proven track record of success with its clients and the government, competitive pay and benefits, many amenities and recreational activities, and a flexible work-life balance for its employees, G&K definitely had several pull factors for graduates and veterans alike, but G&K was far from the only company hiring. Incessant recruiters are recipe for a discontent, especially among those who are best left alone; such was the case of Captain Anna Tsoi, who was prone to answering her unsuspecting visitors with violent outbursts, including at LAMG, charging her with a flurry of jabs in a drunken stupor. Questioning why this recruiter wasn’t returning blows, Anna realized she was a Doll with anti-human attack restrictions in place. Once lifted by Helianthus, however, the ensuing battle was comically short, allegedly ending with Anna diving out a multi-story window with LAMG in tow, landing harshly. Instead of a hospital, she was transferred to G&K Infirmary for treatment of her beat-up body, with all organic limbs still attached.

Groggily returning to consciousness, she found herself before Kryuger and Helianthus of G&K, questioning why she’d been essentially abducted to speak with her. Of course, had she not lashed out at LAMG and foolishly lept, perhaps their discussion could’ve been on more agreeable terms, but nevertheless, the opportunity had presented itself to bring her in for an “interview”, so to speak. Introducing himself, Kryuger mentioned they’d actually met before, though she likely hadn’t remembered it, nor does the story expand his comment; although speculation, this encounter could’ve been the Beslan Incident in 2050. By late 2047, fighting had expanded to Libya, with Soviet forces having consolidated control of Tripoli in the northwest, defending from NATO armored advances from Tunisia to the west. Automated Doll units had only recently been introduced to the war, and this was no different in North Africa, where company commander Captain Berezovich Kryuger led his forces and issued Dolls in the northwestern front. While mobilizing his men to plug the gap near Sabratha, Commissar Pablo, sent by “the old man”, had arrived at their camp deliver orders from their Battalion HQ, informing him they lacked spare transports to fulfill Kryuger’s requests, though this disappointment was somewhat quenched with news that they’d soon be receiving attack helicopter support. Lastly, and the true reason he’d been sent, Pablo passed a message from their Division HQ, who respected his leadership and sought to poach him for StateSec’s Alpha Group once the battle was over. 

Three years later, on September 1st, 2050, the RAG terrorists entered the No. 1 Secondary School of Beslan, and in response, the police, Internal Troops’ local 36th Brigade’s 9th Company, Vityaz, and most importantly, Alpha Group surrounded the school, starting an 11-hour standoff. There’s no evidence of Kryuger’s involvement among the present Alpha members, but it’s the only known point in the lore that Kryuger and Anna were in the same location simultaneously. Moreover, Anna came under G&K’s radar after Kryuger’s friend heard of G&K’s staffing shortage, recommending her for her service history. The identity of this friend and the “old man” from 2047 might have been Zelinsky, and the fact that Pablo had expressly been sent to deliver the offer to Kryuger, it points to someone within StateSec; furthermore, Zelinsky today is closely partnered with Sir Griffin Lyons, Old Misha, and Witkin, serving as an influential, high-ranking Rossartrist agent in the NUSSR. Considering Lyons had met Kryuger before 2052, they may have met through Zelinsky, as Lyons was officially inducted into the Council in the early 2050s from recommendation from wartime head of the British Secret Intelligence Service (MI6), Major General Sir Isaac. Around 2051, Isaac remarkably of Lyons, adding that his father was once one of MI6’s PIC of Northern Europe, landing Lyons in the intelligence craft at a young age, working closely with United States and United Kingdom intelligence services to collect foreign intelligence in Germany and Eastern Europe. Isaac’s gleaming review landed Lyons before a certain member of a Rossartrist organization, implied to be the Prometheus Council, thus inferring Isaac himself was a Councilor or fellow asset to them in the UK, similar to Zelinsky in the NUSSR; the latter, of course, had been asset for far longer. Lyons’ commendable record and beliefs must’ve garnered the Council’s approval, though he may not have been officially inducted as a Councilor until several years later. Persicaria and Lycoris’ extraction from Germany via Lyons’ false IDs and Kryuger’s security team gained the latter positive favor with Witkin, another partner of Lyons and Zelinsky, further tightening the web of Eastern European contacts. Suffice to say, Zelinsky is the most likely candidate for the “old man”, as there’s multiple ways Zelinsky and Kryuger could’ve formed their partnership.

Returning to the infirmary, Kryuger’s interview was more so a screening, probing her for her thoughts of Doll technology and leadership, while discussing the bright potential of their future. There’s an unusual confliction in the text, wherein Kryuger describes the Dolls on base as first generation Dolls, with second and third generation development concepts underway; the objective of Project Neural Cloud sometime in the second half of 2060 was to create the memory backup and transfer system, spearheaded by Professor Irida of the 42Lab Institute of Quantum Sciences, under the International Institute of Quantum Sciences, working in tandem with IOP, who had a research deal with G&K to implement the resultant breakthrough in IOP’s civilian-T-Doll conversions. This project was declared a success in late 2060, but according to Helianthus’ statement when LAMG - another unit of the same Doll model, with the original LAMG in the repair bay - entered, G&K hadn’t acquired the ability to pass on memories yet, implying G&K’s backup server hadn’t been introduced up to this point, still reliant on 1st generation “death equals neural reset” protocol, assuming the Doll could be recovered with the factory presets. What this doesn’t answer, however, is the date of the introduction of second-generation Tactical-Dolls, though Confidential Files 1 does elaborate that the IOP’s goal of standardizing the production and modularity of its Dolls, or those converted from civilian into Tactical frames, yet it’s unclear where the cut-off into 2nd Gen lies; not to mention, the old lore of Doll development is murky when placed alongside Project Neural Cloud and the modern story, though Kryuger does mention an innovation to Dolls’ memory was soon to be introduced, hinting at the modern neural cloud backup technology.

In what leads to perhaps the most ironic line in the entire game, Anna’s sparse guilt made question if LAMG would hold a grudge against her for landing them both into treatment, but Helianthus promised she wouldn’t, explaining that first and second-generation Dolls have immutable base layer commands that govern their purpose, loyalty, and development, with Makarov in RO635’s MOD story describing these as deterministic “seeds” of their neural development, like a blueprint for the mind. Helianthus added that Anna shouldn’t hold any worry or ill-will towards disloyalty, as she’d “never have to worry about being betrayed by a Doll on the battlefield”, because of their intrinsic adherence; oh how well that comment aged, even if RPK16 ultimately was trying to help Angelia. With great promise and sincerity, Helianthus handed the entry contract to Anna, agreeing to the terms presented. Before signing, Helianthus requested Anna take up a pseudonym for security reasons, used as her operational codename around base. It might be a twist of the Lake, such as reading Meitner and Blackwell’s letters within, but the pseudonym she jested was Abaddon, signifying Blackwell’s pseudonym, perhaps as a writer’s foreshadow, possibly brought on by Angelia viewing Abaddon and Laplace’s Demon’s letters, coinciding her Hela procedure into the Lake - instead, choosing Angelia in response to Kryuger’s stern disagreement.

Allure of Niflhel

Auld Lang Syne, for the Final Time No Longer
In the meantime of Angelia’s foray, there’s a dramatic shift to Avernus in the early 2060s, operational in total seclusion as a factory of filtration, death, and rebirth, under the meticulous eyes of Hela, codenamed Laplace, formerly Professor Martha Meitner. The shift cannot be immediately explained, as Angelia, according to current information, had never undergone Hela, nor would that explain why a scene of Avernus today plays back during Commander Angelia’s story from a 3rd person perspective. Otherwise, it’s possible this was meant as a purposeful narrative break, transitioning to Avernus during or after 2061, but confusion stems from unaccounted time and the shift in perspective, where else the other memories were specifically from Angelia’s perspective, breaking continuity to a degree, unless someone’s memories from Avernus were infused with Angelia’s in the Lake, improbably splicing the scenes. Nevertheless, the scene opens with Meitner gazing at an unconscious test subject, now dawning a black exterior, blue interior occultic robes and surgical gloves, with scars of age now obvious across her head and neck. A White Nyto delivered the compiled data from the subject’s scan to her, and upon a swift review of the pages, she returned the document, ordering the Nyto to monitor the resting subject for any anomalies and inform the “others” to prepare to awaken the subject. The identity of these “others” could simply be the Nytos assigned to the surgical or modification floors, but Paradeus has at least three, probable, humans: Meitner, assumed head of Hela research and Nyto Consciousness; William, the Father of Paradeus - though if Bramedb met with him in Berlin in 2064, he may be in and out of the facility; and the unknown “Dr. Harvey”, possibly another Paradeus or Galatea Hela surgeon. Dr. Eugene Rugosa’s procedures on Rosita are in themselves evidence of Galatea affiliates being poached for Paradeus’ research, so Harvey could be another.

Before leaving the room, the White Nyto hesitated for a moment, to which Meitner stated she should just ask any questions occupying her mind. Stemming from her previous background as a university professor and school teacher, Meitner explained how a particularly memorable student once asked a barrage of questions from her unquenchable curiosity, leaving little room for breaks. Almost certainly Anna, the girl’s incessancy was annoying, but nostalgic no less. In a later memory from the Commander Angelia section, Anna recollects another memory - an inception of an edited memory recollecting a memory, entertainingly - while she was in school. Presumably sometime after Meitner and Anna bonded into fair acquaintances, following several ventures to the school’s library, Anna sat at home with her older brothers. Armin, just finished pouring a glass of milk for her, served her as Ramzan entered, and upon nonchalantly preparing to leave, Ramzan - still a staunch patriot, spiteful of the Americans, though not outright bloodthirsty - asked if she was meeting with Meitner. Anna promptly ignored him, leading Ramzan to smack the glass from hands. Shocked, Armin rebuked him, while Anna grabbed her bag and rushed out the house to meet with her - rather apparent that Anna and Meitner must’ve grown closer since their chance encounters in the library, reflected in Meitner’s first letter to Blackwell, explaining that one of her students was surprisingly like them in curiosity and determination, relentlessly asking question after question. 

Listening to Meitner’s nostalgic past, the curious White Nyto asked what determines human identity, whether it be “biological makeup, such as genetic or physical appearance or physical appearance” or something more abstract, “like their experience or beliefs.” Although, as she stated, Meitner was no philosopher, but the Nyto’s line of questioning stemmed from whether or not the test subject was the same human before her death and subsequent Hela procedure. From a purely objective view, the test subject, presumably another Nyto, was biologically the same from cloning; however, a body is merely the soul’s vessel, and the origin of consciousness, whatever created a self-conscious entity capable of intellectual thought, was not so easily answered. To her, consciousness is independent of the flesh, acting only as a medium to interact with the physical world, yet the loss of the body spells the death - or at least, the physical loss of attachment to our world - of the individual. Human existence, however, apart from consciousness, was not exclusive to the individual’s body, thoughts, or memories, as throughout the course of our lives, we make an impact on others socially, leaving “some sort of emotional impression in someone else’s heart”. So, in the miraculous chance the deceased is resurrected, the impression and attachment for the individuality of the spirit is what’s imparted into the spirits of others, not merely just physical appearances. In her discussion with Anna in 2047, one commonality is ubiquitous across human existence: choosing what to do in this roller coaster called life, leaving our imprint in the others along the ride. When the familiarity of one’s spirit is deeply ingrained in the soul of another, the rebirth of the lost isn’t so easily renounced, as their “appearance doesn’t even need to be identical” to be “embraced tenderly by the living”, evocative of her belief that human existence is both objective and subjective. 

Subjectively, as long as others embrace the subject for who they once were, they are consciously the same soul; objectively, if the vessel is identical in appearance, though they do not have to be, biological equivalence dictates them as the same person. Ultimately, the effect of a soul on others is evident of individuality, subconsciously becoming part of another soul through interaction of our physical vessels. It’s a greatly spiritual, philosophical question on the definition of humanity and our existence, as we continue to exist so long as ourselves or another acknowledge us, defining humanity in a roundabout way as the reflection of the mirror stage, where self-perception is the foundation of our personas, all while conscious perception from others of ourselves is also definitive of our existence.
