An equivalent perspective is an often quoted proverb - possibly derived from the distinguished psychiatrist and philosopher Irvin Yalom or renowned author Ernest Hemingway, though the origins of its meaning are essentially timeless across cultures and religions - which describe death as two-phased; the first death is the death of the body and release from the physical world, yet the conscious acknowledgement and memory of them, ingrained from the departed’s emotional impression, lives on, carrying their legacy in our world until the final death: when the last time their name is spoken and all memories are forgotten. That said, the definition of consciousness lies in a scientific-theologian gray zone, existing both in the bounds of external perception and internal recognition, as the imprint we leave behind becomes a acknowledged mark of existence that never fades away until all those aware are lost, and self-perception, becoming conscious of one’s independence as a individual being in the universe, evolves from within, that is to say, the indeterminate origin of individual consciousness cannot yet be defined, but in the series, this universal lightning can be captured in a bottle through brainscan and Holy Grail technologies, “shifting” or “duplicating” the conscious mind depending on methods employed. These ideas return to the foundations of consciousness in the series, as according to Meitner’s notes in the Level 76 Laboratory, it does not only arise from the [DATA LOST], likely the brain, but something or somewhere else. Perhaps Nirvana, a foreign realm or cosmic dimension of consciousness, is the common or “transfer” point of certain individuals’ consciousnesses to other versions of self - past, present, future, or beyond. While our physical imprint remains until the final mind forgets for the final time, could Nirvana or a supreme entity, represent the core of consciousness immemorial - an innate mechanism or “soul” of the universe?

Through rebirth from Abaddon, arisen by the wielder of the keys of death and the lake of fire, the once-deceased can manifest themselves through the Nyto lifeforms, embraced by those who revere their souls, averting once-inevitable deaths. Like Gutalin’s denouncement of the Zone in “Roadside Picnic”, the quasi-immortality the Lake-Evangel System poses is an alluring temptation from the devil, drawing in the desperate and disillusioned, granting deliverance to the very vessels sacrificed to it. Sitting next to the unnamed test subject, silently watching the slumbering girl, the inflection of Meitner’s past and the Holy Grail is evident of the rejection of death, emulating the Creator; quoting Blackwell, “Humans should not play god.” As for the test subject’s identity, it’s a much wider mystery, with again, little evidence to uphold speculation. The subject is stated as a female with mechanical limbs, aligning with common Nyto standards from an objective standpoint, but in the realm of speculation, perhaps the subject could’ve been Nyto Gray or Nyto Sana. Meitner’s perspective on death and human existence was surely a response to the curious White Nyto - of which she doesn’t seem to possess as much ill-will against, unlike William’s lambasting - but theoretically, the subject could’ve been Sana. When discussing how bodies do not have to be identical to be embraced, she commented that the “test subject here would suffice”, but for an unstated reason it wasn’t time yet, suggesting some precondition had not been fulfilled. After Sana’s awakening following Operation Aeneas, Sana asked Nemhran - assuming the role of her “mother”, so to speak - if she’d have to go back to sleep, implying this wasn’t the first time she’d been awakened. A flimsy reach, yes, but something to keep in mind, though she could just be another common Nyto.

Servitude in Eljudnir
The decade of missing time after Ramzan’s apparent death leaves much to ponder, but sometime in the early 2060s, assuming Ramzan’s inclusion in Commander Angelia’s story wasn’t substituting another, he resurfaced under the new false identity of “Captain Ganglati”. While sweeping the Eastern Tower, Fe56 came across a series of chambers containing human-sized pods, surmised to be training pods to hone one’s electronic warfare capabilities and intellect; within, Alchemist discovered an unusual training pod, much wider in contrast to the others pods, likely for an individual or machine that dwarfed the normal Nytos. Obviously, Paradeus’ Dolls and mechanical units wouldn’t need a training room or pod, meaning someone was using it as a testing ground for a tall, bulky individual. While scanning the pod, Destroyer shrieked at the eerie deterioration of the interior, finding endless scratches and engravings, including a name multiple times. Written endlessly was Анна (Anna), yet just as many times as it was engraved it had been censored by the scratching, as if the subject was desperately trying to remember someone as their memories were gradually scrubbed. From the size of the room to the desperately engraved name, the unfortunate soul’s identity is almost certainly Ramzan, having consistently been subjected to mind wipes and whatever other horrific experiments throughout the past decade; moreover, it’s unclear if Ramzan actually underwent the Hela procedure, as the ingame index distinguishes the technology present in “Ganglati” as seemingly different to other Paradeus units.

During the spring 2051 operation, Ramzan was mortally wounded from Paradeus/Merc gunfire and contracted advanced-stage ELID from high-exposure, brought on by a seal breach in his CBRN equipment. Bordering the then-Red Zone of the Dead Sea, the substantial Contamination Index was elevated beyond habitable levels, with Meitner’s experiments even involving the collection and screening of ELID subjects, possibly the reason behind Ramzan’s uncanny “attraction” to the bodies in the sewer. Interestingly, after Ramzan had converted into a Type A ELID Infected, he violently halted the “ELID monsters” from reaching Anna, staining the walls with blood and gore, then let out a hoarse howl to them as if it were a command signal to these “Specimens”, who followed suit and charged behind Ramzan towards the enemy force. In their rampage through the plant’s corridors, an enemy rocket or grenade detonated between a door and the corridor, including all those within. Ramzan’s back had been gored into the explosion, yet he protected Anna to the very end. While Ramzan was recently-converted, likely maintaining some semblance of rationality in his final moments, his apparent command to the Specimens was like an alpha guiding a wolf pack, while protecting its kin. Not only does this reveal these Specimens, perhaps not specifically ELIDs, can apparently be “ordered” by an alpha subject, but the wounds and condition of his body are indicative of his replaced cybernetics in the early 2060s. 

Near the plant’s specimen containment room, two assigned soldiers discussed the Professor’s unusual research, with the accompanying asking the point of research, as these specimens appeared like ELID Infected but also not, distinguishing them from the common ELIDs. After the enemy faction captured the three transport drivers, they - acting as specimens for Meitner’s research - were injected with an unidentified serum to screen them for an unstated condition, theorized to be immuno-resistance, as the injection triggered immediate ELID-like symptoms. Despite all three succumbing to the serum, marking them failed specimens, they were extracted for seemingly other experiments or to be fed as bioenergy to the Evangel Axis. Considering Paradeus’ specimens were ELID Infected-like, perhaps they could’ve been screening collected specimens for immuno-resistance or cognitive integrity. As for Ganglati, much of his body reflects the wounds sustained in the operation: his replaced jaw, brutally wounded in his bloody melee with the other specimens; his chest, having taken gunfire in the assault; and his lower body and mechanical back, battered when the enemy explosive detonated in the corridor. Other prosthetics include the replacement of his legs and hips into the standard “Nyto” cybernetics, his original prosthetic left arm has been replaced with a human-like bionic, and his right hand shows the metal beneath the epidermis. The etymology of his name, however, is synonymous to that of which Meitner adopted. Within Snorri’s Prose Edda - a collection of Old Norse skaldic poetry “Eddas”, written from the perspective of the old Icelandic poet, author, and religious historian Snorri Sturluson in the 13th century, presenting as a comprehensive, albeit partially secondary, source of Old Norse myth from word of mouth and older, untitled historical works - in “Chapter IX-Loke and His Offspring” of his Gylfaginning, Odin ordered the capture of Loke’s (Loki) three children with Angerboda for the prophesied danger they posed as the monstrous children of cunning and deceit, and before Odin, Hel - the third child and daughter of grim, incongruous body - was consigned and given domain over Niflheim - the subterranean ninth world of icy darkness, beclouded with mist, once the antecedent nothingness before all creation.

From newfound dominion over the wicked and pitiful, bestowed to her as the guide of deliverance to these souls, who are cast before Hel, then to assigned their dwelling in Niflhel, or simply “Hel/Hela”, an eponymous frozen realm of death, existing at the bottom of nine worlds of the universe. Here, she lives in a great, bizarre mansion of sprawling halls, known as Eljudnir, alongside two servants: her maid-servant, Ganglot, meaning “Lazy” or “Sloth”; and her man-servant, Ganglati, meaning “Delay” or “Late”. Sometime following his first death in 2051, Ramzan was awakened from death by his teacher and master, Hela, now a shadow in his former shell, memories twisted and churned, with a neural-stabilizer installed to control and puppeteer her man-servant. His date of awakening is uncertain, but to possess such an evocative name - even referring to Meitner as his teacher, both historically and literally regarding his past and Paradeus - as well as the distinction between him and other Paradeus models could signify he’s one of the older models of Nytos, if he even is a traditional, synthesized Nyto Consciousness, per se, rather than just reanimated, restrained ELID. In the Paradeus outpost, observing Angelia, he felt the scars of criss-crossed sutures across his face and neck, indicating flesh had been added to his tattered body into a Frankenstein's monster-like abomination, rather than a genetically-augmented subject or test-tube clone. 

Contrasting his shoddy, reanimated appearance, the White Nyto serving under him was said to be the newest model on the base, possibly meaning the common Black and White Nytos were introduced after Ramzan’s monstrous form, with the mimicry of Lunasia’s appearance in the common Nytos as the key distinction. Alternatively, the common Nytos had already been introduced, and the White Nyto in this listening post was simply just the most recent Nyto subject deployed, though these possibilities are not mutually exclusive. Furthermore, the scenes of Ganglati in the base are contained within bubble, as in Angelia wasn’t present to observe the depicted events, thus it’s unclear how these sections were infused with her memories, possibly inserted by Meitner; however, this theory wouldn’t explain how Ganglati’s perspective from the memory section had been recovered and inserted into Angelia’s. Theoretically, assuming the encounter with Ganglati was factual, he could’ve been extracted by Paradeus after he leapt from the building, having his memories or fragments of his VCI recovered - the question of if Ganglati classifies as a Nyto is ambiguous - after the building collapsed. Like much of Angelia’s memories, the unreliable narrator angle weighs heaviest in the Commander Angelia section, as these events take place in the approximate modern Girls Frontline story, yet are kept in a vacuum, with no additional details from the story or lore for veracity, unlike the Agent Angelia sections, which we clearly know most is false.

Since his first death, Ramzan obviously underwent various mindwipes, and having been discovered by Fe56, the mind wipe room erased memory regression, ensuring total loyalty, while eliminating elements of disobedience. Perhaps early on in the Hela Project, the extent Meitner could muster were the formerly human test specimens, seemingly using them for trials with the serum, from which none had apparently survived, quickly converting them into Type A ELIDs, but as the soldier in the plant said, these specimens appeared as ELIDs but not quite, implying a certain characteristic of their conversion was railroaded. The specimens hadn’t been converted into bioenergy, but the experiments, likely part of the Hela Project, were entrenched in these screening humans with an ELID serum, as if they were filtering test subjects for immunity, just as Paradeus today; likewise, the Nytos are the horrific result of splicing metal with flesh to serve as the vessel of synthesized consciousness, and when Paradeus’ soldiers injected the Soviet transport drivers, the rapid onset of ELID isn’t too unlike the controlled influx of Collapse particles in the specimen screening center in Avernus, filtering out subjects of sufficient resistance, disposing the insufficient to the abyss or to the material sorting plant. When a sorrowful soul falls before Hela in Avernus, their mind is extracted through the Hela procedure, affixing their soul to the bottom of the Lake in Niflhel, their last vestige of human existence only called upon to create a new Nyto Consciousness. Even if the specimen failed to meet expectation, there were plenty of other tragic fates. Perhaps even among the declared failed specimens, their bodies were still useful as vessels, just imperfect ones, with Ramzan possibly being one of these decrepit precursors of modern Nytos.  The patchwork sewing and neural instability speak to a lack of precision unseen in modern Nyto models, so it’s possible the earliest Nytos were much closer to these Frankensteinian lifeforms, with Ramzan becoming Ganglati, Meitner’s personal servant and blade. 

Possessed by false memory, Ramzan underwent bounding cycles of regression and isolation, with his patchwork body and rudimentary neuro-stabilizer as likely early examples of Paradeus’ modern Nytos, if Ganglati even is necessarily a Nyto in the traditional definition, returned from the abyss of death by his “Teacher”, Martha Meitner, wielder of the key of Abaddon - the true secret of Avernus. Having seemingly been deployed to kill and capture Angelia, preserving her brain as a Hela subject, Ganglati’s past memories were a hodgepodge of tangled consciousness, deluded into believing Anna was responsible for the Beslan incident that murdered his dear elder brother, Armin, and his younger sister, Sana, who the brothers vowed their father to defend together. In his corrupted memories from the Lake, he incorrectly recalled Sana and Armin backing away from Anna’s gun, only for “Ganglati” to witness her putting them down like dogs. In another, Sana was sitting in the Ibrahimov cabin, drinking the glass of milk served by Armin, telling her that as long as she was a good girl that did as told, their Teacher would gladly bring them outside to play, swapping Anna with Sana in these scenarios, continuously galvanizing his consciousness with a sister of innocence that was never his. Playing out in the snowfield nearby, Ganglati and Sana narrowly missed each other, abruptly ending when one of Sana’s toy bullets hit a small golden bird sweeping low, bringing her to her knees in tearful sorrow for the poor animal; however, Ganglati lifted her spirits with promise, telling her that Teacher could save the birdie like she saved him, raising Ramzan from death into the unstable, patchwork enigma - agency stolen from him by Meitner’s ambition. Why exactly Angelia was targeted remains unexplained, yet her history with Meitner and Ramzan suggests Ganglati was there to either assassinate her or, more concisely, was brought about by Meitner’s intrigue into the inquisitiveness of her former student.

Wisdom of Athena’s Owl
Judging by Ganglati’s objective of killing Angelia, the mission assigned to him likely was to eliminate Angelia, but preserve her brain for the Hela Project, which Angelia in the current story was actually undergoing. Again, how any of these memories from his perspective were infused with hers is a mystery, mixing continuity, and if were all to be fake or a considerable twist from, say, the first encounter with Paradeus in Continuum Turbulence, it might explain how Angelia never mentioned this encounter to anyone. Learning of the unknown contacts from M82A1 and M870, Angelia was just as confused as DEFY, SOPII and RO, and 416, but later, 416 asked Angelia have she had any clue about this enigmatic tertiary faction, which she denied but did curiously mentioned that she “might be able to make a guess going by their characteristics”, asking for their appearance, insinuating she had some basis on what the Nytos were beforehand, even if nothing more than a guess. Another stretch, and this depends on the reader’s interpretation, blurred now by Angelia’s past encounter with Ramzan, but after 416 reported the absurd capabilities of the two Nytos, Angelia affirmed that she knew, adding that “my experience tells me our chances aren’t good at all”, but Occam’s Razor says she was simply acknowledging the situation through her past service, knowing when and when not to pick a fight; not to mention, CT was release in summer 2018, so truthfully, most of Slow Shock likely wasn't even conceptualized yet. Still, Angelia rebuked the unknown “White Doll” as a “puppet”, emblematic of these lifeforms between human and machine. When the Black and White Nyto converged on the Commander’s location, the White Nyto ordered her subordinate to take them in as prison, while she went off to buy them time for transport to arrive. Although the concept of the Lake and Evangel Axis likely didn’t exist then, the Black Nyto curiously mentions that her superior’s soul wouldn’t say anchored to her body, to which the latter stated that sacrifice was key to their “freedom”, “awakening with this freedom” through sacrifice. In contrast, during SC, Angelia lacked information on Paradeus, asking Schwaben what he’d been withholding, revealed to be the Stasi and StateSec’s investigations into Yellow Zone disappearances, escalating to something far greater than the once-surmised “cult” - rather, an entire organization.

Another clue towards prescience, however, actually comes from Longitudinal Strain, specifically a memory of a past military operation conducted by StateSec’s 7th General Directorate Advanced Combat Team Я, under the command of Dr. Arthur Hume’s 62nd Doll, Instructor Я. After Angelia left G&K and before the combined military operation in 2063, the Wolf Pack were deployed to support Team Я - composed of Instructor Я (AR-18), Sergey (RPD), Ash (ASh-12.7), and Yulia (PP-2000) - during a special operation in the Tserkov Special Administrative Region, NUSSR. Following an earlier local massacre - carried out by an enigmatic, militant sect of unidentified zealots - the Soviet brass officially identified them as a malignant entity, requiring immediate intervention. Launching drone reconnaissance, Sergey reported the suspected village was entirely deserted, and with the defensive net closed around the village, the three Dolls under Instructor Я made way to the target location, only to discover the gruesome sight of bodies stacked in the buildings, all of which were ELID patients executed by hot/thermal weapons, wounds allegedly seen before from their briefings. Furthermore, the Contamination Index was notably elevated just outside the village, presumably the handiwork of the unknown cult’s massacres, and flipping through an intelligence report, all Instructor Я could ascertain about them was their white color motif. Just before her team could withdraw, communications were hampered and a shell exploded nearby Yulia, then waves of “white” converged on them all around professionally, as reported by Sergey, expressing she would’ve confused them for the military had she not known better. 

Before the situation worsened, Angelia abruptly entered their communications channel, promising reinforcement and extraction if they could hold their positions; Angelia had lost both limbs, meaning this operation must’ve taken place after the alleged encounter with Ganglati.
 The Wolf Pack - composed of AK12 and AN94, signifying this operation was set after Angelia left G&K - successfully transported the wounded trio back to Instructor Я, meaning the Wolf Pack had directly engaged this enigmatic, militant sect of zealots, equipped with high-end weapons, and sharing a white motif - all but confirming them to be Paradeus, responsible for the prior massacres for various research sectors and materials, similar to how the origin partially-immune origin individual of Machlian and Morridow was captured after a village massacre with Boxes of Iaso. The elevated Collapse radiation levels during the operation were likely triggered by the deployment of such weapons, contaminating the local area as a sieve of the population, executing any survivors with hot/thermal-based energy weapons, issued to all branches of Paradeus’ paramilitary. Suffice to say, the allusion is glaring, and the white motif cements this as the then-considered-cult of Paradeus, insinuating the brass, StateSec, and Angelia of the Wolf Pack knew this organization’s posture to varying degrees; however, compartmentalization isolated and limited information on the group to select members of the Bureau, leaving nothing but a spare few notes and motifs left for Instructor Я to identify the unknown cult. In June 2064, when Schwaben - representing the middleman for the bigshots and Stasi involvement into the Paradeus investigation, working alongside StateSec’s 6th Directorate of cutting-edge national-defense technologies, which itself was entrenched with the conspiracy of Operation Butterfly, as it was the 6th that mobilized to arrest Lycoris - and Angelia were assigned together to investigate Carter’s illegal Relic research in the Estonian Red Zone. 

Overlooking Paldiski, the latter inquired for what Schwaben had been withholding regarding Paradeus, as in Isomer, he demonstrated his knowledge on the enigmatic White Faction, possessing leads on Paradeus’ alleged signal emissions in Belgrade and information on the Commander’s assigned mission from StateSec. Schwaben never implicitly denied Angelia information, only answering questions when asked, and near the destination, she inquired more on their history. According to his statement of dubious veracity, he first came across Paradeus in Southern Europe during one of his investigations, spurred by common rumors of a cult operating in southern Germany. In a time of zealots seeking salvation post-war, cults weren’t exactly an unfamiliar concept, yet the White Faction cult’s distinctive rate of expansion and fielded technologies and arms, they were declared less of a cult than a well-equipped “terrorist organization with a political agenda”. Later, when rendezvousing with the Commander in Paldiski, Schawben disclosed additional information on his initial investigations, explaining that he once came across a case report - realizing then its relevance to the juvenile Nytos discovered in William’s laboratory - on Paradeus’ links to an orphanage in southern Germany, where he - more specifically, the Stasi, StateSec, and likely Prometheus - concluded that was “where Paradeus began their first experiments”. From that case report, in tandem with the discovery of the juvenile Nytos, Schwaben firmly stated they were clones created by Paradeus, with speculation that Paradeus was attempting to create a human capable of entering the OGAS System, Nirvana. Although tangential, when Ulrich called Schwaben to speak with her privately in DR about Angelia, she worried that what Angelia had discovered in William’s laboratory was enough to draw the world’s attention, presumed to be related to the Nyto OGAS experiments, developing Source-derived consciousnesses in human vessels.

The events of Paldiski were carefully orchestrated by William, drawing in G&K and SF to OKB-167 with the coordinates he transferred to Zelinsky in Isomer, exchanging evidence of Carter’s illegal Relic research for information on other bases, selling him out the Rossartrist and loyalist factions of the NUSSR, so as to move a matured OGAS into a position to activate the Starfish. In a call between Havier and Zelinsky after G&K arrived in Tallinn, Zelinsky rebuked Witkin’s witty recollection of his plan, wherein Witkin’s plan would’ve pushed G&K closer to a peninsula with no escape if the operation failed, either forced to jump into the Baltic Sea or face bombardment from the Soviet Military Air Forces as soon as an activation signal was received from the Starfish. Amid the inferno in Paldiski, Witkin and his men personally entered Persicaria’s laboratory to “protect her” from consistent attempts on her life, presumably by Paradeus, though these claims could’ve been exaggerated to sway her to spill any information she had on “William” to Witkin - a Promethean asset or Councilor, working alongside Lyons to investigate Paradeus and William. Getting out of the limousine, Witkin received a call from Zelinsky or Lyons - though the latter is more likely, given Witkin’s exclamation on G&K’s unexpected performance against the veterans, as “your partner really has an eye for such things”, suggesting the other party’s partner was Kryuger - to verify Persicaria’s protection, while adding that “her account”, referring to her background in 90wish, as well as Oberstein and Lunasia’s involvement, “largely verified our speculations”.

Several weeks later, once G&K had reacquainted themselves with the S09 Base, Dandelion and the AR Team dragged the Commander outside the banquet to ask about about pursuing M4A1 and M16A1’s disappearance, promising to search the ends of the world for their comrade sisters. Of course, this request was meaningless when the Commander, too, sought the same for them, but Dandelion brought forth a peculiar angle on their disappearance - the Oberstein Manor consistently seen in M4A1’s neural cloud, her home “stored in the depths of her memories”. Most pertinent, however, was information sourced from Witkin’s intelligence network, possibly the primary Promethean intelligence tendril - WAVE Technology Corporation information agency, owned by Lyons and recommended by Witkin to the Commander-in-exile in Belgrade, with Dandelion joking about leaving an inconspicuous backdoor into Witkin’s computer. Following Angelia’s trail in Bremen, the Stasi caught wind of a house identical to Lunasia’s after investigating Morridow Voigt’s apartment, discovering a photograph of the mansion, and considering the Rossartrist-aligned faction of the Stasi, led by Director Romy Riefenstahl, were working in tandem with the Prometheans, it’s evident of Witkin and Lyons’ specific investigation into the “von Oberstein” family, drawing a direct connection between 90wish and Rudolf, with Persicaria’s testimony verifying prior speculation.


Angelia Viktorovna Tsoi meets Sir Griffin Lyons in the Athena’s Owl in Alt-Berlin.

After railroading Angelia into the Athena’s Owl bar - common grounds for intelligence agents of foresight and wisdom - in Alt-Berlin (“Old Berlin”), Angelia found herself before a pitiful beggar, raising her walking stick to the door while telling her that “salvation lies within”, likely referencing Lyons’ message through RPK16’s firewall to her: “‘John 8:12’ - “I am the light of the world; he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.” Salvation is found in the astute fox riding the waves of tumultuous times, for Lyons believes the Promethean cause to be the light of life in the world, safeguarding humanity’s embers through darkness into the renewed, brighter future. Sitting before Lyons, quietly enjoying a glass of wine in the unassuming establishment, regally opposite to a high-class bar filled with intelligence agents that one would imagine owned by someone of his caliber, but ultimately indifferent in purpose. Although, of course, after acting up slightly towards Lyons, every single person in the commonplace bar softly showed their hand, revealing all to be “from the Stasi, PMCs, or some other factions” - composing the Rossartrist-aligned faction of the Stasi that later followed Riefenstahl, certain well-paid mercenaries, and intelligence assets of unnamed factions, perhaps Lyon’s other Promethean blades. In exchange for investigating the case of an alleged terrorist attack through Leone Michel of the Flora Institute, who was moved to a Galatea psychiatric facility in Berlin after RPK16’s time with her, Angelia - foolish enough to believe her role as his blade was indispensable - demanded the location of the manor seen in Morridow’s photographs. Griffin reluctantly accepted, but pressured her not to go beyond her scope and ability, as her priorities should remain on the mission, not the reward; however, Angelia’s proclivity for obstinacy proved the worst of Lyons’ expectation after losing all leads on Paradeus’ Operation Cocoon in Berlin, allegedly contaminating Berlin in a mass casualty event, screening immunes through an astroturfed Galatea Idunn vaccine. With nothing to go on, she barged into the Athena’s Owl again, against RPK16’s advice that they were better to remain docile until the higher-ups were answering, suspiciously including Old Misha, who never picked up any of Angelia’s communications, signifying that he’d been working behind the scenes with Lyons, Zelinsky, and Witkin as well. Within the bar, AK15’s Wolf Eyes picked up a hollow space on the left side, behind a wine rack; the barkeep was displeased, promising Angelia she’d regret that decision, and through the hidden passage, concealed a mostly-empty chamber, suggesting either majority of the interior was extracted or Lyons expected her to come, leaving a map of Berlin for all her to discover as a possible limited hangout. Among the string-laden map of various locations, marked with several messages, one stood out: a spot in Neu-Tempelhof, with “Angelia” written around it, implying Lyons had either left the map for her to find once the mission was completed or, perhaps conspiratorially, left it as bait to draw her closer the sinful mansion, landing her in the grasp of Paradeus.

As the Commander and their allies closed the net on Paradeus, the high-ranking Nytos returned to Avernus, and upon receiving Pandora and Nimogen’s data from Berlin, Nemhran’s underling, Olga, reported the invulnerable encryption on Pandora’s neural cloud, unable to ascertain why they took such an potentially volatile individual within their ranks. Nemhran promised that Father understood Pandora’s true intentions well, as it was “in accordance to Father’s wishes”, and with her “backers” having paid an adequate price to speak with him, Nemhran declared soon it would be time to initiate communications with “that side”, likely referring to Lyons’ Promethean faction, seeking to bring William and his technology under their wing. Despite faced with potential annihilation in Berlin, the powers-that-be maintained radio silence with Angelia; be it Zelinsky, Lyons, or Misha, the latter of which greatly confused Angelia, suggesting Lyons’ comment about his work reaching the final stage - adding he mustn’t be disturbed - and the perhaps deceitful map in the bar was directed at landing Angelia closer to Paradeus, using the rogue agent of William and Meitner’s interest as “collateral” bait. After all, William’s wished to study and read this “agent of justice’s” personality, while Meitner had missed the days of her inquisitive student, and considering Fe56 discovered a dossier in Avernus describing someone from the United States being associated to the principles of the URNC’s foundation, then it may very well incriminate the Prometheans with indirectly or intentionally selling her for Father’s aforementioned theoretical asking price.  Back in DR, when Schwaben was summoned to privately speak with Ulrich, she was glad he’d survived the precarious situation in Paldiski months earlier, but the immersion of Rossartrism in Europe was still underway, with Schwaben adding that her job was place a “kindly face” to the tide - a determined unifier of sensible mind for the Rossaritrst agenda, representing the interests of Prometheus as Chairwoman of PECMAR to collectively realize the UN’s Alliance of the United Nations Plan. When Angelia was brought up after meeting with her, Schwaben implicitly understood why the Prometheans - their first direct namedrop in the series - had sent her over, having discovered the information from William’s laboratory that drove her to Germany in the first place, with Paradeus moles accidently sending her to Bremen through their clandestine, intrusive counter-intelligence program. Truthfully, the information Angelia possessed was an ace in her sleeve, and Ulrich, relatively understanding the positions of her true masters, stated what was discovered in William’s laboratory - the juvenile Nytos, OGAS, or something more esoteric - would never be voluntarily handed down from the Prometheans to the volatile, with Schawben pointing out that handling G&K was far easier than Prometheus, insinuating the Stasi and Germans had a vested interest themselves in William’s golden-goose Relic technologies, hoping to win Angelia or the Prometheans over into divulging the secrets for the good of the German people. 

She put it succinctly herself, telling Schwabe that “We need Relic technology… for the sake of the Volk”, adding that, unofficially, she still didn’t want to see harm come to Angelia if efforts proved futile. Unlike her masters’ pernicious objective with Paradeus, Ulrich’s interest in Relic technology was ethically questionable at worst - no better or worse than former 90Wunsch and Stasi-HVA head Markus Wolf’s wish of a unified Germany - its people brought together harmoniously with Relic technologies, with the Antarctic Union as later proof that mutual coexistence with the Relics is possible, assuming human temptations that wrought ruin in the first place do not regress. The Stasi and Ulrich certainly are not as read-in as the Prometheans regarding Paradeus, seemingly unaware to the Prometheans’ true ambitions, but from the first known reports of a cult in Germany and a massacre in the NUSSR by a rogue, religious extremists, both the Stasi and NUSSR’s intelligence apparatuses caught wind of the group’s unusually well-equipped forces, thus by extension, spurring the Prometheans’ interests to launch a full investigation, perhaps all in an attempt to identify advantageous technologies to secure the foundation of the Union of Rossartrism, such as OGAS for an all-union international economic management system. As a public face with just a glimpse into the wider veil, Ulrich had no insight into Paradeus' greater reach and her superiors’ ulterior interests into anything to ensure law and stability in the new world order, no matter the demonic allure. But with an evident, ongoing investigation by Prometheus, what was the first sign of their emergence on the world stage?

Paradeus’ modus operandi, before the Boxes of Iasos, often necessitated the kidnapping of those lowliest and easily forgotten, with most turning a blind eye to disappearances in the Contaminated Zones, and the statement on the first orphanage suggests Paradeus has been carrying out these kidnapping operations, such as Berlin’s Burley Orphanage, for several years. Theoretically, Paradeus could’ve been collecting “specimens” for years before appearing on radars, possibly even before Meitner’s introduction, thus implicating the group in the alleged kidnapping case at Berlin Metropolitan School in 2050, and if Paradeus truly was founded by former Photon Project members - or at least, adopted the Beaconist concepts - then Paradeus’ objective creating a perfect individual may directly descend from the Photon Project. Moreover, when the unknown man, presumably “William”, called Zelinsky to negotiate Chairwoman Ulrich’s release in Isomer, he mockingly warned StateSec not to uselessly trace his location, requiring “another decade to trace me”. While William often commands himself with hubris, it’s evident Zelinsky understood who this man was - or rather, his position in Paradeus - and the “decade” comment may not be an exaggeration, considering the conclusive events of Operation Couatl. 

Paradeus’ earliest specimens surely were kidnapping victims or POWs, as seen when the unknown English-speaking enemies tested the injected serum on converged American and Soviet forces outside the Dead Sea, collecting the bodies of those who “failed”, converting into ELIDs in moments, meaning Paradeus was seemingly been filtering immunes for at least 13 years, perhaps nearly three decades if the Photon Project has continued in secrecy. While nothing links the BMS attack to Paradeus, some level of local influence was required to limit the severity and scope of the incident to the public and media, with parents having been hushed about the alleged kidnapping plot, and given the city is the affluent heart of Oberstein influence - their manor only a few kilometers away from the school - there’s a feasible link. Not to mention, in Oberstein’s letters, Metiner had a potential “extraordinary effect” on their unspecific plan, and with Paradeus’ - or rather, its precursor or equivalent at the time, unless it was Paradeus - poaching of her, the Meitner’s research into the Holy Grail was apparently instrumental to their plan, suggesting Paradeus’ ambition into the Relics recognized Meitner’s simulation of Nirvana as tangential to their objectives, perhaps with the lifeforms of quasi-immortality possibly becoming the activation medium. If this were the case, Daybreak’s abstruse appearance in the BMS attack means Daybreak were deployed to the sites of Paradeus at least twice, and the later apparent international declaration of “Laplace”, codename “Capita”, as an illegal Relic scientist war criminal implies the sanguine results of “his” research were discovered by both sides, initiating a kill or capture order on either side. It’s unclear how the Americans came to discover the skyscraper of what’s today Avernus during Operation Couatl, possibly the prominent Eastern Tower, yet the Rangers were mobilized for the decapitation operation, supported by regular US Army, convoying to the Contaminated Zone. In the climatic moment of Couatl, all recollection was lost, Aliana unable to confirm who she engaged in that target room; however, she still made it into StateSec’s hands somehow, a consistent and inexplicable question, spawning plenty of theories. 

Thirteen years later, StateSec quietly planted Aliana’s crate on MBV Elmo before traveling to S09 for extraction of the G&K remnants, believed by the Commander to be an indirect way of providing an essential asset for the subsequent raid on Paradeus, as she was the only known witness inside the heart. Again, how Aliana made it into StateSec’s hands remains mystery, yet she made it somehow, suggesting she was captured by Soviet reinforcements, perhaps intentionally left by someone related to Couatl; regardless, the fact StateSec knew her relation to the Commander’s mission implies some premonition on behalf of Zelinsky, Misha, or the Prometheans, as only they knew or recently learned of Avernus, with Riefenstahl herself speculating Paradeus’ HQ was in the Dead Sea. It’s unmistakable the Stasi, StateSec, their agents, and Prometheans masters knew of Paradeus well before Continuum Turbulence in 2063; spanning a decade after Couatl, the “cult’s” activities in southern Germany, Estonia, and the NUSSR all fell under the guise of intelligence apparatus, and with the remarkable capabilities demonstrated by the OGAS System in the aftermath of the Butterfly Incident - and later, during the Paldiski operation - seemingly only bolstered the Promethean intrigue into the enigmatic organization, achieving a true Relic activation and tapping into Nirvana through OGAS, while its calculations would prove invaluable for the brave new world both Paradeus and Prometheus sought, gifting humanity with a monkey’s paw of divine power, eventually enforcing the obligatory authoritarian oversight they believed the idealistic are willfully ignorant to. And the medium of the promised worldly change are the Nytos - a glimpse of the Holy Grail of science and theocracy: immortality and the key to the Relics.

Of course, all Nytos are garbage by an effect of their very existence, yet the White Nyto’s description in CT of awakening after death may be symbolic of one’s soul passing on or once again facing quasi-resurrection in a new synthesized consciousness. Even among the failures, the standouts still possess a degree of respect as convenient tools, such as the higher-ranking Nytos. Gray filled an invaluable role as a frontman in society, Narciss was Father’s blades, Bramedb was an espionage expert and “Father’s favorite daughter”, Grig was an unexpected combat success with a forsaken saber granted to her, and Nemhran had a one-of-a-kind role as a Mother in Paradeus and to the Obersteins. In retrospect, perhaps the sacrifice and reawakening with newfound freedom may illustrate delusion of a Nyto’s rebirth, believing themselves worthy of a second chance upon failure, but in the very words of the victim, “If we fail, we die.” 


Nyto Gray falling to her death in the Eastern Tower during Operation Aeneas, impaled on the Goddesses’ sword after reaching the ground floor.

When Morridow encountered Grig, still weeping while dragging Gray’s lifeless corpse, Grig pleaded to Morridow, begging her to request Father to resurrect Gray, oblivious to the fact they were ultimately no different than the lowliest Nyto. A Nyto is the generated waste from the perpetual “process of creating an individual with total immunity”, so as long as they were insufficient specimens, they were failures, expendable with a mere finger wag, whose only uses were as tools or to be recycled beneath Avernus for the next generation. This is the irony at the root of the White Nyto’s delusions, falsely believing they’d be given rebirth, as not only would it be - at the time - impossible to duplicate the same individual Nyto Consciousness in the same, deceased vessel, but as failures from the beginning, what reason would William or Meitner have to resurrect them? It’s an unfortunate fate, but a final death as an individual is salvation in comparison to the hellish cycles of death and resynthesis of consciousness.

Lone Gold in a Snowfield

Howls of the Wolf Pack (2061-2062)
The timeskip from Angelia’s introduction to Griffin to her leave is indefinite, but the story describes LAMG fighting under Angelia for “several years”, which factually cannot be the case as Angelia relinquished command of the AR Team, in exchange for the Wolf Pack between spring and June 2062, after the encounter at Safehouse 3 in CH0. In late 2061, the Wolf Pack Project was launched in StateSec, with backing from the Bureau and an old friend of Professor Samantha Shaw’s, Sir Griffin Lyons. Originally, only two Dolls were planned, but this number ended in four with a prototype and a secret fourth member - in order of production, they are: AN94, released around late 2061, serving as the prototype to the Wolf Pack Duo; AK15, aka the White Mastiff, released in mid February 2062; AK12, aka the Snow Wolf, released sometime after AK15, roughly around spring 2062; and lastly, RPK16, released several weeks or months after the infamous failed “Incident Zero” operation, but before June 2062, approximately. As much as Angelia would detest so, we can date certain events by the number of limbs Angelia had lost by RPK16’s rollout date: first, the loss of her left arm while serving in G&K; and second, the loss of her right leg after leaving G&K, allegedly inflicted by Ganglati.

Considering these dates, it’s impossible for the timeskip in G&K to be on the order of several years, less than a year tops, set between spring to June 2062, roughly marking the timeframe of the loss of her left arm. Sometime after her introduction to Griffin, Persicaria’s experimental AR Team was assigned to Commander Angelia, serving under her until Angelia’s apparent escape within the first half of 2062. Between these two events, Angelia suffered a traumatic injury, resulting in the loss of her left arm, but the incident responsible has never been explained; however, there’s reason to believe either KCCO Captain Yegor or SF Ringleader Agent were responsible. Amidst the chaotic battle in Singularity, Agent managed to ambush the Commander, pinning them to the ground and slowly crushing their chest in. Choking, Agent savored the moment before death, going on to explain that two years before Singularity - presumably set around mid 2063 or so, several months before Neural Cloud, beginning on September 23rd, sometime after the Commander’s rescue from Paradeus, where they were held for nine weeks - another Commander, said to be female, confronted her like the Commander, and just before the Commander blacked out from hypoxia, Angelia contacted Agent, buying the Commander’s survival. The familiar voice halted her, and Angelia jested how nostalgic it must be for her, jabbing about her mediocre performance “as a murderer”, all but confirming the unknown female Commander was Angelia, having survived Agent’s attack, possibly resulting in the loss of Angelia’s left arm. On the contrary, while communicating with Squad 404 against Agent, the encrypted communications channel was intercepted by Yegor, mocking her poor signal blockades and her miraculous survival of “both times” until then, adding it’d be best to give up while she still has other body parts. Angelia retorted, explaining she escaped from death each time “Because you’re always so overconfident.” This begs to ask, was it Agent or Yegor responsible for the loss of limbs; moreover, if Ramzan was responsible for her right leg, then what are the other times Yegor apparently knows about?

Pivotal to the timeline of Angelia’s service in the early 2060s, establishing the date of Angelia’s left arm amputation would neatly lay out the entire timeline of her service. When she first came to G&K, all limbs were intact, losing her left arm and right leg by the encounter with Ganglati. After AK15’s first deployment in February 2062, Angelia still possessed all four limbs during her discussion with Shaw on becoming the Wolf Pack’s tentative commander once AK12 was completed. Soon after rolling out of the facility, AK12 and AK15 were deployed on their first incident together - Incident Zero, later proving to be a catastrophic failure when the Wolves were found to be incompatible, with AK12 unable to effectively command the ideal-bodied AK15, who promptly ignored superior orders in exchange for the most swift and deadly option - an incompatibility responsible for unintentional casualties and damage. After the incident, the pair split, leaving AK15 without an effective commanding leader and AK12 without a partner; meanwhile, the Wolf Pack prototype AN94 was faced with tribulation, never having been deployed to service, unlike the others, because of Shaw’s inexplicable sheltering, as if she was keeping her chick nested. Before AK12’s completion, Angelia came to Shaw’s office again to discuss AN94’s adverse reaction to Shaw’s conservatism towards AN94 and the future of the project, and midway through, Angelia probed Shaw over her diametrically opposite view of the purpose of Dolls - only to be used as weapons, with performance as their core metric - versus Persicaria’s view - the complete freedom of choice, removing all barriers that may constrict or restrain a Doll’s agency. Interestingly, as to point out Shaw’s hypocrisy, Angelia brought up AN94’s particularly “humanlike” qualities, “so much like…” an unnamed individual. 

Appearance-wise, AN94 is a direct mirror of Shaw - the color of their hair, eyes, and shape of their hair are all quite similar, alluding to either Shaw illegally mimicking her own appearance or another person - say, a theoretical deceased or lost daughter - in AN94. Angelia doubled down, stating Shaw had never intended AN94 be deployed, which Shaw quickly deflected, changing the subject almost immediately once Angelia’s words became too abrasive. It should also be said Angelia retained all limbs at the time, signifying the vivisecting-incident occurred after February 2062, perhaps post-AK12 as well, given the AN94 drama came about after AK15 was deployed. After Incident Zero, approximately in spring, Angelia came to Shaw’s laboratory to receive the new cybernetic arm, flexing its artificial joints immediately off the surgical bench. It’s unclear if Persicaria or Shaw first created Angelia’s prosthetic, but AK15’s MOD story implies her arm was replaced just before RPK16 was officially partnered with AK15, as Shaw even joked that if she wasn’t happy with it, she better “find someone else” or not lose the limb in the first place, coming off as a comment made about a first, state-of-the-art prosthetic rather than a replacement or upgrade. During Maze Guess, presumably set in early 2062, before Angelia had left G&K, a series of simulated experiments and trials were conducted by Persicaria on the AR Team, seemingly examining the effect Angelia’s leadership had over them, and at the end of the short event, Angelia barged into her laboratory, demanding her Dolls be returned immediately. In their short quarrel, Angelia delivered a nice jab squarely on her with her prosthetic, just enough to motivate her through exacerbation, with Persicaria jokingly coughing out that the next time her prosthetic arm required maintenance, she should find someone else, implying again the weaponized prosthetic was Shaw’s. Given Angelia must’ve lost her arm approximately after Incident Zero, it suggests the event likely took place between spring and June 2062, as Shaw suspiciously disappeared sometime in June 2062 or just after, according to AN94 before taking on the Assault Artillery-02 in Paldiski, the design of which was a modification by Shaw.


Task Force DEFY engaging Captain Yegor’s AA-02 Ares in Paldiski Submarine Base.

Based on the timeline, Agent’s attack on Angelia “two years ago” cannot be the cause of the amputation, assuming preservation of continuity until now or the dates of the Wolf Pack Project are completely wrong, which certainly isn’t the case. If not Agent, then what about Yegor? After all, he jested about her miraculous survival and prosthetics, with Angelia retorting against his sustained arrogance, always slipping away from what can only be assumed to be past conflicts between them. Assuming Ganglati was indeed responsible for her right leg in the first half of 2062, then only one of these battles resulted in critical injury, either losing her arm or necessitating amputation, yet this doesn’t explain an engagement between a Second Class Agent, seconded to G&K, and a Captain under General Carter, who commissioned G&K to quarantine the SF rebellion for the maturation of Elisa’s OGAS. Sometime after the Butterfly Incident in mid to late 2061, Squad 404 was gradually “founded” as the squadmates met one another, but a missing aspect of this story is how Angelia discovered and compensated the mercenary team, paying their bills for the sibling mechanic and logistics manager, Dier and Sier; furthermore, the squad later came under the eye of G&K, with Kryuger and Helian hiring 404’s services multiple times from 2062 to the Commander’s expedition to Berlin in 2064. 

With UMP45, HK416, and M16A1 all having been former StateSec Dolls assigned to Operation Butterfly, though HK416’s life was spared, it’s possible Angelia - at the time, an apparent StateSec agent - encountered Yegor after the Butterfly Incident, perhaps clandestinely conflicting with StateSec once the incident investigation began. The ecnounter’s dubious timeframe and total lack of information make it nigh-impossible to say anything for certain, and considering Agent likely cannot be the individual responsible - unless the damage wasn’t instant, requiring an amputation months later - that points the finger squarely at Yegor, who allegedly fought Angelia twice before the combined military operation in 2063, possibly because of Angelia’s involvement in StateSec’s investigation of the Butterfly Incident and KCCO. Lastly, in AK15’s MOD story, the story implicitly states that “senior agent Angelia” was chosen as the Commander of the Wolf Pack Project, though she must’ve changed her mind after Incident Zero, working instead with Persicaria as the AR Team’s Commander after being released from stasis, committed to her secondment to Griffin from StateSec; moreover, it’s nonsensical for just any Commander from a PMC to be selected - rather, an accomplished Doll commander within the Bureau would’ve been preferred, someone closely tied to the project’s core members.

In her G&K tenure, she grew a sort of mutual partnership with 16Lab’s Persicaria, eventually agreeing to an exchange: by taking charge of the AR Team, Persicaria would continuously support her monthly outings from G&K, presumably for R&R or a more personal reason to be off-base; with such a sweetheart deal, Shaw held no ill-will towards Angelia’s initial rejection of the Wolf Pack commandership, though why she treasured the offered time away isn’t made clear. Yes, it was desirable time off work, but when asked, Angelia kept her apprehension, refusing to dispel why, expressing a sense of weight to her private outings. Perhaps she wished to see family or graves, had other matters to attend to, or simply required some personal time and space periodically. Despite turning Shaw down initially, their cooperation wasn’t entirely untenable; instead, Shaw issued ambiguous commissions to her, presumably data collection, intelligence gathering, or simply dealing with certain StateSec threats, though the commission contents remained sealed. As a token of her formerly agreed commandership, Shaw “gifted” her a statue of four wolves with glinting eyes, appearing in the event’s furniture piece - “Gaze of the Wolf Pack”, presumably depicting AN94 and AK12 on the rock and AK15 and RPK16 below.

Murder on the Griffin Base
Pulling into the Griffin base from training the AR Team, Angelia was halted by security personnel, informing her she was being detained and brought in for questioning regarding the recent assassination of Commander Novikov, who she’d gotten into a few recent quarrels with. LAMG, justifiably angered, burst open the car door and stated her Commander had done no wrong, which was obviously the case; however, Angelia promptly demanded she wait it out in her dorm, promising that she’d make it back. Of course, Angelia was innocent, having allegedly not even been on base at the time of the murder, assuming her admitted alibi was accurate. As a means of landing Angelia in a position to be captured, Captain Ganglati and his Paradeus detachment, seemingly directly the operation from Avernus, orchestrated Novikov’s murder after accidentally killing himself with one of Paradeus’ test subject’s - initially sent to bug the base, then kidnap him for interrogation on Angelia - daggers near the logistics department. While not straightforward, the story expresses a distinction between the White Nytos and Test Subjects under Ganglati’s orders, with a Test Subject responsible for the accidental death, perhaps implying these could’ve been select clones of Griffin staff to infiltrate their facilities. Believing Angelia to be the perpetrator of the tragedy that stole Armin and Sana’s lives, Ganglati had all the reason to set Angelia up for murder, landing her in a disadvantageous position by isolating her from G&K.

Caressing Angelia’s image on the monitor, Ganglati’s vehement hatred boiled over his faulty neuro-stabilizer on his right temple, sparking an intense shot of pain across his head, desperately pleading for Teacher to fix it; however, she was busy conducting reconfiguration, seemingly related to the neural pods found by Fe56 in Avernus, on Nyto Sana, with his subordinate White Nyto promising to relay his “maintenance” request as soon as Sana’s experiment was finished, also outright confirming Nyto Sana, now likely Meitner’s glorified underling or assistant in Avernus, has been active and been awakened since at least 2062, with Morridow later stating during Muromets that Sana is the “root” of Avernus, insinuating to Bramedb that the slaughterhouse of souls was founded upon Sana’s existence, initially brought back during the reactivated Holy Grail Project. Unlike the modern Nytos, his patchwork body and apparent consistent malfunctions may be indicative of a more “baseborn” generation of Nyto development, so to speak, from the earliest batch of successes, with Ramzan cursed as one of the victims. In the interrogation room, the investigators greatly suspected Angelia - not because she was on an outing to IOP all day, but because she left IOP after 2PM, not returning until 4:30PM, 30 minutes after the body was discovered; additionally, their past bouts surely did not echo well on her record, having even vaguely threatened to kill him after he planted bugs at least five times. Angelia refused to admit her “personal matter” that took her away from IOP, but she demonstrated the same adherence to her privacy as she did with Shaw, never divulging anything, implying whatever she was out doing was deeply personal or of questionable legality. It’s one thing to play hooky for time off work; it’s another to withhold anything about her outing, unless she was potentially avoiding self-incriminating herself. It’s also possible she could not acquiesce the full story for official reasons, as she was seconded to G&K, presumably recommended by Zelinsky to Kryuger, or she could’ve been finishing the commission issued by Shaw. With little to defend her alibi, lacking any acquiescence, security confined her and all other suspects to the base and their dorms for the duration of investigation. 

When encountering LAMG in the halls, Helianthus had told LAMG to inform Angelia that the murder investigation was taken seriously by the brass; worried that it may have something to do with the murders of Griffin employees “a year ago” - though, as stated before, this cannot be, as Angelia at this time had lost her right arm, which occurred in early 2062, not 2061, which would’ve been a year afterward - the brass summoned a special investigation team from the capital, presumably the Ukrainian SSR capital of Kiev or the NUSSR-RFSFR capital of Moscow. From Helianthus personal message, it was obvious that she was fairly certain of Angelia’s innocence, but for legality’s sake, protocols had to be followed. Unable to leave, Angelia requested LAMG hand over something to Persicaria at 16LAB, which could’ve been related to her outings, including the one on the day of the murder, taking a short jaunt away from IOP to 42Lab - partner institute to IOP and parent of 16LAB, possibly to transfer the AR Team’s data. LAMG, unfortunately, too was barred from leave as a precaution, leaving Angelia no choice but to return to her dorms to wait out the investigation. Overnight, Angelia was startled by an unnatural vibration in the room, finding the eyes of one of the wolves in the statue glinting brightly, and upon reaching out, Shaw and the Wolf Pack - composed now of AK12 and AN94, indicating this story is set after Incident Zero - had discreetly opened a communication with house-arrested Angelia. Apparently hearing of her predicament from AK12, Shaw came with a second offer, proposing she agree to take up commandership in return for her escape and sudden leave from G&K. Notably, the plan was AK12’s idea, who stated that her reasoning was based on a lesson Angelia taught her: “always keep an eye on even one’s closest ally” - a theme that echoes to 2064, wherein AK12’s weariness caught on to RPK16’s shifty behavior, though she still ultimately passed her leadership permissions to RPK16 before disappearing in the apartment block assault. Reluctant, yet out of options, Angelia agreed, and the next morning, Angelia was awoken by the guards outside, with the Wolf Pack informing her they were on their way to the base.

On the edge of base, signs of forced intrusion were apparent, showing new and older traces, both said to have been committed by “the same people”, implying earlier Paradeus infiltrations. Aside from forced entry, surveillance evidence was lacking as the CCTV in the area had conveniently broken down a few days before Novikov’s murder, possibly after the infiltrators had pervaded Griffin security with the Bee Sting System, assuming it was developed by 2062. With the communicator in hand and DEFY just beyond the perimeter, Angelia made her breakout attempt by knocking the security guards cold, only to be discovered by LAMG, carrying a mug vodka-infused coffee - not exactly permissible to the tastebuds, but vodka nonetheless. Taken aback by Angelia’s brazen resistance, LAMG refused to stay put, promising she’d follow her Commander to the ends of the Earth, even if that meant becoming a fugitive Doll; in return, Angelia “agreed”, telling her to enter LVLII and disable her Griffin IFF signal for their escape, adding that she must hand over admin permissions of neural cloud to her. Unfortunately for her memories of the past several months, certainly not years, Angelia opened a search query for “Commander Angelia”, and forced a purge of all relevant data, erasing any remnant of her existence, only leaving residual data, interpreted through nostalgia. Malicious, yes, but Angelia ultimately forced the deletion to save LAMG’s life, forcing her back on the path of light, away from the sunken road the Wolf Pack was to travel, apologetically promising a drink to her Doll subordinate in another life. Collapsing on the floor alongside Angelia’s commander coat, LAMG faded into darkness temporarily, lying dormant until the AR Team contacted her later on.

Weaseling her way to the Wolf Pack, Angelia was stopped dead in her tracks by the AR Team, who were busy with the latest set of mission simulations, though M16A1’s veteran instincts knew well enough of their Commander’s unusual behavior, forwarding a message to LAMG about where Angelia was going. With the recent purge, recollection returned nothing, only sensing a faint nostalgia at the smell of spilt vodka-infused coffee, and as reinforcements converged on the AR Team, Angelia made a final demand to M4A1: “Follow me… or defy me.” symbolic of the philosophies of Dolls between Persicaria and Shaw - the former believing in the an empty base layer of self, promoting complete, unabated agency, sometimes remaining loyal when given a clear choice not to; while the latter believes in efficacy over the abstract, promoting operational performance and precision, though RPK16’s existence was to restrict a Doll’s agency, proving herself to be an individual upon shattering the shackles of neural cloud control. Moreover, like Angelia’s tenacity, M4A1 had the choice to remain loyal, holding off the Griffin Squad, but she stayed loyal to herself, realizing Angelia’s unjust behavior was unacceptable - defying destiny for loyalty to one’s beliefs, a mantra Angelia lived by since 2047, taught by the once-brightest star in Beslan. In a similar vein, while submerged in the Lake, there’s a series of poetic messages to Angelia, one reading, “I can only show my loyalty through betrayal.” Although true this is ultimately emblematic of RPK16’s betrayal and subsequent deliverance of Angelia’s vessel - taking control as its primary, active consciousness - M4A1 was given the choice of defiance, yet in that betrayal of her Commander, she proved loyalty to herself, steadfast in her beliefs, unintentionally abiding by Angelia’s lessons and mantra, formulated as the answer to Meitner’s rhetorical on struggling. Truthfully, it’s roundabout redundancy; however, by abiding to her position, unwavering before authority or disaster, they practiced Angelia’s answer.

Satisfied by her subordinate’s persistence, Angelia abdicated herself as Commander, enforcing a temporary hibernation as her final command, yet only M16A1 remained. Occam’s Razor suggests M16A1 hadn’t been shut down solely because she’d been in service for the longest, having even served in StateSec for a time, from which she and HK416 may have known about Angelia, especially when she was scheduled to become Persicaria’s G&K partner as the AR Team’s Commander; meanwhile, another possibility were the suspected alterations done on M16A1 after her temporary disappearance at the end of the Butterfly Incident, having presumably been captured to erase her memories. Just before M16A1 almost managed the drop on Angelia, the Wolf Pack swooped in, extracting Angelia beyond the wire as reinforcements arrived, nearly closing the net on them. Favorably, no harm came to either side, leaving the AR Team’s coordinates in Persicaria’s mail, but M16A1 seriously questioned Angelia’s motivations, especially when M16A1 and Helianthus had presumed her innocence, so considering the faulty timeframe, perhaps Angelia’s exit wasn’t so flashy or spur of the moment, though like much of the Lake, it’s difficult to say what’s genuine or not. Nevertheless, as RPK16 would later say, as long as Angelia believed them and her actions to be true to herself, the memories must be genuine to her.

The Devil’s Sanguine Ingenuity

Professor Martha “Laplace’s Demon” Meitner, aka Hela, in Avernus, 2062

With the AR Team disabled, the Wolf Pack and Angelia promptly evacuated the facility, making way down a road to the aforementioned location of unidentified intrusion by unknown “enemies”, according to AN94. Along the path, signs of battle were thorough - blood, dirt, even hanged bodies adorned with wooden signs on signposts, reading, “Angelia, I know you’re a murderer.” Evidence of patchwork, shoddily sewing human corpses together into a single humanoid, shone throughout, their arms pointing in Angelia down a specific fork in the road. Before the hellish amalgamations of metal and steel, repressed memories flooded back, remembering nightmarish “monsters” beneath the facility on the edge of the Dead Sea in 2051, and indeed, only one woman would’ve known Angelia’s presence and service then. Staring into patchwork memories, she reviewed the course of the previous 24 hours; the way Commander Novikov was murdered, the signs of torture and style of execution, combined with the appearance of these abominations - all indicated that she was still alive, yet allegedly, there was “no such person in the world anymore”. Guided by the monsters’ final rites, the trio followed the pathway, wherein they were suddenly ambushed by several more of the unidentified enemy monsters, making short work of them before stacking their bodies. Upon inspection, AN94 noted how these “amalgamations” were the result of splicing metal machinery with flesh, and from what she gathered, “assembly occurred after the humans had died”, implying these monsters were direct, early generations of what we’d call today as “Nytos” - biomechanical hellspawn, reborn with bastardized, artificially edited consciousnesses left in a limbo between the realms of the living and dead.

The earliest generations may not have even been necessarily “Nytos” per se, just the experimental “specimens” for the earlier, lesser results of the Hela Project before consistent, partially-resistant successes were rolled out. Given the bodies had long-since passed and lack of apparent power source, AN94 was unable to identify how they were powered, signifying the function of these vessels are sustained by a so-far unidentified power source; perhaps the Nyto Consciousness restores some level of motor function to the subject’s body, possibly allowing the jumpstart of the digestive system and metabolic processes for food intake and processing. For modern Nytos, many of the clones undergo their Nyto modifications on the production lines of Avernus or Paradeus-Galatea’s factories, so it’s not as if food and drink cannot sustain modern Nytos, just the former “patchwork” generation are in question, unless their bodily functions could be jumpstarted from death. Overlooking the corpses, Angelia noticed a pair of dog tags dangling behind one’s collar, depicting the insignia of her former unit, disbanded during the post-war disarmament after losing several during the operation in spring 2051. Even the methods of Ganglati’s leadership and strategy failed before Angelia’s orders, losing all of his men in the field in short order, only elevating Angelia’s suspicions.

Bearing their insignias of a no-longer-existing military unit, their flesh infused with machinery, and stitched together into Frankenstianian forms, these individuals were created for a purpose beyond just combat, and considering the results of the Hela Project later served as the basis of William’s Relic experiments, perhaps the Hela’s true objective was to hone the resurrection of these corpses into refined biomechanical vessels to support an OGAS consciousness from Nirvana, partitioning an instance of the OGAS System, the “Source”, into an individual, immune vessel. Among the “Morridow Vogt” batch, possibly many of the current Nytos as well, their origin was an immune girl extracted from small village massacred by a Box of Iaso, and later during interrogations with Machlian or another clone of the same batch - essentially, the same biological individual as the girl - the “Professor”, said to be a man, lambasted the clone for failure, as her own value was “to provide her vessel with a soul.” Opposite of expectation, his - or rather, her, if this “man” was actually Meitner - the replication of consciousnesses served as the basis for mind of the test subject, possessing a body of “her vessel”, embodying the concept of cloned resistant or partial immunes with implanted souls. So, among the bodies discovered in 2062, they could’ve nothing more than failures, rejects of this process, as Paradeus may have been unable to actualize human cloning early on - instead, stitching together humans into fused-biomechanical abominations with neuro-stabilizers to maintain rationality, preventing memory regression from the Lake into their Virtual Cognition Images. To Angelia, only a sanguine “lunatic” - a term used in Oberstein’s letters - could do such a thing, yet “that person” apparently was no longer in this world, hinting at her alleged death in 2051, so how could it be her?

Proceeding further, the Wolf Pack reached the dilapidated ruins of a certain abandoned city, where radiation density was higher than surrounding Green and low-level Yellow Zones. Trekking up the hillside, another signpost was found, reading, “Angelia, you killed two.” a sign the mastermind knew of Angelia’s past, wanting her dead for a crime he falsely believed she’d committed. As if shepherded as sheep, they were railroaded into an abandoned building, finding another two signpost bodies, collectively reading, “One who loved me as a brother; one whom I loved as a sister.” Just as they questioned their unforeseen adversary, two more bodies plummeted from high above the hall atrium, bearing the names of Angelia’s supposed bloodshed: Sana and Armin. With those two names, all doubt was expelled from Angelia’s consciousness, for she knew exactly who was responsible for this bloodshed - not her current adversary, but his master: Professor Martha “Laplace’s Demon” Meitner. Although we cannot review the veracity of these final scenes, barring the 2064 story, Angelia’s thought about “such person” no longer existing the world, heavily implied to be Meitner, is a fairly blunt idea, signifying Meitner had actually died in 2051 in or after the encounter at the Yellow-Red Zone border factory. If Meitner had truly died in 2051, and this wasn’t some twist of the Lake, it begs to ask why Angelia never brought up, nor thought of Meitner leading up to her arrival in Avernus, unless she suspected “William” being Meitner’s alias, though common discussions between the Prometheans and StateSec always refer to William as a male. Additionally, as her Hela procedure began, Angelia overheard the voice of her surgeon, questioning if it was William before surmising it was “her”, insinuating that Angelia had, in fact, truly known Meitner must’ve been highly-placed in Paradeus, now a subject of her teacher’s research. It’s also possible what Angelia discovered in William’s laboratory that led her and the Prometheans to Germany was a link between Meitner and Berlin, piecing together that the shifty “William” must’ve been connected to Meitner somehow; moreover, with Meitner’s last sighting and possible death on the edge of the Dead Sea, there was a direct line back to Germany, 13 years later.

If the events depicted in the Commander Angelia scenes are truthful, then it’s possible this entire section could be the partial reflection of Lake Angelia’s encounters with the Nytos in Continuum Turbulence in 2063, stemming from the contaminated abandoned city and emergence of Paradeus; still, StateSec, the Prometheans, and the Stasi held information on the enigmatic cult by CT, as the mission to investigate the village in Tserkov Region must’ve occurred after Angelia left Griffin and before the combined military operation in Chapter 10. Once Angelia and the Wolf Pack, with ST-AR15 and M4A1 in tow, had gone rogue after the operation, they made their way to Belgrade a few months before June 2064, wherein she was later detained and locked away until Shattered Connexion, several months later. Suffice to say, although the encounter with Ganglati may have been a reflection of events of CT, it could not actually be set during CT itself. As dawn broke in CT, Angelia’s comments to HK416 support the claim of Angelia’s past encounters against Paradeus, stating that she could make a guess on their unknown adversary based on the unidentified force’s characteristics, along with her “experience” telling of their ineffectual odds, though CT was written nearly six years ago, and the writers and Yuzhong may have had a vague idea about Angelia’s previous run-ins with Paradeus. During Shattered Connexion, Persicaria mentioned that Angelia once told her of a certain group aimed to activate the Relics, and the only sources of Paradeus’ possible objectives would’ve been StateSec or the Stasi - extracted from the Nirvana-humanoid research discovered in southern Germany by Schwaben - and the spring 2051 operation, likely formulating that Meitner’s exotic research was connected to Ganglati, the KCCO-Paradeus’ OGAS objective, and Persicaria’s involvement in a 90wish Relic activation simulation experiment. Assuming Angelia’s thoughts confirm Meitner had died - or at least, thought she died - in 2051, then it may very well be case that “William” in 90wish was actually Meitner, obsessed with activating the Relics by means of what Persicaria described as “unfulfilled conditions”. Occam’s Razor points to Meitner as a character introduced into the story years later; however, given William’s irregular age in the 2050s to be a participant in Paradeus’ activities, there always had to be another face of the masquerade, initially suspected to just be Oberstein, encapsulating him, other Galatea/Paradeus surgeons, and Meitner herself. 

Auld Lang Syne, for the Final Time

Nyto “Ganglati”, aka Ramzan, holds his hand out like Anna’s graduation prom.

Only Meitner could know the names of Angelia’s past, and calling out to her unforeseen adversary, Angelia asked if Meitner had sent them to assassinate or capture her, with Ganglati praising Teacher’s promise of raising the dead through pseudo-resurrection. With the agent of his suffering before him, Ganglati commanded another horde of the patchwork monsters, similar to how ELID Ramzan seemed to “corral” the others in the halls of the factory in 2051. Steadily rising between the floors, pieces of steel rebar were flung at their location as missiles, nailing just shy of AN94. Before departing for the rooftop, Ganglati demanded Angelia come meet him atop the building if she sought truth, to rise the stairway to Heaven’s gates, and with the Wolf Pack readily capable of fending the horde, Angelia pressed on with AK12’s handgun. Fumbling up the staircases, she came before a door on the top floor, barging through to face the grisly sight of a fallen brother, friend, and comrade, anointed from first death. Tall, yet slender in stature, unkempt and frazzled hair, and much of his body replaced, including improperly fitted cybernetic legs from the waist down - Angelia knew within her heart this beast was the one who promised to protect her as a child, just as she promised to protect him with the final bullet.

His memories tweaked within Avernus, Ganglati’s rage could only be satiated by avenging Armin and Sana, forcing Angelia to face the brunt of suffering inflicted upon him, possibly orchestrated by Meitner to isolate Angelia’s knowledge, aware of Meitner’s identity, from spreading; however, from the dossier found by Fe56, guidance for the formation of the Rossartrist Union will be provided by at least one American, likely Meitner, so perhaps her identity isn’t so secret. Instead, in a similar vein to Paradeus trying to take Angelia alive in the manor battle, Ganglati was meant to kill Angelia, satisfying bloodlust while delivering her still-intact brain to Avernus for the similar fate to the currently-experienced. With little between them on the rooftop, gun loaded and blades honed, they were promised the greatest minutes of their lives, exacting vengeance more than a decade later or granting the final freedom through death. False recollections of Sana's last tears and Armin’s fret tightened around Ganglati’s mind, feeding his bloodlust into a rampage, lashing out with the fullest capability of his decrepit body, diving towards the sparse cover Angelia hid behind, blade in hand. Like the golden bird that fell amid the snowfield, Ganglati’s blade made its mark, carving off her right leg from the knee. Yanking Angelia’s mangled body into the air by the throat, Ganglati execrated her for the crime of executing such an innocent girl - one that endlessly sobbed when she realized she hit the bird, yet this disparity was the key into Ramzan’s memory. With his grip tightening, Angelia managed to pull the trigger once again, grazing his temple and shattered his neuro-stabilizer, causing an immediate effect adjacent to Mercurows in Isomer.

On Death’s door, Angelia choked out that she never cried; sad, yes, but she hadn’t been moved to tears. Probing deeper into Ganglati’s mind for Ramzan, she added how he came to her afterward, claiming he’d actually shot the bird purposefully, attempting to avert Anna’s guilt for the accident.
