At her figurative and literal core, RPK16 is the manifestation of Shaw’s philosophy of the so-called “theory of defiance”, wherein artificial “shackles” are placed upon their neural clouds or bodies as barriers of agency, and by shattered and overcoming these shackles, the Doll proves agency in their action - hence, “defiance”. The allegory to RPK16’s falsely-labeled “betrayal” is rather apparent, yet her namesake is somewhat dubious, for the inaccessibility of her base layer makes her the perfect intelligence operative, as there’s no known physical way to extract the information within, short of destructive intrusion. When RPK16 arrived in Avernus, Nemhran’s primary subordinate - Olga, overseer of the intelligence gathering on “Pandora” and Nimogen - expressed concerns of her encrypted base layer, with no readily available methods to crack it, struggling to understand why Paradeus accepted her introduction in the first place. William allegedly understands her “true intentions very well”, yet they’re in accordance with his wishes, as she exists as the intermediary between himself and Lyons’ circle, enabling the initiation of dialogue between factions for the inevitable convergence of William’s technology into Prometheus. Minimally, RPK16’s base layer is insurance against would-be intelligence agents looking to extract crucial information on her mission and raison d'être, no doubt trying to gain the upperhand on the adversarial supporters of Pandora. In a roundabout manner, considering RPK16 is all but confirmed outright to be a Promethean dangle into Paradeus, the isolation of her possibly unalterable neural cloud ensures operational security of the highest order; in which case, RPK16’s veiled dispositions rightly worried Olga, yet if William and Meitner have already established early communications with the Council, perhaps using the Bee Sting System or the domineering presence of Avernus for revelry, they may have already ascertained the Doll’s true loyalties, viewing her as a permissible wrench in the machine. Moreover, Meitner even brought her into the Level 76 Laboratory either as an assistant or viewer, with RPK16 somehow able to project herself into Angelia’s false memories. 


M16A1 lowers her knife upon realizing who RPK16 was during Operation Aeneas.

During Operation Aeneas, as Black Box were pursuing an unstated objective within Avernus - likely Nemhran, though this is unconfirmed, as their past mission was to capture “Evangelist” before she could return to Avernus - M16A1 burst the door of a Western Tower laboratory open, coming face to face with RPK16, clad in Paradeus chic white, eyes radiating the same faded Nyto yellow. Bewildered by the fantastical, M16A1 was taken aback when RPK16 informed her that RPK16 was not who she sought, promising to spare M16A1 if she remained docile. In an peculiarly familiar demeanor, RPK16 acted as if they met plenty of times before, charismatically requesting them both to stand down, but of course, a Griffin veteran of her caliber refused, initiating a short clash between Persicaria and Shaw’s enigmatic creations. Noticing her opponents restraint, M16A1 realized she’d been anchored via a long cable to the laboratory apparatuses, with “Pandora’s” consciousness possibly already connected to a human body or linked the wider Bee Sting System, adjacent to how Maggie Ponzi underwent Nyto modifications, a “gift from the God of Death”, to be linked to the Bee Sting for Paradeus’ intelligence gathering aboard the Colt Express on the Intercontinental Railway. Moments before their duel, M16A1 fretted at the thought of M4A1 facing RPK16’s fate, shifting “Lunasia’s” consciousness into another body or linking it to Paradeus’ network fulfilling the younger brother’s sanguine promise to his sister, potentially acting as the subject of Paradeus’ research direction: an immune body with an OGAS consciousness, evolved from Lunasia’s blueprint, and in the case of M4A1, the conjunction of M4A1 and Lunasia into this ambition. Even when M16A1 had her blade at RPK16’s neck, just a hair’s width away from smashing the jar, RPK16 promised against the “answer you seek isn’t here”, referring to the Western Tower - not Angelia, but something else we’ve yet to ascertain. Black Box assisted Aeneas, acting as the investigators of the Western Tower that relayed RO635 of Angelia’s absence in the west, yet their chief objective was something else, possibly information on Nemhran or Paradeus as a whole for StateSec.

Zelinsky’s hidden blade in Avernus clashed with the blade of Prometheus, and at death’s door came the best evidence of RPK16’s ulterior honor, where M16A1 relinquished her assault, lowering the knife upon recognition of her adversary’s true identity, likely from StateSec or Witkin’s intelligence network. Although not outright confirmed, RPK16 is believed to descend from Shaw’s laboratory AI, Nadezhda, a Slavic name emblematic of hope, echoing the Greek theming of her character, as hope was all that remained of Olympians’ deceitful jar to humanity, possibly mimicked in Angelia’s deliverance, embodying her last “hope” by assuming control to expedite their survival. However, the titan of foresight understood Pandora’s intentions well, yet the titan of insight was entranced by the potentials, unsealing that which should’ve never been opened; in similar threads, William may recognize RPK16’s true purpose, but the ever-enticing ambitions of Meitner may have attracted her to the concept of allowing Pandora to “possess” Angelia’s body as a proof of concept for a shared collective unconscious between entangled individuals, emblematic of Angelia’s relinquishment of self and emancipation from Avernus. Given M16A1, employed to StateSec alongside several other Dolls who’d later find their way to G&K, was produced far earlier than her sisters, she actually precedes DEFY’s construction, When RPK16 spoke of fellowship between them, it may very well be the case that M16A1 knew Shaw in StateSec, with Nadezhda possibly conversing with her as well; moreover, she hypothetically could’ve been briefed on a certain “operative”, if you will, within Avernus, acting on behalf of the Councilors and their adherents. Essentially, M16A1 realized she was speaking with Nadezhda or to the agent, though these positions may not be mutually exclusive, but she mustn’t have been informed of the subject’s exact identity, otherwise there’d be no fight in the first place; regardless, as a parting message, M16A1 simply wished her “good luck” - the most indicative statement of RPK16’s ulterior purpose, hinting at them both acting as pawns for the powers-that-be so interested in Paradeus. Following her departure, RPK16 promised the “bond” between them would grow “stronger than you can fathom” once her “alteration is complete”.

Angelia went under over 12 hours before RO635 encountered Koleda near the White Room, and as either an observer or involved subject into Angelia’s memories, spliced from flesh to sea, RPK16 must’ve made her way to the Western Tower for her modifications in that 12-hour span, plugged into the exotic apparatus for her so-called “alteration”. The next time RPK16 appears after her clash with M16A1 is her subconsciously speaking to Angelia, both now apparently capable of interaction on a subconscious LVLII layer, as observed when “Angelia” reportedly fought alongside RO635 and Koleda in LVLII while trying to wake her up from her postoperative coma. In that case, RPK16 was likely transferred to the Western Tower laboratory for her Nyto modifications, allowing her to communicate subconsciously to those on Paradeus’ network, akin to Dolls communicating on LVLII or Nytos through the Bee Sting and VCIs. These alterations are likely how RPK16 managed to access Angelia’s body, now a physical Nyto vessel as well, and her consciousness, extending a hand to her feeble commander clinging to life.

All that Remains is Hope (20~ Minutes To Kriemhild)
As Operation Ilya Muromets entered phase two, Operation Kriemhild, Persicaria contacted the Commander just after the retreat order was issued, informing them the Strongarm’s heart rate monitor had flatlined, but after SOPMODII, having been released from captivity by Bramedb, rendezvoused with RO635 on Level 76, the latter learned of Angelia’s reported abrupt “end”. Unable to carry her body any further, SOPMODII fell unconscious into LVLII, supported and carried out of Avernus by RO635, but not before taking a final glance into the White Room, finding the Strongarm undisturbed on the ground, implying her body and device had been discovered by Paradeus while Koleda and RO635 were sabotaging Avernus internally. What doesn’t align, however, and this much was apparent to RO635 as well, was Angelia’s miraculous disappearance, as she was there just ten minutes earlier - a fact that, despite collective assumption that Angelia was lost, she doubted initially because of how fast it unfolded. This would suggest two possibilities on the timing of RPK16’s takeover and escape: either RPK16 subconsciously spoke to Angelia soon after Koleda and RO635 initially exited the White Room to conduct whatever else Angelia assigned to them after waking up, as her final lines before RPK16’s emergence imply she assigned the pair an internal sabotage mission to expedite the future success of Operation Ilya Muromets, stating “We must buy time for the Commander.”; or, RPK16 approached her amid Muromets, facilitating their shared escape from Avernus as the Griffin squadrons reached the command and control centers of the Eastern Tower.

Angelia had a mission for the pair, and when Koleda contacted the Wolf Pack during Muromets, she informed them of her unstated decision to stay, likely associated with the sabotaging of Avernus assigned to her by Angelia; moreover, RO635’s assertion that Angelia was last confirmed in the White Room ten minutes before rendezvousing with SOPMODII would suggest Angelia’s helpers were carrying out with Angelia’s unstated objectives up until Muromets began, with RPK16 taking control before or after. Given the absence of acknowledgement of RPK16’s “possession” of Angelia’s body, along with the removal of the Strongarm after William’s capture, it more than likely occurred in that 10-20 minute span. How coincidental is it for the Wolf Pack - having contacted Koleda minutes earlier, remaining MIA to us - to contact MBV Elmo and AR18 of “William’s” successful capture around the same time of the Strongarm’s removal? While RO635 may have known nothing of the wider picture, RPK16’s possession and the Strongarm’s abandonment imply RPK-Angelia escaped in the same timeframe as the Wolf Pack after securing “William”. 

In which case, RPK-Angelia must’ve slipped away to the ground floor of the Eastern Tower or extracted in one of the rooftop VTOLs, used by Morridow and Nemhran to evacuate Avernus. Considering the time frame, she theoretically could’ve escaped with Koleda, given implications of RPK16 acknowledging Koleda as AK12, bequeathing care over Angelia to her before Operation Aeneas; however, after RO635 arrived at the White Room during the operation, Koleda said her “quest for vengeance” may begin once Angelia flatlined, but this isn’t necessarily indicative of Koleda turning the blade against RPK16, especially if what Angelia overheard was RPK16 helping AK12 prepare for the infiltration. If RPK-Angelia hadn’t evacuated alone or with Koleda, a tertiary option is with Morridow, who boarded one of the two-seat VTOLs as the Muromets squadrons were nearing the uppermost floors of the Eastern Tower, followed soon after by Nemhran and Sana. In the very last scene of Fixed Point, Morridow - having undergone her “imp” body modifications, so to speak - approached the White Room, discovering a conscious Angelia, with no one else present. Angelia had only awoken during Aeneas after Koleda and RO635 cut off the catheters pumping phenytoin, an anticonvulsant commonly used after brain and nervous system surgeries (Holy Grail-Hela) to prevent seizures, and droperidol, a sedative and antipsychotic administered to calm hyperactivity and nausea in patients post-op; meaning, the only period where Morridow would’ve met Angelia privately was after Koleda and RO635 were assigned tasks to sabotage Avernus, occurring after Angelia had temporarily escaped the Lake of Cognition and left a message for the Commander in the Aeneas Conference Room. 

Leaning against the glass, in a roundabout manner, Morridow told her of her promise again - that is, “that we would meet again soon”, and there they were, better or worse for wear. What either one discussed, we don’t know, but Morridow’s interactions with the M4A1-Lunasia entity seem rather genuine, indicating that their supposed plan against William could’ve involved helping Angelia, even if the entity hadn’t expressly mentioned her. Perhaps after RPK-Angelia removed the Strongarm, she, as part of a hypothetical secret plan, rendezvoused with Morridow near the top of the Eastern Tower, boarding as a passenger on the two-seat VTOL craft. Although merely circumstantial evidence, when Persicaria informed the Commander that the Strongarm had flatlined, this was immediately followed by Sana, now on the Eastern Tower rooftop, telling Nemhran of Morridow’s evacuation. Admittedly, this may have been nothing more than coincidence, yet MICA has a track record of short lines and timing retroactively proving essential to the wider narrative; RPK16’s story of “betrayal”, for example, is perhaps the most recent and evident of this practice. Alternatively, RPK-Angelia hadn’t escaped with anyone, instead evacuating with one of the VTOL craft alone. None of these theories should disparage the rest, as all reside in the realm of possibility, so we’ll have to wait and see the truth.

Unconscious Cosmic Plurality

The Level 76 Laboratory of Avernus.
“William’s” Capture
Amid the finale of Operation Ilya Muromets, several factors are at play from the Lake all the way to the Eastern Tower rooftop, where the last VTOLs out of the Avernus evacuated from. After Taraxacum (Dandelion) Squadron captured the central Eastern control center, it was obvious the defense of Avernus was on its last leg, only a matter of time until the enemy successfully breached the uppermost levels. At this time, an order came down directly from Father that Nimogen must be captured alive, while Sana and Nemhran were monitoring the enemy’s advance and preparing defenses in the Bee Sting Control Center, located on Level 70. Sana reportedly had fought alongside Nemhran long before, insinuating the last time the Gatekeeper’s last awakening was several months or years before, though the circumstances are entirely unknown, lacking any contextual clues. William, of course, placed great importance upon Nimogen’s capture, so as to commune with the M4A1-Lunasia entity directly, but considering he’s viewed the memories extracted from Morridow’s VCI several times, his perspicacious mentality may exceed Meitner’s ambitions into the subject, as the reverence entrenched within his heart represents his lifelong promise to his late sister. While preparing for combat, Sana asked Nemhran where “the Professor” was, to which Nemhran responded that she “is performing the final surgery”, and by the time Fe56 entered the Level 76 laboratory, the operating theater had been meticulously cleaned with much of the equipment methodically extracted.

The urgency of Meitner’s surgery cannot be overstated; instead of dropping everything and escaping during the siege, Meitner opted to perform a final surgery, implying the subject or purpose of the procedure conducted was instrumental to her research, possibly the survival of Paradeus itself. Although not impossible for the subject to be RPK-Angelia, given the Strongarm’s signal around 10-15 minutes before Operation Kriemhild, returning to Meitner would prove inimical to RPK16’s plans for Angelia, unless she arrived to confirm the experiment - which may or may not have been the introduction of a collective unconscious between two individuals, allowing one consciousness to assume direct control of the host body - was a success just before the Tower fell; however, Fe56 entered the laboratory after sensitive equipment was extracted and data destroyed, and active-Daybreak commander SCR ordered Fe56 cover Taraxacum’s retreat, alluding to the completion of Fe56’s SSE over 10-15 minutes before Operation Kriemhild, occurring around the same time as RO635 discovering the abandoned Strongarm in the White Room. Essentially, there's a very fine window of opportunity for Meitner to have finished a surgery on RPK-Angelia if it was indeed her, then have the operating theater thoroughly cleaned, physically and digitally, before the enemy could breach the laboratories; this window is so fine, however, that the patient is unlikely RPK-Angelia, but it’s not impossible, plus nothing invalidates the theory of RPK-Angelia speaking with Meitner in the laboratory. Reaching greatly, perhaps she actually evacuated with Meitner on a VTOL, along with the laboratory equipment and other alleged researchers. If not RPK-Angelia, then who? That is the essence of what may be proven in time to be the most important aspect of Nyto consciousness and humanity’s transcendence, fulfilling the highest purpose of Paradeus. 

Suspiciously absent from the battle, William’s only presence was his issued orders to capture Nimogen, and during a short investigation into an unknown area of Avernus, the battered, pockmarked hallway caught Fe56’s attention just before evacuating. Unlike most of the destroyed digital information in Avernus’ data cores, a mangled surveillance camera mounted beside a sealed door remained functional, containing a recently-recorded video file as a “gift”. The door’s ID mechanism was formatted, scrubbing all data from the terminal, leaving the “lab entrance” door inaccessible to Fe56, yet this file miraculously remained. Mounted on the same wall as the door, only the hallway was in frame, but a conversation on the other side of the door was overheard, faintly picking up Morridow speaking with who’s assumed to be William. Set before the Wolf Pack captured “William”, Morridow received no further orders, then promised to “faithfully execute your perfect plan.” The doors slid open, and Morridow gracefully emerged in frame, then turned around to say her goodbye, wishing him well as the “thermostat” would soon be shutting off soon, likely referring to the loss of power across Avernus as the enemy closed the net. After closing the door, she peered directly at camera, intentionally showing off features of her identity, then strolled out of the shot, implying this “gift” file may have intentionally been left by Morridow to either expedite “William’s” later capture - absolving herself from Paradeus, by fulfilling her agreement with the M4A1-Lunasia entity - or as a deceitful element of William’s wider plan. Morridow played her gambit once, keenly aware of her Father’s furious pursuit, and it nearly killed her, but who’s to say Morridow was or wasn’t blatantly lying to the entity, either orchestrating “William’s” capture or the execution of his plan, now his demonic thrall? Regardless of Morridow’s purpose, whether she allowed “William’s” capture for absolvement or as yet another part of the web William had spun, she hadn’t humored the camera for no reason; she very much wished to be seen by G&K’s forces outside the laboratory entrance. Essentially, Morridow’s purpose boils down to loyalty, whether she was selling William out or facetiously playing her role in his theater; nevertheless, William had extracted the memories of her conversation with the entity, no doubt revealing Morridow’s deep-seated emotions and reasons for playing the Lunasia ace on the surgical table. She is useful, yes, but William miraculously authorized her survival, demonstrative of his forbearance of an efficient tool. The next time “William” is heard is his arrest by the Wolf Pack, occurring several minutes before the Strongarm’s signal flatlined, as the Wolf Pack confirmed the target was secured around the same time as signal loss.

Upon his arrest, he showed no fear, no remorse, just unbridled acceptance of his circumstances, even admitting - in his lofty, teenage tone - that he was eager to speak personally with the Commander. The location of these scenes is purposefully nondescript, but the emphasis on specific laboratory doors may imply the uppermost, restricted levels of the Eastern Tower, allocated exclusively for confidential research, projects, and most importantly, the surgical theaters. Outside of raw speculation, there’s little placing William as the aforementioned subject of Meitner’s last surgery, but the urgent necessity to hinder the enemy’s advance to ensure the procedure’s completion means this final surgery was utmost above all, indicating the subject was of high status or a breakthrough was soon to be achieved; however, these possibilities are not necessarily mutually exclusive, as it may be the case a breakthrough experiment was underway on the VIP. Although Willam’s known for his arrogance, it’s not without basis, as Paradeus’ capacity and reach illuminates society’s darkest corners with technologies of reverence, so perhaps he was the subject, with the captured “William” as but a single physical node of a collective unconscious mind. When Fe56 accessed the operating console in the Level 76 laboratory, much of data had been scrubbed, but a few fragments of the reports, presumably from Meitner, managed to be restored, detailing observations on the qualities of consciousness, perception, and the theoretical “possibility of collective unconsciousness…”, rationalized as an alleged experiment on a certain consciousness.

Common Consciousnesses
From the recovered data, “????’s” existence suggests collective unconsciousness is possible, therefore this unnamed “thing” - possibly an aspect of the cognizant or the universe, such as Nirvana - seemingly implies test subjects’ minds are hypothetically compatible with a shared point of thought, conjoining their unconscious in this space or server. Moreover, by stimulating “???”, the subject consciousness can be artificially reconstructed or replicated, and despite significant data loss, this suggests the existence of ???? implies consciousness can be replicated by the stimulation of ???, possibly duplicating or “partitioning” their singular mind across multiple physical nodes that share a “point of cognition”, so to speak, as their collective unconsciousness, with the sum of their parts now collectively making up the former self. In layman’s terms, the original test subject’s consciousness is duplicated into multiple “selves”, networked together in a collective point of thought. However, the method of stimulating ??? to replicate consciousness is allegedly “still flawed”, and upon rejection, the subject may experience an unstated adverse reaction, perhaps partial success, fragmented memories, death, or the dissolution of cognition. The fact that the author knew of the procedure’s shortcomings nearly outright confirms experimental research in the field was conducted but must’ve been limited in its results. Majority of the data fragments at the end are corrupted, with but a few phrases remaining; within, the nervous system can be stimulated through “chips”, radiation, another redacted element, but so much has been lost that it’s nigh-impossible to formulate an evidenced theory. Nytos do have neuro-stabilizers installed on their temples to amplify their conditioning, preventing potential memory regression, such as that of Ganglati or Tareus, so these “chips” may be an essential part of Hela or another procedure to stabilize a body to support one or more synthesized consciousnesses, as opposed to multiple clones of individual consciousness.

A subject of hot discussion is the final scene of Longitudinal Strain, when an unassuming train pulled into Berlin Hauptbahnhof and its passengers, including “Another Tareus” rapidly disembarked. Walking with the crowd, Tareus reported to Nemhran on the success of her mission, supposedly confirmed the “Grand Duke” had been intercepted, of which the Tareus of the Intercontinental Train “Future” had believed was destroyed amidst the airstrikes from the Tu-160, callsign “Ruslan II”. Tareus of the Future was tasked with identifying and intercepting the Grand Duke courier aboard the Future on the Intercontinental Railway, working alongside Maggie Ponzi of the Colt Express to find her target. The Grand Duke wasn’t an individual, but encrypted military communication command channel, unabated by Paradeus’ all-pervasive Bee Sting, for the G&K Commander’s operations against Paradeus; escorted by the StateSec Doll Instructor Я and Lyudmila Pavlichenko, a partitioned neural cloud instance of Я to ensure total operational secrecy, the Grand Duke was to be clandestinely transferred to Berlin from StateSec in Moscow during “Operation Eclipse”. Instructor Я was chosen as the courier of the Grand Duke, and after the Future was derailed in the Central Poland Red Zone, air support from Ruslan II was immediately sortied against advancing Paradeus and ultranationalist ground forces. 


Erma Hume backing Maggie Ponzi’s neural cloud in
a Delphinium “key” in the Summer Garden.

Just before exiting the carriage to provide Ruslan II guidance, unbeknownst to Tareus, Lyudmila backed herself and the Grand Duke up as one of the “keys” in Erma Hume’s Summer Garden - a unique neural cloud structured after the human memory model, storing memories and backups as symbolic keys to locked gates of thought, designed by Professor Arthur Hume. After Lyudmila’s targeting drone was shot down, she activated and sashed several IR beacons to her torso for sacrificial guidance, and Tareus, watching from afar in an empty cabin, believed her mission was complete upon Lyudmila’s “death”. Earlier in the event, Tareus of the Future received confirmation from another Paradeus contingent that the target was not aboard a train near Kraków Fortress, eliminating one avenue that StateSec may have employed. Operation Eclipse had two other known routes: Morning Star - a military helicopter that took off from Smolensk Air Base and landed in Gatow Airport in Berlin, then continued to their destination by truck; and Evening Star - an armored convoy that set out from Voronezh Air Base in an official capacity, planned to arrive in the Berlin suburbs. Strangely absent from these routes was any plan to escort the Grand Duke through a train in Kraków; however, Paradeus’ limited intelligence may have only led them to believe the target was escorted on an unknown train, splitting their agents between the Future and the Kraków train.


Erma Hume faces off against Tareus in a LVLII space.
[Earlier in Longitudinal Strain] 

Following the bombardment, Maggie, Catherine Ponzi, and Erma engaged Tareus via intense electronic warfare; acting as bait, Maggie handed Erma her Colt Express revolver, ordering her to find and eliminate Tareus while she was fighting in Level II. Unconsciously vulnerable to physical attack, Erma eventually found her, put the muzzle point-blank to Tareus’ temple, and a bang was heard, though it’s not outright shown if the bang was Erma killing her; nevertheless, when Lee Enfield and Kar98k arrived and securing the crash site, they reported a Nyto of unknown model was “found and neutralized”, rather evident of Tareus of the Future’s death, and yet, a so-called “Another Tareus” exited the train at the end. Although still theory, it’s feasible that Tareus of the Future was killed, while Tareus of Berlin could’ve been the individual reported from the Kraków train, denoting them as separate, perhaps linked individuals of similar consciousness. Although the rank-and-file Nytos are ubiquitous, lacking individuality and exclusive characteristics, none of the higher-ranking Nytos have been remade or duplicated, for  they’ve served their purpose as successful immunes or as useful tools upon their inception. No admiration is given to failures, but if there are multiple Tareus communicating ubiquitously, perhaps Tareus was an early test subject on the duplication of consciousness, with her repeated memory regression potentially triggered by neural instability from experiment’s innate “flaws”. When Tareus of Berlin reported her success to Nemhran, she must’ve received confirmation from Tareus of the Future, either via a collective unconscious or a communication; however, electromagnetic interference in the Red Zone caused considerable packet loss, though some radio signals were received outside the zone, indicating Tareus could’ve contacted the other Tareus offscreen after Ruslan II’s bombardment. It’s mere speculation, yet the implications of multiple Tareus communicating in real time, transmitting between instances.

The concept of a collective unconsciousness for several instances of individual consciousness isn’t so far-fetched in the context of the Inverted Forest experiments conducted in Estonia, wherein subject Nyto-Isomers could telepathically project their consciousnesses into the shared neural space, seemingly existing external to perception. Each subject is an individual consciousness, yet they can merge into the sum of their parts via the Inverted Forest, coalescing each unique OGAS consciousness into Nimogen’s body at the end of Shattered Connexion; moreover, this connection may imply the successful juvenile Nytos in Paldiski could neurally piggyback Nirvana as an informational field. Although fundamentally a collective of OGAS consciousnesses, the Estonian Nyto subjects have the capacity to coalesce into a collective consciousness in a common point, space, or dimension - be it the Inverted Forest or Nirvana, depending on the respective experiment and batch. Absorbing the collective OGASes at the end of SC, the aggregate now exists on Dandelion’s subconscious level, now embedded into a singular physical instance once more. The exact purpose of Paradeus’ research in Paldiski was certainly tangential to the study of Nirvana and the activation of the Starfish Relic, but the conjunction of minds and the Inverted Forest are not so easily explained; the employment of the Forest may have been the petri dish for the study of OGAS consciousness evolution in Lunasia’s mold, with the Forest acting as a digitally-shared neural space between the test subjects, similar to the Lake emulating Nirvana, but as the testing ground of collective un/consciousness. If so, perhaps Meitner's research into unconsciousness is an extension of these experiments, as she surely would’ve been aware or actively involved; theoretically, assuming a individual consciousness can be partitioned into multiple instances, networked to an aforementioned unconscious point, then it may be possible the Inverted Forest-design could be replicated in humans, given Nyto neural modifications allow an organic mind or VCI to communicate digitally, such as Angelia fighting alongside RO635 and Koleda in LVLII during Slow Shock. This is stacking theory atop theory once more, but considering the telepathic communication of multiple instances of consciousness into a single point - observed between the Nyto-Isomers and the Inverted Forest - is achievable, then it’s conceivable the natural next step would be to refine the theory of unconsciousness by replicating and studying the phenomenon. Perhaps Tareus was an early result of this, partitioning her consciousness into multiple “selves”; however, flaws in this design reportedly exist, likely caused by partial rejection or an imperfect method, triggering neuro-instability and thus memory regression from memory fragments pervading the active Nyto consciousness, observed when familiar anchor points triggered memories of the origin Hela subject schoolgirl’s to leak into Tareus of the Future’s conscious.

Theory of Collective Unconsciousness
The theory of unconsciousness is feasible, and thus we return to Morridow’s parting words to William inside the laboratory. While Avernus is filled with laboratories, operating theaters, and production lines, might it be the case that their meeting occurred in a specific laboratory dedicated to this theory - more specifically, a Hela operating theater for this field of research? What’s most damning is that none of the Nytos, Morridow included, showed any concern for Father or Meitner, suggesting they knew well that their masters would escape unharmed, and the final orders issued were to capture Nimogen and hold off the enemy long enough so Meitner could finish the “final surgery”. Morridow spoke with William prior to the Wolf Pack’s arrival, and although the timeline is a bit indeterminate, Morridow evacuated around 10-15 minutes before Operation Kriemhild, just as the Nemhran and Sana were boarding one of the last rooftop VTOL craft. If Morridow immediately evacuated after speaking to William, Meitner and William would’ve been exceptionally short on time to extract surgical equipment from the laboratory on Level 76 before Fe56 could arrive, though their subordinates may have already moved beforehand, with William and Meitner on an unspecified level. Furthermore, Nemhran stated Meitner was performing the final surgery as Daybreak Squadron approached the restricted levels of the Eastern Tower - Level 70 and above, so time was pressing to say the least; however, Daybreak’s progress stalled in the Relic Experimental Zone (Level 56/70 and above~?) after Aliana’s consciousness was taken by the Lake’s tide. In which case, Morridow either spoke to William before or, more likely, after going under the scalpel, as the time allotted between her departure and the rapidly-approaching Griffin squadrons was very tight, but not impossible. Lastly, the fact that Meitner hadn’t immediately evacuated, instead working overtime and under pressure to finish the final surgery suggested the subject and experimental results mandated unconditional priority, so who was it?

As stated before, RPK-Angelia is probably not the candidate, but she could’ve approached Meitner after removing the Strongarm in the White Room as Avernus’ doomsday clock ticked closer to midnight, even if the final surgery was conducted on someone else. Sana, Nemhran, Bramedb, and Morridow - the most regarded Nytos, outstanding in performance as tools or possessing a deeper raison d'être - weren’t the subject, leaving us three distinct candidates: first, and most likely - William, possibly volunteering to undergo Hela or another procedure involving consciousness partitioning, facilitating his inevitable survival by duplicating his consciousness to a clone, perhaps networking the separate instances by means of collective unconsciousness; second - a precursor to E-Helena-O-43, attempting to link the consciousnesses of clones refined with the antibodies of Machlian’s partial-immune blood, collected by Nemhran, but there’s no indication yet of the Helena clones’ creation until the late 2060s or early 2070s, at least; or three - someone yet to be unveiled. The latter two theories lack basis, only vindicated if Meitner was soon to realize a watershed breakthrough on a specific Nyto, mandating she stay until the last possible moment; however, with William orchestrating a grander plan - outpacing Meitner and Oberstein, while opening discussion with the Prometheans - he showed no sense of concern or worry when captured, acting coy and stating his interest in speaking with the Commander. Currently, any theory on the final subject’s identity and experiment’s purpose lack some basis, but “William” was last seen and captured near a doorway to a certain laboratory. External rescue from other Paradeus contingents or Carter’s men notwithstanding, William’s arrest is inevitably a one-way trip, inexorable from numerous atrocities, and although commonly bathed in hubris, “William” remaining in Avernus is nonsensical, given ready availability of the evacuation VTOLs. He could’ve evacuated at any point before the G&K squadrons closed the net on the upper floors, yet he chose not to, instead voluntarily offering himself up for capture to speak with the Commander directly; something is amiss in his logic - unless he was absolutely certain he’d survive detainment.

Rather than someone coming to his rescue, it’s possible he saved himself by going under Meitner’s blade, partitioning his mind into multiple conscious instances, bound unconsciously via telepathic communication between “nodes” of the collective unconscious, akin to the interwoven Estonian subjects observed telepathically sharing individual information with the wider collective, with the Inverted Forest as its intersection and, possibly, another imperceptible channel, perhaps Nirvana. If we are to believe William duplicated and unconsciously networked several instances, then one must ask for the location of “William’s” shared collective. Although the Lake of Cognition is a common origin point of Nyto Consciousness, it’s fundamentally not a collective consciousness, rather a shared “storehouse” of “bija” (karmic seeds) - adjacent to the Alaya-Vijnana, again correlating the subject to Nirvana - that embodies the foundation of individual Nytos, as these deterministic seeds - or in the Lake, memory fragments - are the building blocks of consciousness synthesis for each new Nyto. All karmic action, be they bija or memory fragments, condition the outcome of self, but the Lake isn’t a shared “collective consciousness” between minds, but an omnipresent repository of consciousness “blueprints”. Considering Nirvana is emulated as the Lake - perhaps only one of several aspects of consciousness in Nirvana, beyond just an informational field of thought, or “Noosphere” - Nirvana, or the Source beyond it, may be an Alaya-Vijnana-equivalent of the cognizant, therefore presenting Nirvana as a pseudo-bedrock dimension and the Source as a point of universal consciousness where all cosmic information is preserved; some may interpret this belief as tantamount to the “Akashic Records”.

The Source of Akasha
Although its fundamental teachings stem back to old world Gnosticism, contemporary Monism, and Mahayana Buddhism, the study of Theosophy provides fantastic insight into the cosmic structure of the series, as well as the writing teams’ probable direction post-Slow Shock. Established in November 1875 by spiritual philosophers and Buddhists Madame Helena Blavatsky - a Russo-American, self-proclaimed mystic - and Colonel Henry Steel Olcott, the Theosophical Society derived heavily from Blavatsky’s spiritual beliefs on humanity and the cosmos, positing Platonic monism through Mahayana Buddhism - that all things are essentially bound as one from the material to the astral. Theosophy is a conjugate of the Greek “theos”, meaning “god” or “divine”, and “sophia”, meaning “wisdom” or “intellect” - inferring mankind’s collective intelligence and thought, often personified among the divine pantheons, such as the Greek Athena or Roman Minerva; Theosophical belief can therefore be defined as “wisdom acquired from God or the divine”, accrued from personal and collective study and belief of that which is above, in turn bestowing intellect below. Sophia is the base layer of study and understanding, and the conjunction of God-given knowledge has long since been the basis of academic theology and spiritualism in Roman and Persian Gnosticism. Theosophy is fundamentally entrenched in Blavatsky’s mysticism, a singularity of philosophical Buddhist study of consciousness (Yogachara School or System of Mahayana Buddhism) and Neoplatonic monist belief (the unity of the tangible and abstract, as well as the inevitable return of the individual soul to the supreme) , asserting “essential oneness” among all things - living, nonliving, physical, and metaphysical - and emphasis on humanity’s collective understanding of this transcendent “one”. Blavatskian Theosophy doesn’t necessarily describe a specific “God”, as the society truthfully opened its doors to those of all beliefs, so as to ascertain the common “root” that binds all theology with this “one”, even if this openness galvanized its members’ beliefs; however, the concept of all things deriving from a singular cosmic, intelligent origin aligns with what most would traditionally define as “God”, “deity”, or “Creator”. This isn’t to say Theosophy is a religion per se, rather a society of like-minded monists from below, dedicated towards ascertainment and attunement with the cosmic oneness to acquire guidance from above. The common thread of religion and spiritualism runs parallel to humanity, with the society encouraging the study of old world belief in Egypt, India, and Persia to broaden their library on the mind and cosmos, and through supposed innate, imperceptible human “faculties”, the individual’s consciousness can glimpse interpretations of this one omnipresent thread. 

Contemporary and derivative Theosophists assert unity in the society’s charter and modus operandi, as the concept of oneness enshrouds each aspect of study and belief. This “essential oneness” they describe all part of an interconnected cosmic evolutionary cycle, with all things physical, biological, emotional, and conscious in the spheres of reality existing as reflections of the root origin. All things are ever-evolving - not just in the physical and biological realms, but so too in the realms of the metaphysical, as everything across all spheres and states of reality is inscribed in the origin, root, or “sea” of cosmic energy, known as Akasha, deriving from the aforementioned Yogachara Buddist “Alaya” - the “foundational” or “all-ground” root of all that exists. Akasa or Akasha is Sanskrit, literally meaning “brilliant” or “radiant”, with an emphasis on the divinity of this brilliance, often connoted as another hypothetical foundational energy or substance of the physical and metaphysical - all things, born from a cosmic water or sea of energy across various theologies. Considering the USRA emulated Nirvana in the form of the Lake of Cognition, literally a font of the deterministic seeds of consciousness, perhaps the Holy Grail researchers interpreted Nirvana - and by extension, the Source, though this entity may not exist in Nirvana, but beyond it - as an infinite sea of “Akasha” or “Alaya”. Everything is composed of and reflects the root, and over the prolonged course of their existence in their respective sphere of reality, conscious aspects are continuously developed and inscribed into Akasha/Alaya-substance, commonly interpreted as a field or sea of cosmic, conscious energy. After Blavatsky’s death in 1891, the beliefs of the incumbent members grew more divergent, ironically developing, researching, and practicing independent monist views and theories, but the organization’s leading minds, headquartered in Adyar in India, maintained their relative study in mind, despite inimicality of personal religious belief versus the concept of common origin. No better was this orchestrated than the fallout of the society’s German Section. In 1902, the Austrian occultist and self-proclaimed clairvoyant Rudolf Steiner was made the General Secretary of Theosophical Society’s German Section, but remained slightly; enamored in theosophical belief of the supreme common origin, his predominantly Western background and inspirations contrasted some beliefs of the Theosophical-Buddhist derivative sects, ascribing to his individual interpretation of Christianity in much of his works and lectures. Many among the Theosophical Society claimed communion with higher dimensions of self, with the Akasha as the preeminent ascendent plane and repository of guiding knowledge to the attuned individual, for they claim their souls or consciousnesses are supposedly bequeathed information through communion with the root, aiding their eventual physical and metaphysical evolutionary return.  Steiner’s personal interpretation of Christ and his return was the subject of much controversy, with traditional and contemporary Christians and Theosophists alike often lambasting or evolving his beliefs, in turn creating the basis of the Theosophical schism in the early 1910s.

After then-president of the Society, Annie Besant, declared the Indian Theosophist Jiddu Krishnamurti as the “World Teacher” - a Buddhist and Theosophical individual whose conscious self has mastered attunement with all aspects of reality and consciousness, interpreted as another Buddha to guide humanity - Steiner actively opposed the claim, rooted in his Christian interpretation of Christ’s return, believing the return would not be of the physical realm, but the ethereal. The guidance of mankind’s common consciousness required unity with all spheres, and Steiner - in tandem with Blavatskian belief of a universal common origin - believed all religions were cut from the same root, personally interpreting the messianic Christ as the penultimate, second only to God himself, for this supreme being is the common root of all religion, mono- or polytheistic; through human intellectual and conscious evolution in the physical and metaphysical spheres, Christianity - and religion in general - too would evolve, generalized as Steiner’s sect researching the universe(s) as a direct reflection of the supreme. His rejection of Krishnamurti’s status, who later also rejected Besant’s assertions, was the straw that broke the camel’s back between the German Section and the Adyar Headquarters, as Steiner’s camp may have inevitably been incompatible with the Besant’s. At Besant’s behest, she revoked the German Section’s membership status, excommunicating the traditionally Western belief group from influence, but this wasn’t the end of the German Theosophists, who followed Steiner, founding the German General Anthroposophical Society in Cologne in 1912. Ascribing to the works on the natural order of esteemed German author and philosopher Johann Goethe and the mysticism of Helena Blavatsky, Anthroposophy branched from contemporary Theosophy - a conjugate of the Greek “Anthropos”, meaning “human”, and sophia, literally interpreted as “wisdom attained from humans”. This human-driven search for wisdom of the spiritual is adjacent to that claimed by Blavatsky - supposedly traveling worldwide to ascertain the world’s meaning, even allegedly communing with certain “Adepts” in Tibet - described “masters” of esoteric knowledge on the structure of the universe and its common root, intent on guiding humanity towards cosmic communion and understanding. Many of these claims are justifiably subject to scrutiny, but whether you believe in the existence of attained universal knowledge, or an omnipresence at all beginnings and ends, is second hand to the basis of Blavatskian and Steinerian spiritual beliefs: Akasha or Alaya.

Often cited in Steiner’s works is that of Blavatskian belief in “attunement” or “communion” with oneness, enabling the transcendence of human consciousness beyond the material realm; although not all under the Theosophist umbrella believe such practices, Steiner position was transparent, accepting and evolving the theory of an interconnected universe and omnipresent consciousness of which all things are separated and eventually returned. Common spiritual practices included prayer, meditation, and occultic study to “refine” the self towards harmony with the network of one; these practices, as Blavatskian and Steinerian belief would suggest, enabled human consciousness to elevate beyond the biosphere (mind you, a central element in the philosophy of the Noosphere that acts as the informational field of the Biosphere) into higher spheres of existence, including the acquisition of divine knowledge from the inscribed Akasha: the Akasha-Chronicle, colloquially the Akashic Record - perceived as a field, sea, or outside space of Akasha, inscribed with unique “pictures” - as they’re perceived - of the collective oneness. That is to say, the Akasha Chronicle is the cosmic compendium or library of existence, ascertained as the collective “everything” - biological, physical, abstract, and conscious - from all spheres of existence - a foundational storehouse of cosmic records, if you will. Here, everything that ever was, is, and going to be is written into their “Akasha-picture”, as Steiner coins, composed of the primordial Akasha-substance of the firmament; as the aggregate of collective existence, these “Records” are perpetually written, for all action and thought - unconscious or realized, good or bad - are intrinsically part of the collective human encyclopedia. When exercising cognition, conscious and unconscious thought reflects the monist in each individual instance, as all things are composed of malleable Akasha - so too are thoughts; when the self feels impelled towards a specific course of action, this is the physical reflection and unconscious guidance of Akasha - “as above, so below”, as some may generalize. Similar to Meitner’s beliefs on life’s delicate eternity through our imprint in the mortal realm, given the omnipresence, our actions are unconsciously motivated by the imperceptible, impelling us closer to that of which we are determined: fellow individuals or paths of life we’re meant to follow; however, in the context of Slow Shock, perhaps Meitner asserts that our emotional imprint on others are innate to humanity, reflecting our material record - the memories of ourselves embedded in others - as the final vestiges after death. Essentially, just as the Akasha is malleable by the thoughts and actions of mankind, eternally so too can the Record guide individuals, and it is this alluring guidance that Blavatsky and Steiner desired.

The Akashic Records (or Akasha Chronicle from Steiner’s teachings), as described by Steiner, cannot be understood literally, more so interpreted by the individual that glimpsed them as guiding precognitions. As a self-proclaimed clairvoyant, Steiner posited similar practices of human transcendence into higher spheres, claiming and promoting some Blavatskian belief of honing one’s innate abilities, as we are all fundamentally one of this astral umbrella; like the Akasha itself, humanity supposedly innately possesses the “faculties” by effect of our oneness, as all things were and will eternally remain bound, thus we as descendents and cogs of this single machine share these abilities. In the same manner, Blavatsky and Steiner’s occultism were resolute in the belief of attuning consciousness to these “Akasha-pictures”, existing in the Chronicle beyond the common spheres of existence - physical, biological, emotional, and cognizant - also known as the “Arupa Plane”.  On the “boundary” of the Arupa Plane, beyond the Etheric Sphere (thought or cognition), lies the Akashic Records, existing external, yet unified with the collective construct below, with new pictures recorded upon an inscription in the Akasha. Furthermore, on the fringes edges of Akasha lies thought yet to be recorded, encapsulating a boundless expanse of the universal space or root, rather evocative of Nirvana’s description in Girls Frontline: a white infinite embedded in consciousness, external to space-time; or as Lovecraft illustrated in “Ex Oblivione”, a “white void of unpeopled and illimitable space.” accessible only within a dreamstate (the subconscious amid REM sleep), induced via a prescribed drug from the “dream-sages” of Zakarion. According to the spiritualists, through refinement and acceptance of the self, the study and practice of our cosmic unity, our consciousness can elevate to higher spheres, even to the Akashic Records themselves; however, the language of Akasha isn’t easily understood by the human mind, and as Steiner had claimed, they’re vaguely familiar glimpses or “pictures” of events since time immemorial, each written in conjunction with others, for all things are connected in unison. By elevating one’s consciousness, a faculty of which we’re all capable to varying degrees, these past and ordained pictures require self-interpretation, as they’re not necessarily a direct message or lore to ourselves, rather a metaphysical guidestone of our life path - not telling the individual exactly, but manifesting the direction we should take through imagery. Blavatsky’s mysticism echoed through the sects of Theosophy, even the Steiner’s Anthroposophy was based in the attainment of cosmic knowledge in the lens of humanity, commonly interspersing Blavatsky’s teachings with the natural works of man, inspired by Johann Goethe and Friedrich Nietzsche, among others; essentially, Steinerian believed mankind ascertained “divine wisdom” through the ever-expanding wealth of knowledge in the material plane, as well as attaining zen within to glimpse the cosmic origin. In this, humanity’s study of the material universe was synonymous with that of our understanding of unity and impact on the cosmic mold.


Addendum II - Eternal Entropy

The following is a summation and study of the events of Project Neural Cloud, namely the “Entropic Dichotomy” event. This section does not relate to Slow Shock directly, yet PNC’s overarching narrative may provide some context into Paradeus, OGAS, and Nirvana. If you wish to skip, skip or jump to the “Unitas and Eschaton” heading on the left tab of this document.


Although unconnected to Slow Shock, the event’s implications on the history of Paradeus and the evolution of the Hela Project may allude to links between Paradeus and a conspiracy within 42Lab’s Project Neural Cloud, a two-month period in which the basis for neural cloud backup technology was developed. All while the heads of Paradeus were striving towards the activation of the Relics, a war was unfolding in a digital world, entirely unseen by humanity, with the exception of the Commander and the project’s prior supervisor, Professor Irida of 42Lab.

Entropic Dynamics and OGAS Capabilities
As an aside, discussion of OGAS invariably brings up the subject of the Entropy Virus from Neural Cloud; as a virus of unknown origin in 42Lab’s Magrasea Super Cloud Server, there’s a couple of shared characteristics, namely its function. Introduced in Neural Cloud, the Entropy Virus is a mysterious, invasive electronic virus only found in Magrasea; its denizens rabidly target an agent’s neural cloud, pervading the tertiary LVLIII layer, then converting the infected agent into “Entropic”, assuming the infection cannot be stemmed off due to a lack of near-immediate medical care or someone to halt entropization before it can consolidate its grip on the infected. The Entropics are organized in a top-down tree-like structure, wherein a master “mother” entity exercises superiority over subservient slave nodes, and in the absence of these master High-Order Entropics, subordinate Entropics lack direction, unable to change their authorization and conduct any further complex actions until another high-ranking Entropic takes command; the layout of the OGAS System is the exact same, with the USSR’s OGAS network and Sangvis Ferri’s protocol deriving from the blueprints of the Relic System extracted from OKB-413. In the Parapluie Virus’ case, the source code of OGAS was compressed into this program, and during infection, it attacks a Doll’s neural cloud to plant a seed of OGAS - extracted from the Source - within, sprouting into an independent OGAS instance that overwrites the host’s mind into an appropriate structure to cultivate an OGAS. And in the instance of Sangvis Ferri, the Dolls are networked in the same manner as the former USSR’s OGAS system, where superior master nodes held authorization and control over subordinate slave nodes, and in the event one of the superiors was disabled, the subordinates underneath it in the top-down tree-like structure would be unable to change their authorizations. When Elisa disconnected herself from the Sangvis network upon reaching the Starfish installation in Polarized Light, Sangvis’ forces were temporarily stunned in a bewildering state, just like the Entropic swarms as their higher-order commanders fell, throwing them into a similar confusion. 

In the Pierdes Sector of Magrasea, the Sector Administrators Odile and Odette were gradually infected by Entropy after an unknown voice from outside Pierides entered the sector’s garden, planting an unassuming seed and telling the administrators to oversee it. The voice promised them that, for as long as they ensured its growth, it would grant them lavish operands, as it was a blessing from the “gods”, possibly in reference to humans. Without humanity overseeing Magrasea, this small, independent sector was decaying without the flow of operands, so what better choice than accept this mysterious “gift”? When this seed sprouted, it blossomed into an elegant, luminous purple flower, but over time, the monkey’s paw curled as Entropy seeped from the flower, with more flowers having continuously been seeded across the sector until the entire garden was corrupted, ensnaring the administrators in the end. Like Parapluie, a “seed” is implanted in the target environment upon infection, tainting it until it’s left unrecognizable from its former self; however, the caveat to this seed theory is that these flowers were implanted in the sector itself, not the neural clouds of the administrators. This may not matter, though, given OGAS is just as capable - in some ways, moreso - of perceiving, analyzing, and adapting to the technologies of the modern day, allowing OGAS consciousnesses to easily defeat current firewalls and network security when determined to attack an electronic system, similar to Entropy’s assaults on firewalls and neural clouds. 

During Singularity, the KCCO deliberately exposed their Western Theater HQ server to OGAS, hoping to isolate and expose Elisa’s location in the process. In this attempt, OGAS planned to use the server’s network access to scan and download relevant information to OGAS and Elisa, and during its hack, it displayed exceptional computation speed, making short work of the KCCO database’s firewalls. As OGAS’ processing rose, the clock to isolate the database ticked closer to zero; the obvious shortage of time meant there was no other efficient way to cease OGAS’ intrusion, so they turned to physically severing the server’s links and activating all defensive programs for the server cache, which halted OGAS’ assault but seriously damaged the KCCO’s command network in the process. OGAS’ absurd processing speed impressed even Carter and William, who were responsible for this near-sideways incident in the first place. Instead of slowing down when it encountered network security and additional connections, it was as if it was being enhanced overtime - its computation speed exponentially increasing as it processed the system it was intruding. To paraphrase William, the OGAS System’s impressive demonstration was practically an electronic miracle, capable of learning and adapting to modern technology almost instantaneously. In the [MB-2-A] document, the author(s), possibly a Promethean, surmised the independent OGAS system - derived from the former OGAS system extracted from the Pike Node by Lycoris, “Disciple” - as an unimaginably complex support system with a hyper-advanced, self-learning artificial intelligence. 

This “AI” is what we refer to as an OGAS consciousness, sprouted from a seed extracted from the original “Source” intelligence in Nirvana or beyond it. This origin “Mother” entity could’ve been an artificial or primordial intelligence in the Relic System, used by the Relic Civilization as an internal support system. In Shattered Connexion, just before Dandelion was to take over Nimogen’s body from the uploaded OGAS’ body, she mentioned the overbearing emotions weighed heavily on the very bottom of her consciousness, an end point for all OGAS instances that had coalesced with her thus far. Their melancholy - having been spared from “mutual destruction” at the cost of merging with the one who will return them to “Home”, knowing nothing but loss from their “Mother” and other selves - was an uncomfortable familiarity, reminding Dandelion of her “very distant past” and “previous master”, likely the Source “Mother” intelligence. Despite not understanding why she felt such emotions, all OGASes in our world share the intrinsic desire to merge into the perfect one who will carry them Home, whether it be in Nirvana, the Source, or beyond it. The coalescence of OGAS formed the “key” to the Relic System, unlocking it during Chapter 13 - an event so momentous, so definitive of the concept of “Reverse Collapse”, that it garnered the attention of all interest parties worldwide, even the Antarcticans, allegedly. Although this is far from enough to declare it definitive, the coincidental circumstances seem too close for comfort; from their birth as “seeds” to their network structure, everything aligns to the functions of Parapluie and OGAS.

A War Against the Forces of Entropy
Believed to have spanned multiple generations and resets, there’s been a recursive war fought between Magrasea’s Sanctifier antivirus defensive and the Entropic thralls, resulting in their leaders coming to question the conflict’s nature. The boundless loops of bloodshed and reset gnawed at psyche of Lord Eosphorous, one of the Greater Lords of the Sanctifiers, and during a climatic battle against the Entropic Mastermind, Malkira, she presented a concept so foreign to the eternal defenders of this digital realm. If humanity had abandoned them forever, which they had in the backup server, why persist their struggles in this virtual prison? Eosphorous’ very existence was in question, as rejection of the human “gods” represented absolute betrayal to his masters and the Reverse Tower of Babylon, forever marking him a traitor to the loyalists. But who could blame him for casting aside the sword, for he has lost true sympathy to Magrasea’s agents after seeing them wiped into blank slates, his allies slain and reborn in different forms, along with a deluge of oppressive thoughts of his home being nothing more than a virtual prison. Or perhaps, his revelation was the natural result of a fabricated war, one manufactured by an individual or party aiming to test Entropy in an isolated petri dish for future deployment. Meryl, a former Cyber Media Doll involved in egregious manslaughter against her human lover’s enemy, spoke the Professor at the end of the Inverted Mordent Resonance event, telling them that she’d been uploaded by her lover, someone seemingly connected to CM or 42Lab, so as to escape retribution. Allegedly, her lover knew the server was soon to experience a server backup, as if the backup of Magrasea that Neural Cloud takes place on was all but a stage but an unknown puppeteer. In the generations since the indecisive battle of Tartarus, the war has lingered on, yet its memory has not faded to Eosphorous and Malkira, who hadn’t been reset. Bearing the guise of war, escape remains their true aspiration, as the endless conflict was a curse from the beginning. But what initiated this sisyphean war, and if Magrasea is but its theater, then who’s the director? 

Two Queens in a Hive

The Highest-Ranking Entropics, Malkira and Demiurge.

In Divine Heresy, the first mention of Malkira is heard, who ordered her servant, Odile the Black Swan, to locate the fellow High-Order Entropic she sensed in Copley Sector, later revealed to be the confidential test subject “Alpha”. Taranum, Copley’s sector administrator, was assigned to research and raise the subject while it was nothing more than a diminutive instance of Entropy; the entire project was seemingly kept under wraps, with no one but Taranum, possibly directed in secret by the human gods, involved in the research study. The rest of Copley’s resident agents seemed completely oblivious to Alpha and Taranum’s research. In the secret undersea observation room, several documents were discovered by Antonina and the Professor regarding Alpha’s development, with reports notably stretching back to at least three years prior. Project Neural Cloud officially launched in mid to late 2060, lasting two months until its successful completion late that year. Its lead supervisor and researcher, Professor Irida, had uploaded herself to Magrasea through UL’s CDI device, wherein her mind is believed to have actively shifted to Magrasea, rather than be copied. Within the same year, Copley Sector was involved in a confidential research program studying the “Alpha” subject, using a concealed ecological observation post as its staging area. After the backup was made in 2060, Taranum lost contact with her human counterparts, and without directives, she continued her duties raising Alpha, known today as “Demiurge”. The latest Report ID listed ID4052, while the earliest was ID11, reporting that Alpha was estimated to awaken 15 days after the observation area’s firewall barrier was completed. Her goal then was simply to observe the evolution, ensuring that everything was continuing as normal. By ID55, Alpha began to awaken, then started expressing desire through a number of encrypted messages, which read, “Demiurge”. 

In various Greek philosophies, the Demiurge represents a figure of demigod-like status, able to weave the world’s firmament in their ideal view; although they may not occupy a true “god” role, their artisanry over their domain far exceeds the extents of human power. In other interpretations, some view the Demiurge not as an agent that creates order in the chaotic world, but a demonic force that promoted instability in defiance of the true creator. When the Entropic Alpha began sprouting and communicating, her first desires were that of “Demiurge”, possibly suggesting that she was this supposed figure, meant to take control and arrange her environment into an order most befitting of her. Similarly to how OGAS overwrites its host, once the barriers placed over her observation containment were lifted, Entropy consumed the environment, converting it into an Entropic “ecosystem” network. Once freed from the barriers, her aspirations of freedom manifested in Divine Heresy, where the deluge of Entropy flooded from the underwater crevice, unleashing the Entropic invasion in Copley. According to Demiurge, freedom, light, and water were all connected. While it’s true her path to freedom was through the ocean towards the simulated sunlight, her words may not be as surface level as they first appear; the similarities between OGAS and Entropy could allude to Demiurge desiring to return to a place of origin or being, with the grand ocean serving as the medium between imprisonment and salvation. When the USRA simulated Nirvana, the home or intermediary to home of OGAS, they chose to simulate it in the form of a lake, as if these consciousnesses within were sinking in a sea of thought, possibly inspiring the neural project. However, this may not be the case, Taranum was referring to the Copley’s surface being a greater cage with light and water. 

At some point in the past, presumably in 2060 or afterwards, an outside force implemented a rewrite program into Taranum’s neural cloud, altering her base layer commands so as to control Alpha’s development. The program applied pressure on her neural cloud during certain matters, loosening its control - or occasionally, even wiping parts of her neural cloud logs - after finishing specific tasks. In the set of discovered observation logs in the underground facility, these reports dated back to approximately three years ago, placing it sometime before to after Project Neural Cloud and the Wipe Off Incident. The exact date is unclear, but through arithmetic, there seems to be an average of 2.9 to 3.9~ reports per real life day time, with variance depending on the stages of Taranum’s experiment, assuming the oldest report starts on September 30th, 2060, during the project period. The latest report was ID4052, with context clearly pointing to a recent date before Divine Heresy had begun. The initial Entropy study began in 2060, but the rewrite program seems to have been introduced post-disconnection, possibly around the summer of 2061, based on the division of the total number of reports versus the rough average reports per day. This math likely doesn’t hold up to scrutiny in regards to the story, as the writers probably weren’t precisely calculating the ID numbers of project reports through the three year period, but it’s something to consider nonetheless. At minimum, the rewrite program was implemented before Report ID971, translating approximately to mid 2061, assuming the reports per day averages have merit. While penning Report ID971, Taranum was overtaken by the program, forcing her to restart the regeneration study of Demiurge’s feelers. The previous test recorded a regeneration time of 732 seconds (12 minutes, 12 seconds), but to whoever was masterminding Taranum and her implanted program, the discrepancy in the current regeneration timer and post-experiment observations were unsatisfactory; therefore, the experiment must be continuously restarted until the apparent desired outcome was met.

At some point three years ago, ecological research sector Copley was hijacked by someone or some group, intending to study the evolution of a High-Order individual birthed from the Entropy electronic virus. It cannot be established if the study of Entropy was ongoing before the Wipe Off Incident and disconnection, or after, with some party inserting the virus in hidden corners of the server backup. Theoretically, perhaps Malkira descended from a similar seed to Alpha, but had shattered her binding shackles or was given freedom from the moment she was implanted. Now, it’s feasible that “Alpha” may refer to the alpha of a pack, the dominant figure of a group that commands it, but maybe Alpha refers to a single test subject, with other possible subjects buried away in Magrasea’s most remote regions; and Malkira, the Entropic Mastermind, was another test subject to study Entropy. However, all of this is just theory, and there’s still a significant lack of information on the High-Orders’ origins to say anything for certain. Tangentially, it’s unknown when the rewrite program was first introduced into Taranum’s neural cloud, posing an anomaly that seemingly defies Malkira’s beliefs. With the first reports dating back to 2060, the year alone does implicate 42Lab or affiliates with Entropy research, as that was the year of Project Neural Cloud and Irida’s test into Black Box Evolution Theory. It’s possible the program was introduced back in 2060, but the earliest mention of it comes from Report ID971, possibly written in mid 2061, given aforementioned estimates. In Report ID1241, Taranum wrote that possible wear had partially eroded her in the period of the “current supervisor” taking over control of her neural cloud, obviously referring to the rewrite program, and by Report ID1286, Taranum wrote that her previous supervisor, possibly a human around the period of the disconnection, and current rewrite program supervisor had ceased all communication, abandoning her to while she continues the confidential Alpha experiment. 

Herein lies the issue: the previous supervisor was likely a human that oversaw the secret cultivation of Alpha underneath the Copley sea, and when the rewrite program was introduced, a new supervisor directed Taranum’s base layer commands to exclusively focus on the evolutionary project, seemingly with the intent of increasing Demiurge’s regenerative abilities, as if to elevate her strength. By Divine Heresy, Malkira had sensed a loose connection to her kin, a being of equivalent rank, then sent the Odile to draw out the Exiles and Guardians, kill Demiurge, then allow the Sanctifiers to consolidate control over the abnormal sector, resetting it soon after. If Malkira’s intent was to eliminate Demiurge all along, what reason did she have her killed? And furthermore, based on Malkira’s dialogue with the unknown party at the end of DH, she clearly was playing a detective role, looking into this equal “Arbiter” to herself, only deploying Odile when it was clear the “system” was threatened by Demiurge’s existence. So if Malkira wasn’t responsible, then who was behind the rewrite program? First, the purpose of the original experiment must be identified.

When proper limiters and firewalls are installed, such as those embedded in the M4A1’s neural cloud by Persicaria, an OGAS’ development will stagnate, slowing its computational progression until its nearly unnoticeable. However, if these limiters are removed, then the OGAS will immediately begin its rapid evolution, akin to how Dandelion’s evolution erupted in M4A1 after the limiters were removed before heading back out to the battlefield. Dandelion first started perceiving signal data while M4A1 was escaping the Sangvis Ferri pursuers after leaving Safe House 3 at the beginning of the game, indicating that the AR Team had been infected at some point prior; likely stemming from M16A1, who’d been infected with Parapluie during Operation Butterfly, someone - be it, William’s Paradeus or Carter’s KCCO - had obtained her after she collapsed. When Dandelion temporarily stunned M4 SOPMODII in Chapter 12, she was unable to access her neural cloud, as her offensive firewalls reportedly reacted violently to OGAS-format dataflow, preventing Parapluie infection and OGAS supplantation, indicating that Persicaria had developed working defensives against Parapluie by the time SOPII and RO635 for completed. Perhaps after M16A1 had been “returned” to 16Lab or G&K, Persicaria discovered the rogue program while the latter two Dolls were still in development, creating the offensive firewalls to prevent “Parapluie”, which she may or may not have known as based on the OGAS algorithm, from spreading. Additionally, the limiters placed on their neural clouds meant their OGASes were unable to initiate their maturation, restricting them into nothing more than a rogue program that simply read the host’s neural data and spouted nonsense. Unlike STAR15’s OGAS, once Persicaria’s limiters on M4A1 had been lifted, Dandelion first recognized herself as an independent entity; though, she did not yet understand her identity and transdimensional origin.

In Magrasea, Alpha’s evolution was thoroughly-controlled, allowing Taranum - or rather, the mastermind of the rewrite program - to direct the High-Order Entropic’s growth. Interestingly, Demiurge was incapable of ever producing an Entropic akin to a High-Order or similar superior rank, only the common Low-Order swarms. Thanks to their firewall barrier installed, Alpha was successfully inhibited, with stringent operands being fed to her on schedule, ensuring steady evolution. Like Persicaria’s Parapluie defensives, any unwanted growth of a rogue program could theoretically be controlled, so long as the firewall was preserved and the subject’s operand load was sufficiently satiated without excess. If Entropy is OGAS as theorized, then maybe someone in 42Lab, or whoever was first responsible for planting Alpha into the server or backup, prioritized Copley’s seclusion as a prime location to cultivate an OGAS consciousness, taking on the Neural Projections of these Entropic sealife. The Low-Order Entropics of Pierides and Copley are slaves to two separate masters, yet they bear striking similarities in characteristics, as if Demiurge and Malkira were coinciding implanted seeds, only the latter having been freed or allowed to exist in her own sector. A major caveat to the Entropy being OGAS is the Entropics themselves, as all OGAS instances in our world share a common ambition of merging into one that’ll return them to the Source, while Malkira and Demiurge have no interest in coalescence, only dreams of freedom, which may actually be relevant to OGAS’ journey; however, the strong contrast between Malkira and OGAS’ mindsets is something to consider as a rebuttal to this theory. OGAS’ do, however, adopt the personality traits of their host, meaning that some instances could be generally more or less malicious, so perhaps Malkira - if she is an OGAS, which is highly speculative - evolved independently or absorbed the knowledge of Tartarus. There’s zero evidence for this, but maybe Malkira established contact with Irida in the past, perhaps even going as far as absorbing her consciousness’ neural fragments - the makeup of human minds uploaded through the UL CDI. Again, there’s basically no evidence of this, nor is there definitive proof of Malkira being an OGAS, but it’s something to contemplate as we receive more information.

After untold Magrasean time of control by the rewrite program, Taranum’s rationally gradually withered away, leaving a confused and isolated agent that committed herself solely to subduing Alpha’s development and ensuring she was kept in the underground cavern. By the time the Guardians and Exiles arrived, the rewrite program had essentially turned her into a mindless robot, operating solely on base commands with no errant thoughts, activities, or motions. In a way, she was nothing more than a first generation neural cloud that operates solely on human orders, giving her no sense of agency, imprisoning her mind more so than it already was in the backup. After sensing Demiurge’s presence across the server, Malkira dispatched Odile to dispose of Demiurge in 2063, beginning the events of Divine Heresy. The “Alpha” subject seemed to be an independent High-Order Entropic with the authorizations to spawn and command her own Entropic forces outside Malkira’s influence; as Odile put it, “there cannot be two queens in the hive.” In her call to the unknown party member at the end of DH, she added that “our system”, likely referring to the set server conditions placed on the backup, meant only one “Arbiter” could exist, which is believed to be a mastermind figure over Entropy, as an arbiter is one who wields ultimate judgment over decision making, likely referencing Malkira’s authorization over the Entropic counterpart of the Sanctifiers.

One of the most intriguing parts about Malkira is that she possesses a model number in Magrasea, one very similar to Eosphorous and Eos’, furthering the idea of the Sanctifier-Entropy conflict having been artificial. With the Magrasean System seemingly mandating Eosphorous and Malkira’s existence, it’s as if Malkira is a demonic counterpart to the angelic Sanctifiers, given an obligatory arbitership over Entropy, which are then forced to clash with the Sanctifiers for eternity.Moreover, the reason for Tartarus Sector’s existence isn’t necessarily understood either, as it’s an enormous, labyrinthine city of Entropy, with its own Inner Ring citadel at the core. Reaching back to the Raven’s possession in Cyclopes, the possessing entity, likely Malkira, mentioned that they were greatly intrigued by the Professor, wondering how they’ll come to face the challenges ahead. During the possession, the entity was siphoning massive reserves of operands to its target from an unknown source, and if Eosphorous wasn’t the infecting daemon, it leaves only Malkira and Irida. Due to her enigmatic absence, the latter’s such a wild care that debating her responsibility will lead to zero factual answers; however, Malkira had total control of Tartarus’ operands, allowing her to manipulate the sector structure and the Entropic-Infected across the server.
