Furthermore, when the Sanctifiers enter the innermost circle, their overall power is greatly diminished, restricting their abilities and performance in the heart of their counterparts.

Within the Inner Ring, there’s an old Sanctifier Watchtower, entirely corrupted by Entropy, and here remain journals of the first Sanctifiers, written untold generations ago. Due to time dilation, the three year difference in real time from 2060 could mean generations or entire ages have passed, with information of the former Sanctifiers being so ancient that they’ve become lost to time in a fabricated, abandoned world. Most damning of all is Malkira’s resurrection of the other High-Order Entropics, who were arisen from death in a pool of Entropy Liquid, uniquely adjacent to how Sanctifiers are arisen in the Divine Restoration pool in the Reverse Tower of Babylon through their Holy Canon, the basic program of all Sanctifier instances. As long as the Holy Canon and pool remain, a Sanctifier can be reborn in a default setting, losing their prior memories; however, there’s an implication that Sanctifiers can also be reborn in the Inner Ring’s Entropic pool, alluding to resurrection through Entropy and the system-mandated commonality. If Entropy is truly a counterpart of the Sanctifiers, then perhaps the High-Order Entropics are descendents of ancient Sanctifiers, becoming distant cousins of the current Reverse Tower of Babylon, given the presence of the Entropized Watchtower and Inner Ring’s Throne Room, which shares a striking resemblance to the Pantheon, the heart of the Reverse Tower. Despite the obvious Entropic hive foil, the entire structure and throne were likely another Sanctifier stronghold, consumed by Entropy long ago by Malkira or the orchestrators of the Magrasea backup, be they Irida, a group within 42Lab, UL, or some collaborative effort between parties. If so, then the Inner Ring and, by extension, Tartarus could’ve been selected as the host location for the Entropic evolution, raising a potential OGAS seed in this secluded labyrinth with no clear purpose for existing. Considering the ancient Sanctifier architecture, perhaps those responsible shifted the Sanctifiers’ home to the current Reverse Tower, but left or created Tartarus as a secluded sector to cultivate OGAS. When Eosphrous confronted Malkira, she has access to the Watchtower’s ancient terminal, which contained all the written records of the ancients, alluding to the idea that Eosphorous, Eos, and maybe Malkira were not the first in this endless struggle. What this theory doesn’t answer, however, is why there was an entirely separate, seemingly confidential, experiment to study Entropy all the way in the ecological Copley Sector, whose administrator was later given new orders by an unknown figure.

Given the long-time presence of Alpha and the respective research, there’s reason to believe that Copley’s true purpose was a petri dish to study Entropy, with its administrator - under the orders of humans - solely assigned with the responsibility of overseeing Alpha’s awakening and development. When Demiurge finally emerged from the subterranean world, she found herself staring into digitized sunlight, unaware that, by escaping one cage, she had only found herself confined in a greater prison. Odile even mentions that her master, Malkira, is similarly confined, referencing her discontent against the virtual prison. It’s unknown where Malkira was birthed from, but she likely stemmed from another independent seed of Entropy; having sprouted in the very distant past, she was isolated from the studies conducted in Copley, implying the humans were possibly responsible for these Entropy “seeds”. Its study stretches back to at least 2060, suggesting that Entropy was willingly introduced to the server by someone or something, birthing the first Entropics, likely including Malkira herself. When Professor Irida uploaded herself to the Magrasea Server, it’s possible that she or another party were responsible for uploading the seeds of Entropy in the server. While little more than theory, the relevant documents all point to Entropy research just before or during two-month Project Neural Cloud testing period, as the backup seemingly made around the Wipe Off Incident - an incident where the Neural Cloud Sector faced a catastrophic disaster initiated by an unknown event, requiring the sector to be reformatted, only for Antonina to deploy the recently-introduced Neural Cocoon devices to save everyone before it could be completed. The circumstances and suspects of the incident remain the overarching mystery of Neural Cloud’s main plot, and after awakening from their Neural Cocoons three real life years later, the abnormal agent Dolls made their way to Professor Irida’s “Oasis”, a private sector exclusively for the 42Lab professor’s studies. Notably, Irida’s color scheme may relate to the Entropic spawn, as purple makes up the primary color of her palette, along with what seems to be a flower pendant attached to her phone case. Although this is purely circumstantial, it’s peculiar that such an important figure - believed to be lost consciously in Magrasea, possibly even physically dead in real life - wears the same color as Entropy.

Meryl’s lover knew the server was about to be disconnected, hinting that the creation of the backup was planned for some greater purpose, beyond just “42Lab will create a backup of the server as normal”. It’s true that Irida’s notes point to a three-year long experiment on neural clouds to test her Black Box Evolution Theory, likely executed in an isolated Magrasea backup to observe their slow evolution, and given that Antonina received the Neural Cocoons mysteriously from the outside just before the Wipe Off, the research certainly points the finger at Irida being tied to the disconnection. All this was set on the backdrop of UL and 42Lab’s collaboration to test the former’s mind-upload technology, wherein Irida was reportedly escorted to a UL medical facility in late September, remaining in a coma with unusual brainwave activity the following day. When the Commander uploaded their mind, it was as if their consciousness had shifted into the digital realm, rather than being copied and transferred; further, the body’s condition is unclear while CDI-uploaded minds are external to the physical, but if Irida’s emergency occurred after her upload while still in Magrasea, then perhaps the unusual brainwave activity stemmed from a weak connection to the consciousness imprisoned in Magrasea or its backups. Although the conscious mind may be inactive, it’s possible the subconscious mind or another base layer of consciousness still holds that link, even if it may be weak, leaving the physical body to remain a vessel, hung by a single, delicate thread somewhere. Alternatively, if Irida had been extracted successfully, then perhaps she remained in a medically-induced coma after surgery, with her brainwave activity still reverting back to her body. Regardless of the truth of her upload, there’s also reason to believe that she or others were responsible for the seeding of Entropy before or during the time of the Wipe Off Incident.

Although this relies heavily on the theory of Oberstein or his colleagues being associated with UL, the inherent similarities between Entropy and Parapluie-OGAS could be far more than just similarities - perhaps they’re the same thing, with Entropy being a precursor or test variant of the Parapluie. Theoretically, if Entropy is OGAS, then the isolation the backup server offers ensures that OGAS would be unable to escape the server, endangering the entire server and the greater connected networks. As Entropy is born from a seed that sprouts into the vibrantly purple flower, one must ask if Irida’s design and flower are more than just a coincidental design choice, directly or indirectly implicating her in Entropy’s evolution. Irida’s ties to the planned disconnection are apparent, but it lacks substance, namely what purpose she’d have to introduce Entropy; however, as the only person to ever glimpse Magrasea before the Commander, and the main proponent of Black Box Evolution Theory, seemingly tied to the development of third generation Neural Clouds, her involvement in the Magrasea backup is undeniable. As the representative of UL, the “Minister” persuaded the best they could to win over the other enterprises into supporting the mind-upload technology trials, with Dr. Tessier Winter at helm. Theoretically, if this Minister was actually Rudolf von Oberstein, then maybe Magrasea in 2060 was used as a testbed for the Parapluie Virus; after all, 2060 was one year prior to the Butterfly Incident, where Parapluie was deployed by William and Carter to wreak havoc across the SF laboratories, expose Elisa’s OGAS neural cloud, and eliminate Lycoris. Oberstein himself has all but been confirmed to be Paradeus’ former leader, serving as its “Father”, and now continues to back Paradeus through supporting Galatea. 

Potential Paradeus Precedent

The Intermediate-Ranking Sanctifiers, Crime and Punishment.

There’s a dark zone of information on UL’s founding; however, the company is said to be relatively young - stretching back approximately ten years - and rife with its share of controversy and stunning biomedical technology progress. From pharmaceutical research to medical AI research and cybernetics, it's no slouch in the field, even if it’s overshadowed by the other enterprises present in Neural Cloud. Interestingly, the Ascension Sector of Magrasea was founded to research and develop cybernetic prosthetics; additionally, it’s the setting of a confidential, collaborative neuroengineering project between UL and Svarog Heavy Industries, dedicated towards weaponized-prosthetics. Nothing ties this sector’s research to Paradeus, nor does it necessarily even allude to it, but the presence of cybernetic augmentations always brings Paradeus into the limelight, given their prosthetics are a consistent design motif seen in the Nytos and other foot soldiers. During Aberrance’s Chain, the Sanctifiers Crime and Punishment descended upon the sector to put an end to Ascension’s rogue project, the development of an artificial guiding god-like entity, originally meant to emulate humanity’s dominion, but devolved into the False God rampaging through the sector after Lind was planted in its Entropy-infused core. When the Sanctifiers arrived, many players noticed just how in-line they were with the Paradeus motif.

Even among the Sanctifiers, the intermediates Crime and Punishment, along with their combined Greater self, Judgment, are exceptions; sporting the common white and black motif present between the Black Lily and White Rose GAVIRUL subjects and the color scheme of Paradeus. Although both intermediates and the Greater are just Sanctifiers with no obvious contextual connection to Paradeus, all their designs bear distinct cybernetic designs: Sin wields two massive chains, similar to Nimogen and Mercurows, embedded in his forearm gauntlets, each chain’s length and speed controlled by an actuator mechanism; Punishment wields a scythe, similar to the White Nytos’ scythes, that can fold inwards, presumably for transportation and other means of combat or use; and Judgment is an deific, mechanical beast that bears the combined strengths and appearances of the intermediates into a single, great symbiosis. A common characteristic seen in both intermediates and Judgment is their cybernetic limbs and parts. In their concept artworks, both possess antipodal masks and augmented bodies with mechanical spines, with Punishment going a step beyond with fully-augmented legs and a brass-colored claw. Judgment has a yin-yang-like appearance, with equal representation of both intermediates, barring Punishment’s prominence in the head, as Crime was corrupted by entropy during Abberance’s Chain. Aberrance, as an aside, is the state of something being divergent or deviant from the norm, as if it were corrupted or had denied its prior purpose, possibly having double meaning in AC, both for the corruption of Crime and the divergence of the Ascension Sector’s purpose from its intended prosthetic research direction. At peak performance, Judgment transcends into a truly angelic appearance of holiness and darkness, where his left side body is that of Crime and its right is that of Punishment, each side wearing the mask of the opposite, and a radiant halo behind his head. Although none of this implicates Paradeus - not to mention, the cybernetic look is present in some other Sanctifiers, such as Love - or Oberstein with UltiLife, it feels like a rather pointed decision for the intermediates to share the Paradeus color and weapon motifs.

If UL truly is associated with Oberstein, Galatea, or Paradeus, perhaps part of Project Sanctifier’s development was influenced by UL, where the modern concepts of Nytos were tested, then this technology was implemented into the neural projections of Crime and Punishment. It’s a weak stretch, absolutely, but food for thought nonetheless. Like Crime, the combat Isomers Nimogen and Mercurows wielded hidden chains beneath their dresses, and like Punishment, the White Nytos’ main weapon is their massive white scythes. Perhaps the weaponized-prosthetics tested in Magrasea were a front to research the prosthetics for Paradeus, which include, but are not limited to: all Nytos’ augmented hands and legs, Gray’s embedded “mantis blades” and scorpion stinger, Grig’s wrist blades, and Morridow’s spider arms. Galatea and UL stand on the forefront of the intersection of biomedicine and technologies, yet there’s been no mention of the other in their respective games. UL’s relatively young age of about a decade could place its founding sometime between 90wish’s physical split in early 2049 to Oberstein’s cooperation with Meitner in Berlin, and with a possible connection to a figure only identified as “the Minister”, maybe UL is a separate Paradeus front for neuroengineering and biomedical research. Although Galatea is a massive pharmaceutical and biotechnology corporation with international reach, it’s not impossible that other enterprises have been infiltrated or are total Paradeus front companies to manage research and production. The lack of strong leads, however, means this is nothing for us but a cat chasing the vague tails of mice. It cannot be said for certain if the Minister is Oberstein, nor is there a direct tie-in between UL, Galatea, or Paradeus.

Returning to Magrasea, Malkira seemingly views herself as the sole supreme through Odile’s comment on the impossibility of two queens in a hive, but that begs to ask - where did Malkira come from? As Alpha matured into Demiurge, what first began as mass of mushy feelers gradually evolved into something that can only be described as a “biomechanical mass”, composed of these feelers and metallic components; though, it’s unclear if these mechanical pieces were artificial or not. Taranum could’ve transfixed parts from other agents and Sanctifiers on Alpha’s body as she matured, but if they’re not artificial, then it suggests Entropy, through an untold amount of time in Magrasea, evolves these Entropic “wires”, so to speak, to form this biomachine. Further, Entropy Liquid has been observed to physically transform its environment into an Entropic system, possibly similar to how OGAS overwrites a host’s neural structure to one that can properly cultivate an OGAS consciousness. Deep beneath the Copley sea, an Entropic hive had spread across the entire rock stratum and cavern, covering the rocks in a “nervous system” of this “lifeform”. Like a nervous system or mycelial network, the entire environment has become one through the terraforming of the ground, allowing the “system”, so to speak, to communicate across the entire ecosystem, detecting any anomaly that contacts any part. Similarly, the common Cocytus Entropic possesses the same biomechanical look - a cephlapod’s body structure meshed with metal, following the theme of Entropics taking on the form of aquatic life. 

Perhaps the appearance of Entropic infection and the High-Order Entropics is OGAS’ Neural Projection - the appearance of one’s self in Magrasea, based on the system’s best reflection of the subject’s mind. When someone is uploaded in Magrasea, the world they experience is generalized like a Doll processing information in their LVLII, where information is subconsciously inputted then processed. Even the Commander and Irida, whose consciousnesses were digitized into neural data, similar to the neural clouds of the PNC participants, have their own projections in Magrasea, with the male and female Commander taking on the appearance tangential to the 42Lab Professor, though not exact. Even the Dolls in Neural Cloud, before learning that the current Professor wasn’t Irida, were confused by the “Professor’s” appearance, generalizing it as nothing more than a new neural projection. As it’s alien to the server, Entropy’s sealife-like appearance could’ve derived from the program’s origin, somewhere outside the server, developed or discovered by the orchestrators of the PNC conspiracy. The aquatic characteristic is mostly consistent, even for Demiurge’s Entropics, who fall outside Malkira’s domain; and although it’s a stretch, if we assume Entropy is OGAS, which itself is theory, then perhaps OGAS’ projection in Magrasea emulates its self-image or its “Home”. During the Holy Grail Project in the United States Relic Agency, the Lake of Cognition was created or discovered by its project members, serving as the medium space for extracted memory fragments, aiming to explore the impact of the Relic Civilization on humanity. The structure of the Lake is itself the most pressing, relevant question to Entropy, as it’s unclear why the USRA determined a Lake was the proper structure to simulate Nirvana. Given Nirvana’s simulation in the form of a Lake, maybe Nirvana is perceived as an entire sea of consciousness by the embedded intelligences, namely OGAS and, possibly, the Source. When Angelia and Dreamer were pulled into the Lake, they felt their consciousness slowly sink beneath the waves, being slowly consumed by the electronic sea. But why would the Americans choose to study Nirvana in this manner? Unless Nirvana or the “Home” realm of the Source are genuinely conceptualized by us as a body of water, it’s unclear why they’d emulate this exotic form. With how alien Nirvana is us, perhaps the only way to envision this separate field or realm of consciousness is a sea of consciousness, using the infinite, abyssal sea to mimic the vast, blank whiteness of the Relic System in a manner that the current human mind can comprehend. OGAS, proclaimed to be divergent instances of the Source, could’ve taken on an aquatic form in Magrasea, given Nirvana might only be able to be interpreted as a sea of thought, unless the Source exists beyond Nirvana, in a sublime “place” of similar aspects.

Among the Entropics, many possess some aquatic element, such as the common Low-Order cephalopod-like Cocytus. Notably, the most exalted Entropics, Demiurge and Malkira, both possess elements of sea life in their design; though, Malkira is considerably more humanoid in shape, then again, she’s existed far longer than Demiurge, whose evolution was already stagnate beneath Copley. Both have the standard - albeit, much larger - feelers seen on common Entropics, but Malkira has the addition of a pair of jellyfish-like appendages comparable to devil horns on her head, also seen on Ptolomaea’s jellyfish Entropics. In Demiurge’s early development, she appears as a young girl rising from a mass of damaged Entropic feelers, and by her “biological” stage where she escaped her initial prison, the tendrils has grown far larger, in addition to hints of the transparent body of jellyfish or siphonophores. In the matured Malkira, these jellyfish-like “arms” have appear much denser, possessing blackened, barbed stingers on their ends, all arms converging on something akin to an infernal mantle that rests upon her shoulders, and with the addition of her developed tendrils, it’s certainly resonates with the concept of an imperious divine figure over an abyssal sea. Although irrelevant to the Nirvana-Lake concept - with the exception of the naming scheme of Zion (now Nirvana), the God-proclaimed Holy Land in ancient Jerusalem - one of Malkira’s predominant features is that of her tree-like halo or crown, likely symbolizing the tree network of Entropy and OGAS, but it may also symbolize the crown of thorns forcibly worn by Jesus upon his crucifixion, as well as the massive stakes driven through her hands, akin to those driven through Jesus. Similarly, Ptolomaea holds dominion over a number of Intermediate-Order jellyfish Entropics that command the Low-Orders, who collectively led the initial offensive against the Oasis in Perilous Advancement. The caveats to this theme are Caina and Antenora - two High-Order intelligent Entropics found in Tartarus with contrasting designs, especially Caina, who’s red scheme coincides with the elite or matured Entropics seen in various gameplay maps. Antenora sticks to the common purple-black color; however, both are noticeably more humanoid than Ptolomaea or Demiurge. Based on Entropy’s generally understood evolution, the red Entropics are considered the elite, matured forces having the longest development, while younger Entropic begin with the purple-black color scheme. Although she goes against the grain, perhaps Caina’s unique look can be explained by her being a past Sanctifier, corrupted by Entropy in the past.

Caina bears a striking resemblance to that of Raven - a Greater Sanctifier encountered in Cyclopes, who’d been infused with Entropy, which eventually was handed over to Ascension’s False God development by the Greater Eucharist. Given the Inner Ring’s Entropic pool is implied to be capable of raising both Entropics and Sanctifiers, maybe Caina is partially related to Raven, with both possibly being descendants of an ancient Sanctifier from what’s today Tartarus, with their Holy Canon used to birth them in their respective faction’s strongholds. The same might be able to be said for Antenora; though she diverges greatly from the rest. As the Exiles were nearing victory against Raven in Cyclopes, a mysterious, immense power overtook her, as if someone or something else had gained control of the body, causing her to start radiating a purple glow as she requisitioned operands from an unknown source. When Antonina tried scanning this possessed Raven, the consciousness comments that her ability to read the neural cloud data of others was reminiscent of “old friends”, and when asked what “her” aim was by the Professor, she responded in interesting, saying that she was looking forward to our upcoming journey to see how far we’ll go and the choices we’ll make. Later, she rhetorically asks the Professor what they’d do if they found themselves imprisoned “in a cage that you built by your own hands”, unable to find an exit or break free. There’s only two characters that question such ideas, with the third being a potential tertiary theory. After the failed assault on Tartarus in the past, Eosphorous abandoned his ideals and loyalty once Malkira’s perverse words had wrapped their feelers on his mind, not long after losing his closest friends in an ultimately meaningless struggle. In the darkest heart of the labyrinthine Entropic capital, the Inner Ring, Malkira wielded total mastery of the sector’s operands, allowing massive amounts of computational power to leverage Tartarus and her denizens. With victory close at hand, Eosphorous actually successfully slayed Malkira; however, at the eleventh hour, the Magrasea local system reverts the outcome, effectively preventing Malkira from being killed. Additionally, although Ptolomaea, Caina, and Antenora had been slain in the battles leading to the final confrontation, Malkira granted rebirth to her fallen captains, raising them from the grave from a pool of Entropy Liquid. No matter what Eosphorous could do, no matter his choice, the system always rolled back the killing blow, leaving them without a winner. 

With victory as an obvious impossibility, along with the implications that this conflict is doomed to echo forever without a clear winner, Malkira’s recognition that their world was nothing but an antiquated prison wearing the veneer of a digital society, Eosphorous came to the same conclusion. If the path of war was futile by fate, then what purpose was there to continue struggling for their Gods in a world abandoned by said masters? When the entity possessed Raven, it began siphoning an incalculable amount of operands, causing the body to glow purple; speaking in vague tones that sounded with precognition, as if the entity knew what was to come. In her final words in Cyclopes, she added that she’ll be watching the Exiles “from the peak of the spiral”, possibly alluding to the Sanctifier’s Reverse Tower of Babylon or the Entropic Inner Ring. Both Malkira and Eosphorous have realized their imprisonment, with the former even killing her Entropic counterpart early in her development to preserve her dominion and to ensure Demiurge wouldn’t come to suffer the realization that by escaping the Copley research station, she had only found herself in a more grandiose prison. Without humanity’s oversight, there’s clearly no hope for the duplicate intelligences within, dooming them to live in false servitude to Gods that have long-since abandoned them. When Raven was taken over, it’s possible either Eosphorous or Malkira had supplanted her as Entropy took control of her core. She did add that it was a shame for a Greater to fall to such defeat, so perhaps it was Eosphorous, given his holiness over the Sanctifiers. However, the third possibility is just as interesting: Irida. Uploaded to the server in 2060 - either her consciousness being duplicated to the backup around the time of the Wipe Off; or directly to the backup after the incident. 

With Iridia’s research notes into Black Box Evolution Theory, possibly aiming towards the forced evolution of a Doll's mental model to that of third generation neural cloud, several snippets reference using Magrasea as an evolutionary testbed for three real-life years. Conveniently, this is the same amount of time between Irida’s emergency surgery and the beginning of the Commander’s investigation with Persica. Two of the theory’s main conditions were a slow evolution, roughly three years, and the calculus power to conduct such an experiment, questioning if a “large-scale platform” was the answer. Irida’s fate, despite being the most important character to Neural Cloud’s overarching plot, remains a mystery, but her experiment was clearly tied to the disconnection of Magrasea in some way, whether it be with her consent or not. After all, Antonina received the Neural Cocoons from an unknown, external source just before the Wipe Off Incident, the event that saw their first and only use on a massive scale, where the Dolls of the Neural Cloud Sector had their data partitioned to fit into their Neural Cocoons in time before the format. These Neural Cocoons were spread across Magrasea, unnoticed by the roaming Sanctifiers and other agents because of their near-imperceptibility, allowing for them to stay isolated for those three real life years - much, much longer than that in Magrasea itself. Lastly, in the conditions required to test her hypothesis, she needed a way to observe the Dolls’ evolution after the massively-dilated time in Magrasea. What better option was there for her than uploading herself, possibly in secret, to have part of her consciousness hidden away as she waited for the process to unfold? 

The “Oasis”, as it’s known by the Exiles today, was formerly Professor Irida’s personal sector for research and observation, so perhaps she originally wished to use it as the staging area of her studies. When the Commander awakened in Magrasea, they used Irida’s authorizations to become “the Professor”, allowing access to the Oasis, where they first became conscious of their surroundings as the Sanctifiers were launching an attack. But if Irida remains somewhere in the server, where did she go, and what has she done all this time? Three years in real life could mean generations in Magrasea, and like Malkira and Eosphorous, she’d eventually find herself locked in this digital prison, unable to log out of the backup server. Even if, say, the active consciousness was possibly uploaded to the original server, her consciousness would’ve been duplicated into the backup, assuming the disconnection occurred in late September 2060. Perhaps the UL’s patient data on her had unknowingly recorded her brain’s loose connection to the duplicated self in the backup; however, that’s a stretch with little evidence but theories on how Nirvana may allow for consciousness to piggyback space-time, or it could just be a side effect of UL’s CDI on the brain. Regardless, if Irida has remained somewhere in the backup server, then she too is no different than everyone else. A prisoner of a digital reality until they find the exit or a savior discovers their eternal limbo, guiding them on the path towards escape.

The Study of Entropy
Discovering Irida’s whereabouts was one of the Commander’s key objectives assigned by Dr. Persicaria, yet we haven’t yet actually found any strong lead on a potential location. If she’s truly imprisoned, then perhaps she’s awaiting the arrival of an aforementioned savior, with the CLR Event message serving as a contingency three years later; alternatively, she’s found herself abandoned like the rest, and the only path forward is in line with Malkira and Eosphorous. Theoretically, albeit weakly, Irida could’ve established contact with these two at some point in this past, and like the entity that possessed Raven, only someone with exceptional authorizations could expend such drastic operand amounts, pointing towards a few suspects. Perhaps what possessed Raven wasn’t either the Lord of Sanctifiers or the Goddess of Entropy, but the original Professor of Project Neural Cloud, using an Entropic core as a means to establish the connection. If this is the case, then that would require Irida to know of Entropy and have a certain level of control over its direction, enough so to target a specific Greater Sanctifier, then again, she was the former PNC supervisor, so none would have greater access than her. Tangentially related, the Boss of Arcadia - a separate sector for Exiled Dolls and Agents, including its Guardians: De Lacey, Sueyoi, Hatsuchiri, Lind, and Havoc - has show prior intrigue about the Professor (Commander), so perhaps they’re actually Irida, using her PNC authorizations to found or leverage the creation of what’s today Arcadia. Alternatively, and most esoterically, maybe Irida is also responsible for Entropy, even going as far as being connected to the confidential study of Alpha in Copley and unknown origins of Malkira.

During Divine Heresy, an unknown individual contacted Malkira with a Black Goat in the Null Zone, seemingly a special neural projection program that allows for encrypted communications between two parties. Notably, Eosphorous is the only known individual to use these Black Goats, as previously seen during AC, where Hesperus contacted Eosphorous from the Taratarus. After Odile had completed her mission and Love had reset Copley Sector, the other party asked Malkira her reasoning for dispatching Odile. The violent circumstances previously required forceful Sanctifier intervention, worrying the other party that Malkira was potentially overstepping her boundaries, which she replied was only a necessity. Anything that challenged the one-Arbiter “rule”, so to speak, was abnormal and a source of potential danger for both parties, given that Demiurge could’ve escaped, which would inevitably trigger a violent containment breach across the server. As the true Arbiter at the top of the tree network, Malkira senses all Entropy serverwide, yet such a high-ranking leader alien to her was unnerving, requiring her to force her hand, even if it attracted the full attention of the Reverse Tower. When speaking to her partner, she asked for honesty if they had any connection to Taranum’s abnormal research. Notably, the Alpha research notes stretched back to 2060, but the rewrite program was introduced later, pushing Taranum’s experiment to readjust its parameters, so as to possibly increase Demiurge’s abilities. Whoever was responsible, it seemed they wished to direct Demiurge’s evolution towards creating a Entropic power equivalent to Malkira, possibly even aiming to supplant her. By decapitating the greatest threat to her arbitership, Malkira consolidated her position over the Entropics, but the party responsible for the rewrite program remains at large. Although she trusted the other party on the communication, she was no fool, taking their word that Taranum had simply walked a false path; however, this is only partially true, plus Malkira never learned of the research notes beneath Copley, meaning much about the origins of the Alpha study, the timing of the rewrite, and the subsequent forced evolution of Demiurge remains vague to her. Interestingly, their conversation was communicated across the server through a Black Goat - the same Black Goat that Eosphorous and Hesperus spoke through at the end of AC. To be fair, the unknown party, theoretically Eosphrous, leaving out the rewrite program detail doesn’t implicate them outright, as they, too, may have known nothing about what was festering beneath Copley sea. Regardless, the situation’s outcome stood to benefit both parties, as Demiurge was eliminated and the Sanctifiers and Exiles were there to clean up the mess, collectively preventing the rise of a rogue Entropic faction.

The party’s two callers were said to share a respectful partnership, neither outright interfering with the affairs of the other, but there was always the possibility of either side exploiting the partnership for their own aims. So who is this “other party”? Regarding Malkira, there are only three potentials suspects: Eosphorous, Malkira’s true Sanctifier counterpart that gave up the sword once Magrasea’s depressing truth had set in; Eucharist, a Greater Sanctifier, based on the former “Alcyone”, loyal to the Eosphorous faction, who maintained a partnership with Malkira following their battle; or alternatively, Professor Irida: the former supervisor of Project Neural Cloud, first human to upload themself to Magrasea, and possible mastermind of the entire Magrasea backup server. All the events of Neural Cloud play out on a virtual stage, one believed to have been intentionally created by Irida herself or a group within 42Lab, likely as a means to test her Black Box Evolution Theory in isolation for a period of three years, allowing for the Dolls’ neural models to slowly evolve in a specialized programs called Neural Cocoons. These programs were mysteriously gifted to Antonina just before the Wipe Off Incident, which led to the displacement of the original Neural Cloud Sector and the forced exile of all the Dolls partaking in the experiment, possibly including Irida herself. The Sector Administrator of Burbank, Meryl, was uploaded by her human lover just before the backup was made, known as the disconnection, indicating that multiple 42Lab employees were aware of this confidential test. 

At roughly the same time, a High-Order Entropy seed was planted deep beneath Copley, and Taranum’s presumed previous human supervisor assigned her to a secret experiment regarding the sprouting and evolution of Alpha; meanwhile, another High-Order was evolving in another corner of the server, Malkira of Tartarus Sector. Given the presence of research files on Alpha going back to at least 2060, Entropy has been present in Magrasea for far longer than our first encounters in 2063. Although it’s unclear if the Entropic research was occurring before the backup was made, the Magrasean System has recognized Malkira as a necessary “Arbiter”, holding total rule over the Entropics beneath her position in the Entropic top-down tree-like network, similar to the functions of OGAS in the former Soviet Union and the Sangvis Ferri network protocol. Alpha’s existence and externality to the “Malkiraen” network points to the responsible party implanting the origin of Entropy into the server before or after the disconnection. Given strong implications that the backup is a stage, and that the system mandates that Eosphorous and Malkira cannot be extinguished, the puppeteer has seemingly orchestrated a digital war towards a currently-unknown goal. 

In another region of Magrasea, there exists a stronghold known as “Arcadia”, managed by an unnamed “Boss”, who oversees the “Guardians”, an Arcadian organization believed to be an equivalent to the Oasis’ Exiles, comprised of the former PNC Dolls Hatsuchiri, Sueyoi, De Lacey, Lind, and Havoc, as well as whoever else has yet to enter the fold. At the end of AC, Suyeoi contacts the Boss for debriefing, informing them that the “target” hadn’t been located among any of Ascension’s agents. In exchange for the Elaugh’s, the sector administrator, authorizations over the sector, the Boss guaranteed Ascension’s defense through Arcadia, but remained fascinated by Ascension’s deduction from creating a “human” to a God, leading the Boss to ponder. In thought, they questioned that “If we cannot find one, then why should we not make one”, adding that “you lot” - possibly referring to Ascension, Oasis, or the Sanctifiers - owed Arcadia many favors - all alluding to emulating Ascension’s False God experiment, wherein they aimed to create a guiding figure in absence of their human masters. While true that they could’ve been alluding to the Oasis or Sanctifiers, but in the context of AC and the prior conversation with Sueyoi, the Guardian’s target was seemingly related to the research conducted in Ascension; though, the lack of conciseness blurs the answer. Taking the Boss’ words at face value suggests that they’re not human, as they are considering making their own, so their identity is likely not that of Irida. If so, then who’s the Boss, and what - or rather, who - are they searching for? 

When Exiles had awoken from their Neural Cocoons, they made their way to the what’s today the Oasis, Irida’s independent sector, mentioned in spare research notes. It’s unclear when Arcadia formed, but its Guardians must’ve left their cocoons after the same period, coming to or establishing Arcadia around the same time as the Exiles arrival in the Oasis. If Arcadia was a new sector established afterwards, then it points to this enigmatic Boss possessing the same authorizations as Professor Irida and the Commander; however, considering the Boss likely isn’t a human, it throws a wrench in that theory. With the wider picture still unveiling itself, perhaps only a human possesses the ability to create the “exit” for the Magrasea data to log out, potentially allowing the Dolls and, by extension, Eosphorous and Malkira to escape. Apart from discovering the fate of Irida, the primary goal of the Commander’s mission into Magrasea was to save the Dolls still trapped in the backup, regardless of the entailing implications of two independent, duplicate minds. 

The Project Neural Cloud Conspiracy
What first caught Dr. Persicaria’s interest was a strange message embedded in an email between IOP and G&K in 2062; within, the unknown party left an audio file titled “CLR Event”. 

“My apologies for intercepting your mail. I have no choice. They hide everything. Someone sacrificed life. Doll's memories are erased. And we are not allowed to say anything. There is a conspiracy of NC test. The keyword is CLR Event. Please find the truth and save all of us.”

    • CLR Event message, discovered 2062
 
At the end of the audio file, a message played, and when displayed on a spectrogram, it read, “project: sanctifier”. For whoever the sender was, they were certainly related to 42Lab or UltiLife, given they seem to be aware of the suspicious circumstances behind the scenes of PNC. A group within what’s believed to be 42Lab or one of its corporate partners had conspired to deliberately cover up everything on the project, with the involved Dolls having memories deleted and someone having been sacrificed. The keyword to all this was something known as the “CLR Event”, which may be a possibly lost-in-translation form of the Zeroing/Wipe Off Incident, but that’s merely a guess. On the other hand, if the CLR Event is not a reference to the Wipe Off, then something else occurred in 42Lab during the project period, something that Irida likely was implicated in, perhaps having even been the supposed sacrificial individual. There’s already ample evidence of a greater conspiracy at play in 42Lab - from UltiLife’s mind upload trials to the disconnection of Magrasea as a potential means to study Irida’s theory and the Entropy Virus. Meryl’s lover, seemingly a project member related to 42Lab’s PNC or another confidential project, knew that the disconnection was coming, and the plurality of the CLR Event’s sender implies that several were attached to this wider conspiracy. All the following is mere theory, so part or all may not hold up in the future. Perhaps PNC was a multi-faceted project, exploited by those attached to it for unconfirmed goals, which may include: Irida’s theory, which used a disconnected Magrasea backup to study the evolution of Dolls’ neural cloud, seemingly towards realizing the first 3rd Generation Neural Cloud; the study of Entropy, an AI Virus with characteristics remarkably similar to the OGAS algorithm, possibly first implanted by a Paradeus-affiliate group, theoretically UL, to test the Parapluie Virus and OGAS; and the cooperation agreement between UL and 42Lab, first initiated to facilitate a test of the former’s experimental Consciousness Digitization Interface, which could’ve derived from Paradeus or its precursor’s mind-upload technology for the memory fragments uploaded into the Lake of Cognition in the ongoing Hela Project. 

There’s no argument that PNC was an actual project being conducted in 42Lab, that much is true; however, it remains to be seen what purpose 42Lab would have for manufacturing an isolated stage for everything listed above, unless PNC simply granted cover for the responsible party’s true goal. After all, the lord of the AI Virus, Malkira was unable to be purged from the server, as if her existence were mandated by the puppeteers behind the backup server, who inputted system restrictions on certain actions that interfered with this overall experiment. Although the PNC’s expressed goal was the creation of the neural cloud backup system for 2nd Generation Neural Clouds, Irida’s theory points to the development of the 3rd, wherein the subject Dolls possess completely agency over their decision-making, rather than a pre-defined, deterministic set of base commands programmed into their LVLIII Base Layer. In her past findings, when the neural model was active, potential anomalies were triggered, so she needed a way for these Dolls to enter hibernation, preventing them from awakening before the three-year real time period, and without being unintentionally purged by Magrasea’s AI-Antivirus security, the Sanctifiers. At some point during PNC, the server was planned to be disconnected, seemingly part of Irida’s way of studying her theory in isolation; meanwhile, someone related to the Entropy introduced the initial seeds sometime before or after the disconnection, possibly in secret or in tandem with the wider conspiracy of PNC. Presumably around the time or just before the disconnection, disaster struck the Neural Cloud Sector, requiring the sector to be reformatted, implying all those inside would have their memories wiped if they failed to escape. Coincidentally, the Neural Cocoons were anonymously sent to PNC’s Antonina just before the incident, only for them to immediately see use to save the Dolls during the Wipe Off Incident. The lack of time meant Antonina had to fragment everyone’s neural clouds to move them inside their cocoons in time, then cast them across Magrasea, exiling them from the Neural Cloud Sector, which itself had been dislocated, with its current location still unknown, assuming it wasn’t deleted outright in the backup. Through isolation, Irida would ensure the Dolls’ Neural Cocoons would go unheeded by Sanctifier security and the wider 42Lab staff, unless they were implicated as well, possibly in tandem with UltiLife, who were responsible for PNC’s respective mind-upload interface. While the timeline is incomplete, perhaps the Wipe Off Incident was exclusive to the backup, extracted by 42Lab prior to Irida’s upload.

If the Wipe Off was planned, which certainly seems to be case, then one such sequence of events was: first, Project Neural Cloud was initiated in 42Lab around late September 2060; possibly second, Irida and the other 42Lab staff backed up the server to an isolated instance; possibly third, Irida uploaded herself or was forcibly uploaded through UL’s CDI, with the UL Dr. Tessier Winter perhaps as the overseer; possibly fourth, Entropy was seeded across Magrasea, with one beneath Copley and, possibly, another in the perplexing Taratarus sector. Admittedly, this sequence likely isn’t correct, and there’s absolutely issues with this belief, such as, but not limited to: Irida’s unknown location, including if she uploaded voluntarily; the reasoning behind the backup in the first place, given the backup’s externality to Project Neural Cloud, along with bizarre circumstances of Entropy’s introduction; why the digital war between the Sanctifiers and Malkira must continue; whether or not Entropy is OGAS, which would unweave much of this theory if not; and the fact that this entire concept, like others related to Paradeus, lives and dies on the theoretical basis of Paradeus having some link with Magrasea, with the Minister, possibly Oberstein, being the primary intermediate between UL and 42Lab. Additionally, there’s the question on the purpose of why Entropy would be studied in isolation; yes, isolation would ensure the virus couldn’t break containment and endanger 42Lab’s systems, but if the purpose of its introduction was to test Parapluie, then there’s no obvious way William would have access to the backup, unless UL is implicated with Paradeus, in which case, maybe the mind-upload trial by Winter allowed for interested parties to obtain data on the virus before the Butterfly Incident in 2061.

An exact date has never been established for Operation Butterfly, but in the context of Anna’s supposed memories in her time in G&K, she was commanding Griffin Dolls against SF through the second half of 2061, seemingly losing her left arm during a confrontation with Agent that year, considering her comment that she once faced another Commander, specified female, in a similar situation to that between herself and the Commander during Singularity. If Entropy’s introduction was to test the Parapluie Virus, assuming Entropy is OGAS, then Paradeus or Carter must’ve tried to seize the evidence from the backup prior to Butterfly; however, it’s also reasonable that the secret research into Entropy stretched back before PNC, implying either an earlier Paradeus involvement or the relevant research already having been gathered by 2060, eventually leading “UMP40” and “UMP45” being designated as Parapluie’s deployers in Butterfly. There’s far from enough evidence to say Paradeus had a hand in PNC, nor is there enough to say Entropy even is OGAS, but the peculiar similarities of UL’s technologies and research to the Paradeus and Oberstein’s objectives hold some merit; the intricacies lack substantive evidence, but at minimum, UL certainly had a hand in PNC, namely their CDI, which transplanted someone’s memory fragments into the server, possibly akin to however the Hela Subjects have their memory fragments transferred to the Lake. Perhaps the appearance of Entropic infection and the High-Order Entropics is OGAS’ Neural Projection - the appearance of one’s self in Magrasea, based on the system’s best reflection of the subject’s mind. If the United States Relic Agency simulated Nirvana in the form of a Lake, then maybe the original Nirvana is perceived as an entire sea of consciousness by the embedded intelligences, namely OGAS and, possibly, the Source.

Notably, we don’t know when Entropy was introduced, nor the real time date of Taranum initiated her Entropic study, along with unknown third party implanting a rewrite program in her neural cloud. Hypothetically, if the Entropy-OGAS study was launched prior to the disconnection, implying that someone wished to quietly test its evolution, then the mysterious figure that overrode Taranum could’ve had two, possibly mutual, goals - the first, being to extract relevant data or information on Entropic development several weeks or months after the initial Project period; and the second, being to force Demiurge’s evolution so as to defy Malkira’s server-defined Arbitership through the introduction of a second High-Order that possessed the same authorizations. Given that the initial Alpha study stretched back to three years ago in real time, it seems unlikely that it was Eosphorous responsible, as the events of Entropic Dichotomy and its outcome likely hadn’t yet occurred; however, it does not vindicate him from being responsible for the rewrite program, as few would possess such authorizations over a Sector Administrator. The only individuals capable of such would be the Professors, some Greater Sanctifiers, or the Lords of the Reverse Tower, so if not Eosphorus, then who? If Eosphorous was guilty, then he must’ve learned of Alpha’s existence some time prior, yet none have been hinted to know of Copley’s secret, aside from Taranum herself; even Malkira was confused by the sudden fellow arbiter’s signals, so if he was responsible, then he must’ve caught wind of the Alpha experiment in the past. On the other hand, if Irida was responsible, then she may have known or had been directly involved in the Entropy study, possibly created by her and others in secret as another function of her Black Box Evolution Theory experiment. As said before, almost everything on the connections between PNC and Paradeus rest solely on the idea of a theory that Paradeus actually was involved, and with generalized, circumstantial evidence only, this is nothing but theory.

Unitas and Eschaton - 2047-2092?


All of this is to conclusively illustrate the probable inspiration for MICA’s universal worldview: the collective construct that is Nirvana, the Source, Nyto telepathy, clairvoyance, and the transcendence of consciousness from the physical realm to the higher informational sphere, external to perception. If William truly was the subject of Meitner’s final surgery, could it be that he’s “ascended” beyond the barrier of death - that is to say, an individual collective unconsciousness that binds each partitioned instance of his mind, thus averting death as long as this collective and at least one instance exists? It’s a fantastical hypothetical, yes, but this theory is demonstrated among the Estonian subjects, whose consciousnesses could resonate in the Inverted Forest - possibly a neural cloud space generated amidst them or a separate sphere of consciousness, adjacent to the Lake or Nirvana; proof of this “emotional induction” phenomenon and collective communication demonstrates Meitner’s theory is sound, but with so few subjects and issues brought about by rejection, the execution of this theory needs to be refined. Similar to how Nyto technology was gradually honed from initial the Frankensteinian beasts of spliced metal and flesh to precise clones of nearly-stabilized artificial consciousnesses, so too could the theory of unconsciousness, enabling shared cognition via the observed “telepathy” between the Estonian subjects. Apart from theoreticals on collective un/consciousness, some aspects of Theosophy and Anthroposophy resonate with Paradeus’ aspirations; literally translating from Latin as "Prepare for God" or "[For] God, you prepare", Paradeus walks the promised pathway of wisdom, unity, and victory, attaining “divine” knowledge from the Relics and the intangible.

 A conceptual understanding of Nirvana - likely through the transcendence of the consciousness, akin M4A1, Elisa, and the OGAS consciousnesses mentally entering Nirvana through the Starfish’s partial activation - is surely inevitable, as the study of realm and its phenomenon have been a field of Relic research since at least 2047. In communion with the Relics, a chance at revelations presents itself, but to enter Nirvana and beyond, they demand a specific immune human with an OGAS consciousness to activate and pass through the ethereal barrier, entering the Nirvana - the informational field external to our perception, time, and space, acting as an additional dimension, possibly a “Noosphere”, or “conscious” sphere of the physical universe. Succinctly, Nirvana may be polysemous of an informational sphere of humanity and ascendent plane of consciousness - external, yet omnipresent, over all things. And through Steiner’s described innate “faculties”, humanity too is destined to transcend into Nirvana or amass an eternal wealth of knowledge from within by proxy. Crucial to understanding Paradeus’ objective and modus operandi is a simple question on William: “If reviving Lunasia is William’s life goal, then why are all of his actions directed at the activation of the Relics?”

Although not alone in this chase, it was William who orchestrated the maturation and deployment of the OGAS key into the Starfish, successfully activating the Relic and vindicating the Reverse Collapse phenomenon. Paradeus possesses the capacity to replicate Lunasia - cloning and consciousness synthesis have been refined by the 2060s, yet some metric remains unfulfilled. Lunasia’s body has already been cloned, and her digitized consciousness was the blueprint of M4A1, Elisa, and the Estonian subjects, complicating William’s reasoning in his quest; moreover, Nemhran and William only seemed to recognize Lunasia’s faithful return through the M4A1-Lunasia entity, as if the coalescence of all OGAS consciousnesses and a communion with the Voices of Nirvana brought about this entity. Nemhran and William’s reverence of the entity’s passage into Dandelion suggests she is very much that of Lunasia, at least partially; therefore, the routine Hela experiments presumably responsible for Lunasia’s death must’ve pertained to Nirvana, possibly the Source as well, for the actions of the Obersteins demonstrate that of which they seek is no longer of our world. A parallel thread between Theosophy and Paradeus is the concept of accessing and ascertaining the intangible, and although specifics may differ, by reaching into their respective ascendent planes, one communes with a deific force, entity, or reality. In Steiner’s Anthroposophy, he asserts human consciousness is external to the material, and through study and commune with the spirit, one’s self can ascend through to the edge of Arupa, perhaps glimpsing the Akashic Records, returning guiding visions to the individual. Given all is embedded in Akasha, eternally written as cosmic canon, the principles retained are reflections of ourselves on our paths in the material plane, as all things are connected through our imprints on reality, invariably compelling us to others and the world we’re meant to interact - a core tenet of Anthroposophy. This spiritual monism, or oneness with everything above and below, posits existence’s synonymousness, with all Arupa continuously evolving the omnipresent Akasha, as oneness is cosmic order.

Monist belief and spiritualism are shared between the heart of Paradeus and its extrinsic zealots, and nowhere else is this better illustrated in Girls Frontline 1 than the Flora Institute. Tracking a lead on the Boxes of Iaso, cross-referenced by Witkin’s intelligence officials, Angelia and DEFY were given coordinates to the Flora Botanical Research Institute in Bremen, believing it to be the source of the Epiphyllum embedded in these radiological weapons. Notably, RPK16 also handled communications for the team during their official investigation, perhaps another example of RPK16’s contact with her Promethean backers, having received and decrypted intelligence from Witkin’s circle. After meeting with Morridow and Hopps at the Institute, they were welcomed by Senior Research Leone Michel, a specialist of herbaceous plants in the greenhouses and partner of Gray and Paradeus. When asked of her research aims by Angelia, Michel elaborated that much of her work was relevant to the “propagation and mutation of plants”, as certain plants have adapted to the Contaminated Zones, improving their resistance to radiation; for example, the Epiphyllum oxypetalum “queen-of-the-night” epiphyllums are naturally resistance, coexisting where most life would fail. It’s this coexistence that’s the essence of her study, hoping to “find our future” - spoken literally, as flora are harmonious in nature, and if humanity ever wished to rise above that brought the old world order’s twilight years, they too must live harmoniously. In a later short exchange, Angelia questioned the amount of capital flowing into a simple botanical research institute, to which Morridow - a Nyto and adherent of Paradeus - claimed our virtues were above sheer pragmatism, and if we’re to study this natural harmony, what we’d find in flowers is hope - hope for humanity and the world. Ever since first contact, Paradeus’ slaves have sung praises of the coming brave new world their belief will usher in, likely founded on Paradeus-Galatea’s principles of improving humanity through transhumanism, biomedicine, and the excision of that which is inimical to this harmony: the systems and people that brought the old world to its sorrowful state. Tangentially, while secured to Gray’s operating table later in MS, Angelia asked if Gray’s “teacher” ingrained these ideals in her, to which Gray replied that her teacher held Angelia in “extremely high regard” - apparently the reason Gray even engaged with Angelia directly. When asked about this “teacher’s” identity, Gray said she and Angelia had spent a “wonderful time in each other’s company”, recollecting those days “with great fondness” and hopeful of a reunion; however, this teacher did add that if Angelia grew too much of a problem, Gray could forgo forbearance. While factual, although Angelia guessed Gray’s teacher was Morridow, there may have been polysemous references to both Morridow and Meitner; despite Gray telling Angelia not to speak of Morridow’s name, her past with Meitner absolutely resonates in all of Gray’s responses, as Gray herself was the embodiment of the Demon’s sanguine ingenuity over her once best friend.

The teachings of Paradeus have permeated the destitute - the refugees in Estonia and Bohnsdorf Village radicals, for example. Paradeus’ heart in the Dead Sea was isolated from its umbrella - various cults and independent, puppeteered parties facilitating its operations - but many firmly entrusted themselves to Paradeus-Galatea’s ideals in desperation, kneeling to their masters’ commandments; additionally, Bohnsdorf’s foundation was directly supported by Galatea, who provided capital, aid, labor, and the education needed to maintain their community. Under chieftess Elia, the village was a refuge, accepting of those fellow downtrodden, as long as they followed the collective and Elia, established on the principle of primitivism, abandoning the old world for a return to the natural order, driven by those disillusioned by a facade of “escaping reality”, believing the past would free humanity of its modern sins; of course, egoism and avarice cannot so easily be expunged from humanity, as sin itself is innate. Ironically, for a community entrenched in primitivism, rejecting modern technologies that supposedly brought the world to ruin, their loyalty to Galatea is obviously hypocritical, yet as Schwaben told Angelia in Estonia, “there’s a market for this kind of cheap salvation”, selling their souls to powers above them just to survive a bit longer. While not compliant with all aforementioned ideals of Paradeus-Galatea, namely their rejection of modern technologies, their aspired return to a natural order in which all things are supposedly in harmony with God certainly resonates with the concept of unity shared by the Flora Institute cult. Tangentially, an unexplained aspect of Bohnsdorf is its restricted zone, described by the disguised Dandelion as a meeting place for the wealthy, sequestered from the villagers behind cameras and one-way mirrors, as if observing lab rats, and upon Machlian’s appearance, an auction behind closed doors erupted, offering all they had for time with the village’s “saint”. When the Commander saved Machlian from the desperate horde, one of the rich men stated that Elia needed to intervene, or else risk “your future sponsorship”, suggesting the local wealthy traveled to the village for the saint’s services, curing them of their ailments with her Holy blood; moreover, Paradeus forces were embedded in or near the village, as if awaiting the arrival of an enemy or serving as the village’s security, possibly hinting that Machlian’s “escape” was artificial, cyclically finding deliverance in Galatea’s own territory. Considering Paradeus-Galatea’s subterranean facilities, those beneath Berlin Prison and the Dead Sea, the Truman Show-esque theater over Bohnsdorf may hide another facility, imperceptible to the AR Team and Dandelion’s scans.


The “Saint” of Bohnsdorf Village, Machlian, is welcomed with praise by the commune.

The latest, most overt example of “harmony” or “unity” as fundamental to Paradeus teachings stems from currently-limited knowledge in Exilium on the rogue zealots in the Yellow Zone. This enigmatic cult seemingly communes exclusively in the Yellow Zone, well beyond society’s prying eyes, and in the game files, they’re listed as “Unitas”, sometimes shortened to just “U”. Their beliefs are self-evident in the name itself, as unitas is Latin, literally translating as “unity”, “united as one”, or “oneness”. Although little is yet understood about this group, they seem extrinsic to the Paradeus heart , with William or Meitner disconnected to their activities, but the root of their filename signifies “Paradeusian”, if you will, principle. With the Relics and Nirvana central to Paradeus’ existence, tantamount to the “adepts” in Blavatskian belief that guide humanity’s collective ascension, perhaps unitas symbolizes the very same harmony practiced by the Flora and Bohnsdorf cultists, aspiring humanity’s collective passage into Paradeus’ envisioned new world, founded on the basis of transhumanist consciousness - that is to say, the abandonment of our mortal bodies, coalescing the collective in alignment with the “cosmic oneness”. Notably, as you may have already guessed, Helena Blavatsky’s and Rudolf Steiner’s names are the same as the predominant Obersteins: Helena von Oberstein - a group of test subjects born from Helena’s DNA, possibly a subject herself in a Beaconist or later Paradeus experiment; and Rudolf von Oberstein - the original Father of Paradeus. According to the Flora cultists, plants live harmoniously - the foundation of their belief - and among the Unitas cultists, similar reverence is given to resistant-Epiphyllum, or as the Isomer-OGAS consciousness possessing Nimogen in Shattered Connexion called them, “the divine flowers”.

Once Olympus’ gift is opened, unveiling the reality of the Relic Network, we may tread through the gates of that cryptic realm via consciousness, possibly to the Source itself. Consciousness is a facet of Paradeus’ ambitions, given the implantation of OGAS seeds in neurally-supportive environments, particularly immunes, are fundamental to their objective of activating the Relics, often achieved through the development of synthesized, petri dish consciousnesses. With “unity” intrinsic to belief, the ultimate objective of Paradeus in the material plane is to create a collective un/consciousness of humanity, uniformly worthy of its divine knowledge; however, this theory begs an essential question: “How does this correlate to William and Lunasia?” From the perspective of the spiritualism that seemingly inspired Paradeus, the Source or “Home” may be the answer to Lunasia’s Hela experiments, her absence from the Lake, and the reformation of her soul through M4A1 and Nirvana. Theoretically, if the M4A1-Lunasia entity was traversing the Alaya-Vijnana of Lunasia or existence itself, corrupted by Paradeus’ dream, could it be that the Source is tantamount to the Akashic Records, with the Source entity of OGAS representing a cosmic “recordkeeper”, intrinsic to existence or created by a truly godlike civilization? All is subservient to one who wields divine power, but to attain such strength - that which William spoke of over a meal with his “mother” - requires humanity to unlock the Relics and the Source; however, through the Parapluie Virus, created or discovered by Paradeus, the collective consciousness of the Source was partitioned into individual “seeds” in our world, akin to the karmic seeds of Alaya (Akasha) in the Alaya-Vijnana, commonly interpreted as a field or “sea” of this cosmic energy. When Meitner appeared on Oberstein’s radar, he recommended her talents to the group, likely Paradeus or an ancestor branch of Galatea, with great praise, believing her background in the USRA’s Holy Grail Project as advantageous to their plan, implying her research of Nirvana and transfer of consciousness was paramount to Oberstein and his colleagues. In which case, the activation of the Relics and the realization of Nirvana were an element of Paradeus since its formation, and furthermore, if Home or the Source can be ascertained as equivalent to the cosmic record, could Machlian and the Commander’s precognitions and William’s impeccable foresight be echoes from the Records, reflecting themselves in worlds or times that hadn’t passed in our specific physical realm? Both Machlian and the Commander experienced these precognitions amid sleep, possibly pervading their subconsciousnesses amid rest, revealing glimpses of the records of other possibilities, akin to Jefuty’s shared consciousness among individual instances. Therefore, Paradeus or a discovered mechanism dubbed “Parapluie”, as well as the statements of the OGAS consciousnesses, have demonstrated the possibility of interacting with this Source entity; moreover, the Voices of Nirvana spoke as if “Home” and “the Source” are abstracted, possibly alluding to the Source collective consciousness eternally slumbering in its Home dimension, supposedly “corrupted” and “long since been destroyed.” If this entity were to awaken, likely from Paradeus’ “ill-considered intervention” in Nirvana, then it may be the origin of the eschaton - the world’s final destructive judgment discussed between Ouska and Jefuty. 

Returning to the unspecific laboratory, assuming William was Meitner’s subject (possibly even conducted on herself as well), then this hypothetical collective unconsciousness would be a pivotal step towards unitas, ideologically and literally molding human consciousnesses together into a singular mold, though William’s collective would likely be exclusive to his interconnected instances, partitioning his greater will across multiple individuals. Similar to the Isomer phenomenon, consciously-linked beings may possess the faculty of telepathy, enabling metaphysical communication, not unlike that of the telepathy between the Three Goddesses, who share Nirvana as a “common space of consciousness”. In Chapter 1 of Reverse Collapse, Jefuty demonstrated this faculty by telepathically communicating with Lige in the laboratory tank from the ridgeline outside the base - a trap laid by William to locate her. When the second GAVIRUL Reproduction Project was underway during the Honeymoon Period, the project’s colloquial name overshadowed its actual, coined by those who “understood what the project meant.” The Goddesses are the potential keys William seeks, yet even the Lunasia test subject may just be a part of Lunasia von Oberstein’s title, with the Goddesses’ purpose representing Lunasia O’s salvation from death - a vessel for her soul seized from Heaven.


At the end of all things, beyond the physical realm and sea of consciousness, nestled within an Akashic “Home”, will the fire of Lunasia’s soul, stolen by Meitner’s protege, bathe the world in the “Mother” Recordkeeper’s wrath?
